name: Best Western Plus Casino Royale - Center Strip

reviews.title: Still waiting for refund of the deposit!! It's a SHAME!!
reviews.text: The location is perfect, the rooms can use an update but they we're clean. Value is good. Service is rubbish. By checking out they told us we will get back our deposit within 3 days. After 25 day's allready and several mails they keep asking the same questions which we allready answered.

reviews.title: Great option for Sphere concerts
reviews.text: We were in town for a concert at the Sphere.  It was a short walk to the Venetian and you could access an indoor tunnel that took you directly to the Sphere.  There are also a lot of food options very close by, and it is centrally located to a lot in Vegas. The AC worked well.  It was a very affordable option with friendly and helpful staff.  It is a comfortable place to sleep when in town, as I figure most people who visit Vegas don’t hang out in the hotel for long periods!  Pleased with our stay.

reviews.title: Smaller property with great fun
reviews.text: This was a fun stay  we were there for the F1 races which caused total mayhem getting around town.. the property is a little tired, but the service in the front of the house truly make up for it,Thomas and Katrina make the magic happen they’re very helpful (extremely funny) the rooms are on the smaller side with relative comfortable bedsIt’s a smaller property with a lot of conveniences to other neighboring hotels, overall the stay was great… didn’t appreciate the added $15 fee for taxi service to and from the airport.. just another money grab for F1

reviews.title: Location is GREAT!
reviews.text: Stayed here at the center strip in November.  The location is phenomenal with a Walgreens, Denny's and Subway within minutes of the hotel.  Check in was easy & flawless!  Our room featured a mini fridge, some great Keurig coffee, and Pharmacopia Citrus products.  Bed was a little firm for my liking, and the bottom sheet never truly stayed tucked.  A/C worked well, but there was no way to control the fan to stay on constantly for background noise.  Earplugs helped remedy that concern.  Truly enjoyed our stay here and definitely loved the location!  Would definitely stay here again when in the area.

reviews.title: Wonderful teip
reviews.text: When I arrived in Vegas I was overwhelmed and overstimulated. The front desk was so kind and it was just what I needed. Everything about this stay was wonderful.

reviews.title: Stay here for value and location
reviews.text: What a wonderful surprise.  Came to see the show at the Sphere and based on what I researched this place was a 1/2 mile away so I could walk. Nice room, Keurig in the room, hangers that came off the bar, super cozy bed, no view but that was no problem, felt safe, and a small frig. I go on to visit my mom in Summerlin and the place I stay there has none of these things and is more expensive!  Highly recommend. Lori at the front desk was also super helpful.

reviews.title: Location Location Location
reviews.text: Location, location, location! We chose this hotel for its location and moderate price, and we were not disappointed! From check in to check out, we found the front desk attendants to be friendly and helpful at all times. Anything we requested or needed was handled in a very timely manner. Although somewhat a little dated, our room was clean and had the necessary amenities. Its location is perfect for accessing transportation, food and casinos.  Unlike the larger hotels where you have to walk 1/2 mile to get to your room there are only four stories so it's easy to get back to your room to change or if you forgot something. Would highly recommend. We were very happy and will return.

reviews.title: Location, location, location
reviews.text: First off I rate hotels/restaurants among their peers. It mens I can give 5 stars to a fast food joint and 3 stars to an expensive restaurant even though the foods taste the same. It is all in the expectation. Best Western Plus is a 3 stars hotel no doubt. But is a 4-1/2 starer among 3-star hotels and I round it up to a 5.I was staying in the area for three nights attending a Sphere event Friday night. I could not justify spending $800 at the Venetian for Friday so I stayed at BWP instead. Now the good, this hotel is at the perfect location and you can walk anywhere up to Wynn and down to Cosmopolitan. The hotel rooms area is literally 20 feet from the casino entrance out to Las Vegas Blvd. To immediate right is a Walgreen which you can buy pretty much anything, Venetian is just down the block. Walking distance to all the fast food joints like Five Guys, In-N-Out, and there is a White Castle in the casino if you never tried their steamed sliders. Wynn Buffet and Bacchanal Buffet are within walking distance. I can’t emphasize how nice it is to be able to walk right out onto the strip without having to walk across an entire casino floor.The hotel has ample parking in the back. The room is comfortable, has Nespresso machine and a mini fridge. and has super speedy wi-fi (didn’t even turn on the TV since I was able to stream everything to my laptop). Is it as every-detail-is-perfect as a Hilton? No. But again it is a mid-class hotel.The not-so-good. The ice machine on the floor did not work. This is the first hotel I stayed in where the ice machine did not work. At least the mini-fridge worked. When I checked out I was told  by the front desk the total bill had been emailed to me that morning so I declined to get a paper copy. I never received the bill. I really have no other complaint.Now the extra credit. I left something in the room upon check out, and got a text from the hotel that they found it in the room right after I landed back in NYC. Even though it took them almost a month to finally have it ent back to me, the fact that they proactively contacted me about the left behind item was first class service. That earns the extra half star that lets me round it up to 5.This hotel might not be what you want if you want to impress a date on a Vegas trip. But f you want convenience and practicality it deserves serious consideration.

reviews.title: Top location!
reviews.text: Aging hotel but top location in the middle of the Strip, free parking, bedroom and bathroom that needed renovation but were clean. No extra charge which is rare now in Vegas. Very warm Welcoming. Two downsides: no breakfast and work on a new hotel right next door (the hotel is not responsible for it but think of the balls quies). Very good Price quality ratio, I recommend!

reviews.title: Hidden gem on the strip.
reviews.text: Thomas was fantastic at the desk. So personable and gave us great info on eating establishments. Great attention and attitude.

reviews.title: Not so wonderful - but average accommodations for the cost
reviews.text: We were generally dissatisfied with the accommodations.  The bathroom sink had drain flies and a bad odor.  The hot water was very limited for a shower.  The second and third day we were here; water was tepid at best.  We were capable of making the beds and hanging up towels, but when we needed clean towels, Housekeeping responded quickly to our request.  The cost was reasonable, and the parking was free, so that was in the hotel's favor.  Still, we won't be coming back here.

reviews.title: Pitch perfect for a business trip.
reviews.text: This was a perfect hotel for someone on business that needs to stay on the strip.  Great customer service, above and beyond.  The room was just right for someone who needs a desk and good internet to be able to work during their stay.  Walk out the front door to the strip and super easy access to the Conference Center at the Venetian.  Very fast to get out of your room and down the elevator.  IN ROOM COFFEE!  At any other casino hotel in Vegas there is no in room coffee, you have to go downstairs and pay $7 for a single cup of coffee.  The front desk provided me with as many coffee pods that I asked for.  Very quiet, again unlike other casino hotels and I was able to make the room very dark for a great night's rest.

reviews.title: Regular hotel on the strip. Budget friendly, good location, and clean.
reviews.text: Nothing special about this place, BUT nothing bad about it either. They were accommodating with special requests, great location, and clean rooms. What more could you ask for in a budget friendly hotel right on the strip.  Stayed here 4 nights and were perfectly comfortable.

reviews.title: Small but good.
reviews.text: Dont expect much. Its a bit dated but so are all the hotels on Vegas strip. You will get free parking. Casino is downstairs. The location is on the strip. Parking is very easy - there is a small entry next to the huge Walgreens sign, take that - tons of parking available for hotel guests. You wont get a view but its affordable. I stayed in Luxor earlier this month, no view and $20 for parking and bad hotel staff at the entrance.

reviews.title: Highlight location
reviews.text: Unique location, spacious rooms, good cleaning Service, but expensive for what it offers, casino with unpleasant smell.

reviews.title: Road trip from Colorado springs, Utah Bryce Canyon and back.
reviews.text: Perfect location for proximity to everything.Nice with swimming pool.Good and large room. Coffee machine,refrigerator,good AC.Too bad there was no breakfast.Good free parking outside and inside .

reviews.title: Unbeatable location, no resort fees. would return as the price is fair and has everything you need
reviews.text: Excellent location and room exceeded my expectations. very friendly staff. Clean. good value for money.

reviews.title: Great Deal!
reviews.text: Excellent location on the Strip, close to everything, comfortable room, medium-sized refrigerator, coffee machine, large TV and  casino. For the price, it's great, and there's no resort fee.

reviews.title: A gem on the strip.
reviews.text: This place is a gem.  The person at the front desk was a bit terse.  But, the room was really reasonable.  It was updated and clean.  And the location could not be better!

reviews.title: Great location with quiet comfortable room on the strip near the Venetian.
reviews.text: The hotel was well located in walking distance to the Bellagio to see the fountains, close to the Venetian, not far from Paris Las Vegas for example. The hotel room was well equipped with fridge, coffee maker, comfortable beds, bathroom with bath and shower. It was quiet as our room was located at the back of the hotel.

reviews.title: Fantastic few nights in Vegas
reviews.text: Amazing location right in the centre of the strip.Spacious room. Great amenities.Very helpful staff.Nice quiet pool.

reviews.title: Highly recommended
reviews.text: Perfect location, everything you need very close, small hotel, always clean, friendly and polite staff, spacious room with everything you need. no resort fee, you pay what you see in your reservation with nothing extra.Not luxury hotel do not expect comforts from large hotels. I recommend it 100%

reviews.title: Best Western Casino Royal Center Strip
reviews.text: Descent if your just looking for a place to lay your head and don’t want to spend too much time in the room. The AC sucked had to buy a portable fan. The refrigerator in the room didn’t get very cold so lost some food from it. Luckily we spent a lot of time away from the room. Positives are the free parking and no resort fees. After walking through other hotels it may be worth paying the fees. Also the White Castle inside the casino was closed before 11pm every night because they sold out. Wish they would better stock really wanted to try it. Again if basic is what you want this is fine.

reviews.title: Great little Joint
reviews.text: Their casino is like a stick to the carpet and enjoy a foot long hot dog and cheap beer.  Their rooms are the opposite. Tidy, clean and have sensible stuff in them which the bigger hotels are eliminating to make you use their facilities. Namely a refrigerator and a coffee maker.  The microwave in the business centre was handy too.  The little pool is private and comfortable. Unlike the big house hotels that have a thousand people around them. Who thought that you could find a quiet pool or place in the strip. Nice to sit and have your coffee of a morning. The place is only four stories high. So you don’t need to spend half the day in the lift.  No resort fee.  The staff were nice. Felt like old Vegas. I am coming back before the developer rips the joint down. Ice machines there too.  Panda Express next door. Wallgreens close. I used Harrah’s to get an Uber from as a tip. Thanks Casino Royale. Enjoyed my three nights.

reviews.title: Great location in the heart of the Strip
reviews.text: Close to everything. Nice room. Large TV and very well appointed bathroom with essentials. The room as very clean and the blinds kept out enough light for day sleeping. The pool was very small but clean and inviting. This is a no frills spot but it is only 4 stories and the hall drops you right into the casino.

reviews.title: No hidden fee’s…
reviews.text: The Casino Royal is not a fancy resort on the Las Cegas strip. It is however, a clean room with free parking and no hidden fee’s. The hotel does offer a small sized pool, and economical food options on the first floor. You are also close to a nearby Walgreens. Our room came with a mini fridge which is a plus. The location on the strip is excellent as you are just steps away from the action when you stay here. I can highly suggest the Best Western Casino Royale on the strip based on the location alone.

reviews.title: No Control Over AC! !!
reviews.text: Very Disappointed – No Control Over AC!I was extremely disappointed to find that we couldn't control the thermostat in our hotel room—especially at night when we prefer to sleep in cooler temperatures (around 70°F or lower). The system seemed locked or limited, and the room stayed uncomfortably warm despite outside temperatures in Las Vegas being over 100°F. This made it very difficult to sleep. I wish I had known about this restriction before booking. Comfort is a basic expectation, especially in such extreme heat. I won’t be staying here again.

reviews.title: Location, location!
reviews.text: Well, this little hotel is a little bit dated and it is a Best Western so it’s not fancy. I gave it a five because we were pleasantly surprised by how great it suited our needs! Everyone who worked there was so thoughtful and friendly and helpful. Clean comfy bed and pillows. Good air conditioning. Fun “fast” food on site. Location, location is what this hotel has. It was a 2 min walk to get an Uber to anywhere but you could also easily walk to many mega-resorts, restaurants and the Sphere. This little hotel is just nestled in among them. What a great value!

reviews.title: The Best Value on The Strip!
reviews.text: A very clean and comfortable room in a central location.It took us just a couple of minutes to walk from our room to the street.Friendly and helpful staff in the lobby, who patiently answered all our questions and went out of their way to make us feel welcome.

reviews.title: Basic hotel with no resort or parking fees
reviews.text: I hope to help anyone who plans to stay here. I will start with the positive. No resort fees and free parking. The room was clean and met our needs. Beds were comfortable. A complimentary continental breakfast would have been a nice addition.  The parking/registering/entering hotel was very confusing and lacked any signs to help. When you enter the parking lot (which too is confusing) you will enter right after you pass Walgreens. Behind the casino building, you will find some street level parking but also the parking garage. After parking, the elevator will take you down to ground level and you will enter the casino through the rear for hotel registration. The signs inside the casino are good and lead you to the registration desk. After registering and retrieving your luggage, you will need the hotel key to access the actual hotel which is a separate building from the casino. The entrance is across from the rear entrance to the casino.  If I go to Las Vegas again, I would stay here again now that I know the above. Just know, the pool and fitness center are basic. The rooms are basic but, it met our needs.

reviews.text: I hope to help anyone who plans to stay here. I will start with the positive. No resort fees and free parking. The room was clean and met our needs. Beds were comfortable. When you enter the parking lot (which too is confusing) you will enter right after you pass Walgreens. Behind the casino building, you will find some street level parking but also the parking garage. The entrance is across from the rear entrance to the casino.  If I go to Las Vegas again, I would stay here again now that I know the above. Just know, the pool and fitness center are basic. The rooms are basic but, it met our needs.

reviews.title: Centralized on the strip.
reviews.text: It was nice having restaurants and lounges open 24/7 on property.  The location was very centralized on the Las Vegas strip and the bus stop is only less than a minute walk going either Northbound or southbound making access to all venues easily accessible.

reviews.title: Not great
reviews.text: Stayed for 2 nights and was just about bearable. Best Western has usually been ok in the past but against the opulence of some of the Vegas hotels, it was grim. We were focussed on cost and car parking and didn’t want to pay the extra charges most hotels levy for Wi-Fi etc but in hindsight I wish we had paid more for a nicer hotel. You get what you pay for. I wouldn’t return.

reviews.title: Great location. Everything else just average
reviews.text: The location is great. Right in the heart of the vegas strip.The rooms are a bit small but comfortable.The hotel is a bit dated and needs upgrading. For eg the key card system doesn’t work sometimes and we had to go back to the reception a few times to sort it out. On our first night at-the hotel there was some problem with plumbing and they turned off the water for 3-4 hrs. The staff was helpful.

reviews.title: Convenient on the Strip reasonably priced clean rooms
reviews.text: This Best Western is right on the strip in between the Venetian and Harrahs.It’s clean and comfortable. Not luxury by any means but the price isn’t a luxury price tag either and there isn’t a resort fee. There are refrigerators in the room but no microwaves. You can go to the first floor to use a microwave. It’s a little inconvenient but again the price is great. There are king rooms and rooms with two double beds and nothing in between. The parking is free too. I would stay here again (3rd visit this time) but I read that most likely this place will be torn down and something bigger built on the property. I tried booking different dates into February but it says no rooms available on any date and January was bookable until January 31 so I would say it’s going bye bye.

reviews.title: great choice for a few days in Las Vegas
reviews.text: Great choice for a few days in Las Vegas. You're in the middle of the Strip. Book a parking space. You drive just past the hotel on the right into a small street. Then you enter a courtyard with parking garage to park your car. Through the back entrance you enter the casino, where the hotel reception is also located.

reviews.title: Very good establishment for our stay
reviews.text: This hotel matches with all our needs for our stay in Vegas. Location on the strip,  quality of the room equipment, staff very friendly and helpful. A microwave would be "nice to have" but can live without for a few days.  Very easy access to the parking.

reviews.title: Inexpensive Hotel on the Strip
reviews.text: The hotel was nice.  Yes it is showing it's age and is going to be taken down within the next year.  The bed and pillows were comfortable there was marijuana smoke wafting down the hall and we seen one cockroach in the hall but no bugs in our 1st floor room. The Pizza Hut pizza was very inexpensive and tasty.  For the price of the room and it being in the center of the strip I would stay here again.

reviews.title: Dingy
reviews.text: Our ground floor room was clean and quite and the air con was beautiful icy, and it’s right on The Strip but for Aussie travellers it’s like staying at an aged RSL, halls smelled of different types of smoke, decor is dingy but the room was clean, walking through the slot machines with an 8 years in wouldn’t do again

reviews.title: Perfect location for walking the Las Vegas strip.
reviews.text: The location is excellent for walking the Strip and going to shows and people watching. Our room was comfortable and very quiet. The hotel has free parking. We enjoyed coffee in the room unlike some hotels on the strip. The front desk staff were very friendly and helpful! We'd stay again!

reviews.title: Great cost benefit. Free parking makes a big difference.
reviews.text: Excellent cost benefitSuper well located! Right in the straw of the Strip with Mc Donald and Subway 24h, has Outback and other tbm options, plus a great 24 hour market well glued on it. The staff was super attentive to me and friendly. An old hotel but very comfortable, huge bed, very clean despite being carpet what is common in the region, simple but good and clean pool. You can't find any hotels that value in this point of Las Vegas, free parking is also a difference. It was worth it. I loved it!

reviews.title: Best Western/Casino Royale on the Strip
reviews.text: Great place right on the Strip.  Perfect location! Walking distance to just about everything.  Denny's and Walgreens are just steps away.  Check-in was easy, parking is easy, check out was easy.  I would stay here again!  Say hi to Mr. Mack the friendly security guard!

reviews.title: Great cost benefit and excellent location
reviews.text: The hotel is old but comfortable. The room is huge and they provide coffee machine and capsules. The location is very good, in the middle of the strip. There's a Walgreen next to the hotel. There is also pharmacy and restaurants nearby (including inside the hotel). One of the points that drew our attention was having free parking and they didn't charge the Resort fee, which is super common in Vegas. The only point of improvement is the bathroom, which is bathtub and not box, so they use curtain. But we liked quite and we found the cost and benefit excellent!

reviews.title: 50th Birthday In Las Vegas
reviews.text: Small central casino. Clean, quiet rooms, good A/C. Cheap eats and drinks. Outback steakhouse on property, Dennys next door. We have stayed here many weeks since 2017. We would like to thank all staff for everything,  as it looks like being imploded in the new year. Such a shame.

reviews.title: Excellent Location &  Very  Quiet
reviews.text: The  Best Western Royale Casino Las Vegas is a great place to stay. The staff are very friendly. The rooms are very clean & it is so quiet in your room. We stayed on the 4th floor for 5 days. We had an ice machine on our floor & fridge in our room for your own food & drinks.It is in an excellent location. Denny’s next door for breakfast is good & well priced. The hotel gave us a 20% of voucher x  2.There is a convenience store at the entrance of Denny’s. It took about 15 to 20 minutes to walk to Plant Hollywood we’re there aresome good places to eat & drink for cheap. Flights & Ocean One. Just google them.Coming from the airport by taxi cost $29 + tip. Returning by Uber was only $20 at 8am.Enjoy your trip to  Vegas!

reviews.title: You have to adapt!
reviews.text: Surely it remains a good solution in Las Vegas for those looking for a cheap hotel with free parking and easy to find (just pass the hotel structure and there is a sign with parking, follow the road and see the places reserved for hotel customers. Parked the car is accessed by a back entrance and through the immense hall with slots there is the reception). With the card you enter the rooms that clearly look like rooms of a Two Star Motel. In the end you are there but do not expect much, even cleaning is not the best. The location remains fantastic, between the Venetian and the caesar Palace on the other side of the strip. It is a structure that requires a strong spirit of adaptation 😅

reviews.title: Very happy with stay
reviews.text: Arrived early so expected to drop off our luggage and kill time on the strip but was pleasantly surprised to be given our room key right awayHave stayed on the strip many times, usually at one of the big resort hotels, whilst the front casino is small and not very modern the rooms are extremely adequate,  very clean with all the bathroom and coffee/tea supplies needed. Very friendly and helpful staff and NO resort fee, what more could you ask!!!

reviews.title: No resort fee!
reviews.text: Clean spacious room with great A/C.  Best value on the strip.  Uber in and Lyft out for < $20 each way from airport.  Walking distance to the Sphere.  Not the greatest of casinos but Venetian and Harrah’s very close by.  No resort fee as well.  Nice pool and quiet.

reviews.title: Great location
reviews.text: The room was lovely, had everything we needed. We used ear plugs so can’t comment on any noise. The location was great, right in the thick of everything. The pool was lovely for a dip after a long day. The staff were helpful. Only thing that spoilt it was the mass of gambling machines but I guess that’s what LV is all about

reviews.title: Second stay as good as the first
reviews.text: My husband and I had stayed at this hotel in 2016 and saw no reason to look anywhere else on our return to Vegas with our niece and nephew.We were able to afford two rooms for the only time on our road trip and were delighted when we checked in and discovered that our rooms were beside each other on the top floor.Accommodation was as we remembered, clean, comfortable and quiet, despite our rooms having a partial view of the strip.  The temperature in Las Vegas was ridiculous when we arrived - 123f / 50c - but the air conditioning kept us cool.  We also used the pool quite a bit and found that there was always room to sit in the shade.  Pool towels plentiful.I’m sorry to hear that this hotel is due to be demolished next year, as we feel more comfortable in a smaller hotel than in a massive resort, but at least we got to stay here one last time.

reviews.title: You won't find a better value for your money anywhere on the Las Vegas Strip
reviews.text: We've stayed here several times now and sure, it's dated and it could use a refresh, but the rooms are clean and you will not find any place with a better hotel providing a better value on the Las Vegas Strip, period.The room rates are reasonable and there are NO RESORT FEES!  The rate you see is the rate you get (plus the 12% state and city taxes)The rooms are a 2-minute walk to the casino and the Strip.The parking is close to the rooms and the casino as well -- no mile walk just to get to and from your car.  And parking is free!The pool is small, but refreshing, and usually pretty empty with a lot of shady areas.The on-premises casino is a throwback to the Las Vegas of old.There are several fast-food outlets on site. And did I say that there are NO RESORT FEES?!?!If you want the stay in the lap of luxury you can always overpay for one of the big resorts, but if you would like someplace convenient and clean to rest your head at the end of the day, then try the Best Western Casino Royale.

reviews.title: A great little hotel near everything
reviews.text: Great little hotel right in the middle of everything.  We were a bit apprehensive based on a few reviews.  Found this hotel to be very clean , quiet and surprisingly many families.  Staff was great.  A bit awkward to check in.  Park in back leave stuff in car.  Go through casino to check in and they will show you the back door to enter. We would definitely recommend and would stay here again

reviews.title: Great place in middle of everything!
reviews.text: This hotel is in the center strip of Vegas, it’s very convenient for shopping, restaurants, casinos, uber etc. The staff at the premise Mr.Thomas and team were very welcoming and made sure customers are taken well care of. They also have free parking and no resort fee as added bonus.

reviews.title: Vegas trip
reviews.text: The hotel staff was excellent.  The room was clean and amazingly quiet being located in the middle of the casino. The bed was a bit hard for us but the pillows were great.

reviews.title: Quiet small hotel on the strip in the middle of it.
reviews.text: This hotel is neat because it is small and on the strip. If your looking for a quiet place to stay on the strip this is it.

reviews.title: Excellent place
reviews.text: This business uses tools provided by Tripadvisor (or one of its official Review Collection Partners) to encourage and collect guest reviews, including this one.

reviews.title: Overall, simple and good experience within my budget!
reviews.text: Plain and probably your cheapest option on the strip with free parking. Front desk lady was nice and attentive.Bed was comfortable and linen was clean.A/c was SO LOUD that I had to turn off! Luckily the room kept 72 F even with air conditioning off.There was hair from other guests in the shower 🤢Overall, simple and good experience within my budget!

reviews.title: Good choice for Vegas Strip
reviews.text: Great location, nice rooms, clean pool, helpful friendly staff. We had 6 family members including 2 children in 2 rooms. Very good experience!

reviews.title: Good hotel for the price
reviews.text: We were looking for a hotel close to The Sphere. We literally walked out of the hotel almost directly onto the moving sidewalk into the Venetian which took us directly to the bridge to the Sphere. Great since the temps were in the 100’s. Hotel was a little dated but was clean and all the staff were very friendly and nice. There were several food options also. Again nothing fancy but did the job. Casino was all slots, no table games but that wasn’t the purpose of our trip. Plus no resort fees. Would stay again.

reviews.title: Nice old time casino &bar
reviews.text: Excellent bar , great bartenders pity it’s closing next year 2025 , all in all a great few afternoons spent there. Reviews we had read were not true to actual place , security seemed good , never saw any trouble .The food outlets within the hotel leave a lot to be desired though.

reviews.title: Great Place to Stay in Las Vegas
reviews.text: Stayed here June 11 - 14, 2024 at it was GREAT! Service was friendly,  room was clean n a/c was cold!! Room was close to casino floor and hallway was secured by key card. NO RESORT FEES.  Fast food was available in the casino and very nearby. They also have an Outback.  It's also next to a Denny's n Walgreens for breakfast and to buy water & snacks. They have my favorite slot machine (Wheel of Fortune). I could afford to stay at the New York New York or any other big Casino and pay $5 for a bottle of water & exorbitant prices for everything but honestly I really enjoyed the Best Western Plus Casino Royale and will be my go to Casino Hotel when I travel to Las VegasRicardo

reviews.title: Outdated, but good.
reviews.text: We stayed here for 3 nights. The hotel is outdated, but otherwise fine. Don't expect too much of it, but price quality is fine especially considering that you are close to everything. Staff you speak little to not, so yes whether they are friendly I can not really say. Breakfast is not offered.

reviews.title: A Terrible Time Was Had
reviews.text: The entire casino smelled of sewage the entire Trip.... The bathroom sink in our room also smelled of sewage every time we turned the water on. The bathtub drained VERY SLOWLY,  causing the water to quickly pool around your ankles.... GROSS!! The pillows were so small that they had to double fold over the pillow cases so they fit. Both the mattress and pillows were extremely hard and uncomfortable. Very thin bedspread. Dressers were dusty.  Room decor looked nothing like the photos on website. Ice machines broken on 3rd and 4th floors. Refrigerator wasn't cold even on highest setting. Inside of coffee machine with black specs of dirt when I ran the cycle with clear water THREE TIMES . Snack machine broken. This entire stay was terrible and not worth my hard earned money and vacation time. 😡🤬😡🤬😡

reviews.title: Hotel not well maintained
reviews.text: The only advantage of this hotel is the location, other than that, it’s a rough place to stay. Very poorly maintained. The other guest were a rough group. I saw multiple altercations just when walking in the lobby and casino area. Would not ever stay here again. I actually had to check out early

reviews.title: Location, location, location!
reviews.text: Location was perfect for our needs. It’s not a fancy hotel, but totally fine for our needs. Rooms and hallways were clean. Pool was very quiet and clean. Bed was comfortable. No complaints honestly, great value hotel. Was nice to have Denny’s and White Castle close by for food, and Walgreens was just steps away to pick up drinks, fun Vegas gifts and whatever else we needed. Bummed to hear this location is closing and hoping it will remain a Best Western in the future as they are a hotel brand we trust and use often.

reviews.title: Bestwsetern
reviews.text: Being as we say at Best Western anywhere we can when we travel. This one Was just fine , Ac worked great , Shower had plenty of pressure and good hot water supply. Room was clean , Nothing to complain about .

reviews.title: Best Western Royal casino. Would not recommend!
reviews.text: The rooms were extremely small and had a bad odor to them. The ventilation system was very loud while trying to sleep and when swimming in the pool my son would go underwater in his goggles and he would see all types of dead bugs. The worst worst for me was no complimentary breakfast. Every best western I have ever stayed at has complimentary breakfast.Being a rewards member I had higher expectations and I was very disappointed. The rooms smelled like cigarette smok even though they were non-smoking rooms. The internet would not work for us and I slept terrible. I hate to be a Debbie Downer but it was not a pleasurable experience at all. The only good thing about this place was the location on the strip and that was it.

reviews.title: Cost Effective
reviews.text: It’s one of the few hotels without a resort fee, it’s visibly an older building but if you’re looking for a cost effective stay to just rest your head and keep your stuff - it works. We had a few hiccups, mainly our AC not working properly which was not ideal in the heat (turned out it was a system wide issue). We woke up most morning hot and uncomfortable, we had a fan that helped. The cleaning staff were friendly and helpful, front desk was 50/50 on friendliness. Our check in and out staff were great, but mid stay when I went to go mention our coffee maker being broken, the staff members seemed dismissive and not pleasant. I will say you get what you pay for here, it’s not a luxurious stay but it is a great location and you save money for actually doing things in Vegas!

reviews.title: Good hotel
reviews.text: Very well located hotel, no parking or resort fees.Theme hotels are very close to the Best Western.The rooms were big and clean.The entire hotel staff was very helpful and kind.Good price for the location! I would stay again!

reviews.title: Best affordable hotel on the strip hidden gem for sure
reviews.text: If your looking for an affordable option casino Royale Best Western plus is the answer. No resort fees, clean rooms, free parking, and all day happy hour you can't beat it. A hidden gem for sure. It's not fancy but clean great accommodating staff and amazing service.

reviews.title: Great place to stay!
reviews.text: This was my first trip to Vegas, and after reading questionable reviews of the mega resorts, I decided to roll the dice on the Best Western. I am so glad I did.We really enjoyed our stay here. The location is perfect — directly across from the Mirage and south of the Venetian. There’s a Walgreens and multiple chain restaurants on site. (Try the $6 Bloody Mary at Denny’s.) The casino is small, but the slots treated me nicely. Free drink service as well.Our room was spacious and comfortable with a mini fridge and K-cup coffee maker. All of the staff was very friendly and helpful. A big shout-out to Greg on the casino floor for making our trip exceptional!Sadly, I heard the hotel’s days are numbered as they’re planning to build another resort tower, but I hope to be back again very soon for one last hurrah.

reviews.title: Top hotel in the middle of the strip
reviews.text: Top hotel in the middle of the strip! You can also park here for free. There is a casino and several food stalls in this hotel, such as the Pizza Hut. There is also an outdoor pool where we enjoyed swimming. It's not big but great for cooling off. The room was clean and we were not bothered by any outside noise. Highly recommended this hotel! You also have no unexpected costs here because you do not have to pay a resort fee.

reviews.title: Enjoyable stay
reviews.text: Hotel is located on the strip in the middle close to everything. Parking lot in rear of hotel both outside and in multi story plenty of parking without hassle of a valet. Quick friendly check in. You enter hotel through the attached casino on the ground floor and then go up in a private lift to the floors where rooms are. Large room with everything I needed fridge, bathroom, TV, WIFI, sofa and little kitchenette. For me this was a very nice hotel and above average room but I don't expect to much.

reviews.title: Hidden Gem on the Strip
reviews.text: This was a pleasant surprise, nothing fancy, and no resort fees. This hidden gem is centrally located on the Vegas strip, right across from the Mirage, and in front of the Bellagio. Arriving from the airport, you enter a weird back alley entrance. Upon entering, after you find the front desk, the service is one on one. There is only one person and the desk, and checks in each party individually. Katrina was the person that checked my party in, and was absolutely the best. Her energy and personality made the check- in pleasant and fun. Also who made the experience great, was the staff in the small casino. KUDOS to Mark, Daryl, Donovan, John, and Mike. Also thank housekeeping, and security staff. Rates are reasonable, the pool is never crowed, considering this was a weekend stay. The rooms are very nice and clean. Don't expect a view, depending on your room, but who goes to Vegas to sit in their room. Amenities in room, coffee maker, iron with board, and a blow dryer. I will definitely stay here again!!!! THANKS CASINO ROYALE!!!!!!!

reviews.title: A whole in the wall
reviews.text: The rooms were clean, the services were not existent. Staff was rude when asked for help and you could hear everything on the other rooms

reviews.title: A dated but good hotel
reviews.text: Hotel is in a good location on the strip with big clean rooms. Had a couple of small issues on my first night but they were immediately addressed by the hotel employees.I like this hotel because from the strip, it is just a couple of steps and you are in the guests rooms area! Hotel is very dated. I have been here like 10 years ago and nothing has really changed. Nothing wrong with it but not every one might like it.Check in is in person which I prefer than automated.I would stay here again.

reviews.title: Gem on the Strip
reviews.text: The only reason I marked a star off was because of the broken ice machine on our floor. We received superb service from check in to check out. The room was clean with a fridge. It was nice to receive $20 credit for $20 to play the slots machines. We didn't swim but the pool area was nice to set with your morning coffee. Always a good sleep with the firm mattress. If you are looking for a decent cheap motel on the strip, this is the place to stay.

reviews.title: Alright
reviews.text: In the heart of the strip, you do everything on foot. The rooms are spacious and well equipped. The bedding is of good quality. Parking is free for guests which is perfect given the location of the hotel. The casino offers reasonably priced hot dogs, but the pizzas are overpriced.

reviews.title: Pros over cons - 3.5 rating
reviews.text: Pros: 1) Location - it is in the middle of the strip with easy access to Harrahs, the Venetian, the Mirage, and Caesar’s for any shows or entertainment.2)Cost- no hidden resort fee and very affordable. 3) Cleanliness - was clean with no bad smells (old carpet may not be clean ).  4) Free parking Cons: 1) If you need sandpaper while in Vegas you are in luck, these towels will do the job. 2) If you like sleeping on plywood, this mattress is for you.Overall the pros out weigh the cons and I would stay again.

reviews.title: Never Again!
reviews.text: Never AGAIN!! I can’t believe this place received a 4 star rating. The only positive thing I can say was the lady checking us in  ( before we checked out) was very nice. You must walk through a smoke filled sour smelling tinged with alcohol to reach the desk of the  sounds of casino is your music…. So be it. At 4:00 pm it was loud , stinky and obnoxious so imagine this at night?! In order to go to your room a trip right through the middle of the crowded casino is necessary- and hope you are fine dragging your bags of the rather disgusting stairway. If this is offensive - - I would say - definitely YES! It was offensive. It was a picture of any imaginative negative of Las Vegas you could think about. KNOW there are excellent choices here of nice hotels- FIND ONE!

reviews.title: We recommend!
reviews.text: Great value for money! Located in the "heart" of the Strip, close to everything Las Vegas has to offer. Casino hotel with no extra fees. The rooms are spacious, clean and affordable. They include a small kitchen with a minibar and a coffee maker with unlimited capsules. We recommend!

reviews.title: Hidden gem.
reviews.text: This is a seemingly unknown hotel hidden behind the Casino Royale. It’s a Best Western Plus, and it was generally to that standard, comparable to a BW Plus anywhere. Perfect location between Harrahs and The Venetian. Free parking, free WiFi, no resort fees. It’s obviously older, with almost a retro feel, but it  is well maintained, and was very clean.  Did online pre check in, so that was easy when we arrived. The room was very quiet, with none of the noise from the strip, or internal noise from adjacent rooms.  Bed was comfortable, coffee maker and fridge in the room. We had a few hours between checkout and our flight and the free parking was for the entire day, so we were able to leave our vehicle there while we spent the last bit of time on the strip. The only regret is the news that the hotel and the Casino Royale have been sold and will be demolished and replaced with some monstrous tower and whatever goes with it. Kinda sad.

reviews.title: Never again
reviews.text: This is essentially a motel with interior access. Located within a less popular casino which was fine. The room was adequate in size as there were only two of us. The bathroom was old and cramped, barely any room for an adult to move around in. The shower was not made for tall people and the shower head was not adjustable in anyway. There was a mini fridge and coffee pot which was nice. Housekeeping is clearly not a priority as a giant cobweb hung in the corner of the room. I refused to walk around barefoot as who knows what was living in the carpet. The bed was fine, comfortable enough. No view of the strip at all, just the back of buildings. It smelled like a motel and was not inviting at all. I travelled with my best friend and unfortunately I let her husband make the reservation. He loves to save money and views hotel as “just a place to sleep” as he primarily travels for business. I will not stay there again as I have no problem splurging for a nice hotel room for a few nights in Las Vegas. The location was convenient but that’s really the only thing on the pros side.

reviews.title: A good hotel with excellent access to the strip.
reviews.text: This is a very good, reasonably priced(for vegas) hotel. If you want quick access to the strip, this is the hotel. We found it to be very quiet and generally well run. We asked for maid service every third day, but the cleaning was complete and generally well done. There were a few small concerns. The ice machine on our floor didn't work and taxis would not pick up on the property. We had to wind our way through Harrah's casino tothe back area to catch a cab.

reviews.title: Small Hotel in a Great Location
reviews.text: The hotel is on the strip, so it is in a great location. There are some small fast-food restaurants located in the lobby/casino. Also, other food selections are nearby. Even though hotel is on the strip, I did not hear the noise from the street or in the casino located in the lobby. The cleaning needs some improvement.

reviews.title: You're paying for the location - that's it.
reviews.text: I've given well over 200 reviews and this is one of the only low ratings I've given.  Here we go:PROS: Location.  It's right in the middle of everything and you can walk to anywhere on the strip from here.CONS: Location.  First trying to find the garage and attempting to enter or leaving among hellacious strip traffic is a tall task.  You'll want to tuck it away and not use it again until you leave.  Wouldn't recommend if you're intent is to use your car daily.Staff.  Nobody was at check-in, it was a slow process and perhaps I caught them on a bad day (or maybe I was having a bad day) but I found them rude.  I'm usually not one to care about these things, but that was my impression.Elevators.  Don't get anything on the 2nd floor.  1st or 3rd, yes, but one of the elevators was shut down and the other elevator - get this...DIDN'T OPEN ON THE SECOND FLOOR.  If you selected 2, it would go up, not open, then go back down for the next person on the first floor.  If you selected 2 and 3, it would do the same for floor 2, not open then go up to floor 3.  Not a great situation if you're not mobile and you have luggage.  Room temperature.  It's February and my room temperature upon checkin was 76.  So I put the AC on full-blast and went on the strip.  Came back 5 hours later and it was 76.  24 hours later, it was down to 70.  I can't imagine what this place must feel like in the summer.If your plan is to not sleep and barely be in your room, this is perfect.  If you need just a bit of relaxation, I'd never stay here.

reviews.title: LOVE! PREFECT LOCATION!
reviews.text: Stayed here for the second time for my Birthday trip and it was the same experience I had the first time but I figured I would post a review so my readers know my opinion hasn't changed! I LOVE this hotel! Its in the PERFECT location. Its center strip, next to Venetian and it has a pool, casino, clean rooms, a restaurant attached, you cant go wrong! Best Westerns are always a fave and so clean! 10/10

reviews.title: Inexpensive but not in a good way.
reviews.text: The only thing good about this place is the location, do not expect anything nice. It's def. run down and showing its age. I would say it's even below a typical Best Western standard. It does the job if you need a place to rest your head, but it is old dingy and dirty. There was a huge cobweb in the corner of our room, the carpets were terrifying we didn't dare walk in bare feet, my pillow fell on the floor, and I left it there. You cannot control heat or AC setting in your room, and it was very stuffy and uncomfortable for sleeping.  Also, if you are tall you will have to squat in the shower to wash your hair. It is in a convenient location on the strip, and you are close to so much, but if I ever go back, I wouldn't ever choose to stay here.

reviews.title: One of the best located hotels on the Strip
reviews.text: Have come to Vegas a few times, but the first time at the Best Western.  Location was amazing, walking distance from the two main shows we were visiting (Coliseum and The Sphere), good parking behind the property as well.However, place, although clean, is a bit worn and outdated.  If you can do without this then I do highly recommend. We stayed here because it was the only hotel for under $800 for Super Bowl weekend (paid $360 for a night's stay)

reviews.title: Hidden Gem on the strip
reviews.text: This was a hidden gem! Great location, clean rooms, very safe (literally guards everywhere). Front desk staff was amazing. (Thanks Tom & Lori ). Great food options on property. I could not believe the value for the price!! I would absolutely stay here again.

reviews.title: Excellent welcome, excellent value for money, thank you Thomas
reviews.text: We had an excellent stay in this hotel 👌👌 superb staff very very friendly professional the location is perfect in the middle of the strip 🤩🤩 a big thank you to Thomas who left the room for us until our takeoff at midnight really great for being rest and take a shower before leaving for Paris 🙏🙏🙏 it's great 😀😀 we'll come back that's obvious 🙏🙏 Nora Eddy and Enzo 🤩🤩🙏🙏🙏🙏

reviews.title: Super reasonable for a strip hotel
reviews.text: Although it's a dated property, BW Casino Royale rooms were clean, very comfortable bed, coffee maker and the location is walkable to the Sphere. You can't beat the price. We would definitely stay here again, It's a good value for those that are just there for a couple of nights.

reviews.title: Perfect Spot
reviews.text: This hotel is located in the perfect spot on the strip, and at the time I stayed there were no resort fees. The hotel was very clean and all the people that I encountered that worked. There were very helpful and very friendly  The Price Is good and I will have no problems staying here again

reviews.title: Best Bar Staff on the Strip
reviews.text: Service is amazing. Each bartender has their own unique qualities and skills that make the experience amazing! Mike! Mark! John! Donavon! Darrel! George! Thanks for a great experience. Go to the Bar at Casino Royale for a true "Vegas" feel!

reviews.title: Poor service
reviews.text: I have stayed here in the past with no issues. They do not have enough staff slow check in and could not get an answer from the desk. Garbage transfer out side my window constantly noisy all night .The place including my room had a strong smell of Marijuana. Not worth the price.

reviews.title: Great location to Sphere
reviews.text: I chose this hotel due to its proximity to Sphere..able to walk to the U2 concert. Bed comfortable and room clean. Entry to parking lot is just past the hotel next to the Walgreen's..difficult to enter at times due to nonstop pedestrian traffic. Only negative was noisy during the night.

reviews.title: Terrible customer service, Room has no cooling.
reviews.text: no AC Hotel was dirty. Poor customer service. Front desk staff were rude and unaccommodating. Bathroom still had hairs on the floor. Will definitely not go here again. Machines were greedy, no comfortable lounge

reviews.title: GREAT PLACE TO STAY
reviews.text: This hotel is a hidden gem on the Strip.Everything the hotel advertises is true.The rooms are very clean, beds are comfortable.Everything worked perfectlyWith some pluses  if you pay attention to the hotel's explanations you will enjoy a wonderful stay.The hotel has a microwave  next to the business center, clean and working.If you have a car, covered parking is very safe.And all this in the middle of the Strip and without a Resort Fee.The only thing that is a personal choice, the hotel controls the temperature of the air conditioning, you do not have the option to control it in the room.And keep in mind that you are in Las Vegas so you will hear quite a bit of noise.Great place to saty.

reviews.title: Weekend stay
reviews.text: Excellent location mid strip close to restaurants other casinos comfortable beds a fridge but no microwave a little street noise on the 2nd floor great free parking large spaces friendly helpful staff no wait at check-in

reviews.title: Don’t bother!!
reviews.text: Smells horrible  and no payouts. Don’t fall for their promotional scam of $200 promotional credits… You have a select aisle of two old slot games and you have to get 4000 credits in order to get your hundred dollars.. so pretty much you’re sitting there for 10 minutes pressing max bet until you blow all your promotional money.

reviews.title: Value
reviews.text: Stayed 4 nights for leisure.Yes the place is older and not the glamour of the big hotels but it is clean, right on the strip, and rooms have quick and easy access to the centre of the strip, restauraunts and bar.We dont spend barely any time in the room anyway but when we did it had a fridge, keurig coffee maker and was clean and cleaned daily. Reasonable rates and no resort fee.

reviews.title: Las Vegas Strip Best Location
reviews.text: The Best Western Casino Royale is always worth considering, and not just because of its location. It's not just the price that's convincing, the rooms are also perfectly fine. Of course there are luxury hotels and the rooms are definitely better and the view is great, but they're also easily $200 more expensive. Since you're only in the hotel to sleep anyway, a clean room with decent beds is enough for us, and that's what we get here.

reviews.title: Great locatiok
reviews.text: If you want to be right on the strip, walking distance to many properties & the monorail. Multiple fast food options in the casino. Free parking if you can find the garage. The two bed rooms are double beds.

reviews.title: Nice hotel - as long as you don't need heat in your room
reviews.text: If you're comfortable at 60* this hotel is for you!  This was the most miserable hotel experience we have had in many years, due to the lack of heat.  This hotel has a central heating system that cannot be effectively controlled from inside the guest room.  In December, with high temps in the low 60's and overnight lows in the low 40's there was NO HEAT available at all in our room until the outside temperature dropped to 50 degrees.  We stayed 3 nights and our room got progressively colder each night.  Being in our room outside of bed buried under blankets was chilly to the point of discomfort. By the time the heat came on (which meant lukewarm air blowing feebly out of the vent) it was late evening.  The front desk told us this is "their system" and could not be altered.  To us, having adequate heat is not an amenity but an expectation in civilized overnight accommodations.  This lack of heat SHOULD BE CLEARLY DISCLOSED on the room information when booking.  We booked a room we could not enjoy, could not even sleep comfortably in, because we weren't informed.  Had we known about the lack of heat, we would not have booked a room here.

reviews.title: Centralt beläget
reviews.text: Responsive noise from the corridor penetrates the room, a lot of running in the corridor which made it difficult to get undisturbed sleep. Parking is limited and you can't book one in advance. The lobby is located inside the casino long way between the slot machines from the parking lot

reviews.title: Race weekend travel
reviews.text: Luck to get a quality room for 3 nights on the VEGAS strip.  Clean, safe, and many restaurant choices.   Book in advance is the key on big event weekends.  Not to mention the CASINO, and location, location.

reviews.title: EXCELLENT LOCATION
reviews.text: As they say in business, location, location and location.  This little place is wedged between Harrah's and the Venetian. So we were able to save money on a room and we spent most of our time (and money) at the Venetian.  Plus there's a well-run 24-hour Walgreen's between the 2 places. I did not like that the hotel's pool and small workout room were located, yes, behind a secure gate but, at night, I still wasn't willing to go there on my own.  Otherwise, it was clean and our 3-floor room was quiet as long as the window was closed.  On the whole, I would recommend this place as a budget alternative.

reviews.title: Great place
reviews.text: Great place on the strip I was in room 217 king bed . Had a fridge coffee maker . Room was very roomy .  Bathroom decent size . And very clean . Uber and Lyft dropped off ourt back but only Lyft picked up . Next door to hurrahs . Great location on strip no resort fees . Everyone was friendly  and helpful . Denny’s next door . Easy walk down to hard rock and back was here from 2 nd to 8th Nov  .  I would totally recommend anyone to stay here .

reviews.title: Five Stars for Superb Value and Location
reviews.text: This is a best kept secret on The Strip. Located near The Mirage and The Venetian, it's a great location from which to base. My room was modern, clean and comfortable. No frills.  The casino is slots/electronic games only. Join the Best Western program free and search for rates well in advance.

reviews.title: Comfortable but don't stay on the Strip during F1 in mid Nov
reviews.text: We were there for our birthday celebration. We picked the Casino Royale since it was located in a great location and they don't charge for parking and resort fees. However, we didn't know that the Formula 1 races closed down the entire strip at night. It's ok if you didn't have a rental car. The bed was comfortable and quiet. The fan was really loud though. Overall we may stay there but not during F1.

reviews.title: great experience
reviews.text: great hotel, great location great staff. tina at the front desk is so good at this job she should be making 6 figures touring the cou try traing new employees. I loved the location and you cant beat the rate. 10/10 will be back again.

reviews.title: Excellent.  Perfect location
reviews.text: Hotel is in perfect location on the strip.  Rooms are detached but easy access to casino, fitness center, pool and (free) parking structure. Room was clean and quiet, bed very comfortable, nice to have in room Keurig machine and refrigerator. Casino had a lot of good machines.  Outback Steakhouse and other dining onsite was nice.  Just steps away outside was alot of fun, dining, bars, shopping and music. Highly recommend this hotel..it's definitely different from the big resorts on the strip but in a good way. If you want easy walking access and comfort this is the place.

reviews.title: Sold my parking space
reviews.text: No good amenities, sold All convenient parking to outsiders for street event! No luggage cart availability. We've stayed at Many Best Western Plus Hotels and Never expected/experienced this negative .

reviews.title: Great hotel
reviews.text: Just back from our 1st vacation in Las Vegas and had a great time at Casino Royale. Room was clean and tidy and bed very comfortable. Coffee machine in the room was handy (no cost) as was the fridge. We booked this hotel because of there being no resort fees and it’s great location on the strip. Staff very friendly from reception, cleaners to the casino staff.We would have booked to come back next year but having looked at the prices they have risen massively from what we paid this year so we are looking at nearby hotels instead which are working out cheaper, even with the resort fees they would be charging. It’s a shame as we are coming back to get married in Vegas and would have liked to stay at Casino Royale again but not when there are cheaper alternatives.That said, would check prices for other future visits as we would be more than happy to stay here if we could get a room at a decent price.

reviews.title: Very enjoyable stay
reviews.text: I spent 2 weeks in this hotel, it was just what I wanted!, the room was big enough for 2, it was spotlessly clean, clean fresh towels delivered every day, room was vaccumned and bed linen was changed twice a week, air con worked really well and it was not noisy, water was hot and a good steady flow, room was super super quiet never heard a sound except for one night police/ambulance/fire were going off big time,staff were exceptional and went out of their way to help and advise, even replacing the coffee maker as the one in room was not heating up water, Coffee cups and water cups were replaced with new ones as needed and same with coffee tea etc, it was literally 5 mins from my room on 4th floor to strip and that was including waiting for elevator.The Outback Steakhouse was to die for food and service were superb, so much so, I went back a second time,The location of this hotel is unbeatable with everything you need within walking distance, Dennys. Walgreens, Maccas Panda King and Mexican next door, Pizza Hut Footlong Hotdogs and Subway on premises, I will definately stay here again and would give it 10/10. I loved my stay here and comparing it to my previous stay at Caesars Resorts I would highly recommend, especially if you do not want to pay over-inflated prices for a resort pool and expensive cocktails.My only beef was I did not get a cocktail made by the world famous Mark from the bar, NEXT TIME

reviews.title: Best value on the Strip
reviews.text: The Casino Royale is in the middle of the action. Its vintage look is a plus. Easy access to upstream or downstream, no need for a car, and if you have one, parking is free. Very good Value/Quality ratio

reviews.title: Great Rooms On The Strip
reviews.text: Casino Royale is a great place to stay and play in the middle of the strip.  The rooms have refrigerators and free coffee. It's a short walk to the casino from the rooms. The pool is small but nice - no fee to use a chair or table. If you use the vending machines for soft drinks, etc. the prices ranged from $1.25 - $1.75 (very cheap for a strip hotel). They also offer free microwaves if you need to use one in the vending area. The gaming floor offers a variety of slot machines and drink prices are cheap.

reviews.title: Very pleasant stay
reviews.text: I was pretty anxious what we'd end up with based on some reviews.  The hotel was very responsive to my questions and requests and we got exactly the room type and location we asked for.  We weren't expecting in room coffee, which was such a nice surprise so we didn't have to go find a coffee shop.  Fancy it is not, but it had comfy beds, a quiet and dark place to sleep (also a great surprise) and bathroom that worked well.  The temperature was moderate outside so our room was a good temp.  If it's been sweltering or LV "cold" out that might change our opinion a bit, but hard to know. We'd definitely stay here again.

reviews.title: Not special
reviews.text: Centrally located, free parking, but that's it. It is a very basic hotel that is more casino than hotel. You have to look for the reception, which is hidden somewhere behind the slot machines. The hotel is in need of renovation and the carpet is quite worn. The rooms are clean and the bathroom relatively spacious. The final downside is the fact that I have not yet received my deposit back after 11 days. I won't be coming back here anytime soon.

reviews.title: Great location, musty odor in 100-level
reviews.text: Rooms on 100-level, which is slightly below ground level, have a damp musty basement odor. Gym room very small, only a couple pieces of equipment. Outdoor pool is small, not well heated, there is no hot tub, and the pool area is fairly small. Staff and service are great, front desk staff were great, check-in was quick, housekeeping came by daily even though we declined housekeeping (in which case are supposed to call whenever you need anything), rooms were quiet, heard nothing from adjacent rooms or hallway that earplugs couldn't handle. Bed and pillows were comfortable. AC worked well, bathroom had two switches, one for powered ventilation with a light, one for a secondary light. Room 106 showerhead's adjustable settings were not adjustable, broke on the all stream on setting. Official pictures of room were identical to room received. There are bars on the ground level windows preventing sliding, but nothing to stop a window from being kicked in.

reviews.title: Best value on Las Vegas strip
reviews.text: I should not share this because more and more people will come here!  Free parking, no resort fees, best location on strip, fridges in rooms, clean, nice pool. What else can you ask for. This is the absolute best value on Las Vegas Strip. This place is great! Casino is a little rough around the edges, but has character.

reviews.title: Las Vegas on a budget
reviews.text: Nice place to stay. It is clean and casino looked nice. Its price is why we picked this hotel. It is older and not elaborate but is a good place to stay. The rooms we were in didn’t have a view but who stays in their room in Las Vegas. Parking was free!

reviews.title: Good things come in small packages
reviews.text: Perhaps the smallest hotel right on the strip.... but certainly one with a big heart..... everything you need is there or close by. Rooms decent size, with all facilities.No breakfast included, but many options close by.

reviews.title: Not Bad!
reviews.text: The location for this price is incredible, it's at least half the price of the other surrounding hotels, if not more. There's a parking garage in the back (it isn't the easiest to access but it is included in the cost of your stay) and even though it's dated the beds were actually very comfy and the rooms stayed nice and cool. You can hear people from the hallways but not the rooms which is great for Vegas. The front desk staff was extremely friendly and helpful. We would stay here again!

reviews.title: Great Staff and Hidden Gem
reviews.text: This hotel is a hidden gem.  Tucked in between the Venetian and Harrahs, on the Vegas Strip, you'd never even know there was a hotel there.  It definitely doesn't have all the bells and whistles that some of the bigger hotels have, but for the price, it was a great stay.  Rooms were clean and incredibly quiet.  The front desk staff was amazing. So helpful, friendly and funny.  No resort fee and free parking for guests of the hotel which is a HUGE plus on the strip.  A great option for those looking for convenience of being on the strip but without all the fanfare of the fancy hotels and casinos.  Well worth the stay.

reviews.title: Location, location
reviews.text: We choose this hotel for a couple of reason on our most recent trip to Las Vegas.Location, middle of the strip.  Lots of restaurants close by.  We like the restaurants on the Lina Walkway.Hotel has no resort fee.  What you see is what you pay.  No surprises at the end of booking.We also liked that you could reach the street almost immediately coming from the elevator. No need t wind your way through the casino.  The room was clean, spacious and offered a mini fridge and Keurig coffee machine.  A regular coffee on the strip was $6.00 so nice to have your first cup in the room while getting ready in the am.  Bus stop was next door going downtown and across the street going the other direction.Only down side was to catch a taxi or Uber needed to go next door to Harrods are the back of the hotel.  It wasn’t a big inconvience.We sat around the pool one afternoon.  The pool has no glitter or glamour.  There were loung chairs and table and chairs.  Guests appeared to enjoy a place that was quiet while reading, visiting.  Pool was cold.  Probably not heated.  Temp in Vegas was low to mid 30 Celcius so thought the pool would be warmer.Check in check out was easy.  Front desk stored our luggage as we had a late flight.  We’re told to bring luggage down by 9:00 as the storage area was small.Also they offer free parking if you have a car.Will definately choose to stay here next time in Vegas..

reviews.title: Great access to Sphere!
reviews.text: This hotel is literally a few doors away from the Venetian and access to the Sphere/U2 concert (which is exactly why I chose it). If you can ignore the smoky, worn down casino area, the rooms are clean, safe and relatively quiet. Access to Lyft and Uber is right out back and the Outback Steakhouse Restaurant was very good. Plus Walgreens right next door is awesome for late night snacks, etc. Just steps from the Strip. No sleep on our last night due to a loud rapper/performer outside the hotel 3 stories down, but it was otherwise a very good choice if you want access to the Sphere and all the Venetian and nearby casinos have to offer without paying for resort fees you might never use. Beds are very comfy.

reviews.title: Casino Royale - Staying on the Center Strip
reviews.text: The 2nd stop in our US vacation was Las Vegas. We wanted to stay soemwhere in the Strip but to avoid the high price hotels. Best Western Plus Casino Royale was our choice and we weren't disappointed. The property was clean, modern style and - even if it was in Las Vegas - silent. I liked that the price had included a parking lot in the Park garage.The children enjoyed the pool which was clean and wasn't crowded.

reviews.title: Great location
reviews.text: Casino Royale is in the perfect location on the strip. It's so easy to park the car (for free!) and be able to walk to the Linq promenade, etc. No resort fee is a huge bonus! This is an older, outdated, musty hotel but our room was clean and everything inside it worked. It was quiet and bed was comfortable. Perfect for our 1 night stay. The woman at check in was friendly.

reviews.title: Oldish hotel with a warn out feeling
reviews.text: Hotel is on the strip, However when we arrived the computers were down, elevator was broken and parking was confusing. Staff did their best, but based on my many stays at BW I expect much more from BW hotels.

reviews.title: Royale Casino
reviews.text: Right in the middle of it all.  Easy to get to all the main Strip casinos and a fun little casino of its own!  You get a voucher to Denny's for breakfast next door but the line up was every day and about 40 minute wait

reviews.title: Niche
reviews.text: Very small and very dark room, located on the ground floor of the hotel. Although soundproofed, the noise from the strip comes through. The location is excellent, right in the center, opposite the Bellagio and the Ceaser Palace. Suitable for one night and for those who do not suffer from claustrophobia.

reviews.title: Quiet and Close to Everything
reviews.text: For its price we got a hotel that was not only quiet .. it was convenient and was close by to EVERYTHING. We went to a convention and it was literally a 10 min walk where we did not even have to drive and park and pay for convention fees. The receptionist was super sweet and had customer service.Overall I would come back here again!

reviews.title: If you want a working hotel, go somewhere else.
reviews.text: The elevator's the coffee makers, the ice machines.And the toilets. Did not work The only positive thing I can say It is on the strip. And there weren't very many homeless Sleeping or or begging for money?

reviews.title: was a great 46 anniversary stay
reviews.text: we always use BestWestern have not been disappointed at any so far the staffs at all have been good always going out of their way to help or see if there is any problems me and the wife are both handicapped they have aways taken care of are needs

reviews.title: Staff was not friendly
reviews.text: That manager kicked me out he said I should vacate in 10 mins after 11 AM I asked 30 mins. However the cleaning was so sweet. Even the front desk staff was not so friendly. I might visit this but do not wanted to be treated the same way again.

reviews.title: average hotel with good location
reviews.text: Check in process was fast. Employees were helpful. Room was clean, and size was ok. Parking was complementary. The only thing that I didn’t like is the accessibility from/ to main Street as it was very busy so it took so long to wait till I can get in/out.

reviews.title: Great location  on the strip itself but hotel premises showing its age.
reviews.text: Ideally placed on the strip within easy walking distance of a number of interests, although monorail or Deuce buses readily available. As for the hotel itself, it is very much showing its age, with a number of small maintenance issues which required attention. The smell of drains from our bathroom basin was quite strong but we have let the front desk know this.  All staff were friendly and helpful, especially, Laurie, at the front desk. The rooms, though, are spacious and with reasonable amenities. Housekeeping though was not good as we didn't have our room serviced once. Having been out all day and returning after days out at 4/5 pm, often the room had still not been done. Notwithstanding all of that, reasonably priced and excellent location.

reviews.title: Great price, friendly staff!
reviews.text: Great price, no hidden resort fee. Free parking. On the strip close to the other casinos  The bartenders: Mark, Mike & George are the greatest. Drinks are the cheapest on the strip and free if you're playing the slots.

reviews.title: Disappointed
reviews.text: No A/C in my room! The hall and Casino were much cooler. If fact, I was ready to sleep in the hall. The rooms are not design with a single room unit. They have a central system, so beware. Every else was good.

reviews.title: Well worth the cost . Fantastic service so far and another week to go . Thank you casino royale .
reviews.text: I am currently staying in this hotel . If you want a Las Vegas resort with all the bells and whistles then this is not the place for you . However if you want cleanliness - pleasant and helpful staff with the best Barman in vegas then this is the place to stay . Yes it is basic - but what more do you need than a decent bed , good shower , fridge for cold drinks , great coffee maker and safe . This hotel will is exceptional value for money . The casino is not the best to say the least , but let’s cation is great . Staff fantastic - thank you so far and I have another week to go .

reviews.title: Good Find
reviews.text: Great location, greay price,, nice room. Perk to have fridge and coffee maker.. Nothing fancy but didnt need fancy siince who comes to Vegas to stay in room! Well maintained. Be warned the doors slam shut which is very noisy. Your door will rattle when other's doors shut. Quiet other than the doors.

reviews.title: Best Western Casino Royale
reviews.text: This was our fourth stay and as usual it was great. Friendly helpful staff and nothing was too much trouble. Such great value and bang in the strip.Thanks again to everyone at Casino Royale for making our holiday enjoyable and stress free. We will be back….. somewhen 😂

reviews.title: Security Nightmare
reviews.text: On the first night of our stay at this property we were awakened when Hotel Security overrode the door lock and attempted to allow 2 people into our room. The front desk did not properly show our assigned room as occupied. This was a horrible experience. Known problems with the thermostat caused the AC unit to constantly switch off of A/C and to heat. Maintenance was aware of this type of problem and was able to quickly rectify.

reviews.title: Nice place great location. Parking is the best.
reviews.text: Sometimes you run across people hanging out outside or in the mens bathrrom that you know don’t belong in or around the casino. But other then that I would recommend . Great place to gamble If you like older and newer machines . Cheaper drinks.

reviews.title: Fabulous home away from home
reviews.text: Great place to enjoy the city and have a great place to feel at home, loved the convenience of being in the center of the strip and I also enjoyed the hospitality and security. Everyone was very accommodating and kind.

reviews.title: Great location
reviews.text: It's right next to The Venetian, but the Bellagio Fountain is about a 17-min walk. The property is an older facility with a casino on the ground floor. Pizza Hut, Outback, Subway, and $2.99 Footlong Hotdogs are located there too. Parking is free. Bed is comfortable but fridge has no freezer and was unplugged so it took a long time to cool. Otherwise, the staff offered a lot of helpful information about getting around. There is no free breakfast.

reviews.title: Excellent
reviews.text: My family and I stayed at Best Western Casino Royale and staying here was a very good choice.The hotel is located in the middle of the Strip, it's easily accesible, it has clean rooms with decent size and all the necessary things that you need for a stay. The room has an empty mini fridge. You need your room card to get access into the rooms area. They don't charge resort fee.I liked the fact that you don't have to walk a lot to get from your room to the Strip. It's located close to restaurants and pharmacies, you can also find cheap eats in the casino.The staff is friendly and check in and check out are easy and you have a real person, not a machine, like in other hotels.This hotel is perfect if you are not looking for huge resorts with large pools, this is a good option if you want to enjoy Las Vegas Strip.

reviews.title: Tucked in amongst the big ones!
reviews.text: This is our second stay and pleased to say it met our accommodation needs. We don’t gamble so the casino not a thing.  Front desk team friendly.  Security with room key access to room hallway and pool and fitness center.  The room was comfortable and our needs met.  Pool was clean!  Fitness center did not have alot of selection but met our needs.  My conference was at Caesar Forum, so an easy indoor walk though Harrahs to Linc to the conference space.

reviews.title: Great hotel
reviews.text: Hotel room was very clean and comfortable. We stayed in a jr suite on the 4th floor and it was very spacious and comfortable.  It had a seperate bedroom/bathroom from the living area.  There was a sleeper sofa and loveseat that was comfortable, table with chairs for eating or playing cards/games.  Had a refrigerator and coffee maker that was very useful.  The pool area was nice and clean.  Casino was downstairs and offered several food options, could of used a little more security in the casino because the homeless and drugged out people kept coming in and walking through.  Right on the strip and an easy walk to other casinos and food.  Walgreens next door for any forgotten items.  The staff was very friendly and helpful.  Our only hiccup was the parking--we had rented a 12 passenger van and couldn't park in the parking deck, so desk clerk allowed us to park in parking lot behind casino, when coming back from sightseeing the security guard would not let us park there again without permission from desk--had to go get another pass--would been nice for everyone to be on the same page.

reviews.title: Best Western+ Equals Best Value on the Strip!
reviews.text: Sure you can stay at the fancy casino resorts, but if you want to save some money & get right to the heart of the action, Best Western + is YOUR place. YOU can always stroll the other resorts. Not only does BW+ offer free parking in a garage, wifi, pool, fitness center, business center & wait for a it...a fridge and coffee maker in your room (struck GOLD!), there is also a couple of mircrowaves down in the snack area on first floor. We were up on the 4th floor, room 416, not far from elevator & ice machine and honestly, never heard a peep, except for one drunk couple dealing w/ attention issues...it is Vegas after all.
