The room was quiet..although we had no view, we were not there for one, we were there to quietly rest after a crazy day w/ fantastic A/C and again, did I mention the fridge? Unfortunately, we did not make it down to the pool, but it looked lovely tucked quietly away from the hustle and bustle. A couple cool things to add as perks in the hotel, to get your Rewards card, there is a guy who stands right next to the hotel check in & will do it all for you remotely! Speedy! There are tons of reasonably priced places to eat there: 24hr White Castles (yum!), Subway, Pizza Hut to go, Outback & yes, even the $3 hot dog place...which we enjoyed our first night there...more bread than dog, but what the heck, when you need an inexpensive snack, it was perfect. The casino itself was smaller than the biggies of course, & while we did not have luck on our penny slots, you are right in the thick of the action on the Strip. Steps from Harrah's and the Linq Promenade and Flamingo Wild Habitat. Just across the street from the amazing & sadly, soon to be renovated Mirage & Volcano. Yes, there is even one of those red, Tix Tonight booths right outside...but do your homework first, come to them w/ the prices you already know because they are not all deals like the Broadway tix booths. Getting in and out of the BW+ with your car can be tricky & you do have to time it right...first don't miss the small driveway after the Walgreens, because you will not want to reroute down LS blvd again. Next, there are constantly streams of people, inch out carefully. TIP: there is a back exit to the BW+ garage, that you can enter through Koval blvd. But for the best trip, park your car in the garage w/ security cams and go walk. Tip: Outback entrance from strip leads you straight to guest rooms entrance in BW+, bypass casino. Rooms clean, staff friendly & FRIDGE! Enjoyed 3 days.

reviews.title: A great value for a clean & comfortable room
reviews.text: A great location right in the middle of the Las Vegas strip. A clean, cool and comfortable room with a nice firm mattress. Room made up with toiletries and towels every day. Coffee maker in the room was very convenient.

reviews.title: Excellent location and always clean!
reviews.text: We love the location of the hotel. It's conveniently located on the strip which makes it so easy to wonder up and down the boulevard.  The hotel is clean and the pool area is secluded and quiet. Comfy bed and nice bedding too. The parking is convenient and very easy as well. This Best Western is one of our favorites!

reviews.title: Great location, no resort fees
reviews.text: The location is great - next door to the Venetian, overpass to the Mirage, Walgreens next door. The room was pretty small but did include a safe (for all your winnings), coffee maker, fridge. Getting to my room on the 2nd floor was through a door (you need to use your room key for security) in the casino then down a ramp to the elevator or walk up a carpeted set of indoor stairs.  It was a long hallway to my room so ask for a lower number room if walking is difficult. Other reviews mentioned homeless people and noise but I didn’t notice any of that in my two days there. The front desk people were very helpful. And not being charged resort fees made this an attractive choice. Uber drop off was at the hotel but for pickupI had to go all the way through Harrah’s unless I walked through the BW parking garage and on a stinky service street which only took a few minutes. The casino was small and crowded compared to the monster casinos around it, didn’t have any table games but it was busy.

reviews.title: What a great surprise!
reviews.text: Excellent location on the main strip. Cosy little casino with affordable dining on site. Rooms have coffee makers and fridge.  Rooms were clean and the staff were polite and helpful. It's a great way to have  Vegas vacation on a budget.  I'd definitely stay again. Oh and the pool and gym are really nice.

reviews.title: Loud
reviews.text: Very loud cleaning crew, would wake us up from 7-9am. Location was nice though and friendly staff. Next to the harrahs that has the monorail. Overall, I would stay here again if I had to, but next trip will most likely be spending more money on a nicer place.

reviews.title: BWP Casino Royale Center Strips
reviews.text: BWP Casino Royale Center Strips Had a very good location that come with free parking. For the price of the room that had with such good location is considerably cheap in Las Vegas. I stronger recommend this hotel to u

reviews.title: Never Ever Again
reviews.text: Our first room was on the ground floor, facing the parking lot. The odor of mold and urine was pretty intense - and together with the guy smoking up outside our window had me asking for a different room on a different floor. On the plus side we were pleasantly surprised to find our car NOT broken into like so many others in the parkade.

reviews.title: Great value
reviews.text: Located right in the center of the LV Strip, this hotel was great. It wasn't expensive, we didn't pay a resort fee, and it offered free parking. All of which were great as we were only staying in Vegas for a night before flying back home. The front desk staff was helpful and friendly, and this was a great value and experience for anyone who doesn't feel like dealing with casino nonsense.

reviews.title: Loud hallways and clogged shower drain
reviews.text: Our shower was clogged our entire stay. We called Friday afternoon and ask for it to be fixed but no one ever addressed or fixed the shower. We bathed in dirty water backed up from the drain for 3 days.

reviews.title: Best deal on the strip!
reviews.text: This place is a hidden gem right next to the Venetian! Entrance to the elevator could be a little nicer, but once you get to the hallway to the room it's really nice. Great bathroom, shower, bed and pillows. TV great too!

reviews.title: Just location was good. Room was dirty and non working AC
reviews.text: Booked for location and availability and disappointed. Room was dirty (stained sheets,dead bugs behind fridge) and ac was non working and felt stuffy.Low shower head pressure. Only stay to sleep cuz it sucks

reviews.title: Great stay and would highly recommend
reviews.text: Located centrally on the strip so easy walk right onto the strip. Located across the street from Caesars palace and located next door to Harrahs.Rooms are comfortable and very well maintained. Staff are friendly and very accommodating. Would definitely stay again and would recommend to people looking to avoid paying the resort fee but also looking to travel on a budget.

reviews.title: Air conditioning did not work!
reviews.text: I never write negative reviews and am not a picky traveler but after staying here I cannot believe this hotel is rated as highly as it is. The convenient location is the only thing it has going for it. My kids also had fun at the pool. The rooms are very small, there was mold in the bathroom on the wall, the ice machine on the 2nd floor did not work. Our air conditioning in the room did not work at all, it got up to 76 even with the window open on a chilly spring evening. The hallways smelled disgusting every time we walked down it, like rotten garbage. I am very disappointed in the quality of this stay.

reviews.title: Very Good
reviews.text: Very good hotel on the strip you can walk to most of the places on the strip. No car needed. Car parking is also good here with no extra charge. Front desk is helpful if you need stuff they sends someone out to your room

reviews.title: Another Great Stay!
reviews.text: I've stayed here a couple of times and both times were great! Rooms are clean,  staff are amazing,  in the middle of the strip, and since the hotel is smaller,  you get to the strip quicker.  This is my go to place to stay everytime I go to Vegas and highly recommend staying here. This was my Mom's first time staying here as well and she loved it.  The staff went above and beyond to make sure our rooms were close to each other as well. 😊

reviews.title: Don`t think twice just book it!
reviews.text: GREAT location, within walking distance of the main attractions on the STRIP (Ceasar Palace 5min walk). The staff is super friendly; however, housekeeping let down. They change towels and take out the garbage but don't clean the room/bathroom. Also, there is no kettle in the room, but they have an iron, an iron desk, and a coffee machine. Overall loved our stay and will definitely recommend it! Great budget-friendly option.

reviews.title: Unexpected Gem
reviews.text: As many times as I’ve walked past Casino Royale on other LV trips, I actually never realized it was a Best Western. Lucky for me, it finally showed up on my search results when I was looking for a room. It was extremely well priced, and the location was perfect. The rooms were clean and very comfortable! They were quiet, too. Our AC unit didn’t work right, however, and it was quite warm and stuffy in our 3rd floor room. Luckily we could open the window, and in mid-March that worked just fine, but it will be a problem mid-summer. I also did not see or use the pool, but I believe it was indoors. If you want more of a resort hotel with an outdoor area, this isn’t it. But again, perfectly fine for us in mid-March. The only restaurants in the immediate hotel area are chains (Dennys, Subway, Pizza Hut, McDonald’s, etc) but its a very easy walk to the Venetian next door, or Caesars Palace across the street for more fine dining options. The bus stop is also very close by. Overall, we had a great experience, thought we got a great value, and we would definitely stay here again.

reviews.title: Grand Canyon and Vegas vacation
reviews.text: Excellent price as no other hotels could compete. Excellent location on the strip, in the heart of town and a safe location for families. Excellent rooms with a refrigerator and coffee maker. Excellent parking within a covered garage and at no charge.

reviews.title: Hidden Gem on Center Strip
reviews.text: I was a bit concerned by some of  the negative reviews of this hotel, but since we were traveling in early March, I didn't want to pay resort fees for amenities I wouldn't use. I was so glad I booked with this hotel!Yes, the casino is really skanky and it is really unfortunate that the front desk is located there, BUT, the hotel itself, which is in a separate building  is spotlessly clean.Our room was really lovely and clean. It was a good size and the bed was so comfortable,  I slept better than at home.The bathroom was a bit small, only one person could fit at a time, but that was fine. The only complaint I had is that the water pressure was a little low for my liking, but there was always plenty of hot water. There was a little breakfast bar, with a keurig machine and mini fridge. The coffee pods weren't the greatest so we bought our own, which was still cheaper than buying a coffee.The only thing that was really missing was a luggage rack, but we made do. We also wished that there were instructions to control the thermostat. It wasn't very intuitive.I noticed other reviews said it was noisy, but we didn't find that to be the case at all and we were right beside the elevator.They also gladly stored our luggage for free for the whole day that we checked out as our flight was at midnight.I am so glad I booked this hotel for our 4 day stay in Vegas. We were so busy every day, just checking out all the things to see along the strip that we wouldn't have had time to use any resort amenities, even if we had them.I highly recommend this hotel for anyone who wants a clean place to lay your head at a great price.

reviews.title: Only to sleep
reviews.text: The hotel has pros and cons.Pros: Location is excellent, across from The Mirage. There are several dining options, shops and pharmacies nearby. The bus stop is almost on the sidewalk. There is a McDonalds next door. The hotel receives internet packages free of charge. Wifi worked well at no extra cost. Parking is free and there were always spaces. The bed is comfortable but small for two people. Towels were new and changed every day. There are available power outlets and usb ports. Television was fine. I didn't turn on the air conditioning as it was cold. Opened the window.Simplified check-in and check-out. There is, in the room, a mini-fridge, coffee maker, safe, ice bucket, and ironing board. Access to corridors and rooms is by card.Cons: acoustics are bad, you can hear conversations and noises from the hallway and other rooms. Cleaning is not good. The room is dusty and the floor is carpeted. There was no cigarette smell, but there was a carpet smell with old wood. I felt a certain insecurity, as there was an incident at night, in front of my room, which cannot be explained by the reception. One morning, when I opened the bedroom door, there was a strange drunk in the hallway, and two policemen. There are few employees in the hotel.In short, if you're not a fan of frills and you're looking for a well-located, inexpensive hotel with a comfortable bed to sleep in, it's worth it.

reviews.title: Awful Customer Service!!!
reviews.text: Customer service was awful!! I called in for room service on my 2nd day stay so that housekeeping could come take the trash out, clean our bathroom, and for clean towels. (Mind you I didn’t even ask for full service) The lady that answered at the front desk said that she couldn’t guarantee someone would make it to our room to take care of this, I called at 11am, which I have never stayed at a hotel that wouldn’t jump on this request to satisfy our members stay. Being a prior Best Western employee I know this is not how we speak to our paying costumers and especially not on such an easy request. This Best Western does not deserve to be a PLUS hotel. The room was also not the cleanest and the shower/tub would take forever to drain the water out, which would push back how long it would take for us to shower. The bed sheets had stains, thankfully we packed our own sheets to replace those, because at this point I am sure if I had requested new sheets for the beds I would have never got them. I will not be going back nor will be recommending this to anyone.

reviews.title: The perfect little hotel, amongst all the enormous hotels.
reviews.text: If you want to be on the street within a minute after leaving your room - this is the only hotel on center strip that offers that. Nothing fancy, only exactly all you need. No resort fee. Parking free - and close.

reviews.title: Room was freezing!!
reviews.text: This place is terrible. The temperature of our room never got warmer than 68 degrees. The staff blamed it on an old central heating and cooling system. To add injury to insult, when we asked for an extra blanket, they told us they were out because so many people had requested them!! Don't waste your money on this place!

reviews.title: Nice and affordable room
reviews.text: Located in the strip, this was a great spot to find. The only problem i had was getting to the free parking. Their is no light to stop the pedestrians from walking near the only entrance to the hotel. The room and service it self was fantastic. No complaints and cheap fast food was nearby too.

reviews.title: Excellent location on the strip
reviews.text: Excellent location lots of machines. Kuric in the rooms good choice of fast food pizza hotdog, pretzels, subway. However, no table games we had to go elsewhere to play blackjack.Very easy parking super convenient. Will definitely be staying here again.

reviews.title: Great location.  Centre of strip
reviews.text: Hotel was a great location. Outback Steak house was located in hotel. That had amazing food.  Walgreens was practically next door. Cheap booze. This is a smaller casino. Pizza Hut express in Casino. Overall it was a decent place

reviews.title: Great central location.
reviews.text: Smaller 4 story hotel, recently updated. Everything worked fine and a fridge and Keurig was nice. Room was comfortable, spacious and quiet. Nice to not have to negotiate a huge casino, large crowds every time that you want to leave. In the centre of the strip with lots of restaurant, entertainment options.

reviews.title: Hidden Gem close to Convention Center
reviews.text: We like this property since it's close to the convention center and includes a mini kitchenette with fridge and coffee maker.  No fuss experience. Will likely book here again for value and location as long as we can.

reviews.title: Would stay again
reviews.text: Hotel room was spacious & clean. Everything you needed provided in the room (towels, coffee etc) Great location to the strip, parking if you need it. Still fairly quiet at night for a good nights sleep if you need it. Helpful & friendly staff. Bonus, no resort fee!

reviews.title: Quiet and comfortable, but with some issues
reviews.text: I understand that running a hotel like this on the Strip is extremely challenging, and even finding and retaining capable employees is a daunting task, so I want to be honest about our experience, mostly so management knows how guests experience the hotel, not to beat up on anyone about the issues they're dealing with.First, our room was mostly clean, and everything worked, but there was at least one silverfish bug scooting around in the bathroom, and the bathroom was not as clean as it could have been.  I've seen worse, but I don't recommend worse, and I tend to expect a little higher standard from Best Western properties.  For me, if the bathroom isn't clean, then I don't trust that the rest of the room is any cleaner.Second, you have to do something with the parking garage.  It's filthy, and trash laying on the ground when we first arrived, was still there days later.  I made the mistake of taking the stairs up to the third floor, and the stairwell was strewn with garbage, and I felt lucky that it wasn't worse.  If it had just a little more garbage in it, it would have rivaled the look of the McDonald's next door to the hotel.  I don't know what you can do, honestly, but the garage was gross, and if it's gross, it's probably also unsafe.Third, I have no idea what you're doing in the back parking lot, but it's really weird to tie off areas of the parking lot - areas where guests are to park when checking in too - in a seemingly random fashion.  I'm not sure why that was being done, though I'm sure there is a reason.It is challenging getting in and out of the parking area with our car as the flow of pedestrians almost never stops.  I'm not sure if there's anything that could help with that, but it does make things interesting sometimes.Now, all that said, the room was small but comfortable, the bed was great, it was quite quiet for a hotel on the Strip, and the front desk and housekeeping were quick to respond to our request for additional coffee for the Keurig coffee maker.  The website when we made our booking made it sound like there was breakfast offered, but apparently not.While the hotel was conveniently located and we had a great few days in Las Vegas, we probably would not return to this hotel based on the issues with cleaning - both in the room and on the grounds and parking garage.

reviews.title: 2nd time not the same
reviews.text: 2nd visit to this hotel, we were disappointed, it was better the first time we came about 4 years ago. This hotel seems to be not very well maintained, it seemed a bit run down,our room had a smokey smell that was very strong even though we asked for non smoking room, we asked for a different room and were told that there wasn’t one!  The room it self had some stains on the lamps and a bit of damage in the bathroom. The staff did come and spray the room which helped a bit but the smell still lingered. The staff is very friendly and the location is great, no resort fees but we probably won’t stay here again.

reviews.title: Hidden gem
reviews.text: Best Western Plus Casino Royale -  Center Strip was a wonderful surprise to my husband and I.  He is a professional pilot and travels constantly.  We also travel extensively together.  Branded properties in the Hilton and Marriott chains are where we typically stay, so we are accustomed to a certain level of service and amenities...although admittedly, we continue to see significant declines in the quality of these properties since 2019's pandemic. Thus, we didn't expect much from BWP Casino Royale.  We expected a mediocre stay and indifferent service.  Were we ever wrong!  Our stay equalled (or even exceeded) many of those other "higher-end" stays in overall experience, incl. cleanliness, quiet room, bed & room comfort, team member warmth, friendliness, & courtesies extended.  A few details: Thomas (front desk.  Hotel manager?) answered the phone prior to arrival & assured us we could store our luggage there both prior to and after check-in.  (Our flights were especially early and late in the day and we were reluctant to drag it up and down the Strip.)  We arrived ~10:30 am via Uber -- and because our room was ready, were allowed to check in a whopping 5 hours early.  Tina -- personable, warm, friendly and efficient -- cheerfully checked us both in and out, and allowed us to store our luggage for 8 hours prior to our evening departure.  It is obvious that Casino Royale does this frequently; their system is efficient and secure.     The most pleasant surprise was how *quiet* our room was -- we couldn't hear a thing: not  traffic, cars in the parking lot, other guests, or noise from the attached casino.  It was wonderful!  We also loved the location: entrance to the Mirage (and "The Beatles: Love") was as simple as crossing the Strip.     Casino Royale is across the street from the Mirage, and so hidden it is easy to overlook.  It is not glitzy.  Our first-floor room overlooked the parking lot (discovered only when we opened the wood shutters). This was not a "con" to us, as we weren't there for the view.  Decor was comfortable and pleasing. Unlike many places, including higher-end ones, daily housekeeping was provided (unless declined).   We wish we would have been able to control the heat.  It was locked in at a comfortable temperature but it would have been nice to be able to notch it up or down a bit.  The room was in excellent condition and immaculately clean.  We did not utilize the Keurig coffee maker, pool, or included breakfast.  We felt secure and safe at all times. Our stay was earned through last summer's Best Western Plus promotion and was at no charge - but the Casino Royale team acted as if we were full-revenue guests. We look forward to returning to this hidden gem.

reviews.title: A great stay
reviews.text: A lovely,  clean, quiet budget hotel located on the Strip. No resort fees. Room was spacious and clean. Slept well every night. Located bear to the Venetian and Mirage. Easy to get around. Small casino, not the fanciest.

reviews.title: WARNING ⚠️⚠️ ATM COMPROMISED
reviews.text: The casino and hotel will ignore you and NOT do anything to stop the fraud of your chip debit card information from being stolen at their ATM machine on the casino floor. Unbelievable they allow it! So bad!!! When I called them they said they don't own the ATMs...nothing they can do...it is their responsibility to safeguard their guests. Shut down unplug remove something!!! A simple evaluation of the ATM will expose the fraud..but they won't!! Avoid this location. ⚠️

reviews.title: Casino Royal - no frills but great location and perfect for getting around the strip!
reviews.text: first off I will mention that the Casino Royal is obviously NOT glitzy or glamorous. HOWEVER....we knew that when booking our stay. we met friends who stayed at Caesars.  Caesars is so huge we had trouble finding them and the slots etc were super tight. Casino Royal is no frills, but the room was clean and with only 4 floors we only ran into other guests on the elevator twice!  it's just an easy stay....parking is free and right out back. the slots were loose some days.  we were easily able to walk across the street to meet our friends and as it was a bit chilly we could pass through Harrahs and the linq to stay warm. the staff who we checked in and out with were amazing! so nice and helpful!  so as long as you know what you are booking as far as low cost & no frills, IMO Casino Royal is perfect.  yes, there are a few sketchy individuals hanging around the White Castle and wall greens area at the end...but we never felt unsafe and there are plenty of homeless in front of the fancy casinos as well lol  the Keurig in the room was clutch! I have stayed in numerous other Vegas strip hotels and had to venture out for $7 coffee in the morning. maid service was great, hallways were quiet, no street noise, and you can exit the parking garage out the back to skip alot of the strip traffic.  no complaints from my husband and I and we would definitely stay at Casino Royal in the future.

reviews.title: 3 night stay
reviews.text: No air in Dec, it was SO hot and muggy in the room. I was told to just turn off the fan. Had to open the window and hear the loud noise of the docking station to cool down. Will no go back unless this is fix. They claimed they do not run the AC in the winter. To hot to sleep well. Woke up to 76-78 degrees.

reviews.title: Needs cleaning
reviews.text: Hotel staff were very helpful which is about the only positive thing to say about this hotel. No room AC, had to sleep with window open, which was loud. The hotel itself needs a strong cleaning, everything outdated. Casino was dirty/outdated.

reviews.title: Spend your money elsewhere. Rude Staff and Filthy!
reviews.text: Rudest staff I have met at any of the BW I stay at.  And I have stayed in more the 6 countries and 40 states.  Room was disgusting, we got "forgot" about by housekeeping and the free night travel voucher was not honored after it had been accepted when the reservation was made.

reviews.title: The best of both ways, the North and south of the strip.
reviews.text: A perfect place right in the middle of the Strip. Easy access , clean rooms with coffee and tea facilities, there's a fridge too a plus for cold drinks. Rooms are spacious. A special mention to our Guest Sevice supervisor TINA CURRY, she was very helpful with our many questions,  Always a smile on her face that makes us so welcome.

reviews.title: AC/Heating Unit Bad
reviews.text: You cannot adjust the heat, it just blows cold air. Desert gets cold at night, so good luck asking the front desk. They will ask if you need help to turn off the system or send a non-maintenance person to check it out, but it's not their fault. Cannot recommend this property to my friends.

reviews.title: No resort fee!
reviews.text: This place does not have or claim to have the polished perfect decor of some of the bigger casinos - but if you just want a roof over your head in a more than comfortable room without having to pay a resort fee,then this is the place for you. Located bang in the centre of the strip opposite the Mirage and Caesars Palace,next door to Harrahs and the Venetian it’s a perfect spot.Yes - it’s a bit rough around the edges but beer is $3 at the bar, it’s $7-10 pretty much anywhere else nearby. A mention to George who runs the bar on the late shift - a great character who makes you feel welcome. He’s also got an eye on what is going on around him. If you don’t want to get hassled when sitting having a late drink. he will look after you. We will be back.

reviews.title: Believe the bad reviews!
reviews.text: Travelers when doing reviews include your room # so others won't get that room. Mine was rm# 213. A/C did not work. Was told a/c was shut off for all rooms, (all 4 floors) and the heat was turned on because it was getting cold at night(low 50s), but you really can't control it because it is central heat and air. B/S answer. They have same set up the other 4 hotels I stayed at during my trip. I have pics that show that a repair was tried and failed they left the air handler/ fan assembly open to the crawl space area between the floors. So, instead of the air being drawn through the air filter it was sucking all the dirt and dust and bugs and mice droppings from the crawl space. They told me without batting an eye I could open the window to control the temp. 3  BW reps gave me this answer. I said what if you were a woman alone staying on the 1st floor, you wouldn't want to open your window in this area. Since heat rises the 3rd and 4th floors and towards the middle would be the hottest, so it does not make sense that the individual  rooms would not have control of the temperature.  I had my window open from 730pm to 8am, it got down to 48 degrees outside but only got down to 71 degrees inside. There were lots of homeless people in casino check in area, especially to charge there phones, security at times kicked them out. They were in parking garage in there cars, on all floors some smoking weed. I would go to my room or leave in my car and come back and they were still there in their cars. One woman got totally naked changing clothes from her trunk, she obviously wasn't staying there. There is more but I fixed the stuff wrong myself. Do yourself a favor do not stay here.

reviews.title: Decent basic hotel if wanting to avoid resort fees, located centrally on the strip, good shower, comfy bed and bedding.
reviews.text: Decent basic hotel if wanting to avoid resort fees, located centrally on the strip, good shower, comfy bed and bedding.

reviews.title: Great Location
reviews.text: The Hotel is located on the Strip. It is very convenient to go everywhere. But it has some issues. The rooms, although big, are not cleaned very efficiently. The carpet is smelly and the sheets they must definitely be thrown away and get new ones.I have stayed many times in Best Western hotels in Europe and I didn’t had any issues. This was by far the worst one in terms of value for money.

reviews.title: No AC
reviews.text: There is no AC in the rooms our room was 80. We were told we could give you a fan or we could check you out. Could not get a drink in the casino as the waitress walked by so quickly you couldn’t even order.

reviews.title: Casino Royal loses its gambling soul
reviews.text: The Casino Royale was always a nice place to stay and offered good price rooms and the gambling was good. The Casino had a great gambling section and was priced up cheaper (min stake) than the big Casino equivalents. My Wife and I loved playing there and the 5$ craps table enabled my wife to learn and play craps.However, since Covid, all the Blackjack, Roulette and Craps tables have been replaced by slot machines. What a shame, probably explains why it was never busy anymore. The Craps table used to have a good set of Dealers who interacted nicely with customers. It was a fun place to be. Not anymore, it has lost its soul, just another Casino with Slots. We are unlikely to return there again after being regulars over the years.Bring back the dealers.

reviews.title: Awesome hotel
reviews.text: The best part of this hotel is the front desk staff, especially Elia, she really made sure we had a great time. The rooms were fine, the mattresses were firm and the pillows were good. The bathroom looked like it had been remodeled and the showers were hot. Everything was clean and smelled great. You could not ask for a better location, as soon as you walk out of the hotel/casino you are right across from the Mirage and are in easy walking distance to other casino's. There are good and cheap food choices in the hotel, the White Castle and Pizza Hut were good options. The casino was kind of small but had enough machines that we gambled there a few times, wish they had a few more Top Dollar machines but overall it was a good casino. The other bonus is that they do not charge resort fees. We go to Vegas once a year and this is hotel we are go to stay at every time we go, highly recommended.

reviews.title: Great stay
reviews.text: Super clean and comfy, excellent staff, amazing location, would highly recommend to anyone visiting. Also excellent value and perfect location for exploring the strip, will definitely stay here again if we’re in town

reviews.title: Best Western Plus Casino Royale - Center Strip
reviews.text: Unfortunately cannot recommend Casino Royale due to bathroom uncleanliness and terrible water odor in the restroom. The proximity is in the middle of the strip which is convenient. Would probably stay at Harrah's or Linq next time.

reviews.title: Feet saver
reviews.text: Strategically locacted,center of everything,in all directions,your feet will thank you later,I mean come on,your stay in your room is a small percentage of all Vegas has to offer may as well stay in the heart of the strip

reviews.title: Definitely Not What I Expected From Best Western
reviews.text: When I entered the entrance from where I was dropped off, I had to walk through the casino to get to the front desk.  The desk clerk that serviced me did not ask me if I was a Rewards member.  I had asked for an early check in and since the clerk did not say anything, I reminded him that I had an early check in.  His words was, "I am taking care of that now".  The clerk asked me if I wanted the room cleaned daily in a tone as if there was a charge for that.  The hotel does not offer shower caps for the ladies that don't want to get their hair wet.  When we would arrive late at night after our activities, we would ask for coffee and cups for the next day.  The clerk that was on was "snippy" saying that we could call for those items.  My question is how long would we have to wait?  We were not informed that there was a restaurant where we could get breakfast nor were we offered a voucher to get breakfast at a close by restaurant. The area of the hotel is not sealed off as non smoking. The only real thing this hotel has going for it is that it is on the strip and close to where many of the tour buses pick you up for the tours.

reviews.title: Buffalo slot machine winner
reviews.text: The Best Western hotel/the Casino Royale winning was the best ever. I have played the same machine up and down the strip. At the Casino Royale I have the best luck. I have won $9500 major win more than anywhere. I stay at the hotel as well. I have gotten to know the staff and management and consider it my home away from home. I am back every 60 days.

reviews.title: Location and service
reviews.text: Both the above were very good for our one night stopover, we’re not keen on LV but had to pass through, so this location suited us for the night. Clean, comfortable bed and room - one major gripe is that bottled water was only provided for ‘premium’ members ! There was a heatwave on when we were there - not good enough!Hope not to go to LV again but would stay here again if needed

reviews.title: A good value
reviews.text: As this hotel is right on the strip it is a great value and was much less expensive than other hotels. If you don't care about the statues of staying at one of the large hotels with a brand name to pay for, this is the place for you. All we need is a clean place to lay our head at night and this place was perfect.

reviews.title: Best Value in Vegas
reviews.text: Excellent Location on the strip. Research the entry road before you go and go into the entrance by the multi- story car park, not though the casino as we did. Its what it is, bit basic and the rooms adequate but very good price. gazillions of restaurants everywhere and the magic of the strip 20 paces away. No breakfast but pool outside and felt safe at all times. Very friendly and helpful staff too.

reviews.title: Excellent location
reviews.text: Located right in the middle of all the big casino's, but at a great value, parking garage is easy to get in and out of, plenty of resturarants that you can afford nearby and in the casino, like Outback, Denny's. There is a Walgreens.

reviews.title: On strip
reviews.text: Best location to be so close to the strip. We walked everywhere. Car park is a bit unsafe but hire car was fine, it was more the open drug use and street walkers getting ready more than anything. Staff were very friendly and the room was perfect, with a small kitchen area.

reviews.title: Great value hotel and incredible location
reviews.text: Extremely easy to find hotel in an excellent location, right opposite Mirage and sandwiched in between Harrah's and The Venetian. Really nice and small.Parking really easy to find behind the hotel.Seamless check in and check out. A little difficult to walk through the Casino but not a problem.Very good sized rooms with excellent storage space. Bathroom a bit on the small side but can't complain when you're on the Strip.Hotel has a Subway, Pizza Hut and Hot Dog outlet at the back of the Casino.Good pool as well with ample seating and lounging areas.Excellent value for money and NO Resort Fee - amazing.Would definitely stay again!

reviews.title: do not stay here
reviews.text: poor room service, no hot water in the mornings, front desk seemed indifferent to our requests and concerns beds were uncomfortable not what you would expect from a Best Western+. Lobby rest rooms floor was nasty and unsensitized

reviews.title: Disappointed
reviews.text: Stayed for 11 nights. Its our 4th visit to this hotel.  We noted that all of the manned gaming tables have been removed and replaced with extra slots etc.  The Casino entrance doors are either broken or falling apart so first impressions are poor. Reception staff were very friendly, and casino waitress Lisa was excellent!There is a major problem with the homeless in Vegas, worse than ever at the moment. Unfortunately they congregate outside the hotel door.  This intimidated my wife to the point we cannot return. They use the hotel toilets at the rear which is unpleasant for all concerned. Finally, we were very disappointed to find the pool was out of order for over a week. There was no information or apology for the loss of such an important facility, given that we normally use the pool every day this was unacceptable. Reception had no idea when it would reopen.Sad to say that we will now look elsewhere.

reviews.title: Staff & Casino top notch; shame about the hotel
reviews.text: No resort fees? Free parking? Sounds great, eh? Read on before you think you are getting a true bargain. Be warned, there is a pest issue in this hotel! The check in area is way through the casino from where the taxis and car park is so be prepared to drag your cases through slot machines and Vegas revellers on the way to check in. The front desk staff were super friendly and I can’t fault that experience at all. We were accommodated as requested on the 4th floor after reading some reviews about noise and questionable activity in the adjoining car park area.First impressions were that the rooms are generally small and tired, in dire need of a refresh or upgrade. Room appeared clean. I noticed a couple of small flies in the bathroom, but sometimes you expect that if doors / windows have been opened during a guest change. We decided to only get our room cleaned on request (Covid and that). We asked for housekeeping after 4 days of the stay. I would say the cleanliness is questionable. The bedding was only remade, not changed. The carpet was obviously not vacuumed.To add insult to injury, we discovered a large cockroach on returning to the room one night, which I had to apprehend. On informing the front desk, we were offered a room move which I declined (the hassle of repacking and no guarantee of another critter-free room seemed a non- starter). No apology however, which in customer service is a huge red flag. Apparently “when it rains, you never know what will turn up”. Funny, in the 5 other times I’ve stayed in Vegas, all in different hotels, when there’s been a bit of rain I’ve never even seen a ‘roach anywhere… In fairness, they sent someone up with some bug spray within about an hour to treat the bathroom. We discussed the option of checking out and changing hotels, as we both felt uncomfortable and frustrated at the apparent lack of concern. About an hour later, we were horrified to spot a large cricket / creature next to our beds. Needless to say, I was online and booking us into another hotel before we checked out. No way were we sleeping in that room again!! On check out, we mentioned our issues and reasons behind it (grossness and pest issues). Again, no apology and a bit of a knowing nod, indicating that this is a known problem to staff. I will be contacting the local health authorities as there’s obviously a pest issue in this hotel that they are not dealing with. As an aside, the casino itself is great. Cheap drinks, low gambling minimums and great staff. Shame about the hotel. Best Western seriously need to take a look at what they are offering here.

reviews.title: Best Hotel on the Strip with NO RESORT FEES!!!
reviews.text: We wanted a clean, centrally located hotel on the strip and we picked the BEST! From the pre registration email to the last day of our trip, the staff was amazing. Room was spacious & clean. Great choice.

reviews.title: Good location, Clean,
reviews.text: This hotel is in a good location. Parking is free. Beer at the bar is $3. The casino to this hotel is right in front of the volcano at the Mirage. This hotel sets back off the strip, no good views from your window. Bathrooms are small, one person at a time can use the sink. It does have a refrigerator and a Keurig with coffee and tea. Bed was comfortable, we had to ask for additional pillows. Staff were friendly. I've stayed here twice. Only 6 miles from the airport. Casino has a White Castle, Pizza Hut, Subway and foot long hotdog place to eat right on site. We were given coupons to Denny's next door and there is also a McDonalds on the other side. Walking distance to many of the larger casinos. We had trouble adjusting the room temperature. Thermostat was no even close to the right temperature.

reviews.title: All about the location and the staff
reviews.text: Perfect Center Strip location! leave your room and be on The Strip in 30 seconds! And no Resort Fees!!!Those 4000 room hotels are nice but they are so big it takes forever to navigate through them.The front desk and bar staff are top notch and the drink prices are incredible.

reviews.title: Diabolical Service
reviews.text: Reserved this hotel through booking.com, unfortunately there was a problem with payment being taken from my card so I contacted the hotel  to try and pay direct but I was reassured by the Manager, Thomas,  that no payment was required until check in and my booking would not be cancelled. Upon arrival on Friday I was told my booking had been cancelled and I would have to rebook, the rate went up from $459 to $529 through booking.com. The receptionist said she could provide a room for $612, when I said I shouldn't have to pay more than my original booking she knocked it down to $538. I could not speak to Thomas as he wasn't there until the morning and was apparently the only Manager. The fact that I knew his name and had a customer ticket number meant nothing, I should have bern given an upgrade for the original price, they obviously do not know how to treat their customers. Ended up booking Treasure Island which was 100% better the the urine smelling Casino Royale, will never attempt to stay there again or use Best Western.

reviews.title: Average Casino
reviews.text: Older, smaller casino. Kind of a stale smell inside.  Cheap bottles of beer available.  Good for a quick stop.  Never win anything there however, so tough to recommend it for anything other than a quick stop.

reviews.title: Lovely hotel on the strip
reviews.text: Great hotel in a great position right on the strip. Lots of free parking (4 level multi story)  behind hotel. The entrance is just after you pass the hotel. Rooms are clean, spacious with fridge, iron and coffee machine and beds are comfortable. The casino on site is a bit dreary but we didn’t go to gamble so was no big thing. No resort charges so all in all a bargain place to stay in Vegas.

reviews.title: Good Management!
reviews.text: My wife and I have wanted to stay at this property for quite some time, however COVID postponed our opportunity a couple of times. We finally got to stay here in August and we REALLY wanted to love it. Unfortunately we had a couple of hiccups during our stay. I really do not want to complain about our stay but just a couple of words of caution.First- we asked housekeeping for extra pillows, as only 3 were provided for a king sized bed. We were denied extra pillows which was puzzling. After checking with the front desk, they agreed to try and retrieve more pillows and drop them off in our room. We went to dinner and retured to our room where the door was left open. This really freaked us out, as we knew that the property isn't in the safest place. Luckily nothing was stolen. Admittedly, the door was a little tough to latch, but it would only makes sense to pull on the door when exiting just to be sure.Second- My wife was really excited to use the pool. We were looking for a low-key pool spot that didn't have a bunch of partygoers. This pool definitly hit the mark for that, however it was closed the first morning we were there with no indication when it would be re-opened. Luckily it opened shortly after noon, but it would have been nice to get some kind of communication so we could have planned accordingly. In addition, there were a couple of very shady characters attempting to gain access to the pool area, and one of them got pretty nasty when my wife wouldn't let him in. Thomas the manager, did take care of the problem and I will mention him later.Lastly- the halls of the hotel are in bad need of a good vacuum. The carpets were pretty rough.Overall what I would like to share is how amazing the front desk staff are...Especially Thomas! He is awesome, and the only reason we would consider returning.Thomas - I know you read these reviews, and I am sorry I can't give your property a 5-star rating. I REALLY wanted to, but had to be as honest as possible. You are awesome Thomas and thank you for being great at your job and the things you can control!

reviews.title: Excellent Hotel showing its age
reviews.text: We stayed here over July 4th Weekend whilst we were day tripping outside of Vegas. We found the hotel to be fair value for the time that we stayed. The location is superb and the pool was clean with fresh towels available. Parking was complimentary. The rooms feel a little jaded which is the only reason to knock off a star but overall you get exactly what you pay for, Staff were friendly and the great value bar in the casino was a great place to stop for an easy late night beer. You shouldn’t stay here expecting 5 star vegas but for what it is, the Best Western absolutely delivers and we would have no hesitation in staying again

reviews.title: Great location
reviews.text: This hotel is located on the strip across from the Mirage and Caesars. Easy access to all other resorts. The room was clean and even though no breakfast service at the hotel many options nearby. Diffinately would stay again.

reviews.title: Birthday celebration
reviews.text: We came out to celebrate a close friends birthday!  The manager Thomas and his staff were amazing! They were very accommodating and made sure we had the best time while staying at there hotel. We will definitely be back to stay there on our future trips to Vegas!

reviews.title: Great Budget Casino
reviews.text: Stayed here a couple of times now and enjoyed the stay. Rooms are great but it's not something that bothers me anyway. If you are going to Vegas to sit in your room, you're in the wrong place! Had a little problem with a leak in the bathroom but the lady at reception was really kind and apologetic and got it sorted out. The casino is in a great spot right in the middle of the strip. Next door is the Venetian, across the road is The Mirage. You have plenty of food outlets in the casino. Pizza Hut, Subway, White Castle, Foot long Hot Dogs (nice and cheap). Mcdonalds outside as well. Bottled beers are only $3 from the bar which is way cheaper than most other places. There is also a Walgreens next door so you can fill your fridge up if you want even cheaper beers! If you go to Harrah's next door yo can get the monorail which will take you to the north or south end of the strip for $5 each way. NO RIP OFF RESORT FEES ! When you are visiting from the UK and staying longer than most people do then resort fees add up. Like other people have mentioned there is a problem with homeless people hanging around outside in between Casino Royale and Harrah's. Overall this is a great little casino in a prime position in the middle of the strip.

reviews.title: Best Bargain for a Center Strip Stay
reviews.text: Needed to attend a professional education conference held at one of the fancy hotels but by staying at BWCR I saved at least 50% (hundreds of $$) rather than comparably sized room at the host venue. Because of its mid-strip location it's in walking distance of most of the destinations and has easy access to both the Deuce (Strip bus) and the LV Monorail.     As long as you regard the property fairly as a 2-star hotel and not unfairly compare it to the 4-star venues nearby, you'll be quite satisfied. I recommend asking for a room on the upper floors--I was initially on the 1st but captured at least bug (cricket or palmetto) a day. It's easy for them to come in and look for moisture with an access door midfloor and room doors have a major bottom gap. I was moved to the 3rd floor and there were no bugs.     There is a parking structure and it offers ample space, it's almost like a secret building. I have a larger vehicle and the space are actually roomy! Tip: enter from Koval, not from the Strip. You'll save yourself time and won't have to dodge the Strip walkers. The structure is purely functional, don't expect Disneyland cleanliness.     Dining options are good enough. There's Outback for table service. If you love sliders, rejoice as there's a White Castle right next door. The Subway in back will save you time waiting in line though.     CONS: They an emergency A/C repair scheduled for the 2nd night I would be there--notice was that there'd be no A/C (summer in Vegas!) for 8-10 hours. They would offer NO bill adjustments other than waiving cancellation fees (not very customer-centric). The front office staff however was excellent. I interacted with three employees and they were all helpful, courteous, professional, friendly, and looked out for my needs. So the staff is great, but be aware management seems to be about the bottom line and not the guests when there's a problem.     If you're looking for the Best Western free breakfast, this is not one of those venues. On the plus side there's a Denny's right next door to the north and a McDonalds to the south, so no problems finding a plate of eggs.     So if you're looking for lower cost Strip stay (I'll withhhold my comments about the Circus...) this is probably your best choice. Their casino machines are a bit limited. I like video poker but they mostly have slots.

reviews.title: Las Vegas's best hidden gem
reviews.text: We loved our stay at Best Western Plus Casino Royale! Staff was super friendly and accommodating. This hotel is located in the middle of the strip and has NO resort fees!! Their nightly rate was also very reasonable. The hotel area is very quiet and private. When we first walked in our room it was very clean and smelt clean as well. If your not looking for a big resort and wanting a smaller hotel mid strip, this is your hotel!!

reviews.title: Customer service is the best!
reviews.text: Excellent customer service! Thomas is always friendly and one of the best! Our room was clean and exceeded our expectations. The pool was clean and refreshing in the 100+degree days. This hotel never disappoints.

reviews.title: Nice but be careful
reviews.text: Great hotel 4 the lads if u r not bothered about some of the low life outside...1 word of caution....beware of some, not all bar tenders! We ordered vodka and tonic and one day.And he poured us water and tonic...on observation he was doing that 2 others to! Watch out!!!

reviews.title: Great Location
reviews.text: This Hotel /Casino is in a great Strip location opposite The Mirage. No resort fees. Fridge and coffee machine in room. Beers for 3$ on site. Small friendly hotel which makes you feel wanted. Free parking for guests with a car. Walgreens next door. However you do not get a strip view from your bedroom.

reviews.title: The worst overprised hotel I have ever had the displeasure of staying at!
reviews.text: Well..I just don't know where to start so I will start at the door...My wife and I taking a vacation. Thought because it was a Best Western Plus I might get some kind of tourist satisfaction. .WRONG! Homeless derelicts in tatters laying outside the entrance to the door leading to my hotel room. Human excrement and urine all up in the the parking structure that obviously the hotel does not care about since it was there during the whole duration of my 4 day 3 night stay. Drug dealers and thugs hanging around as if it were the neighborhood liqueur store. Rooms are small, shabby and itchy (most likely indicating that I wasn't alone) and the casino is a cheap knockoff that's run down and waiting to suck up all your cash. Incredible! Prices for this ghetto looking hotel are astronomical for a dump. Yeah the staff was nice but what angel ushers you into hell? I don't know what all these misinforming good reviews are about because I know for a fact that this place is old, smelly, ghetto and it sucks! I smell a fix. They had to have payed people to leave those good reviews. For the money they charge you can easily get a 4 or 5 star hotel on the strip or anywhere else in Las Vegas. Save yourself some heartache and disappointment and seek shelter elsewhere.

reviews.title: It's a Best Western on the strip
reviews.text: It's a Best Western on the strip.  Doesn't have all the fancy bells and whistles like the nearby resorts, BUT it's a nice, clean place to stay ON the strip.The Good,No resort fee.  Not a fan of the nickel and diming of resort fees.Right on the StripClose to the fancy resortsFridge in the roomRoom was clean and relatively up to dateHotel passageways clean and well lit.Was able to easily connect my Firestick to the TVGood speeds on the internet.  No problem streaming a movieNeed a hotel key card to enter the area with the hotel roomsThe badAC has one speed...high.  Sounded like a jet engine.Avoid first floor rooms.  One side is a sketch ally and the other is the back parking lot.The uglyLots of homeless in Vegas and the strip is no exception.  A number of them hanging out around the hotel entrance.   For the most part none of them bothered folksVegas does have it's share of unsavory characters as well.  I did feel a little unsafe in the area between the Casino Royal and Harrah's.   But it's also out in the open and busy area.  Just like everywhere else, don't let your guard down. This is my second stay at Casio Royal.  I received the AAA rate, my rate was less than what I'd pay at most of the on strip hotels that charge resort fees,

reviews.title: A true gem on the strip!
reviews.text: Centrally located, it is easy to overlook next to the bigger resorts. If you’re looking for a great value, this is the place. Had a great night sleep and enjoyed the casino. So easy to get anywhere on the strip. A little difficult to get to the parking garage, but it’s just past the green fence. Have fun!

reviews.title: A Great Find
reviews.text: I was so empresses with the staff, my room # and the location and the ease of staying here. I was looking to be in the center of the strip and I literally was. I loved the quiet pool in the morning, the snack bar and the games at the casino

reviews.title: Awful hotel
reviews.text: Recently stayed for 5 nights and i would never return. Location is good.Hotel awful. Felt quite unsafe when entering the hotel part as it is in the casino right by the door. Bedding was filthy, duvet had blood on it. rooms are VERY basic. Pool was so unappealing we left after 20 mins. Would not recommend.

reviews.title: Consistent Quality and Value
reviews.text: Each time we stay at the Casino Royale we get what we expect; quality, value, cleanliness, convenience.  Parking is a breeze and access to your room is done quickly.  You're next door to numerous food locations.  And being centrally located you're within moments of all the major entertainment facilities.

reviews.title: Best Deal on the Strtip
reviews.text: Never been to Las Vegas and had to blindly select a place for my family and friends.  We were pleasantly surprised that we could get an Inexpensive hotel with Free Parking, in a Great Location, that was Safe, Clean, Comfortable, with Good Amenities.

reviews.title: Will return when the rate is good
reviews.text: Pro : the parking is free and easy to get to. The location is very goodThe room has a large fridge No resort feeThe room was very clean Con : the toilet needs to be replaced it’s very old, it kept running all night It was difficult to control the airco The price that I have paid (weekend) was crazy and not worth the price I don’t like the carpet in the roomThe badroom is very small I had no view The blinds are very thin so when the sun comes up you are awake The walls are very thin so you can hear others speak

reviews.title: Unclean room
reviews.text: Entered room and bad smell. Toilet was not clean and the cause of the bad smell.  Areas of the rooms was not cleaned prior to my arrival. Staff was informed and simply stated they were sorry. Door lock did not work properly.  Since I was only sleeping there, I put up with it but won't return to that property

reviews.title: As Always, a Good Stay on the Strip
reviews.text: We've stayed here maybe 5 times now over the last 5 or 6 yrs. Its a convenient location, mid-strip.. its nothing fancy, really, but, thats what we like. No half mile walk from our room out to the strip. Maybe a hundred steps, if that. No breakfast, no exciting dayclub pool party scene. Does have a small pool, though. Just a quiet nights sleep in a decent room on the strip, minus the resort fees. Plenty of places to eat all around outside. A walgreens for essentials is maybe a half block north. Everything is right there, really.

reviews.title: Awesome Trip!
reviews.text: It's a smaller hotel in a big area, in between the Venetian and Harrahs, great location lots of food, grand canal shops just a short walk, rooms are on the smaller side but clean and looked recently painted. The refrigerator in the room is also a plus not many rooms in Vegas have them, staff was great asked for extra towels and a pillow within minutes had both. Nice parking garage in the back, and if they don't tell you there is a back way out of the garage that goes out beside Harrahs garage, bypasses the crowd on the blvd.

reviews.title: Great location, really free parking - but drawbacks.
reviews.text: Like most (every?) other hotel on The Strip you have to walk through the casino to get to your room.  The only alternative is a dirty and dangerous alley driveway.  The room was very small and badly in need of updating and refreshing.  Not dirty, just really used.  While considered deriguer in most locations, breakfast is not included in this hotel or most of its competitors.  Two big pluses:  free parking you do yourself so there is no need to tip someone (thus making it not free if you did) and location on The Strip within easy walking distance of many of the major attractions, casinos, bars and restaurants.  Despite being cramped, the room did have include a comfortable chair, not a desk chair but a place you could actually enjoy sitting.  Do not get a first floor room.  The rooms run along an alley that can be noisy and somewhat concerning, especially at night.

reviews.title: Clean, Friendly staff, economical
reviews.text: We came for a wedding. We had visited Las Vegas in Dec so we didn't want to spend a lot of money again. The best Western was in the middle of the strip, economically priced. When we got there I was a little taken aback because it's set back nothing fancy, but what was important to me was the cleanliness of the hotel which met my expectations, location was great and staff was very friendly.

reviews.title: Gem on the Strip
reviews.text: Convenient located hotel in the middle of The Strip. Awesome choice and reasonable prices for the overall package.No ressort fees and free parking, own structure in the back.Both Deuce stops (NB/SB) in like 100 yardsdistance.Sadly no breakfast, but Subway, PizzaHut and HotDogs stall at the back.They make you walk through the whole casino at checkin, but don‘t be fooled, there‘s a back entrance with an elevator.So no need to traipse through casino all the time.

reviews.title: Great location
reviews.text: Loved the location. Hotel is older, but very well maintained!! Customer service was very good, small pool was nice and clean, enjoyed having a Keurig coffee pot with lots of coffee. Bed was comfortable too!!

reviews.title: Great access to the Las Vegas strip but underwhelming room
reviews.text: The position of this hotel on the strip was great for sightseeing and was very affordable. But, that is about where the advantages end. The air in the room would not cool the room below 75 and the outside  temp was only mid 80's. The rooms are small with limited views. I get this an affordable spot but just a few perks could have made me ignore the faults. Be very careful as many homeless are around the parking lot as it is tucked behind the building. Overall if you just need somewhere to sleep within Vegas, this does the trick. If you are looking to take any family, you might want to look a little higher in accommodations.

reviews.title: Hotel is great - Casino not so much
reviews.text: The staff and accommodations were wonderful. My answers are based on the hotel only and not the the casino.  The casino, well not so much.  Very loud, very dirty and very smoky. Bar allows cigar smokers at the bar.  The rewards card was a joke. My wife got one and she was able to access the rewards offered (20 free play after playing through 20 dollars & another 20 after playing through 100) however, after I played over 20 and lost it all, the promo never game up.  Spoke with a casino attendant and he stated that because I had won that is was not available.  So for not winning, no promo no nothing. What a scam to collect people's identity's.

reviews.title: Table games are gone
reviews.text: We were very disappointed.  All table games have been removed.  We specifically chose this hotel because we often played blackjack and craps here.  The fact that there was no indication the games had been removed was very frustrating.

reviews.title: Suprisingly Disappointed
reviews.text: Staff is the best, but rooms need attention!  I have stayed at several different Best Western hotels in different states and I have always had a wonderful experience.  Rooms have been clean and staff has been great, but I was sadly disapponted with my BW Vegas stay.  The staff was amazing but the rooms were not clean and some things needed to be tended to by maintenance.  The hotel is in a prime location but the hotel rooms do need a deep cleaning.

reviews.title: BW - Convenient!!!
reviews.text: Our stay at the BW plus Casino Royale was great! So convenient in the center of the strip but also because we could run up to our room in 30-60 seconds from the strip to pick something up or drop something off.

reviews.title: Low key, the best spot on the strip!
reviews.text: Let's be honest here, when we go to Vegas we are just looking for a place to lay our heads that's convenient to traverse the Strip.  This place fits that bill perfectly.  If you want a suite or a fancy schmancy room to hang out and waste your time in Vegas, this is not the place.  If you want a comfortable, clean room with a great central location for all your walkabout needs this is the place.  A few other highlights would be, no resort fee, free parking, and the cheapest bar on the Strip, with prices that are the same as my first visit back in 2018, and likely longer!

reviews.title: Fantastic location, just what you'd expect
reviews.text: This is exactly what you'd expect in a Best Western --- good but not great accommodations, excellent wi-fi, very reasonable prices. The location is excellent. Easy walking up and down the Strip; easy access to / from the free parking on the Strip or behind the Strip; very helpful staff, and daily housekeeping! (Even Hilton's don't clean daily any more. But this Best Western does!) Views from the rooms are dreary, as is the casino (which you have to walk through to get to the front desk). If you need a great view from your room, stay elsewhere. But if you want inexpensive, walkable, great location, standard-decent accommodations, and nice people, the Casino Royale works. And Betsy at the front desk was a delight!

reviews.title: Great Location and Rates
reviews.text: The ambiance of this property is wonderful. The staff is very helpful. Our only issue was the third night of our stay, the sink backed up and we had to move to another room. It wasn't until after our second call down that we were offered the opportunity to move as our first call did not produce any results or any one coming up to even check on what was being reported.

reviews.title: OK hotel and casino, great location
reviews.text: This hotel does not charge for parking and also does not have resort fees.  The location is center strip, directly across the street from the Mirage.  There was a great view of the volcano that errupts nightly.  It is a sight to see!  Every staff member I encountered was extremely friendly and helpful.  I commend the secuirty staff and the way they controlled things professionally.  I would not bring small children to any Las Vegas trip.  The location of the hotel is perfect for getting around the area by foot or by car.

reviews.title: THE WORST AND TREAT SENIORS TERRIBLE
reviews.text: Ruined my 60TH Birthday and given oneof the worst rooms because I spoke for myself.  Unprofessional and uneducated. No pride in their appearance especially the front desk people. I called twice and was told my 2 days was confirmed and paid. That was a lie

reviews.title: Clean, Comfortable with Fantastic Location!
reviews.text: Clean and comfortable with a location on the strip that is half the price of neighboring hotels. Minimal time to check in / out. Gambling floor felt safe at all hours. Hotel guests were quiet during night hours.Staff was very friendly. Highly recommend - hope to be back soon!

reviews.title: Wonderful stay
reviews.text: Service was fast. Toilet clogged and staff was up in our room in 5 minutes. The rooms are always nice and clean with a safe, coffee maker and fridge. I have been going there for over 25 years and I know most of the staff. They are friendly and I feel safe there. There are a lot of homeless people; but isn't that everywhere. Just be aware of your surroundings and if someone is bothering you there is security staff all over the casino.

reviews.title: Best of both worlds in Las Vegas
reviews.text: We chose this hotel as it's location is perfect and there was no rip off resort fee added to our bill.I've stayed in the big resort hotels in the past, but this was better. Where they had the 20 minute walk, just to get from room to outside the hotel, we managed it in less than a minute. And unlike the big places, this has character!The choice of eateries here is great. We did Denny's, Outback Steakhouse, Nathans Hotdogs and Pizza Hut. All excellent.The casino was great and the slots paid much better than MGM Grand, Caesar's, Bally's etc.The room was large, had a fully stocked coffee maker, free internet and plenty of channels on the large screen tv.All the staff that we encountered were very pleasant and polite.Will definitely be back.

reviews.title: Dirty /not safe
reviews.text: The casino was full of homeless people at night. They watch you play and follow you around. I did not feel safe being in there alone. Someone was sitting by the room entrance selling drugs. The security didn’t care. The elevator broke and my friends got stuck. We had no apologies or anything to try to accommodate the distress. The halls were stained and dirty. The rooms were clean, the air conditioning did not work or maybe they control it.

reviews.title: Everything You Need .
reviews.text: I previously reviewed C.R. 2 years ago and wasn't impressed by their cleanliness .However ,all the other reviews said it was very clean so we gave it another and I'm so glad we did .We have just returned from a week there and we had a great time . The staff were helpful and friendly and made us welcome .There is no resort fee at this hotel which is a big plus .Also you have a Keurig coffee machine and a fridge in your room - pretty rare for Vegas now .A microwave is by the vending machine ,there is free wifi and a room with a printer , computer - so handy for printing off boarding passes and checking on flights .Just use your room key to access it .The casino is literally right there as there are only 3 floors to this hotel , and so you can be out of the hotel in minutes .No walking miles just to leave the building .You are smack bang in a great location on the strip - by Harrahs , the LINQ ,Mirage , Flamingo's , The Cromwell , Ballys to name but a few .Denny's and Walgeen's  are on your doorstep for cheap eats and water /snacks .It really is the gem on the strip !

reviews.title: Have stayed here several times
reviews.text: We have stayed at this property several times on our latest trips to Las Vegas. Just a great location. Really like this hidden gem on the Strip. Their parking garage is so handy and love the older style Casino. Rooms are clean, comfortable and fairly updates. Easy access to the strip and casino. Re ommend it and plan to stay there again

reviews.title: THE Place to Stay
reviews.text: Location was perfect - across from the Mirage, steps away from Caesars, next door to the Venetian, Harrah's and the monorail.  Parking was uncomplicated.  Next door to McD's, Panda Express, White Castle, Subway and $2.49 foot long hot dogs.  Rooms were clean and comfortable.  Towels were soft.  It's only 3 stories tall with a small casino on the ground floor which makes using the elevator and getting a seat at the slots very easy and enjoyable.  Truly a place you should consider for your next stay in Las Vegas.  I know I will be returning!

reviews.title: Hidden Gem on the Strip
reviews.text: The location of this hotel can't be beat. Right in the middle of the strip. Easy walk to the majority of the larger resorts. Free parking. No long walks from the parking garage to your room or the casino. Lots of places to eat within a 5 minute walk. Walgreens and White Castle next door. Check in and out is easy. Staff friendly, available and helpful. Always clean, beds are very comfortable.

reviews.title: Cheap, Great location, but NO AIR CONTROL 80 DEGREE ROOM
reviews.text: This property is in a good location on the strip at a fairly cheap price. That's all the good I have to say about it... We stayed 3 nights in December and our room was 80 degrees everyday the air does not cool it down only heat. We contacted the desk at first they sent someone up and determined it was broke then we was informed it was not in fact broke that the system will not run AC if the heat is on in the whole building. We could open the window, which was overlooking an ally where trash trucks and semis unloaded and made all kinds of noise all night. Along with not so quiet people smoking. The lady told us basically to just deal with it there was nothing they could do sleep with the window open or sleep in 80degees. The casino was clean but security let's some homeless people and drug dealers walk around inside the casino, I was asked by a guy in dirty clothing carrying a 12 pack of beer if I knew where to get any crack. Which he was not far off because I hard people selling stuff in the bathroom....if your looking for a cheap place to stay and be super warm In the room with no individual control on your temperature and don't mind dirty people asking you for crack, this is the place for you

reviews.title: Little Gem
reviews.text: I like a best western, but had never stayed here.  Was attracted by the cheap rate, free parking, and lack of resort fee.  I have to say that it was also those things that made me slightly nervous as to what we would get.  The hotel is small compared to its neighbours.  Our room was very quiet, and clean  it had everything we needed.  It is a fab location, really close to so many things.    We didn't want any frills, with so much on the doorstep, we just wanted a safe clean comfortable place to sleep, and this ticked the boxes for us.

reviews.title: Looks rough, but shockingly safe and clean! Pleasant experience!
reviews.text: First yes, the outside of this place has seen better days, and depending on the crowd in the casino at the time it appears seedy or run down, but my husband and I found this place by accident and were shocked and pleasantly surprised at the hospitality and facilities. This review is ONLY about the casino, not the hotel (both are attached). Each Best Western is independently owned and operated, and accordingly to a cashier in the casino, this is the last independently owned facility on the Strip. We were walking by on one of our last nights in Vegas and came in to play slots. They have a $20 promotion, so we played low level slots and each had a beer (bottle beers are $3, large cups are $10). All brand name stuff, and they had hard liquor for sale as well. Although the crown gambling were heavy smokers, all of the doors were opened to the place and there was a lot of light and fresh air coming in. The casino (in spite of the smoke) was clean, safe for women, and the bathrooms were neat and tidy. At the back of the casino is a standing-only cafeteria bar that serves $2.99 hotdogs, drinks, and there's a 24 hour Denny's, but I didn't see it. The hotel itself has been remodeled along with all the rooms, so this would be a great place for a group of guys or girls who want to party but also save money. As it's near the rougher, more crowded end of the Strip, I wouldn't recommend this place for kids or families. We plan to definitely return, as the slots had a high payout for us, and were much cheaper than those at the Aria or Bellagio. If you want a place that saves you money and you don't care about the ambiance, come here to play, have a drink, or get a room for the night without paying through the nose.

reviews.title: Staff is lacking any friendliness
reviews.text: Elia was the only nice front desk staff member, all of the housekeepers were very friendly. Everyone else would not care to help you or try to hang up on you. They did not care I was a diamond select member who requested a low floor, they put me on the 4th floor next to garbage trucks who were beeping all night.

reviews.title: No Resort Fees, Free Parking And On Strip
reviews.text: Chose this property due to it being on the strip (across street from Mirage) and no Resort Fees  (not paying for something I’m not going to use) plus free parking. Staff was pleasant, no rude encounters with front desk personnel and when I couldn’t open room safe due to low battery, security came to room within minutes of my request, no long wait. Television has good selection of channels and no problem with free internet speed. Rooms are decent sized with a mini frig and pod coffee maker, bathrooms are small though w shower/tub combo, would be difficult to have more than one person in bathroom at a time. I was right by elevator and room was quiet. Do think doors should be a little more secure as it seemed if someone wanted to push hard with shoulder could get it open. Felt room was clean and hallways seemed to be kept clean. Would suggest better quality of pillows as only 3 small ones on king size bed and all were soft so maybe a variety.  Not a large but at least a choice of eating places in hotel. Have read other reviews about homeless bugging people, did not encounter that problem, yes did see a few in parking area however they are on strip as well and will not judge someone who is experiencing difficulties, just say like anywhere you go be aware of surroundings. Because of location and other amenities would stay again.

reviews.title: Great location & rates, not so great layout.
reviews.text: I liked this place. It’s centrally located and it had a great price. I strongly recommend for an adult or couple who want an inexpensive Vegas Strip experience.  I only have two complaints.  1) The AC didn’t work the best.   2) The layout is not very good. a) The entrance to the hotel rooms are in a different location from the front desk. Someone will have to show you.b) Some of the rooms are very far from the entrance.  Ask for a low room number, ignoring the floor. Example: Room 401 is much better then room 249.

reviews.title: Not as Good as expected
reviews.text: This hotel was conveniently located in the center of the boulevard. Plenty of places to eat in the area. The room  was comfortable. However, we did experience Marihuana odor coming under the door to our room which was not good. This hotel does not provide a taxi service for its guest to get to the airport when you are ready to leave. They ask you to walk over to Harrah's hotel to their taxi pick up location. So if it's busy, you may wait a long time before you can get a cab. This is not ideal to get to the airport on time. We were lucky that a taxi pulled up at the hotel back entrance for another matter and he volunteered to take us to the airport.

reviews.title: Clean room, easy parking, no resort fee!!
reviews.text: I go to Vegas once a year usually and over time my needs have shifted. I am not interested in all the amenities that the large resorts offer and therefore do not like paying the extra $30 per day on top of room charges for the “resort fee” just for the convenience of staying on the Strip. This is why I like this Best Western. Also, if driving into Vegas the parking here is awesome. I came and went and I always had the same spot in the garage when returning! Being able to walk only 2 minutes from car to room is a nice bonus.Basically, if you are looking for a simple hotel without all the extra bells and whistles and want to be relatively centralized on the strip you could do A LOT worse than here. The staff was very friendly too and did a great job of keeping the hallways and walkways clean and tidy.

reviews.title: Best location
reviews.text: Very clean, very safe, and the location is excellent. Many nearby restaurants to eat at, Denny’s, White Castle, Outback Steakhouse, Pizza Hut and many more. The price is right the best on the strip no doubt.

reviews.title: great place to stay
