reviews.text: we booked a king sized bed room for 5 nights. it was clean, and the room was a good sized, plus the room included a fridge and a coffee maker! how many hotels in vegas offer those free in room. oh plus this place has NO RESORT FEE! the only issue we had was with the AC not working 100% but its cause its an old property so its a central unit for all the rooms so u can only control it so much, but the window opens so we just left the window open to get it cooler. its a small property so its easy to get from the casino to your room in like 5 minutes. theres a Walgreens next door for cheap drinks and snacks, plus theres a Denny's, a Outback Steakhouse, White Castle right there connected to the hotel. the casino its self is small but its got alot of slots. it had a strong smoke smell to it (didn't bother me) so if you dont like cigarette smoke id avoid it. definitely recommend signing up for their players club. the 1st $20 you spend on slots they give you another $20 of free-play. it was a great stay overall. ill definitely will be back.

reviews.title: Excellent assistance at al times
reviews.text: This Best Western was right on the strip next to Venetian and across street from Mirage and Treasure Island. NO RESORT FEES!!The room has a Keurig and a refrigerator and a microwave in the lobby.There are numerous eateries. In BW is Fat Tuesday, Subway , Pizza Hut and Nathan Hot Dogs.  Literally out the front door is Outback and Dennys(24hr) and a Walgreens(24hr)The staff is excellent.I went over to the BW day before check in and asked for an early check in on my arrival date(I was at another hotel that was going for 700$ a night with 50$ per resort fee and I stayed at that hotel first 3 night as it was reasonable for mid week)The receptionist said as long as rooms were ready I could check in.  I got there at 2pm. Checked in.They gave me a room near the mid hallway elevator...which was great for me and my bad back and my luggage situation. Those room numbers are 225, 223, 323, 325, 125, 123. When I checked out my flight was at 1145p. I left my luggage with them and then went and had lunch. Played a few slots and then returned to the hotel lobby area and ELLA came up to me and said I could sit in the business center and got away from the noise in the casino. What a difference it made, Her kindness and thoughtfulness. Realizing my 12 hour wait for my flight home. I will be back to BW when I come back to Vegas.

reviews.title: Located in a great area
reviews.text: Hotel is at the heart of the strip. Very accessible and easy to find parking. Right next door you have panda, chipotle, and mcdonald's. You can access CVS and the castle restaurant from inside the hotel. The volcano eruption is literally across from the hotel. Other nice hotel are within walking distance. Rooms are a little outdated but the beds are comfy and there is a mini fridge.

reviews.title: Fabulous location!
reviews.text: This hotel is right in the heart of the Vegas Strip and is close to just about everything. A first floor room has never happened for me in Vegas before so that was a nice treat. I would return in the future for the location alone.

reviews.title: Perfect price and location
reviews.text: The Casino Royale was perfect for our stay in Vegas. Very reasonable in price and the location was excellent. Free parking, no resort fee with coffee and a fridge in the room. Definitely will stay here again.

reviews.title: Great Location-Good Value
reviews.text: Bare bones but pretty clean room in an excellent location—within walking distance to tons of attractions and restaurants. The room was surprisingly quiet, and the property still provides daily housekeeping.

reviews.title: Best Western in downtown Las Vegas
reviews.text: If you want to stay on the Las Vegas Strip without paying the prices of those famous high-rise hotels, the Best Western Casino Royale is the place for you!  You’ll be right in the heart of the city near all the famous attractions.  Our room was clean, comfortable, and surprisingly quiet for being downtown.   A free parking area is included.  A man greeted us upon arrival, and helped us find the check-in desk on the other side of the casino.  Watch carefully for the driveway into the Best Western because it’s easy to miss.We had just one issue.  We couldn’t control the thermostat in our room, so we couldn’t get the room temperature to our liking.

reviews.title: Good stay except for sewage smell at guest entrance from parking lot
reviews.text: Not having been to Vegas in 18 y, I chose this resort due to location, reviews, no resort fee, and the fact that there wasn’t a mile long walk to get to our room. It was a fine, comfortable room, with the perfect weight comforter on the bed. There was no separate hotel lobby- the reception desk was in the middle of the casino. Friendly reception and casino staff. The only unpleasantness was the sewage stench permeating the casino from the parking lot entrance.  We probably won’t be back to Vegas again, but after seeing how the strip has changed, with no taxis on the strip, and needing to go to a shared Uber pickup spot in the back of Harrahs, I would stay there instead.

reviews.title: Best value on the Strip
reviews.text: Great location.  Very clean.  Room was nice.  Very quiet.  Free, secure parking garage.  Nice pool. No resort fees.  Reasonable rates.  Close to everything you want to see.  McDonalds next door for great coffee.  Room was nice size.  Front desk staff was friendly.

reviews.title: Casino Royale
reviews.text: This hotel met our needs just fine.  The room was clean, bed was comfortable. Bathroom was clean. There is a refrigerator and a Keurig, the bigger hotels don't have that .... well, they do, but you have to pay more.  Plus, THERE IS NO RESORT FEE AT CASINO ROYALE, like  there is at the big hotels.  The pool was the perfect size, my husband and I had it to ourselves which was nice. We will definitely stay there again if we go back to Vegas.

reviews.title: Best Value on the Strip
reviews.text: We always stay at this hotel when we are in Vegas.  It's not a big showy elaborate hotel like MGM or Caesar's or the others, so if that's what you are looking for, this won't suit you.  But, we love it because it has the amenities we want - a coffee machine (!! - yes, those fancy Vegas hotels don't have that!!), a mini-frig, no parking fees, no resort fees.  Plus, it is right on the Strip - step out the door and you are there!  The Mirage Volcano is directly across the street.  Their casino is small but their Rewards program is great.  The rooms are decent size, small bathrooms but good showers, and the beds are comfortable.  Due to COVID, rooms are only cleaned when requested but that suits us just fine.  Again, it's not a fancy place but it is comfortable, in a great location, and a great value.

reviews.title: Amazing stay great customer service
reviews.text: When checking in there was NO LINE walked right in got helped right away. Love that its small and easy going. Tina (front desk lady that checked us in) was amazing great smile helped with parking pass and making extra keys Manager is doing an amazing job with his team and crew there keep up all the great work and ill be staying again very soon!

reviews.title: A Small Oasis in the Middle of Madness
reviews.text: A lot of people may not know about the Royale but its a fun little place to spend some hours gambling.  Slots are pretty loose and the variety of games is quite good for the limited space here.  Make sure you get a players card--the rewards are really good--earned nearly $100 in food comps in just a few days playing.  Cocktail service is OUTSTANDING!  Tip your server and she'll be around every 10-15 minutes to see if you're okay.  Drinks are not too strong nor watered down.  Bottled beer at the bar is $3--best deal on the Strip!  They've done away with their table games--presumably due to Covid--but the table games were good--great craps and blackjack--hopefully it'll return.Rooms are recently remodeled but nothing too fancy....clean, comfortable and the staff is very friendly.  Only drawback to the Royale is getting there--the entrance to the parking area is tucked between the buildings and unless you know it is there, you might drive around the block multiple times.

reviews.title: Real Customer Service.
reviews.text: Casino Royale the best spot on the strip. Nice pool, the rooms are good size, cold AC. Great customer service, nice place to gamble and have a little fun. Walking distance to dining and other Strip Casino's.  Outback Steakhouse, take the elevator or a short walk up the steps. Food court at the back of the Casino.

reviews.title: Nice Little place to stay.
reviews.text: This little gem was one of the best deals on the Las Vegas Strip during the busy season. Rooms are clean and well managed. Check in was a breeze, check out was quick. I will return and spend more time in this hotel.

reviews.title: Middle of Huge Hotels
reviews.text: Why expensive hotels?? Unless it's your first date with someone. I used to check-in with my young family in a family-oriented hotels, tried expensive hotels too for experience. My first time here at Best Western - Center Strip last weekend. As part of the name implies (Center Strip), it's in the middle of actions, and walking distances to nearby huge hotels and restaurants. With free parking, no resort fee, are plus savings. If you are only using the room to take a little rest and retire for the night, this is the best I can recommend.

reviews.title: Worst Hotel Stay Ever
reviews.text: Front desk when coming in was extremely rude. Seemed as if we were bothering her when checking in. Shower was falling apart. Several transients followed us in to the hotel from the casino (you had to have a room key to access). We a transient smoking CRACK AT ONE OF THE SLOT MACHINES!!! Have no idea where any security was! We will never stay here again.

reviews.title: Perfect location
reviews.text: The hotel may not be glamorous but that is one of the best parts. It is what it is a hotel. The room was a good size bed was comfortable air and tv worked. The location was key  you are smack dab in the heart of the strip. Plus NO RESORT FEE!! Thank you for that also

reviews.title: Good Value
reviews.text: The property itself is a bit tired overall, but the value is there.  The location right on the strip made the overall experience worth it.  I would stay there again for the money.  Make sure you get directions to the parking garage as it is hard to find on your first visit.

reviews.title: Unexpected gem with few flaws.
reviews.text: Affordable accommodations with an excellent location on the Las Vegas strip. The room was quiet, comfortable, and clean. The rest of the property was a little "tired." Polite and helpful staff. A lot of convenient foods options nearby. Ample free parking.

reviews.title: An absolute grimey dump!!!
reviews.text: This place is an ABSOLUTE DUMP!!! Came here on business for a conference and the moment I walked in I wanted to puke. The best way I can describe it is grimey. It old and not well cleaned. Aside for shoddy service at check in, my safe not working and my toilet poorly flushing, my bathroom had hair that was not mine around the surround of the tub. I was there for 3 nights and it was never cleaned ( despite telling Allan at the front desk about it). As I was getting in the bed, I took my socks off and there was long blond hair stuck to my sock… again not my hair.  Just all around filthy.  Only thing going for it is the location.

reviews.title: Great Place
reviews.text: Laurie did a wonderful job as always, our last stay Tina also did an amazing job with our EARLY check it. This time the manager or GM I forgot his name he came to our room fixed our remote and went above and beyond our expectations. The staff here are alway courteous and friendly making you want to stay over and over as we have :-) the BW Mobil app showed it was sold out but two different times they made special accommodations. The hotel is conveniently located in the middle of everything. If your not looking for anything fancy this is the place and when I say fancy I’m talking about resort, water slides etc. THIS is the place. The rooms are nice, great working order, the decor is updated the beds are comfortable and when you close the curtains it’s really dark. You have to be careful because it can cause you to sleep in hahaha

reviews.title: WOW! What a wonderful place!
reviews.text: Hubby and I had a wonderful stay here! Clean, and VERY safe.  We were in room 135 and it was perfect! I felt safe here and in the small casino.  No resort fees! Pool area was clean and also safe.  Right across the street from the Mirage and within walking distance of Caesar's Palace! We will be back!

reviews.title: Hidden but worth the find
reviews.text: I've walked by the Casino Royale countless times in our previous Vegas trips and I know that I must've seen the Best Western signage but it never clicked. We even ate in the Outback restaurant upstairs and didn't realize there was actually a hotel there. Centrally located on the strip, making it very convenient for shows and attractions at the major casino/hotels. Across the street from Caesar's Palace and the Mirage. Very clean and surprisingly quiet. Small rooms, but since basically it's just for sleeping in the town that never sleeps, it is exactly what you need. Clean room, clean, comfortable bedding, clean bathroom. All in all, an outstanding place to stay. No resort fees and very affordable. Especially for the location. We've done the Paris and others on the strip before, stayed off-strip as well. This was the best place for us. We will definitely stay here again when we travel to Vegas.

reviews.title: Excellent
reviews.text: Perfectly located in the center of the strip. Everything was very clean and the hallways and room did not smell like cigarettes or pot, which is a nice change from a lot of hotels in Vegas. A little hard to get in and out of since you can only get to the parking garage from the Strip, but we will definitely stay again our next trip!

reviews.title: Best location, best hotel, best price
reviews.text: This is my favorite hotel on the strip because it is clean, has everything u need, the location is awesome and NO RESORT FEES!! The staff is wonderful and always make me feel welcomed every time I've stayed. I hardly tell anyone about this hotel because I like keeping this gem all to myself.

reviews.title: Not to friendly.  Saw a guy passed out at a slot machines. Security just walked right by did nothing.
reviews.text: Not to friendly.  Saw a guy passed out at a slot machines. Security just walked right by did nothing.

reviews.title: Better than expected
reviews.text: I read previous reviews about the property and they are true (the parking garage is small, sketchy and smells like pee and the rooms are sorta in a back alley, though indoors hallway us accessed via keycard), but the pros outweigh the cons if you know what you're getting. Being right on the Strip is amazing. Access to many food options on property is great (I only ate ate Outback and got a drink at Fat Tuesday, but both had excellent service and food), no resort fee, good room rates (for Vegas) and less crowds are all worth it to me. Room was comfy and fridge was a definite plus.

reviews.title: Conveniently located to restaurants and casinos
reviews.text: Check in/out was super easy!  Room was very clean, the a/c worked well (important after a day at the Grand Canyon). Bed was very comfy, casino downstairs along with food options and a Fat Tuesday. This was a quick trip and suited us well!

reviews.title: Poor customer service
reviews.text: Pool was closed 3 days when we asked when it would be available we were told to just walk to a hotel next door and use the pool there (not a Best Western hotel) and if we didn't want to do that we could check out and find another hotel to stay at. The   room smelt like smoke and you could hear every conversation the room next door was having like they were in the same room with you .

reviews.title: Good little motel on the strip
reviews.text: This motel is in a good location the rooms aren’t to far from casino or strip the parking is a little confusing but other than that a descent motel on the strip centrally located across from the mirage

reviews.title: Very convenient location, and very inexpensive
reviews.text: Our first impression walking into the Casino Royale was that it was very dark and kinda crowded. It gave me a weird feeling, but I brushed it off. We checked in (very short line) and it was fast, and then went to go to the guest rooms. There's a secured room-key entry door that leads to the guest rooms, which the keys we received never worked with it. (thankfully other people were with us). There were 4 floors and we were on 3rd, which was a very short walk compared to any other hotel in Vegas. When we got to the room it was very clean and quiet, and the layout of it was very convenient. It had a fridge to store food items but no microwave. Overall, the rates are well worth what you're getting. (No resort fees either!). I'd definitely consider staying here again when in Vegas due to the location and how well kept the rooms are. I also love the exterior of the hotel! Very aesthetically pleasing.

reviews.title: Good Stay on the Strip
reviews.text: Location was excellent. On the strip within walking distance of most major sites, but back from the street noises far enough for a perfect night's sleep. Room had everything we needed except a microwave.

reviews.title: Best western
reviews.text: Fun and affordable. I would definitely stay with the Best Western Casino Royal The staff was fun and friendly along with maki g you feel right at he!!! Thanks Best Western team for making my family and I feel great on our wedding/vacation!

reviews.title: Surprisingly Nice.
reviews.text: Extremely clean room(kudos to house keeping).Basic room with comfortable king bed, coffee maker, refrigerator, and large flat screen TV. No microwave. Plenty of hot water and good water pressure.Can’t ask for more fore the price. One has to walk through the casino to get to the front desk.

reviews.title: Friendly, helpful staff and clean rooms
reviews.text: Stayed for 3 nights.  Good price for the location and the pool is clean, has towels, and 3 loungers only. Fitness center was still closed due to the Virus.  Need to walk some distance to get Uber/Lyft back to LAS and the pickup point is NOT easy to find.

reviews.title: Amazingly convenient
reviews.text: From check-in until check-out, it was a seamless experience.  We had a suite that had a living area with two couches and a mini-fridge, a separate bedroom with a king-sized bed, and a beautiful bath with a jetted tub and separate large shower.  Free parking and no resort fee were a rare find-- and very much appreciated.  All the staff from housekeeping to front desk to the restaurant hosts and servers and bartenders all sought to make sure our anniversary stay was perfect.  And it was.  The convenient location was the icing on the cake.

reviews.title: Great place to stay
reviews.text: We enjoyed our stay. The swimming pool was open which made the kids happy. That's always a Plus. The perfect place to stay and the hotel/casino is on the strip next to the Venetian and walking distance to the Fashion Show Mall.

reviews.title: Typical BW combined with casino in perfect location on the strip
reviews.text: Stayed one night.  Small casino and restaurants.  Rooms are sectioned off and separate from the casino.  Nice clean rooms.  Exceptional service.  Thomas at the front desk went above and beyond to help me.  Free parking, and no resort taxes.  If you are a loyal BW member, I would highly recommend.

reviews.title: Central location and clean room, but much lower level than all other Best Western Plus that we’ve used.
reviews.text: Central location and clean room, but much lower level than all other Best Western Plus that we’ve used.

reviews.title: hotel room very good, surrounding not so
reviews.text: We arrived at the casino at midnight. Unfortunately the hotel registration is located in the middle of the building, which means walking through the crowds and smoke filled casino. The first impression was bad, the casino itself and the adjacent hotel building look tired and scruffy. It was also quite dirty that night but by the morning some cleaning had been done. No complaints about the room which was of sufficient size and comfort or the tiny but functional bathroom. Both were spotlessly clean. BW provided white, soft towels; very good sheets, and a comfortable mattress assured a restful sleep. Parking the rental car was no problem. The parking garage was almost empty during our 4 nights stay. The best about this hotel is the location in the center of the action. It’s wedged in between the Venetian and the Harrah’s and across from the Mirage and Treasure Island. If they could clean up and modernize the general areas it could be an altogether enjoyable stay.

reviews.title: Good location
reviews.text: I stay regularly at both Best Western inns and Las Vegas hotels. I’ve probably stayed at most of the strip and downtown casino hotels by now. As a Best Western inn, it’s fairly typical of other basic Best Western inns, minus the breakfast they give you at other Best Western inns. As a casino hotel, it’s a couple of notches below a place like Bellagio. I wasn’t sure if I should rate it as an inn or resort, so I’ll just identify what I liked and disliked about the place. Liked: 1. Location. It’s right on the strip. 2. No resort fee. What they advertise is actually what they charge. 3. Friendly check in. After he checked us inn, the desk clerk led us towards the elevator. He also let us check in early at no fee because we are diamond members. 4. Not huge. I’ve stayed at the really huge hotels like MGM and found that it seems to take forever to get to and from your room. It  is much quicker to get to your room at this inn. Disliked1. The location of our room. Room 200 that we were in was close to the Strip and faced Harrah’s.  It was noisy at night. If you’re not the late-night party sort of person, ask for a room back away from the Strip where you may not hear all of the Strip noise. 2. Lack of meticulous attention to cleanliness. Our guest room windows were dirty. For the two days we were at the inn, the indoor stairway leading to our room had debris on it and also a slice of lemon that was never picked up. 3. Lighting in guest room. We would have preferred softer lighting. The bulbs gave off a harsh white light in both the bedroom and bathroom. 4. Wide wooden blind slats instead of darkening curtains. Light leaked through those slats. 5. Lack of hot tub. There was an outdoor pool, but no hot tub. Overall, the price we paid for the nights we stayed was fair and we got points for our stay.

reviews.title: Location and price is all I can say about this place.
reviews.text: The rooms are not right on the strip...there is no view. The have a parking garage but it does not connect to the hotel or the lobby. When you check in and park you must walk through the entire casino to get to the lobby. They did a temperature check on each person, so everyone must go in. We unloaded our stuff, got it to the room then had to go move the car. Not a handy place for people who are elderly or can't get around well. Our room was nice but small. Our view was a wall of the parking garage. The internet did not work. I called the number provided for service but she was unable to get it connected or working. I love how they act like you don't know how to connect your phone and it's all your fault. I gave her all the IP numbers and everything she asked for and she couldn't even get the internet to work. I couldn't find a hair dryer in the bathroom. I later found it in the floor of the closet. The refrigerator did not have a freezer space. I had to ask for extra pillows and they were delivered to our room within five minutes. The lady at the front desk even called back to confirm that I got them. The location is great for visiting the strip, it's about in the middle. The parking is free and the price can't be beat. They just need to do something about the check in. Also when you enter the parking garage you have to go left, if you go right you end up in the employee parking area and you can't park there. don't forget to put your parking pass in the car once you get it.

reviews.title: Great value!
reviews.text: This hotel is right on the strip, but still inexpensive and NO RESORT FEE!  The rooms are fine, nothing special, but the location and value are excellent.  I had a pickup with furniture loaded in the back.  When I mentioned that, they suggested I park in the “check in only” spaces which are the highest traffic, most watched location to get added security.  They truly did care about helping us out!  We will be back!  My wife, who hates Vegas, even liked the stay.

reviews.title: Valentines/ birthday/ babymoon
reviews.text: Worse hotel in Vegas you can stay. My wife and I stayed during valentines day weekend.  We were asked to leave the first morning we were there due to our service dogs. Cause they were barking. And we had a very rude couple/family or individual next door to us. After we specifically requested to be put at the end of the hall way. We messaged the property a week in advanced to verify details about our service dogs. They were aware they were chihuahuas prior to our stay.  Only after the complaints were made,they offered a room at the end of the hall.After the drama and embarrassment it wasn't worth taking a chance..After they came to our room door with security and had the security guard baby sit the door while we vacated the room. The manager that was on the clock that day verified not once but twice that I would be receiving my cash back given they placed the money on a hold.  Once I was checked out and packed I went to retrieve my 316.08 and was told "oh it has to go back to the card" I have no cash available.  How do you not have cash when you are a casino for god sake. Privately owned at that. From what I was told after I left and made my attempts to get my $ back. It's March 2nd and I'm still waiting for my money to be released from me. The bank stated that best western puts a 21day hold on funds in the event of charges. The hotel manager blames the bank. For not releasing the funds. When all it takes is a simple piece of paper to verify with the bank they are no longer charging. I will never stay at a best western again... I was embarrassed, disrespected, disappointed with customer service & care. Top it off my wife is pregnant at the time she was 12weeks along.

reviews.title: Hidden Gem on the Strip
reviews.text: Where not sure what we would see when we checked in since we had read a couple of bad reviews of the property, but after checking we were very satisfied with all aspects of the property including the parking, front desk staff, cleanliness of the room, size of the room and direct access to the Strip. Don't know what happened to the couple of people that had put in a poor review, but we were very happy and definitely would stay there again. The small size of the facility also made it so easy to just go down the elevator right out  the front door to the Strip. Great location, right across from Caesar's and ton's of affordable eating places within a couple minutes walk. Small casino, no frills but gave you more of the "old Las Vegas" feel. Room was probably the cleanest we have had for a long time.

reviews.title: Not great
reviews.text: I’ve been to Vegas many times and stays have ranged from motels (back in my college days) to higher end hotels as an adult.  We chose this location as a last minute, day off arrival given the cost and central location of the property - which you really can’t beat. The room was clean, they didn’t charge for parking or a resort fee (not sure how they could since it is no where near resort level) and they had great customer service. But that’s it for the good stuff. They rooms were small and walls were super thin. We heard every door slam, the water running upstairs and vacuuming.  The AC unit also is a joke as it didn’t work. On both nights our room got up to 77 degrees, when it was around 40s outside. So when you open the window to cool the room down, within minutes you’re freezing. Our room also faced the alleyway which was loud due to service trucks. I would stay here again but only as a last resort.

reviews.title: Noisier than cheapo Motel 6, HVAC doesn't work
reviews.text: Room was completely unusable and they need their franchise pulled.I went thru:-3 sets of keys-Security only being able to use their master key successfully 50% of the time- banging and shaking from the room next door and overhead until past midnight-the AC and circulating fan failing around 2AM and waking up to a broiling room at 300AM.-Front desk did not send somebody up, suggested I open the window to the lit alley way where *industrial* quantities of marijuana and other drugs were being smoked just below the window. -Front desk finally calling security to come and inspect the HVAC after the 3rd call and 20 minutes. They got the fan to turn on in neutral/fan only.-Another recirculating fan failure, and the *heat* coming on full blast. Would not shut off.- Finally, an hour and a half later(430AM), a standalone fan was brought up and the room HVAC disconnected-At 707AM, jolted awake by room shaking due to room next door. Security called. 15 min later, more shaking from the same room. Persisted until past 9AM.I paid for a room to sleep in without being disturbed, and I didn't get 3 hours continuous quiet the entire night. Front desk was told, and they offered 500 bonus points (about $0.50). I demanded they comp the room.  This was well short of BW Plus standards for this PLATINUM member.

reviews.title: Best western casino royal
reviews.text: Great staff. Clean rooms and a great price. We were in the middle of everything on the strip.  If we go back to Las Vegas we will definitely stay here again. It is also right next to a McDonald’s which I loved lol

reviews.title: Great
reviews.text: Great place me and my wife really enjoyed our self great room I just wish y'all had microwave but great comfortable and clean place with great staff and a great casino me and my wife will definitely be back

reviews.title: Rest, Relaxation, & Fun
reviews.text: I've stayed in plenty of resorts on the strip, but particularly during the Covid restrictions, I would say that this was the BEST LOCATION FOR THE PRICE!!! A DEFINITE REUTRN!!! Service was impeccable!!!

reviews.title: Christmas Vacation
reviews.text: Very clean, friendly staff, great location. Free parking and no resort fee. Just make sure and inquire about an incidentals hold. We were very pleasantly surprised about the quality of the hotel for the price. Great place to stay.

reviews.title: Best Western Plus is a plus
reviews.text: Best Western Plus is a plus. Whenever I travel I always look for and choose a BW plus. I’ve gotten lucky each time in Atl, TN and now Las Vegas. Great stays each time and very nice people, clean and affordable

reviews.title: Customer service sucked
reviews.text: As a Diamond Elite member and a Best Western employee I was very disappointed with the check-in process at this hotel the man that text me and was very rude and not friendly at all you didn't recognize the elite status or offer me the free play that is given by the casino you could definitely use some customer service training but he is an older gentleman so maybe that was why was my first time to Las Vegas and I was definitely disappointed with the hotel and itself and the customer service the room was clean I guess that was a good thing no ice machine no breakfast and the wifi only worked half the time

reviews.title: The. Center. Of. All. Fun
reviews.text: Great. Place. In. A. Big. City. Location. Great. Close. To. Breakfast. And. Dinner ,  walking. Distance. To. Shopping. Site. Seeing. A. Big. Mall. Close. By. Parking. Car. Was. Great. Close. To. The. Entrance. To. Hotel. And. Casino

reviews.title: 1st Time in Vegas
reviews.text: This was my 1st time in Vegas. Being I'm not a gambler, I just needed a place to stay for 1 night. This hotel is conveniently located in the middle of the strip, next door to restaurants & 15 minutes walk to the fountain show. There is free parking in the back of the hotel (parking lot or garage), the parking entrance is at the end of the building complex. The non-smoking room was decent, the bed was very comfortable but the heat on the a/c didn't warm the frigid room (it was 45 degrees outside). There was no microwave in the room, there is one located on the 1st floor where the vending machines are located. My room on the 3rd floor/pool view was quiet, until the sound of an outside bell chimed at the top of the hour. Note: Due to covid, your temperature will be checked (touchless thermometer) & when you are checking out, you must leave key cards in the room. You don't need to go to the reception, you can call from the room.

reviews.title: Best Western Plus Casino Royale
reviews.text: I stayed 3 nights as a base for a day trip to Death Valley. The room was very clean and the location is right on the center of the Strip. Best of all there was no resort fee. There is a casino at the hotel which I did not use.

reviews.title: No individual temperature control in the room
reviews.text: We were there on November 9-10, 2020.The air condition/heating of all the rooms of the hotel are controlled by a centralized computer. We called the maintenance, but they were unable to overrun the setup, and they proposed instead to provide us with additional blankets!!Hence we had to cope with a room temperature between 69F and 72F. This was not our first stay in this hotel, but it will certainly be our last.We wonder how such a reputable brand as Best Western, can condone such a bizarre method.

reviews.title: Great hotel
reviews.text: This is a great hotel right in the center of everything.  Check in was easy.  The rooms were spotless clean.  Staff was following Covid protocols.  I felt very safe staying at his hotel.  Rooms were secure.

reviews.title: Older Hotel
reviews.text: This is an older hotel located center strip.  It was great for an inexpensive stay for one night before flying out in the morning.  Check in was prompt and the service great.  The room on the other hand was just okay at best. It was clean and did have a fridge and coffee pot which is not common for rooms on the strip in Vegas.  My complaint is the view we had.  We had a ground floor room and it looked out into a kind of storage area with chairs  piled all over.  There was also trash scattered about and a homeless person was sleeping there in the morning.  It was disgusting!  Don’t accept a ground floor room with this view.  The place also had a constant smell of marijuana.

reviews.title: Solid Value on The Strip
reviews.text: The room is what you'd expect from a Best Western.  It was clean, modernly styled, and in a great location.  The only knock on the place was the garage.  The stairs were disgusting.  When you park in the garage, just walk down the ramp.  Hopefully, they'll clean that stairway up.

reviews.title: Casino Royale Las Vegas
reviews.text: Great hotel. Great location. Not so good food available in the casino area. Everything else was great and we had a great time. Would definitely stay here again if I ever decided to go to Las Vegas again.

reviews.title: Back for a short stay
reviews.text: On our way home from the east coast we stopped in LV.  We had enjoyed our prior stay at BW Casino Royale and it remains a good place to lay your head.  The rooms are clean and spacious.  I love its location and the fact there is no resort fee because, well, it's not a resort.  Plus it won't take you forever to get your room from the sidewalk unlike the many massive casino-hotels where you have to walk a mile to get from the sidewalk to your actual room if not longer.  Would definitely plan on staying here the next time.

reviews.title: My Vegas experience at BW
reviews.text: We enjoyed our vacation!  This is mainly because of the room.  We spent the majority of our time in the room because we didnt leave until later in the evening.  We enjoyed the casino as well.  The only issue we had was the coffee maker didn't work.  Overall? GREAT EXPERIENCE!

reviews.title: NEVER AGAIN!
reviews.text: I will NEVER stay at this property again. There was a large party split between two rooms; one directly across the hall from us, and one a couple of rooms down from us. Every 60-90 minutes throughout the ENTIRE night there was VERY loud arguing, fighting, cursing, sexually explicit conversations, elicit drug use, and constant slamming of doors in the hallway immediately outside of our room. We called the front desk to have security address the issue on several occasions. On one occasion, the front desk clerk even said there was nothing she could do about it. However, each time the security guard came, he just told them to quiet down, and left... the issues NEVER stopped. I actually wanted to leave the hotel by the time that this activity hit the early morning hours; however, I could see and hear the crowd outside of my hotel room and did not feel safe opening the door. I never felt safe, and did not get any sleep.

reviews.title: Super extraordinary Staff
reviews.text: I would give this hotel more than five stars if possible. I have never been so impressed by the people that work there. From the cocktail waitress who was super friendly and always checking to see if I needed anything, to the people that worked at the registration desk, I arrived before check in time but they put me in my room right away, I can’t hear on a phone because of my cochlear implant and needed to call my bank, they made the call for me and always checking to see if I needed anything, then there was the morning floor manager, I kept having trouble getting my rewards card to work and he would come by all the time to check on me. My room was clean and very pleasant, I had a coffee machine and a small refrigerator and internet.I am and always will be impressed with the efficiency and friendliness of the staff at the Casino Royale Best Western. You can’t find this type of personal service in a large hotel, but you can find it at the Casino Royale!

reviews.title: Good Enough
reviews.text: I chose this hotel for the location. Centrally located and I was able to walk up and down the strip. Room was good...clean and comfortable. They provided vouchers to restaurants. The casino was spacious. This trip was days before the lockdowns and travel restrictions.

reviews.title: A pleasant surprise
reviews.text: I didn't even know this hotel existed until this trip. It is quite hidden and easily missed but not anymore. It has a fantastic location and at least during Covid, it was super easy in and easy out. We actually timed how long it took us from the parking to the front desk and from the front desk to the room and each were under a minute which we loved! The room was clean and I loved that it had a coffee maker and fridge in the room! I will definitely be staying here again.

reviews.title: Everything was great except the beds.
reviews.text: Everything about the hotel was great except the rock hard beds and flat pillows. Check in was a little slow as they only had one person checking people in. But have waited longer at bigger strip hotels. The staff was super friendly though. Room was very clean. Had a fridge and a view of the pool that we never made it to but looked nice. Decor in main areas a little outdated but besides the beds was a good place to stay with a great location.

reviews.title: Great place right on the Strip
reviews.text: Great place that is right on the Strip for a good price. Parking is free and is easy on and off Las Vegas Boulevard. The room was clean and comfortable. The check in staff was friendly and accommodating. I'd definitely stay here again!

reviews.title: Cheap, dark and dirty, old style Vegas
reviews.text: Went here to find some cheap roulette and a $2 foot long hot dog. Did not disappoint. Only place I found on the strip with $1 roulette and hot dogs served until midnight. Be mindful of your surroundings, it’s kind of like gambling in a big gas station.

reviews.title: Location, slots, and food.
reviews.text: This hotel is located on the strip, right in between the Harrah's & Venetian Hotel & casino's. The hotel has several restaurants  on site. (Pizza Hut, Nathan's Hot Dogs, Subway, Dennys, & Outback steakhouse) There is a McDonald's, White Castle's, & Panda Express next door. Along with a 24 hr. Walgreens. So finding some grub isn't a problem. The parking lot area is private behind the property. And there is only 1 road to the parking lot. And its north bound on the Las Vegas Blvd. (AKA: Strip) it really wasn't a problem getting to it. Because traffic was light, but if traffic was heavy. Your gonna sit and wait awhile.The room a a bit small, but very clean. It features a nice size flat screen TV, (With a nice variety of channels) Small freg, Keurig coffee maker, alarm clock, many plugs to power your devices. The closet hides a safe, iron & ironing board. The beds are comfy, along with the pillows. But no microwave.Unfortunately, this property isn't allowing guests to use the ice machine, pool, or allowing housekeeping to clean your room. But if you need anything, call the front desk will bring your needed item to room. (Extra towels, shampoo, ect.) And knock on your door. But don't open the door, til their gone.(hotel policy) Due to the Corona Virus. And note: when you check in the security guard is called to take you temperature before you check in. Along with all you guest's. Another Covid-19 precaution. The casino has a nice variety of games, if you just want go play real quick, instead of roaming the strip. There is a bar in the middle of the casino. You not required to wear a mask while playing on the floor. But are encouraged to if you want. Hand disinfect stations are around the floor. I seen several people donning a mask. But social distancing was followed by patrons. Overall it's a decent property, but because of the Covid-19 precautions. The amenities made things inconvenient. But I understand their concerns. On keeping their staff & visitors safe.

reviews.title: Viva Las Vegas
reviews.text: Fantastic location,  decor a little dated but room spotlessly clean.  Coffee/tea machine replenished daily.  Clean fluffy towels. Fabulous bar staff  fantastic prices. Located in the middle of the strip  opposite The Mirage and next to Venetian.

reviews.title: Awesome Hotel & Satff.
reviews.text: Awesome hotel & staff. From the time we showed up very late 4a.m. to the time we checked out the staff were wonderful. Very clean and right on the strip. WE'RE VERY SATISFIED ON OUR 4 NIGHTS STAY. 24 hrs restaurants are on the primacy.  We did not hear any traffic from our room. The beds are comfortable, right on the strip. You can see the Mirage Volcano show from the Denny's restaurant up stairs with a nice view. Front desk people are excellent.

reviews.title: smack in the middle of the strip
reviews.text: I chose this property primarily because of location to the nightly outdoor shows at nearby properties. Very handing a just a short walk across the street.Driving access is also very easy with the parking garage at rear.Room was very comfortable and clean.Bed/s were also quite comfortable.A number of choices for eating are either in the Casino or next door and there is also a Walgreen next door

reviews.title: Center of Strip without the Resort Fee
reviews.text: Best place to stay to avoid the dreaded nightly resort fee that the other strip properties add onto stays.Pros - easy to find room and get down to casino. Has great eating options right on or next door to the property. You don't have to spend a bundle on food if you don't want too. Casino has fun up to date games. Excellent hotel lobby staff. Thank you for the easy check in and out! Room was basic, king bed overlooking McDonalds. Ample counter top, dryer in closet, safe, refrig, coffee pot, shampoo etc. It was perfect.Cons - hotel key didn't always work, needed to rekey a few times. Hotel is not smokey, but the casino is more smoke compared to the larger casinos. Breakfast is in Denny's with 25% off coupon, nothing on site except for subway (and it's not too good). Hard to find hotel lobby because you will enter in the back, walk through casino, head to left, and the lobby is toward the front. Guest room entrance is again through casino and head left more.Overall we are coming back, it's so worth staying here!

reviews.title: Good, basic place to stay in the center of the action. Loud housekeeping
reviews.text: Mostly enjoyed our stay at the Casino Royale. Very affordably priced, and I loved not having to pay a resort fee upon check in. This place is located right across from the Mirage and right in between the Venetian  and Harrahs, so perfect walking access to all of the action on the strip. Rooms are basic, but very clean.  My complaint with this hotel lies with how early housekeeping starts cleaning the hall and rooms and VERY loudly. They were slamming doors and vacuuming the hall  right outside of our room at barely after sunrise on a SUNDAY morning....we would have liked to have slept in past sunrise after being out all night..  This issue aside I would probably stay here again as it was a good value.

reviews.title: Disappointed
reviews.text: Stayed Here recently checked in for four days. Everything was great in till i checked out i had left behind a bag of Make up worth $100 bucks plus some glasses and once i reached the airport i called the hotel to inform them they said they let housekeeping know and were told they didn't find anything witch i know, i left it on the counter above the refrigerate. I work at a hotel also when i guest leaves a item behind i make sure they get so really disappointed in the customer service.

reviews.title: Best value on the Strip
reviews.text: Great location, nice clean rooms, and easy check in.  Inexpensive eats in the Casino or just a few steps away from other eateries (I enjoyed a meal at the White Castle).  Can park your car and then just walk to everything, either up or down the Strip.  Will stay again when in town.

reviews.title: Small, dumpy hotel with security issues
reviews.text: Not best best we material.  Small rooms.  They only replace towels, coffee, etc and make the bed daily. No cleaning during stay. Heating/cooling system sucks, hotel and casino have become run down and bums are hanging around all over.  It's a great location on the strip.  Price is a little cheaper than Harrah's but not worth what you give up for that.

reviews.title: Not so big, but o so great
reviews.text: What a lovely hotel right in the middle of Las Vegas. Service was super! We had delayed luggage and the staff was o so friendly and helpfull! Thanks Elia 👍🏻👍🏻👍🏻. Rooms were okay, swimmingpool small but cool water. Next to everything!

reviews.title: Nice budget hotel along Las Vegas Boulevard.
reviews.text: Best Western Plus Casino Royale a small nice budget hotel with no resort fees. Located along Las Vegas Boulevard, the most bustling areas. This hotel stand in between 2 giant hotels - The Venetian and Harrah's Las Vegas Hotel and Casino, opposite was The Mirage. Best Western was surrounded with lots of attractions, casino, restaurants, shopping malls etc.Check in process was fast and efficient. Room was already ready at 0940hrs (1/2 Sat). The friendly helpful gentleman who process my check in even guide me the way to the guest room access sliding door.Assigned with room 210 was equipped with a King Size bed, a extra sink in the room, mini fridge, coffee maker and iron facilities, single seater sofa etc. Room was facing the backyard without view. Bathroom provides all necessary amenities with bathtub. This hotel was rather old and small but facilities still in working condition. There is pantry room ,equipped with vending machine( snacks and drinks) microwaves and even computers for guests to access. Room soundproof was rather poor, overheard banging of doors, footsteps and even guests chatting along the corridor. This hotel design rather simple and easy access to guests room, access thru entrance nearest to McDonald's, swap the room key room at the reader for the sliding door to open in order to access to all guests room. Guests don't really to to bear with all the cigarettes smell by walking thru casino for lift lobby. Definitely will visit Best Western if visit LV again.

Location was great. Everything that you could need in the room. Was clean spacious and comfortable. Price was exceptional and staff were great friendly and helpful and always had a smile.  Overall a great experience and will definitely be coming back.

reviews.title: Unassuming hotel right next to the strip
reviews.text: It's fine. It's not one of those grand, magnificent monsters that you often associate with the Las Vegas strip. The rooms are clean, there is a tiny gym and a swimming pool. The casino is rather big and there are dining options inside the hotel as well.

reviews.title: travelbill
reviews.text: This property is good value for the Las Vegas strip. The features are free parking, no daily resort fees, on the strip with the action, rooms are accommodating, clean, and comfortable. The down side is the AC did not work properly and it was very noisy in the late evening. Great value for the strip and would likely stay again.

reviews.title: Fabulous location.
reviews.text: We booked this Hotel on advice from friend’s and were delighted with everything.It may not look palatial as the surrounding Hotels but had everything we wanted and needed.Felicia checked us in and this was very swift and we were quickly in our well equipped bedroom.Two large double beds,  desk,  tall boy,  tv and two comfortable chairs and bedside cabinets were in the bedroom with plenty of lighting,  overlooking the pool.A very nice coffee machine with plenty of coffee capsules was a nice touch and fridge to keep food/drinks cool.  Being English we bought tea bags from Walgreens right next door to the Hotel along with fresh milk. The bathroom was spotlessly clean,  plenty of fluffy towels and toiletries were replenished each day.Breakfast wasn’t included but we were given vouchers for Denny’s adjacent to Casino Royale which we used every day of our stay. There is no resort fee at this Hotel,  free WiFi,  a large car park,  Outback Steakhouse upstairs (which is excellent),  it’s right on the strip and close to everything.  Being a Best Western member I also collected points.Thanks to all the hard working staff,  we had a great time and will certainly be back!

reviews.title: Location, location, location.
reviews.text: Brilliant location between the Venetian and Harrahs. No resort fees. We had a quiet room on the 2nd floor with a view of the pool which was still closed for season, no traffic noise.If using Uber, they will drop you at the back of the hotel but not collect. You need to walk through the parking lot at the back to Harrahs parking where there is a large Uber pick up area. No issues with hotel. Clean and comfortable.No breakfast included but they gave us coupons for Dennys which is in the same building. Felt safe with the kids. They have a business centre room for use but when we needed it, the computers were all down but staff in reception printed our check in info for our flights instead.

reviews.title: Great quiet haven on the busy strip!
reviews.text: This place is right in the middle of the action but once you are in the room it is quiet, relaxing with everything you need to make your stay in Vegas complete.  Being a non smoker i read a review about the room being smokey - this is not the case.  In fact Reggie who was on the front desk (who made us feel so welcome like all the staff) made it very clear there was no smoking allowed in the room - only in the casino.  The room was fresh and the beds were 10/10 comfort.  Free Wi-Fi was the icing on the cake so we could keep up to date with the weather.  Would recommend based on comfort and the lovely staff - you were fantastic and made our Las Vegas experience great.

reviews.title: Nice location on the strip
reviews.text: Arrived in Vegas just after midnight and took a cab from the airport $30 inc tip. Hotel is nestled in between Walgreens and McDonalds but parking is behind the hotel down a side street. You need to meander through the casino and the reception desk is located in a cubicle . Check in was a little painful as it was busy but the staff were friendly and quick. There is a door which is for guests only to get to the hotel rooms (via keycard). Rooms are pretty good, ours had a wet bar with fridge , coffee machine , safe, tv and the Usual suspect of an ice bucket!! Bathroom was adequate and well stocked. 2 double beds were comfy enough. All in all a great alternative to the big hotels. No breakfast is served but coupons for Denny’s were given. Pizza Hut and Subway were on the premises. Didn’t use any of the other facilities.

reviews.title: Best place on the strip to stay!
reviews.text: Not only was the staff exceptional but with 20 steps to the strip it was amazing! Rooms were totally quiet and clean and casino was just the right size! Bartenders were the best! I will tell everyone I know to stay here!

reviews.title: Amazing
reviews.text: The location was great, close to a Walgreens a Denny’s was also near by. The room was clean not spot clean but it was ok. The parking was also good we had no problems finding a spot. The staff was great

reviews.title: A Great stay in Vegas!
reviews.text: This hotel is very conveniently located right on the strip within walking distance of it all! We had a great time and the staff are excellent! Great prices and service.This is our go to place when we go to Vegas!

reviews.title: Great Location
reviews.text: Quiet in your room and right on the center of the strip for any shows you want to attend. Great housekeeping staff, just ask if you need anything. Free parking and no resort fees are an added bonus. Denny's Outback and White Castle on site for quick food.

reviews.title: Stay - check in and out not the best
reviews.text: Had problems with keys at check in where we had to get keys twice to get into the room.A/C did not work very will with a difficult thermostat and no fan power.Tried to use BW Travel Cards at check out and the clerk was not happy to do it as she said they are hard to process

reviews.title: Never again
reviews.text: Smokey room. Hot water went away mid shower. A/C not working. Desk told me to open window but the noise made it hard to sleep. Closed window shut off heater and then the smoke smell started filtering into the room. Hot water went away half way thru shower.

reviews.title: Clean, Comfortable, Affordable, Not Glitz and Glamor
reviews.text: The old Las Vegas on the Strip.  Not sleek and stylish but room is quiet, clean and comfortable.  It is close to everything on the strip.  If you want a bed and shower/bath tub and aren't looking for all the extras this is the place.

reviews.title: Great Value
reviews.text: This hotel is a great value. It is clean, comfortable and in the middle of everything. There is no resort fee which is wonderful. Parking was free. Honestly staying at one of the more expensive fancy hotels just didn't make sense to me. Oh and it was very quiet which was amazing.

reviews.title: Ok spot on the strip
reviews.text: We spent a little time at the Best Western while in Las Vegas.  I was not as impressed with the Best Western casino. It was cramped and seemed dirty compared to some of the other larger hotels.still, they took our money as well as any other casino!

reviews.title: Old school, great value
reviews.text: The Casino Royale has the touch of old Vegas (not retro, but it REALLY IS old school) and it does not have the artificial hubris (and co-located expensive glitz and fake quality) of nearby hotels who not only gouge with high room rates but then leaves you a last GOTCHA with an EXORBITANT "Resort Fee" which is just another fifty bucks a night surcharge - THAT THE CASINO ROYALE DOES NOT HAVE! That really burns my butt as that the "resort fee" seems to be the latest trend to sucker folks to hotels and then nail them as a parting gift. I would come back to Casino Royale as it was very adequate, had plenty of nearby locations for solid food and I didn't have to walk and walk and walk and walk to just get from mu room to the lobby. Given a choice I would stay here over ANY more time at the Venetian.

reviews.title: A typical Best Western
reviews.text: Your typical Best Western hotel, but situated on the Las Vegas Strip. It was very close to the Sands,which was where out convention was located.  Room was small, but clean and the bed was very good. The shower had adequate pressure but could have used a bit more volume. Maid service was good and the Keurig worked well.

reviews.title: Excellent Hotel
reviews.text: Clean room and very comfortable bed. Keurig coffee maker in the room.Felicia at check in was very friendly and ready to help, as she was last time we stayed at this Hotel.Thomas Martinez was very helpful every time we had a question or request and getting our luggage stored the last day while we were at a trade show.It is employees like Felicia and Thomas the ones that make a huge difference and want us to come back.That shows that customer service is number one at this property.

reviews.title: Great Place to Stay on the Strip in Las Vegas
reviews.text: We were in Las Vegas for a professional conference.  The location is superb.  The parking is accessible and easy to reach from the guest rooms.   The proximity to Denny's and the coupons provided allowed us to have breakfast conveniently and for a reasonable cost.  By merely crossing the street, we were able to walk to the Forum shops at Caesar's;the Mirage and the Harrah's were both nearby.  We would definitely plan to stay here again.

reviews.title: Best customer service
reviews.text: Top to bottom the best staff of any place I’ve ever stayed.These people actually care!They treat you like you are the only guest they have.I mean everyone. Management,front desk, bartenders and housekeeping. Seriously, it’s the quality of the people that make this place real gem!

reviews.title: Great stay.
reviews.text: We had a blast. Our room was clean and the bed slept great. This is not advertised as the Bellagio so don’t book if that’s what you want, but it’s a great value in the middle of the strip. Had a few good hits in the casino also! We would definitely stay here again.  Thanks Casino Royale for no resort fees.

reviews.title: Great port in the storm
reviews.text: Conveniently at the Strip and next to a Wahlgreens, the location doesn’t get much better. Unlike many places in the Sin City, they’ve thought of soundproofing their rooms. Staff gave a warm welcome and personal service. Would expect better cleaning: made our bed but didn’t change the bedding. Less unexpected; you’ll have to navigate yourself through a Casino to get to the desk. Overall worth the $

reviews.title: Convenient to the strip,  but the rooms aren't great
reviews.text: This hotel is convenient to the strip and has a nice casino, but accessing the registration desk is very challenging. Parking is separated from the hotel, so in bad weather you're exposed. You can't independently heat or cool your individual room since the HVAC system is either on heat or cool for the whole hotel. Also, pretty noisy.

reviews.title: Love Vegas
reviews.text: Walking along the strip was awesome and a short Uber everywhere else made our stay fantastic.  We also love Denny's and it's right there! We would stay here again but for many more nights!  Thank you for the great experience.

reviews.title: What a find A*******
reviews.text: An amazing hotel, right on the strip, great location, friendly staff, great room, great facilities, lots of extras, why pay any extra, not necessary. 1 minute from room and we were on strip, not half hour to get to your room. I recommend this hotel to anyone, we loved it and it made our NYE Vegas stay perfect...

reviews.title: Christmas in Las Vegas
reviews.text: Spent Christmas here and it was delightful. There's a reason this hotel is traveler-rated higher than many 'prestigious' hotels on the strip. We were in a King room (311), and it was clean, attractive, spacious, and quiet. The bed was very comfortable. We appreciated the fridge and Keurig coffee maker. The wifi reception was flawless.No one seems to have reviewed the fitness center off the pool deck, but it is quite respectable. A TV, a treadmill, 2 bikes, and an ingenious universal-style cable machine made by a company called Inflight Fitness that can hit pretty much every bodypart. Bottles of water are free from the refrigerator.We are Best Western fans anyway, but this hotel, with its friendly staff, is a gem, perfectly located in the middle of the Strip. Happy New Year to all the staff!

reviews.title: I would stay here again
reviews.text: Very nice place for the price. Literally in the middle of the strip! Denny's is attached as is a very good White Castle and a Walgreen's. Super convenient. The rooms were clean, and in good condition. The bed was very comfortable but there are only 4 pillows and they will not give you any more! The mini fridge was not very cold, just a tiny step up from being turned off completely. Even though it was on high. Staff was friendly. Overall, we would stay there again.

reviews.title: A small jewel in the Stripe
reviews.text: If you don’t like large casino hotel (limited amenity), this is one of very few remaining small hotel offering all you need, e.g., water, coffee, etc. Room very clean. Excellent location right by Venetian. Unlike large casino (we had bad experience of auto burglary), this hotel garage is very safe, only one entrance with security guard there 24h. The only pitfall is that the room size is very small, no comparison to larger and newer casino hotels nearby. Unless you book a suite room, I would recommend a King bed rather than 2 Queens, which you will find tight space remaining to walk.

reviews.title: Decent price and comfortable quiet room in the middle of the Strip
reviews.text: The hotel is well located in the middle of the Strip, close to the Deuce bus station Harrah, neighboring a Walgreens and having several restaurants inside, including a great Steakhouse Outback. The hotel has only four floors and some 450 rooms; they offer free parking. Our room and bathroom were quiet, large and very clean; we had a refrigerator and a coffee-maker in the room, coffee and tea, good toiletries, excellent wifi. The reception was very kind and friendly. At check out we asked for a shuttle to the airport and the reception staff called it for us ($9 pp). We haven't been asked to pay any hidden resort fees; however at check in we had to deposit a $75 fee that was returned to us at check out. The hotel does not have/offer breakfast.

reviews.title: Real good value
reviews.text: My son and l  stayed at the  casino  royale  September  ,really good value, no resort fees,all staff very friendly,won some lost some,nice hotel right in centre of strip,cannot fault it at all.used uber for transport,  excellent, half price of normal taxis. Travelled from  England which  we do often  .the hotel made our stay worthwhile

reviews.title: 3 Day Crash and Burn of Vegas
reviews.text: Perfect location, excellent staff, great rooms! My boyfriend and I spent 3 crazy days in Vegas without stopping. This hotel was our rock and kept us from losing our minds. I don't know how they do it but it felt so quiet and secluded and separate from the bustle of the strip. We were pleasantly surprised about the quality of the room we received. Will definitely stay again the next time we're in town.

reviews.title: Best staff anywhere!
reviews.text: Tina at the front desk was fabulous! She took us to our floor and told us several key things, including how to leave without dragging luggage back thru the casino. Casino staff were very friendly and helpful too. Rooms are clean and visually pleasing.

reviews.title: Great location noting fancy
reviews.text: Rooms were clean but small. Good price and value for what we received.  Casino was fun.  Best part is the location. Great location on strip for the price. Would stay here again. Lots of food options nearby. Very easy access to casino and strip.

reviews.title: Best Hotel & Casino in Vegas
reviews.text: As ever (we have been staying here for over 5 years) we loved everything about Casino Royale. Rooms are not huge but more than big enough for 2. Fridge and coffee maker in the room is a huge plus. Staff at reception are always helpful and friendly and make check in/out really easy. Love the selection of slots in the casino and it is not so large that we lose each other when we play different games, Special mention to the bar staff and waitresses who do a fantastic job and are always cheerful and friendly. $3 beers are also good!

reviews.title: Great Location
reviews.text: Spent 4 nights. Check in was quick. Had an issue with the plumbing, fixed asap. Opened the window to get a breeze, could not believe the noise from the strip, shut the window, no noise. Fridge and coffee maker in the room. Right b/t the Linq and Harrahs. Could not be a better location. No resort fees as well.

reviews.title: A Good Place to stay if you get a deal.
reviews.text: The hotel was not what I expected for the price we paid. But it was clean, had decent emenities. The staff was awesome and very helpful. I liked the hotel but it was pricey for a strip Hotel in Vegas. I had other family members that paid a good price, much, much less. But that was because they purchase far in advance. I belive my price was high because I only booked 2 weeks in advance. But looking past price it was acceptable and clean. Free parking was a perk. Lots of places close by in walking distant. We were on the 2nd floor. Very quiet, my son was on the first floor which was close to the garage and a trash compactor. They complained of noise. Overall, I had a decent stay.

reviews.title: Road trip
reviews.text: We enjoyed staying here.You can not go wrong with the price and the location.Parking was easy, internet works fine, clean and tidy.If you want the flash hotels then book elsewhere and pay alot more but we were happy with here and would stay again.Couldnt fault the location.

reviews.title: Great location value for money
reviews.text: We are a family of four adults visiting from Australia. We are not big gamblers but came to vegas just  for two nights as part of a larger holiday. I chose this hotel as I wanted location and value for  money  and  that's what we got.The hotel is in the middle of the strip. It is attached to a ground floor large casino which  my 21year old sons loved. We of course visited all the amazing flash places  but for my guys they didn't want to spend 25 per bet. Our hotel has a roulette table where you can do one dollar bets! I would say that the staff working here and on the tables aren't very friendly.Right next door is the ticketing booth where you can buy all the shows for half the price. I wish I had waited.The room itself is older but clean and I booked a non smoking room and can smell NO smoke so that's a bonus. Beds are ok.Bathroom  is ok.  As I said value for money. We would stay here again it suited us.

reviews.title: NEVER again
reviews.text: I’m giving this hotel a 2 only for its location which is excellent.  I’m a regular at Best Western Plus hotels and have never hated a place as much as this one.  The parking garage and elevator were scary.  We checked in only to be given $5 Denny’s coupons in place of the breakfast buffet usually offered at every Best Western Plus I’ve ever stayed.  The hallway to our room had people lurking and staring as well as being extremely humid and hot.  We get to our room and it is also hot and humid.  Humidity in the desert?  My glasses actually fogged in the room!  We were not able to get the room to cool down. The view was the loading dock and bags of garbage.   The shower went from warm to cold and back again.  Never did get hot water.  The sink water smelled putrid and the beds seemed old as did the pillows which had an odor.  The room was clean and the decor ok but nothing else was acceptable.

reviews.title: Basic Hotel - Would stay again
reviews.text: We were flying to Vegas for a long weekend. The only time we spend in the room is to sleep, so I really didn't want to pay the high rates of the big casinos.  I found this hotel on hotels.com and it was a great price. I will say that it is a basic hotel, no glitz and glamour. That being said, it is right on the strip with access to everything. The rooms are average size but are very clean, which in my mind is all I need.  We will definitely look into staying there again when we get to Vegas.

reviews.title: Fantastic location
reviews.text: Great location on the Strip to explore Vegas. Really appreciate that there's a Dennys and White Castle adjacent to the restaurant for quick and easy meals. However, the rooms were a little dated and due to the design of the building slightly dim.

reviews.title: No resort fees and fantastic location
reviews.text: Visiting Sin City during chilly temps last week and wanted to check out the Best Western Plus Casino Royale on the Las Vegas strip. BW is an older property on the strip, from the late ‘70s with about 150 rooms. With an older property there are some annoyances like thin walls. I was on the first floor which had sort of a “basement feel.” Even though the street view of my king bed room was the alley, it was surprisingly quiet. The hallway was another story. You could clearly hear people’s conversations as they walked by. As guests left their room, you could also hear the door opening and closing – loudly. The king bed room was very spacious and clean. The Keurig coffee machine was a nice touch. There was also a small refrigerator in the room. The hotel location is fantastic being ON the strip with no resort fees, a multitude of restaurants all around this hotel and a Walgreens and Dennys are right next door. Walgreens has beer, wine, and liquor. BW gives guests coupons to use at Dennys at a nice savings (25% off). The staff was phenomenal. Very friendly with excellent service! The check in and check out was pretty quick. Some transients do have a tendency to walk through the casino lobby. One even sat at a slots machine and fell asleep. But I give props to LVPD by immediately taking care of business and taking out the trash. Finally, I did have a pleasant stay and would return to stay here when visiting Sin City.

reviews.title: Hidden gem
reviews.text: Great little hotel tucked in between Harrah's and Venetian, great staff, very helpful and kind. Great access to several quick restaurants. Right on the strip, great for walking around. Small casino, but lots packed into the space.

reviews.title: Nice hotel in a great location
reviews.text: Driving here does mean coming down Las Vegas Boulevard and trying to cut across the foot traffic to get in. The car park has dedicated spaces for hotel guests, which is good. Check in was quick, but the downside is having to go through a smoky casino to get to it. If you are a non-smoker the casinos are bad news, but unavoidable. The room was clean, comfortable and despite being above the casino, didn’t smell of cigarettes. Being close to the strip and being in a 24/7 hotel I was expecting a noisy night, but it was quiet and we had a good nights sleep. The shower was good, with decent quality towels and toiletries. Overall, we enjoyed our stay and unlike the mega hotels along the strip, you can be out of you room and on the strip in a couple of minutes. If we go back to Vegas would stay here.

reviews.title: It's a great place for the price!
reviews.text: It's a great spot right in the heart of Vegas on the strip.  You can't beat the price for such a great location.  It's small but has everything you need to have fun.  That is our new stay place when we go to Vegas from now on!

reviews.title: Nice, clean and friendly!
reviews.text: Our room was clean and comfortable. Staff was friendly and helpful! We will definitely stay here the next time we're in Las Vegas. Felicia at the front desk was awesome and walked us through everything available to us.

reviews.title: Decent Economy Vegas Strip Hotel
reviews.text: The Best Western Plus Casino Royale is an economy Strip hotel and is located on Las Vegas Boulevard near the very center of the Las Vegas Strip. It is located just north of Harrah’s and south of the Venetian. The Mirage is also just across the street and there is a convenient cross walk near the Casino Royale south door. The property has a small pool, but I could not find it using the hallway signs (not sure where it was but I gave up looking). I paid $175 for Friday night and $167 for Saturday night (no resort fees). This hotel is one of the few in Las Vegas that does not charge a resort fee.  It is also one of the only hotels that charges you to use the room safe.I stayed in a Standard King Bed room for 2 nights with my wife in mid-October and did not have any issues. We picked this hotel for our weekend part of our stay since there were no resort fees and the rates were very reasonable.  The weekend rates at other nearby properties were very high. I transferred to the Delano Hotel on Sunday night when their rates were more affordable. The check in process was annoying since they only had one older gentleman working the front desk (and he was very slow and deliberate). Not sure why they did not have more people working on a Friday night. Checking out was much easier since they had 2 clerks working.  The room was clean, and the bed was comfortable.  The view from my room was bad as it looked directly at the large recycling area of Harrah’s. This was not a big deal since I did not go to Vegas to sit in my room and look out the window.Overall, I thought this was a decent, economy Vegas Strip hotel and recommend it if you are looking to stay near the center of the Vegas Strip and want to save money. There is nothing fancy about this hotel and you should not stay here if you are looking for any pampering or first-class service. This property probably has the shortest walk from your hotel room to the Strip and I found this very helpful. I would stay here again.

reviews.title: Willie
reviews.text: Our stay was great ! We were able to get to all the places we wanted to go to . The plus was no extra fees on top of the room fee. Very pleasant room Please don't change ! For those of us who, only get to occasionally vacation the price was spot on. Very friendly staff.

reviews.title: Best value  in Las Vegas
reviews.text: Rooms seemed newly painted, everything very nice.  But the LOCATION was fabulous.  You can be stand on the Strip right outside the front door, 2 minutes walk from the  Venetian, across the street from the Mirage, which is right next to Caesar Palace.

reviews.title: A Vegas trip
reviews.text: Check in/out was fairly simple & straight forward.  Told them I did not require maid service during my short stay.  Maid cleaned room Sunday.  I was not happy!  Asked fora shower chair.  They have 2 "handicapped rooms" with built in chairs.  Sorry.  I couldn't take a shower all weekend.  Had to 'sponge bathe' in bathroom sink.  Saturday, the water would not heat  up!  The front guest room elevator is in a tight corner.  Tight squeeze!  Over all I would not go back, thanks.  Preferred my stay in 2018 @ the 4Queens!

reviews.title: Simply The best Westin on the Strip
reviews.text: Just come back from Vegas and stayed in the Westin, Fantastic Location and free Playson all games and slots cant fault anything about this little Gem of a Casino the Staff and Mallllnagement are Hands on the bar is also cheap and Busy will Definitely be backFor more

reviews.title: Perfect Location
reviews.text: Perfect location, right in the middle of the strip, with the price tag of a hotel 3 blocks off the strip. Just a few steps through the casino (grab a $3 beer on the way through) and you're right in the middle of the action. Free parking and no resort fees!! Highly recommended

reviews.title: Best value on the strip
reviews.text: Good value with no extra charges. Room was nice and clean and we had no noise issues. Staff were all very friendly and helpful. You get a discount voucher for Denny's which we used for breakfast and it was huge and really good.

reviews.title: Absolutely the best value
reviews.text: Have stayed at the Casino Royale 4 times now and it is the best value on the Strip,The rooms are clean comfortable and with no resort tax and being able to access the t  Strip in just a few minutes instead of 20 mins at some of the big casinos it’s just so convenient. There is a pool and business centre and the front desk staff are extremely helpful, wouldn’t stay anywhere else..

reviews.title: Amazing Little Old Casino on Strip
reviews.text: Surrounded by large, newer casino/hotels, this small, older casino was amazing.  Our room on the third floor was very nice and amazingly quiet.  It was so busy and noisy on the street and inside the casino but the hotel part was quiet.  Interesting old-time casino look on the outside.

reviews.title: Absolutely amazing!
reviews.text: I can't say enough positive things about the BW Plus Casino Royale! My first time in Vegas. Came for conference at the Mirage. We had a double, mobility accessible room. It may have been one of the cleanest hotel rooms I've ever been in! During check in, we were walked to the rooms entrance, as the registration area is in the middle of the casino. Everyone was so helpful & friendly. The Casino Royale is awesomely located about mid strip so u can walk either direction & find lots of landmark casinos. I don't gamble so I can't really comment on casino, though it didn't seem as big as some of the others. However, this is a wonderful launching point. Our room was nicely decorated, pillows & bed very cozy, & VERY clean! 1 day we came back to a cleaned room & a can of granite cleaner was left beside my hairspray, as it blended in with my other things. This let's me know that they do thorough cleanings even DURING ur stay! Are there more expensive, posher places to stay? Sure there are but if u want a comfortable, well maintained, price conscious, & immaculate place in the middle of the action to stay, you've found it!! Drinks & snack machines SOOOOO REASONABLY priced!! Kudos to management, as this type of care & hospitality starts with them.
