Double bed accessible room pros (room 102):* adjustable hand held shower, perfect for all heights* lighting for makeup & hair was awesome* granite counter tops * grab bars both sides of toilet & all around tub* small refrigerator in room* keurig coffee* room darkening plantation shutters* directly beside room with drink & snack machines & microwavesCons:* no microwaves in rooms, must go to snack area to use one* tub with fold down transfer bench - no roll in shower rooms * if paralyzed & need transfer assist, probably not going to be able to get in tub* area between toilet & tub entrance not bigI think it might be safe to assume I would definitely stay here again!

reviews.title: Decent hotel on the Strip
reviews.text: If you plan to spend a few days in Las Vegas in the thick of things, but do not want to pay the prices of Excalibur, Caesars Palace, Luxor, etc., then Best Western Plus Casino Royale is a great choice: a decent hotel, while still at Strip.

reviews.title: Count down started
reviews.text: Thirty four days until our annual anniversary trip. Fifty three this year. Booked a room with Thomas last week. Can't wait to see him, Alan, Sharon, Tina, Ilsa my friend Reggie and all the crew. We,ve stayed here for years. Tried some of the big hotels but this is our hotel. See ya soon.

reviews.title: casino royale
reviews.text: stayed here for a week 19/09 and cant fault the place,nice large room cleaned everyday if required ,staff very pleasant helpful and approachable particularly front desk,the room comes complete with FREE wifi,fridge,safe,iron/board and to top it off no resort fees,we had family staying at the more glamorous mirage and mgm and they were gobsmacked  at what we got for our buck as they didnt even have a tea maker,the beds were very comfortable and must admit sleep quality was very good,its location is excellenet for getting about with eateris on site and on each side inc maccies,would highly reccommend dennys next door,

reviews.title: My 50th Birthday week
reviews.text: 50th birthday week brilliant hotel rooms are lovely spotless clean, tea & coffee in room every day replenished, the pool area although small is again spotless clean and towels at the poolside a lovely touch for guests

reviews.title: 8 day vegas stay
reviews.text: Brillant little hotel on the strip has everything you need without the rip off resort fees the larger casinos charge, outback steakhouse was great and so close to other casinos if you want to try your luck elsewhere.

reviews.title: Perfect location and great value
reviews.text: This hotel offers clean, comfortable, spacious and surprisingly quiet rooms given it’s central location right on the strip. Rooms included a fridge and coffee machine and there was also a pool on site. The bus stop for the Deuce is right outside making it easy to travel the strip but there are plenty of attractions within walking distance too. No resort fees and free parking made this great value.

reviews.title: Great Location but Not Clean .
reviews.text: The staff and location are brilliant . Our room was so handy for the casino and exiting the hotel too .The problem we had was the room just wasn't cleaned properly .I wrote the word Hi in the dust on the tv table and it was still there when we left .The dust behind the tv was ridiculous , and the bedding was stained .The bathroom floor was never mopped and the carpet was very dirty .I have no idea why our room received so little attention but it was nothing like the standard of cleanliness you get at Bally's .

reviews.title: Customer service!!!
reviews.text: Booked this hotel as we love the location right on the Strip and handy for everything we need. Check in was fast and easy but the 2 female members of staff really need to get a grip on customer service and basic good manners. Yes we are British and we are a gay couple so when one of them started to whistle god save the Queen we could easily have taken it as good humour or could have just as easily taken offence. This is not the first time we have encountered this sort of behaviour from hotel staff in the USA. Sad to say that we will not be back to this hotel again. Sorry best western but you have lost our custom for good.

reviews.title: Good Value Hotel ight on the Strip
reviews.text: Very nice spacious room, clean and comfortable with plenty of hot water. Perfectly located on the Strip for the attractions of Las Vegas. Good car parking availability. Although we didn't use it there is a swimming pool.Downsides - The walk from the car park through the casino to check in was a pain. "Mature" talking loudly in the corridor or letting their doors slam shut during the night and in the morning.

reviews.title: Excellent Value
reviews.text: This was my first ( husbands 3rd)  trip to Las Vegas. We were very happy with our choice of hotel. Located in the centre of the Las Vegas strip directly across from the Mirage. This hotel is quiet ( we were on the 3rd floor and faced the inside courtyard), clean, spacious, safe, secure and comfortable. We had a fridge in our room, free wifi ( worked great!), free use of an in-room safe and a relaxing outdoor pool area. The staff were friendly.No breakfast included however McDonalds was right next door and the hotel offered discount vouchers for Denny’s. Bus stop to reach the old town was conveniently located right outside the door. This hotel was very reasonably priced with no resort fees which made it affordable. If visiting Las Vegas again in future, we would definitely stay here again as well as highly recommend.

reviews.title: Not spectacular but good base to stay in Vegas
reviews.text: Its really hard to rate this hotel, it does nothing wrong, in fact it does a lot of things well but should it be given 5 stars because you can park for free and there are no hidden resort fees to pay when you check out. On the other hand should it be down marked that much because it is not jaw dropping as you walk through its reception, only visitors themselves can decide.We had 4 nights in here 19-22 September. We found the car parking and checking in easy and after this we needn't have stepped into the casino had we wished. Our room was located in the adjacent building next to the casino which had its own separate entrance and could of walked through the drop off point of car park on to the strip if we choose. The facilities in the room which was clean and maintained every day had iron, coffee machine, fridge and acceptable bathroom. For those unfamiliar with Vegas hotels it should be known that you can wander into any of the big glitzy hotels without being challenged to view their glorious features, you can even use most of their facilities subject to one off fee that is much less than the extra cost of sleeping there. the casino in the best western hotel offers gaming at roulette and craps at 1/2 minimum stakes than most on the strip which is great if you just want to dapple because your in the gaming capital of the world and are not a high roller with thousands to lose. The drinks bought here are also amongst the cheapest to be found on the strip. The adverse effect of cheap or free drinks is that sometimes tables could be occupied by free spirited louder customers partying meaning game play was not always as fluent or taken seriously as the higher priced tables at other casino's we visited. The pool at the hotel was clean but small and not visually pleasing but was not used much by guests so we had no problems finding sunbeds and was one of the few places around(this includes the posh hotels) where you couldn't hear the continuous noise from slot machines.  The location of this hotel is a good as any in the strip with the benefit of not having a potential 15-20 minute walk from your room to the outside world or to use some of the hotels facilities. During our 4 days we Walked around Caesars Palace, The Venetian, The Mirage and the Bellagio witnessing all their wondrous attributes and returned to the relative piece and quiet of our room for bedtime or last drinks.We enjoyed our stay at the Casino Royale(party of six) and I don't believe I would have enjoyed my time in Vegas anymore had I stumped up the extra to stay in one of the iconic hotels near by (perhaps I should  have given it a *4* ?)

reviews.title: The Place to Stay!
reviews.text: This is most definitely the place to stay on the strip, as a regular visitor to Vegas we have stayed in numerous hotels on the strip, including NYNY and the Bellagio, casino Royale is by far my favourite - excellent value for money and no resort fees!! The rooms were spotlessly clean, towels changed daily, bedding changed upon request, fridge and coffee maker in the room! The rooms were spacious and had everything you need for a week in sin city! We used the pool a couple of times, no issues getting sun beds or towels. I read couple of reviews you could smell smoke from the casino in the rooms, we never had this problem in any of our 3 rooms! Excellent value for money and will most definitely stay at Casino Royale again!!

reviews.title: Great stay on the strip
reviews.text: Located right in between the bigger hotels. Great service, great cleaning, great parking and perfect location for a Vegas stay. No breakfast included but there is a subway downstairs. Would definately visit again.

reviews.title: Perfect location
reviews.text: The location of the hotel is by far the best thing about it. Fairly basic, no frills rooms and facilities and a small casino but right in the middle of all the best bits of the strip and was a good price. Had quiet nights sleep there and really appreciated how close to everything it was. If you're just going to sleep there, it's a bargain hotel in a great location.

reviews.title: A clean and quiet room in Vegas.
reviews.text: Modern, clean and well equipped room. Quiet as requested which isn’t easy in Vegas!. Friendly and helpful staff. Very comfortable king size bed. A coffee machine which was easy to work!. Nice bathroom so all made for a relaxing oasis right in the middle of the Strip. Easy and FREE car parking.

reviews.title: excellent location
reviews.text: Stayed here 14th-21st september, budget hotel right in the middle of the strip,  bit dated basic but clean. Only has a small pool but wasnt very busy so we always got a sun bed. would definitely return to this hotel, plus theres no resort fees.

reviews.title: Brilliant location great value 10/10
reviews.text: The location is fantastic we just loved that u can walk out the door and your bang in the middle of the action of the strip. Also it’s not crazy large like some places so you don’t have to walk for miles to reach your room, a massive bonus.Our room was floor 2 near the lift, we were not expecting much after some of the reviews here but were so pleasantly surprised!! Room was large with comfortable bed and room appears to have been recently refurbished .very clean bathroom & bedroom.. the linen very clean and white fluffy towels and good decor. Ok not any amazing views but who cares! you only sleep there, walk outside to see the Vegas views. There is a good size fridge a coffee maker , both a big bonus too. Great car parking right outside and FREE !! And very easily accessed and we had no trouble with it, we could understand some of the negative reviews about it on here!!! It was amazing. I would stay here every time.!! Oh did I mention it’d so cheap and no resort fees !!  we booked many months in advance and couldn’t believe the brilliant price we got ! I would seriously recommend this hotel if you are looking for value for money and a great location on the strip near all the action. So central! If you want luxury and opulence book the Bellagio! But be prepared to pay a lot lot more!!! We’ll definitely be back here we just couldn’t fault a thing! The best!!!

reviews.title: Another good stay..
reviews.text: Stayed at this hotel many times before and may do again.. Access to the parking lot at the rear always a challenge with the strip pedestrians.. felt like I needed a big 4x4 :) rather than my Full size hyundai sonata.. Checkin within the Casio is a little meh.. smokey and the the only time I was in the casino. The checkin staff were friendly however slighly questionable as one of them hummed 'god save the queen' to the lady checking us in.. not sure because we were british or because we were two guys checking in.. I chuckled either way.. however some might not..Room was on the 1st floor as requested and as expected and exactly the same as our last stay around 1 year ago. No resort fees, no parking fees etc as expected. 1 minute walk to the strip, 1 minute walk to the parking lot, 10 minute drive to a walmart to stock up on necessities. I always tip housekeeping when leaving in the morning to get my room turned around asap to ensure its ready for my return, the housekeeping staff here speak good english and this worked well for me. All good as usual.

reviews.title: Nice Business Hotel - Good Value for Money
reviews.text: Premier location, nice rooms with good value for money. The only thing is no restaurant, you have to go outside for breakfast. Other than that its perfect. Staff is extremely friendly and attentive. I would go there again.

reviews.title: LOCATION & PRICE PLUS NO RESORT FEES
reviews.text: Handy Location right on The StripNo Resort FeesFree Parking on-siteRooms have been recently refurbishedGood lightingIce-maker on our floorGood size room, large king bed (a little firmer than I like, but everyone’s preference differs in this regard)Casino on-site Has a small pool but we didn’t use itThis was our second stay here and we would stay againIt mightn’t have all the extravagant attractions that other hotels have, but being right in the middle of the strip, it’s really all about LOCATION & PRICE!

reviews.title: Not a great place for family
reviews.text: The room was small but comfortable enough for a heavy tourist destination like Las Vegas. But the front office is right in the middle of a casino and it was chaotic. We were traveling with a  young kid and it was not a great environment. Otherwise it was a great location, close to all the attractions

reviews.title: Great bday stay in Vegas
reviews.text: The best hotel stay ever. The manager Tomas is great as well as Laurie and Reggie at the front desk. We arrived early and they made sure we got in a room. It was my bday and they made it great. Great location great rooms and great staff. Right in the heart of vegas. I will stay here every time I come to Vegas. Thanks again for the hospitality.

reviews.title: Ray stay
reviews.text: Good rooms and service. Convenience of transportation. Good amenities like swimming pool and exercise room. Affordable restaurants near the property. Staff is friendly and helpful. Casino is a little bit tight.

reviews.title: Hidden gem
reviews.text: This hotel was located right in the middle of everything. And the prices were great on everything. ATM, drinks, gambling, food, and accommodations.  The hotel was very clean and the staff is very nice.

reviews.title: Great stay on The Strip
reviews.text: This hotel is perfectly placed in the middle of the strip. It's right next to the venetian, across road from the volcano show and easy walking distance to the Bellagio for the fountains. There is a Walgreens next to casino which has good food and supplies. Staff are friendly and helpful and there is a pool and a small gym which has adequate equipment.  Would definitely stay again, even though its right on the strip the hotel rooms are behind the casino so its quiet.

reviews.title: Nice modern and clean rooms and no surprise resort fees
reviews.text: I was pleasantly surprised. Small hotel and casino compared to most on the strip, but the rooms were very nice with a little wet bar area. Customer service was top notch and the hotel is very conveniently located. Parking was close to the back entrance and the best part is that it was free. I would definitely recommend this Best Western.

reviews.title: Good location for no frills traveler
reviews.text: We really liked this location, so close and basically within walking distance to everything. Front desk staff is very welcoming and helpful. The rooms are clean, comfy and all one needs for a Vegas getaway. No resort fees - definite plus. We enjoyed meeting Mark the bartender, so nice and he WILL remember you every time as well as your favorite beverage, best waitress was, hands down, Nia. The casino is a bit old with limited selection but this is a great hotel for a home base when you explore Vegas. If you don’t want to break the bank for a nice/clean place to crash, this is it.

reviews.title: Best Western Casino Royal
reviews.text: This hotel was well placed for the attractions on the Strip.  It is in the middle of the Strip, just a short walk to the Belagio Hotel and other attractions.  The staff were very friendly.  We once missed the daily visit of the housekeeping.  Reception followed this up leaving a message on our room phone, saying if there was anything we needed, to contact the reception.

reviews.title: Decent hotel, good location
reviews.text: Based on other reviews we chose to stay at Casino Royale because of the location and NO RESORT FEES! We are glad we did. If you rather spend money on activities and dining instead of f a room that you only sleep and shower in, this is the place for you!

reviews.title: Affordable, convenient & NO RESORT FEES
reviews.text: Comfortable stay. Hotel centrally located on strip and convenient to many area attractions. Very close to the Harrah's Monorail stop. Enjoyed our stay and would consider for future plans in the event I revisit Las Vegas,

reviews.title: Great stay.
reviews.text: This is located right in the middle of the strip which was great.  The rooms were clean, spacious, quiet and even had a fridge (which can be hard to find).  The staff were friendly and helpful.  The casino bar sells $3 beers and there is plenty of good eating options within a block walk.  They do not charge a "resort fee" like a lot of the others and have free parking and wifi.

reviews.title: Amazing
reviews.text: Such a great location and nice people to interact with. very nice housekeeping and clean rooms makes for a enjoyable stay. Entrance is a little hairy but once there it's a good time. Also visit the bar nice people to serve you up a good drink!!

My stay at the Best Western plus casino Royale off of Las Vegas boulevard in Las Vegas was awesome. The stay was comfortable nice and clean. The staff was friendly helpful and funny. Most of all there was no noise in the hallways of the motel and there was really no smoking that bothered me. I love where the location sets and I will recommend anyone to visit this location. I will be definitely visiting them again...

reviews.title: Perfect Location
reviews.text: We loved our stay at this hotel, everything was close by, the atmosphere was excellent...close to the airport....there was a bit of confusion with the Uber pick up point but once we figured it out it was all good

reviews.title: Darcy
reviews.text: BW Plus Casino Royale exceeded all my expectations! Friendly helpful staff and great location. Check in/out easy. Many great food/drink/gaming options on site. The pool area is beautiful and quiet,c hotel is right on busy stip area! I will definitely be back!

reviews.title: Great location
reviews.text: Great location, no resort fees, located in the middle of the strip, within walking distance to food, has a great pool area to relax during the day. Outback Steakhouse upstairs, staff very friendly and any issues are dealt with within minutes, has business room, vending machine and ice machine. Rooms on left side would be better as rooms on right side look down on the loading docks of other casinos.

reviews.title: Great location on strip-free parking
reviews.text: Rooms were upgraded and very clean. There was no breakfast or any type of voucher. The lobby stank like smoke because it was attached to the casino. There was also no microwave in room--only 2 down on the first floor. Parking was free and very helpful

reviews.title: Vegas Vacation
reviews.text: The Best Western Plus Casino Royale was stationed right in the middle of the strip so you had access to all the hotels and could walk 30 minutes in each direction to see all the action.  Please note they do not serve breakfast as all other Best Western hotels do but there is a Denny's or White Castle in the immediate vicinity as is a Walgreen Store.  They provide a refrigerator but not a microwave - so if you need one ask before hand.  We drove and parked our car in the parking garage for our stay with no problems.  Comfy room enjoyable vacation.

reviews.title: 1st time in Vegas
reviews.text: Picked this place because of the price and it’s central location and the fact it as no resort fees so the price what you see is the price you pay . Good 3 star accommodation in the middle of the strip . Low stakes casino downstairs if that’s your thing . Small pool area out back which was good and bottled beer only $3 a bottle which is very cheap for the central strip area . Paid $9 a bottle at the Paris hotel further down the strip to give you a idea

reviews.title: It's A Dump
reviews.text: I booked this hotel because it had a central location and did not have any additional resort, parking or internet fees added on to the room fee and we were just passing through for the night. Big mistake. The hotel parking is NOT secure. It is behind the casino and is in a non gated, no security garage. The garage elevator was broken so we had to go down a dirty, dark, scary stairwell that had a full trash bag broken and spewing food all over the stairwell. We went back to retrieve something from the car an hour later and there was a group of methed out gangstas yelling , screaming obscenities, talking trash roaming all over the garage. They finally peeled out in two cars burning rubber and we noticed neither car had back plates so we wondered if they were boosting cars. The access to the Hotel room is off an alley/driveway and  back parking lot behind the Casino that has sketchy looking characters hanging out at all hours. I would not feel safe at all staying here if I hadn't been with my husband. The Hotel looks like a total dump from the exterior but I will say the room itself was clean and the linens were OK. If you are an adventurous person who carries a handgun, is interested in scoring some good drugs or perhaps meeting some alternative characters you might enjoy staying here. Otherwise take my advise and pay the extra bucks to stay in a nicer more secure Hotel.

reviews.title: Surprisingly quiet
reviews.text: In the middle of the strip a great place to spend a couple of nights exploring Las Vegas. Rooms are comfortable and clean, Hairdryer, fridge, coffee maker and TV. Pool for guest use and multi story car park. Reception in the middle of the gaming hall which is pretty noisy. Mac Donald’s right next doo, Outback steak house on site, Walgreens just down the road. Dinner at Gilleys is substantial but it’s Las Vegas so nothing is cheap. Paris hotel, Bellagio and Venitian worth a visit, but be careful in Caesar’s Palace it’s huge and it’s easy to get disoriented. First and last trip here - Vegas is like marmite love it or hate it.

reviews.title: Great hotel Great location
reviews.text: Hotel is well located, room was very clean and everything worked perfectlywe loved the bed and the comforterthere's a walgreens right beside and so many options to eat last time I stayed at Stratosphere which is also Best Western but this time was much better ! it's on the right spot

reviews.title: 3 rd time -still the charm!!
reviews.text: Stayed june 9 to13 in room 336..this was a quiet room at end of hall overlooking ally between casino royals and Harrah...no view but crazy quiet given mid strip location!  Comfy bed..cold fridge..great housekeeping! This is not a fancy resort  All the things I love about this place are well known- no resort fees, free parking, great location! ( Vegas is quite easy to navigate by car and opens up a world more of things to  do)Really appreciate the Denny's coupons given on check in. Tixfortonite is right outside doors..fat Tuesday's also right on street side ( they really will fill any cup..I had my wahlburgers one refilled) One thing I did miss over my previous visits was the tshirt/ souvenir stand is gone.We will certainly be back and if you would rather spend your money on activities rather than fees and parking..this place us for you!

reviews.title: Best Stay for the Value
reviews.text: Our suite was very roomy, comfortable, and very clean. If you don't go to Las Vegas to swim on the resorts, you will love this, I did! No resort fees and center of the strip. I will definitely be staying here again.

reviews.title: Excellent stay
reviews.text: We stayed in room 329 on the third floor.  Despite overlooking the car park entrance this was very quiet.  Very comfortable beds, husband wanted to bring the pillows home!  Very clean.  Loved having a coffee maker in the room, but no milk or creamer supplied.  Having a fridge and ice bucket was great, ice machine nearby.  The only issue was the keycards for the door which kept cutting out so it could take a few tries to get through the door from the casino and then again to open the room door.  We changed them at reception but it kept happening.  We booked the room through booking.com 7 months before our stay at a great rate and as Casino Royale doesn’t charge resort fees we were very happy as the price had doubled online by the time we arrived.  Excellent location right on the Strip!  If you want to watch the Volcano at the Mirage, don’t stand outside Casino Royale as the trour buses pull up right in front and block your view so make sure you cross the Strip  Your nearest ATM is right next door in Walgreens and charges $6 per transaction.  The cheapest we found were in Fashion Show mall at $4.  Reception gave us 25% off coupons for Dennys too.  Would definitely book here again.  Worth joining the membership scheme at the casino as you get your first $20 back if you lose.  You can’t cash it in but you can use it to play the slots and then hopefully cash out any winnings, which we did.

reviews.title: Great Bar
reviews.text: Staff are so friendly especially Mark.Prices are fantastic and not a smoky atmosphere.we always drop in and have been regular customers for years.They serve great cocktails too.Some fast food outlets on the property too

reviews.title: Can't go wrong with this place
reviews.text: Unless you are a high roller, this is the place to stay.  It is in the middle of the strip, across from the Mirage.  Odd layout in that the desk is on one side in the casino, and the rooms in another building.  So what, room was clean, quiet, secure.   It is not a suite, but it was cheap and comfortable.   You can walk anywhere from this location.   Parking was free in a secure garage.  Exit to the street if you don't want to navigate casino.

reviews.title: Excellent stay
reviews.text: Clean rooms kind staff Close to everything Nice pool Everyone very helpful Within walking distance to everything Denny’s and McDonald’s and White Castle close byBeds very comfortable in the middle of everything Would definitely stay here again

reviews.title: Perfect Location
reviews.text: This was our first trip to Las Vegas and we chose this hotel for (a). It's location on the strip. Right in the centre and very handy for getting to all the other attractions, and (b) The great value. This was the only hotel we could find that did NOT charge a resort fee.  The room was very comfortable and well equipped and was always well maintained.  If we come back to Vegas we will definitely be staying at the Casino Royale again

reviews.title: Budget heaven
reviews.text: If you want a clean , extremely well located hotel that doesn’t cost an arm and a leg then this is it . No resort fees mean there are no nasty surprises at the end of your stay which in Vegas is a giant plus. The rooms are well away from the casino floor and we heard zero sounds from it . Towels were changed daily and the cleaners actually cleaned your room and didn’t just move things around. The room has everything you need so all in all a little gem of a hotel that could teach it’s bigger more prestigious neighbours a thing or two.

reviews.title: Close to everything
reviews.text: The hotel is close to everything got new slot machines good parking nice rooms right across the street the hotels volcano erupts every night and in the lobby there's a Ben & Jerry's that has very good ice cream

reviews.title: Vegas and No Resort Fees
reviews.text: This was my 4th trip to Vegas. A really well located hotel close to the centre of the strip. The room was comfortable and I was located at the back of the hotel, which was strangely quiet given the location. I didn't use the pool but it seemed busy when I went for a look. Outback steak was delicious as was the Ben and Jerry outlet in the foyer. The staff were lovely especially the lady who checked me in and the chap from Cuba who helped with my bags when I left. I had some very minor issues with the overall cleanliness of the bathroom, but other than that my stay was faultless! Thank you Casino Royale - I will be back 😊😊😊😊

reviews.title: Mother"s Day trip
reviews.text: We always stay here great location clean staff great close to everything right on the strip easy to get to my son takes to to las vegas every year for Mother"s Day for the last sixteen years we have a great time

reviews.title: Excellent location
reviews.text: Great place to stay,bang in the middle of the strip, no resort fees or parking fees. And you can be in you’re room literally 2mins after coming off the strip, lovely staff. We will definitely be staying here again, well done casino royale keep up the good work 👌🏻

reviews.title: First Vegas Visit!
reviews.text: Stayed for 5 nights as part of our holiday to the US. The location is fantastic, right between Harrah's and The Venetian. All the staff we encountered were very friendly and helpful. The room was brilliant, very spacious with a king sized bed, fridge, decent quality coffee maker, large wardrobe, good wi-fi, and in room safe. We had a room overlooking the pool area and the rear entrance to the hotel/casino. We had a couple of nights where we were woken in the early hours by people congregating outside the casino and by delivery lorries "beeping" their way into position to make deliveries, but no biggie really. There are a number of onsite eateries including an Outback steakhouse and a Denny's ( which was always really busy!). Pool area is small but perfectly adequate. All this for a really good price and NO RESORT FEES! Would definitely stay here again.

reviews.title: Great hotel! Would stay here again
reviews.text: Our group of three friends booked this hotel well in advance so got a great price for this hotel. Amazing location - right in the middle of the strip near the Bellagio and the Venetian and lots of other casinos. Right next door to Walgreens, Denny’s, McDonalds, Chipotle and many more.24 hour casino like lots of the hotels. Subway, Pizza Hut, hot dogs, bar, Fat Tuesdays and Ben & Jerrys all on site. Cheap and cheerful! The casino seemed a little more relaxed than more of the big name casinos also. Also there’s a place right outside to buy discounted show tickets. The room was a good size, housekeeping daily and a safe in the room. We had no noise problems in the room. The air con is a little noisy. I’m not sure if the myth of pumping oxygen into the rooms is true but we didn’t get an awful lot of sleep so I’m not sure if it was the oxygen or just the Vegas buzz!

reviews.title: Amazing hotel
reviews.text: I will enjoyed by stay. Staff were very friendly n helpful. Room is extremely quiet and all the facilities were up to the mark. Internet was amazing, room was clean and daily atleast 1-2 times room boy was following up if there is any thing required. Overall amazing experience.

reviews.title: Weekend stay in vegas
reviews.text: This was our first stay at the Best Western casino Royale and was our best stay in Vegas in. 5 visits, Checkin was easy and we had an early arrival room was very good with coffee maker and fridge.We had good nights sleep as room was quiet on 2nd floor. They stored our bags until we had to leave.Could not fault would stay again for the price it is good value and service

reviews.title: Great value on the  Las Vegas Strip
reviews.text: Great Value for a Las Vegas Trip hotel. Free parking!! The rooms were clean and quiet, but a little dated. Nice pool, and was really private.Nice small casino, they have a really good players club, it was worth signing up for.

reviews.title: Week on the strip
reviews.text: Arrived and staff very welcoming , room was what we expected and very comfortable and served its purpose well.  Excellent location and onsite facilities, pool was a little smaller than expected.  No resort fees , bonus !

reviews.title: Comfortable and quiet
reviews.text: Casino Royale is located towards one end of of the strip, with good access to other properties. We used Uber a lot to get around, and found we have to walk through the next door property, Harrah's, for pickup. That's a minor inconvenience except when checking out with luggage.The hotel doesn't have a real lobby or any other quiet common area, just a million slot machines and a small front desk tucked away. But that's Vegas!There's no breakfast. Instead we were given discount vouchers to Denny's next door. When we went to get breakfast the queue was a half an hour wait, so we gave up on that idea. There are no places to get decent food on the property, only junk to go.The room was comfortable and quiet, so no real complaints there (the shower head could do with some maintenance). The staff were friendly and helpful witha couple of very minor requests.

reviews.title: Great stay at a great price
reviews.text: Great hotel, great location in the centre of the strip.  Rooms spacious and clean, and coffee machine provided.  Staff welcoming and helpful.  Anything you want to see or do in Las Vegas easily accessible on foot from this hotel.  Although the rooms are located above the casino there was no noise disturbance. Parking available, just had to request a permit from reception. Pool rather small but clean and tidy.  We had a wonderful stay, and would highly recommend this hotel.

reviews.title: 1st choice in Vegas every time!
reviews.text: Fast check in and a warm welcome from friendly and attentive staff at front desk which is located through the casino area, rooms were freshly maintained and spacious. This hotel is in a excellent location on the strip. Good breakfast options in eateries beside the hotel which will suit any budget. I like this hotel is not big. It means no dragging of luggage to high floors or through lobbies of the bigger hotels, the pool was quiet despite being next to the strip and spotless clean with fresh towels and new seating and sunbeds to beds. This would be my choice every time I were in Vegas. A bargain price with no hidden charges or fees. We had a comfortable stay.

reviews.title: Great place to stay on the Strip!
reviews.text: My husband and I and another couple stayed here for 4 nights during March and we were amazed. We had a twin room and our friends had a king room and we were literally 30 seconds from the strip. We didn’t even have to get in a lift but there is one so you don’t have to struggle with your luggage but once you have unpacked access to the strip is great. The room was clean, spacious enough for Vegas and the beds were very comfy. The fridge in the room made it easy for us to have a few drinks which we purchased from Walgreen’s which is next door. Walgreen’s was also handy for snacks and fruit. Check in was was super easy and quick with no waiting and on check out the staff were kind enough to call a taxi at 5am that was large enough for our party and all our luggage. I would highly recommend this hotel for anyone looking for a comfy clean room without any resort fee’s that is very handy location on the Strip. We can’t wait to return! Thanks Best Western Casino Royale xx

reviews.title: Perfect Location, good value for money!
reviews.text: the hotel is ideally located in the centre of all action on the strip! lots of bars and restaurants nearby and walking distance to all major casinos. Venetian is right next door and mirage is just across the street. a pharmacy right next door is also useful. a good steakhouse and a cheap and good diner right above the casino. the reception is in the middle of the casino which can be a bit confusing in the beginning. Rooms were neat and tidy. However, the roof seemed thin as i could hear people walking above. Overall good experience and excellent value for money. Would definitely stay here again!

reviews.title: Perfect Location on the Strip
reviews.text: We got a great deal through Booking.com for 2x nights, the room was very spacious with 2x queen beds - very comfortable! Located right in the heart of the Strip across the road from the Mirage. There are a few fast food outlets within the casino plus a Ben & Jerry’s :)

reviews.title: 2019 Las Vegas trip.
reviews.text: We always stay at this hotel.  It's clean and friendly.  Parking is really easy and quick.  It's directly across from the volcano.  $3 beers are a plus.  There is no resort fee. The front desk was very helpful and accommodated our request.

reviews.title: Right there in the middle of it all.
reviews.text: Perfect location.My advice is to cross Las Vegas Blvd so you don’t get stuck in the frozen drink line.Room was clean and comfortable.The front desk was very friendly and helpful.Walgreen’s is right next door.

reviews.title: King room with no view but got free parking, wifi,refrigerator, and coffee maker.
reviews.text: King room for 2 nights was a good deal try getting deals for this hotel beginning of April 1-6th because it will sell out and cheaper rates. You get a refrigerator, coffee maker Keurig, ironing board, free parking and wifi.Parking is good but tricky just because it can get super crowded with people and cars traveling by. You will have to have a parking permit though. The casino has Fat Tuesday drinks, subway, pizza, and cheap hot dogs, Outback steakhouse, and Ben and Jerry ice cream. Next to this hotel is Venetian and Harrahs, right across the street is the Mirage with its famous volcano show that last about 5 minutes. Great place.

reviews.title: All good but the HVAC
reviews.text: I checked in and out the same day.  This hotel was very nice, great people, nice rooms but NO AIR CONDITIONING.  There antique system only allows one temperature, set by the Hotel.  No matter where you put the AC control set. it never goes anywhere, same steady stream of the same temperature.  They have a "chiller" on the roof, ad wherever that is set, that is what you get.  you have NO control of the Air Conditioning whatsoever.  Hey Folks, if you are visiting Vegas, you are i a desert!  Play there bit DON'T STAY there.

reviews.title: Small but well placed
reviews.text: There are pros and cons for the hotel, it is small but the casino has plenty of games, there are plenty of cocktail waitresses with regular service. But the bar does $3 bottles so is great value. The guest rooms are easily accessible and mine was literally about 20 paces from the hotel front door, which was a real plus.The rooms are clean and well equipped, the coffee machine and fridge are a bonus. There is a Walgreens next door so the fridge can be stocked cheaply.The staff are friendly and helpful and  there is security in the casino . The downside was some of the clientele that gather in the casino late at night is not good and seemed to be made up of homeless and party girls.There is no resort fee and the rewards card was excellent .Despite the downside I would stay there again and it is great value

reviews.title: Clean, comfortable and great location!
reviews.text: Hotel was right on the Strip!Perfect location. Big, clean rooms. Little old fashioned but comfy. Rooms were cleaned every day. Hotel's casino not so nice than other hotel's but it didn't matter cause we spent most of the time on the Strip or other casino's. Hotel has Pizza Hut, Subway and few other eating places. Hotel reception was small and not so inviting, but staff was friendly. Easy access to monorail next to Harrah's hotel. If you want hotel which is at perfect location, clean and you don't have to pay any resort fees, then Casino Royale is your hotel! Just few steps from hotel lobby and you are right on the Strip!!

reviews.title: Yeah! Vegas, Baby
reviews.text: Lets get the negative out the way. Its a hotel with a 24/7 casino, and you can get woken up by celebrating guests at all times of the night. now then, you get to the hotel travelling North on the strip and turn in right, next to the adjoining walgreens supermarket. they have a small open air parking lot , plus a larger multistory garage. check in is through the casino and is done very efficiently. the room is ok for a few nights with a small fridge for drinks etc, a/c and a niice comfy bed.It is quite well decorated and maintained although you can get a very slight wiff of drains. A lift to all floors and lift in multistory parking. Access ramp into the rear of the hotel and casino. The flat screen TV has loads of channels to keep yourself occupied. In the casino below, there is pizza hut, with a limited menu.. A Subway and a dog seller. A white castle takeaway is also on site. No breakfast is offered onsite, buyt you get discount (%25) on the dennys breakffast menu.The hotel  is centrally situated on the strip, next to the Venetian hotel/casino, acroos the road from the Belagio and its fountain show. daily change of towels and regular change of bed linen If we returned to LV again, we would certainly stay here again, probably more due to the fact they charge NO RESORT FEES and NO PARKING CHARGES (a real bonus on the strip).

reviews.title: Vegas strip accommodation
reviews.text: My partner and I stayed here for 2 nights and had also booked a room for my daughter. The service was friendly, the room was great, and the location was perfect. If you want to experience the Vegas strip without paying stupid prices then this place is awesome!

reviews.title: Smaller hotel on the Strip
reviews.text: We stayed at this hotel which was much smaller than the majority of the hotels on the strip.  The rooms were fine, it was in an excellent position, staff were helpful, no complaints, would stay there again

reviews.title: Las Vegas Vacation
reviews.text: Hidden little gem middle of strip next to Harrah's. Great value option. Nice and friendly staff Smaller more intimate casino area. Room was small but clean and comfortable. Would definitely stay again

reviews.title: Right in the middle of the heart of the strip
reviews.text: The hotel is right in the middle of all the fun. There is Mcdonald's, Panda, and chipotle right next to the rooms when you exit to the left. It is right next to harrah's, linq, and across from the mirage. We went in march and the madness was incredible. To the right you have the venetian, paris, and palazzo. The noise level was at the max outside but didn't transfer inside. Parking was not hectic at all. easy to find. A little difficult to go in because of pedestrians but other than that it was fine. Receptionist Tina was great. Amazing service she gave us.

reviews.title: Trip to Las Vegas
reviews.text: The Best Western Plus Casino Royale is a fantastic choice for those who do not want to spend a lot of money to sleep, yet want to be in the middle of all the action. The room was comfortable and clean with enough amenities to satisfy my needs. This is not a huge room, but since I am only using it to sleep, who cares.  The rates are very reasonable and the location is perfect; right across from the Mirage.  The staff is personable and competent. The Casino has some very loose slots as well.

reviews.title: My Happy Place!
reviews.text: Perfect location.Real, not fake friendly front desk! Sharon and Tina helped me a lot but everyone is nice.The bartenders?I’ve been bartending for 20 years and I know good ones when I see them.Mike, Mark, Darrel, Donavon, George, Walt and the other Mike!

reviews.title: Good value for money
reviews.text: Casino Royale is definitely small when compared to the major casino/hotels on the strip, but does that really matter? They do not charge resort fees at all and the rooms were well equipped with all you could need.Good points:Very clean Good room facilites: Comfortable beds, safe, coffee machine and a good, warm shower.Good general facilities: Vending machines, ice machines and a free business centre.Decent casinoBroad choice of diningWalgreens next door for essential groceries etc.Bad pointsCasino staff weren't particular friendly, came across as a lot more unhappy than those at other casinos.Housekeeping staff (though very good at their job) were very noisy early each morning in the corridor, they woke me more than once during our stay, even though they were nowhere near our door.

reviews.title: Great location, no frills
reviews.text: The location is perfect on the strip and without the expense of resort fees.  No frills and simple room, but clean.  No view from windows, because only four stories high. Mine looked at wall, but I spent little time in room.  Small casino, but staff was extremely helpful

reviews.title: Great first visit to Vegas: small but perfect
reviews.text: Stayed for four nights with my partner this month. The hotel is small however within two minutes of leaving your room you are on the strip next opposite Mirage Volcano. The hotel was clean and equipped with a safe, hair dryer, iron and board along with a coffee machine. The room was cleaned daily with fresh towels and bedding. The beds were comfy, we had no issues with sleeping. We were on the ground floor with a view of the car park however we only used the room to sleep so the view didn't affect our stay. The staff were very friendly and approachable and they allowed us to lock our bags away securely on the day of departure until we left for the airport.We would definitely stay at Casino Royale again.

reviews.title: A small casino
reviews.text: Casino Royal is a small casino but great for a fun gambling experience. They have $3.00 bottle beers and a foot long hot dog for $2.49 and a white 🏰 castle.what more can you ask for.  What a fun place.

reviews.title: Casino Royale great location
reviews.text: If you want good value for money, in the best location but not in one of the big themed hotels; you just want a pleasant nights sleep then the BW will be fine for you. Nice clean room, fridge & coffee facilites. Not noisy and too busy to get to your room.

reviews.title: Perfect spot
reviews.text: If you're looking for a place next to everything there is just pick this cute hotel in the middle of the strip. There are 24 hrs food places nearby subway, dennys and white castle to name a few. Recommended place to be specially if you're out mostly during the day.

reviews.title: Vegas first timer
reviews.text: Great location, great price :) would definitely stay with them again and will recommend to friends who want to visit Vegas, compared to the larger hotels which you can visit and eat in anyway, this was by far the best value for money

reviews.title: Great Loc. But needs improvment
reviews.text: The location was a great spot. The shower head was bad or the water pressure. I was not sure which one it was. The smoking section was right in front of the front counter area. This was a meeting place to meet up with others in our party as everybody knew where the front counter was located. I think the smoking section needed to be move away from this spot. They have a lot of gaming machines but not to many gaming tables. The guest does not have control of the AC at certain temps outside. So I had to open the window. That made it real noisy in the room. I will be staying at a Best Western again but not this one. The place was clean just a bit dated.

reviews.title: Basic hotel right on the Strip
reviews.text: My experience matches most of the reviews here. The rooms are like thousands of rooms you'll find in hotels across the country. A couple of beds, a tv, a bathroom. The fridge is a nice addition. My view was an alley and a wall. Like some other reviewers I experienced some noise when the window was open, which was fixed easily enough by closing the window.  I also wasn't a fan of having to find my way through the casion to get to the reception desk. Thankfully you only have to do that once.  But you can't beat the price for the location. Next door to Harrah's, across from the Mirage, 2 blocks from the Shops at Caesar's. I don't gamble so I don't have a review of the casino. Great option for an affordable room right in the middle of all the action.

reviews.title: Right on the Strip
reviews.text: This hotel is right on the strip so the location is brilliant. The rooms are nice and comfortable; TV, fridge and a coffee machine. The casino isn't the best but it has everything you need.I would like to thank Sharon on reception who was super helpful - she arranged for two bed's in our room - we'd booked a double bed.  Nothing was too much trouble. She even let us check in early when we'd been refused this from another member of staff.Overall its a nice hotel in the centre of everything!

reviews.title: Fair price and great stay
reviews.text: If you are looking for a fair price, peaceful place but still on Strip - this is the right place!The hotel is really small if compared to all the others on Strip, for me, that was a bonus, with no resort fees and parking included. The room was available before the check-in time, and I was able to leave my luggage in secure room when I checked-out. All the employee were very kind with me. The room was very clean and it was cleaned everyday. There were also a coffee machine (with compatible capsules) and small refrigerator.

reviews.title: Good value for money
reviews.text: The location was excellent and the rooms were quite comfortable and spacious. There were many eating places within close proximity to the Hotel. There were also many shopping areas withing close distance to the Hotel. Public Transportation was readily available.

reviews.title: Great value for money
reviews.text: Very reasonably priced hotel. Good location opposite the Mirage. The rooms are a good size, although bathrooms are small, can only fit one person at a time. Very quiet rooms with comfortable beds. Helpful front desk staff.

reviews.title: NASTY BATHROOMS
reviews.text: I fly into town for a meeting and this place was right on the strip .I am a long time BEST WESTERN DIAMOND member and still have a lot of points When I arrived I had very little hot water , the next morning I had none . What was worse is the smell of sewage backup into the drain that made me want to vomit .I called the front desk and told them the issue , asked for a manager whose names is “ Thomas “ he is the assistant manager . I nicely explained to the person on the phone that I request my points be refunded for the stay . There was a knock on my door , it was the repair guy and “ Thomas “ I could tellImmediately that Thomas had angry hostile body language. I explained the again what the issue was and I would like my points refunded . The look he gave me was like he wanted to fight . So I asked him to leave my room. I did not feel comfortable with someone like that , who was acting that way to be near me . He refused to leave . I backed away from him .I thanked the repair guy and left a tip for the maid and left I was told by another staff member that there is no preventive maintenance done on the place and it’s very old BOTTOM LINE : I am a premier member at Hilton and Marriott. Save yourself the hassle and stay at a nicer place I would recommend Homewood Suites by Hilton and the Airport . I have stayed there many times and should have stayed this this time

reviews.title: Great value for money.
reviews.text: If you want a good hotel for little cost that is directly on the strip, this is it.The price is very good and the rooms are very clean. The decor is slightly old but is in character with the area. Very comfortable beds and pillows. A very friendly staff who cannot do enough for you. The price of beer is far cheaper than most places on the strip, in fact, 50 percent less. The food is also very reasonable, especially hot dogs etc for snacking.

reviews.title: Small but comfortable rooms, inexpensive, very well located and NO RESORT FEES!
reviews.text: First things first: this casino/hotel has plentiful free parking for patrons. That in itself is a big win. The garage is easily reached from the Strip. Head Northbound. Pass the Linq, Harrah's, and then take a right into a narrow service road just after Walgreen's.Check-in is inside the casino: just follow the wall to the left as you enter from the car park. The check-in staff are friendly, helpful and unflustered.Unusually for Vegas, you don't have to talk a marathon to get to your room. The hotel itself is reached from the car park: look for a blue canopy near the multi-storey parking. Your room card (eventually) lets you through the motorised entry door. This concerns me a little: it takes a long time to close after it's been opened, and there's no internal "close" button, so anyone could tailgate you through the entrance and have access to the building.The rooms are smallish by Vegas standards at 285 square feet, but they don't feel it. Don't expect fancy views. Likely, you'll be looking at a car park or a service road - but did you come to Vegas to stay in your hotel room and stare out the window? Exactly. Decor is "desert sand" in colour, with tasteful touches and pleasant pictures. Easy on the eye. Everything is clean and tidy.The windows have good blinds, which along with light-excluding curtains, mean a very easy sleep.Talking of sleep, the bed is ridiculously comfy. I could do without the bolster cushion (what _is_ the point in these, anyway?), but that's easily set aside. There are plenty of power points. This is not one of those properties where you have to decide whether you want a table lamp or to charge your gadget. It's a very welcome change from Vegas standard.There's a kitchenette. Keurig coffee is supplied as part of the deal, and surprisingly it's not at all bad. There's also a fridge. Ice machines are, of course, down the corridor, along with vending machines - although with a Walgreen's within three or four minutes' walk across the car park, why would you not shop?Opposite the kitchenette is a wardrobe, with a digital safe. Mine didn't work. I called the front desk...and a very friendly and helpful security guy turned up within ten minutes, replaced the batteries and...wait for this...adamantly refused a tip!The bathroom is definitely Vegas standard, with a tiny tub and shower over, although the little bottles of amenities are plentiful. They're strongly citrus scented. Your hair will end up smelling like a clean kitchen counter, but hey, you're clean and they're inclusive, so why not?You get a 42" flat panel TV. As the room's not huge, it seems even bigger. There's a desk, with plenty more power points. I was at a conference, and got a fair bit of useful work done at that desk. It has a proper office chair, not a cheap wooden one - top marks for this! Oh, and a room phone. I don't know what the pricing is for calls, as I use my own phone, but it was handy for contacting front desk, as I mentioned above.I've left the best about the Casino Royale until last. There are NO RESORT FEES! This property does not subscribe to the invidious Vegas tendency to quote low room rates, then double the cost with these spurious fees. This, along with the free parking, totally endears them to me.Let's talk about the local area. The casino that's attached to the hotel is nothing special, really. It gets passing trade rather than attracting it. If you want a fancy floor, the Venetian and Palazzo are next door, and the Wynn estates past them. If a mid-level one, you're surrounded by choice: Harrah's and Linq on this side of the road, Mirage and TI across the Strip.So let's talk food. There's a Denny's above the Walgreen's next to the car park entrance, so that's breakfast sorted. You'll get a generous voucher book when you check in. Otherwise, you can probably ignore the Panda Express, McDonald's and particularly the White Castle. (I was ignored for five minutes with no other customers present, and gave up waiting for the staff to stop gossiping long enough to serve me.) The $1.99 footlong hot dog stand inside Casino Royale definitely fills a hungry hole.There are far better food outlets in the casinos; far too many to name. Just wander around and find something that fits your needs. Oh, and once you've seen the Mirage's volcano show at night, walk south and see the Bellagio fountains dance to the music.This is a great little property. It won't be my last time staying here. And I can say that with confidence, as I've already paid the deposit.

reviews.title: Perfect for Vegas haters
reviews.text: There's an entrance to rooms right off the strip. No walking through smoke filled casinos! The room was good. I had some trouble with the thermostat initially. With the cold temps, there was only heat available, yet the room was at 74 degrees. I guess they switched the building back to cool in ensuing days.I appreciated the reception walking us all the way to our room instead of letting us fend for ourselves. In contrast, the fancy casinos have a long line to check in, and then they point a finger towards the elevators, if you ask.

reviews.title: Great staff! Great Location! Great stay!
reviews.text: Pros: Clean, fresh room! Decent size. Free parking and perfect location by the strip. Very welcoming staff, which is much appreciated. Cons: No breakfast. Had to step out of the hotel for the restaurant. So, you can't be in your jammies. :)

reviews.title: Great stay for the money!
reviews.text: Doesn’t look like much when you arrive by taxi at the back entrance, but once you settled you get a whole lot for your money. The staff is really nice and helpful and the cleaning is excellent. The location is right in the middle of the action on the Strip. The only negative thing I have to say is the view from the window of our room. It faces a wall of a tiny back area, which results in that you keep the blinds down all day. Although a perk because of this is silence during night time.

reviews.title: A hidden gem right in the center of the action!
reviews.text: The hotel is a bit difficult to find. Use your GPS and take the driveway. Our room was beautifully remodeled, with 1st class tile, granite, and bedding. No short cuts. Our room was immaculate and very quiet. We didn’t have to drive anywhere. We could walk in either direction to enjoy Casinos and fabulous dining.

reviews.title: Fantastic stay
reviews.text: We stayed here for 5 nights, it’s right in the centre of the strip and with no resort fees.I’m sure that a lot of the more expensive hotels have very flash rooms, but we were more than satisfied with Casino Royale, the rooms were clean and Felicia who checked us in was really helpful.The rooms were cleaned every day and fresh towels were provided.Would definitely stay here again!

reviews.title: Little Old Fashioned Island of Calm
reviews.text: I'm not a gambler so just walked through the room full of slots, but once through the accommodation key locked door it was another world. On first appearance I expected noise from the casino below the accommodation area. Happily I was wrong. My room was clean and quiet. There was no view, but it didn't matter as I was only in the room at night. It was good to have a refrigerator in the room, and if needed a microwave in a common room down the hall. The king sized bed was comfortable and the bathroom/toilet clean and stocked. If I have to go back to Las Vegas for another convention, I'd return to the Best Western.

reviews.title: Just for fun
reviews.text: With being a rewards member. I try to stay at BW's. When available. Get them points and receive them free night stays. Which is what I did on this trip. The employees with the hotel were great and it's right in the mix of Vegas and the strip. The casino was good but small. Single deck blackjack and a couple roulette tables is all I need so we had a great time. Will definitely stay at the hotel in the future

reviews.title: Excellent Customer Service
reviews.text: Whenever we are gambling at Casino Royale, the two individuals in the office - Catrina & Reggie - always greet us with a smile and excellent customer service.  They help us with whatever we need and are happy to do so!  We really enjoy gambling here!

reviews.title: Great Location and No Resort Fee
reviews.text: This was my second trip to Las Vegas so I was looking for a strip based hotel but one that was cheap. This hotel fit my requirements as not only did I get a great deal for 5 nights, this hotel also does not charged the dreaded resort fee which made the price even better. This hotel is located opposite the Mirage hotel so in a prime location. It’s located near Denny’s, McDonald’s, Chipotle and Panda Express. Within the hotel itself there was a Subway, Pizza Hut and a few other restaurants so as you can see plenty of places close by to eat. I liked the fact that to enter the hall way to head to the rooms you needed a keycard what with it being a small hotel and therefore close the casino area and also entrances/exits. The one advantage of the hotel being small is that you don’t have to walk a long way through the hotel and casino like you have to do with other hotels. The room was your standard room you can expect from Best Western so I had no complaints. I did like that there was a decent size fridge in the room as that allowed me to go to the Walmart that was about 15 minutes away by Uber and stock up on some beverages and breakfast items to store in the fridge. My room was facing the back alley but thankfully I didn’t experience any loud noises from them late at night or early in the morning. All in all I had a great stay and would definitely stay here again and would recommend this hotel to others.

reviews.title: I will always stay here!
reviews.text: You can book this Hotel a year from your date and it will be good but the closer to your date it's expensive, more than the surrounding hotels, and this hotel offers no attractions. But it's a nice place to stay. It's right in the middle of the strip. Also very clean linen. Wonderful housekeeping staff.

reviews.title: Fantastic location and price
reviews.text: Booked this hotel early last yr and got a great price for 10 nts for 3 adults..havr also stopped here before. great location And price is good. Free parking . Had a little room view of Venetian and palazzo. Rooms kept clean every day and clean towels daily. Staff are very welcoming. Will always book to come back here. As no resort fees and it's opposite mirage and ceasers. Also as a nice out back steakhouse inside along with white castle subway foot long pizza. Denny upstairs. Next door is mc Donald. Panda express and a Mexican place. Casino is small but always had fun and won few times..in all a great place to book

reviews.title: On the strip!
reviews.text: We stayed at Best Western Casino Royale Feb 9-12, 2019. We first stayed at Casino Royale in Feb, 2016 so we knew where to enter the property; where to park and where the check in desk was. On our first visit in 2016, we found the process confusing, but it was easier this time. Parking- Free self parking. You park at the rear of the building in a parking structure. - They have 20 minute parking parks at the back of the building just in front of the parking structure, so you can go in and check in without having to lug luggage through the Casino (The hotel side is next to the casino so when checking in, don’t lug your bags through). Once you check-in, you can return to your car and collect your bags and enter the building to find your room. There are 4 levels and you need your room key to enter the building. There is an elevator immediately to your left as you enter the door. Check- In- Quick & easy- our room was prepaid so that made things easier- staff were friendly enough- we were given a discount compound for Denny’s which was nice. Room- 2 double beds- the beds were really hard and incredibly uncomfortable - our room was impeccably clean- the usual toiletries were provided as was tea/coffee making- our room had a small mini/bar fridge- housekeeping came each dayLocation- located on the strip - right next door to McDonald’s - In between Harrahs and The Venetian- Denny’s is in the same complex- Outback Steakhouse on-site - Ben & Jerry’s on-siteIt’s a nice cheap alternative to paying the  exorbitant prices of other strip casinos.

reviews.title: Hidden Gem
reviews.text: Stayed here in January 2019 during the Consumer Electronics Show. The room was clean and spacious. Parking was free. There were no hidden fees. The location is excellent: on the strip nestled among some of the big name hotels. Many attractions are in walking distance. If you are interested in a good, clean room with a great location, this is for you. There are not a lot of frills at this hotel but they can be found a few steps away. I felt safe at this Hotel.

reviews.title: would stay here again
reviews.text: great location on the strip, great casino!  We had a fabulous time.  got a surprise early check-in.  Everyone was friendly and professional. Big plus that it has no resort fee.  Walgreens being on premises is very convenient

reviews.title: Awesome Location on the Strip
reviews.text: The location was awesome, staff was great and rooms were clean and comfortable. However, we had no temperature control in our room. Apparently during the cooler months, the ac doesn’t work. Well, it was 75 degrees in the room at night and I can’t sleep when it’s warm. So, we were forced to open the window. Worst part is that our room faced the back alley where they process all the empty bottles and took all the delivery’s for the hotel next door. Thousands of bottles breaking all at once throughout the night and trucks beeping as they backed up endlessly. VERY loud! So, needless to say, we didn’t sleep much the 4 nights we were there. Heard from other people that the rooms on the other side of the hotel were very loud at night too as they were near the entrance and they heard people and taxis coming and going all night. I would stay again if the ac worked. When the window was closed the noise was tolerable.

reviews.title: Small but Big
reviews.text: Location was excellent right in the middle of the strip. Staff friendly, good wi-fi, rooms were spacious and cleaned every day. Bar at the hotel was good and cheap compared to the other big hotels around. Leave a dollar tip every time you buy a drink but its worth it. Yes I would recommend this hotel if you don't want to pay sky high prices for a fancy hotel

reviews.title: Stay here great location
reviews.text: Right on the strip no hidden fees. The casino is small and fun great staff.Makes a good base for seeing Vegas. it is clean and all you need. Right next door to Denny's for a great breakfast. Stay here and skip the hidden Vegas charges

reviews.title: Great get away stay
reviews.text: We were there to enjoy a show an just enjoy the area.  This motel has a perfect location with everything you need.  Rooms are clean and comfortable.  Many food options are close by from full meals to quick pick ups.

reviews.title: Stayed over Christmas 2018
reviews.text: The hotel is located excellent. It is close to ALL, free parking. If I come again i may stay there again. Friendly staff (Elia, Thomas). I just wish someone had told me that on New Year eve strip is closed so i won't be able to return my car that evening. Thanks to Dollar I was able to return it at the airport for a tiny fee do to circumstances so it worked great.

reviews.title: January 28th to February 5th 2019 trip
reviews.text: I chose the casino royale best western for many reasons. We had never stayed on the strip (always stayed downtown ) the price was good. No resort fee,free wifi, microwaves on first floor, rooms have a fridge,and it's on the trip close to many of the bigger hotels.  I was not disappointed, check in was super friendly (Sharon was wonderful)the room was clean, and super quiet. free parking and easy to get in out onto the strip without having to walk forever! Walgreens right there for whatever we needed. I would definitely stay again. If you dont mind not fancy but economical easy access and comfort this is the place.

reviews.title: Average
reviews.text: This hotel is in a great position on the Strip. Parking was free and had no trouble finding a space. To get to reception was a bit awkward with cases as had to go through the casino . Staff we ok. Not very helpful. Room was comfortable and clean. Down side to staying in a casino hotel is people go to bed all through the night so if you want to sleep take some ear plugs.

reviews.title: great price
reviews.text: while the price was good and no resort fees. I wish I would have just went somewhere else and paid the resort fees. The rooms were not clean the air conditioning only worked at night and check in was really slow.

reviews.title: Hotel on the Strip that's different
reviews.text: A small hotel (four floors), opposite the Mirage that offers a very different experience to the others on the Strip.  From reception to our room on the fourth floor took 5-6 minutes.Room was large, completely updated, clean and quiet. Reception staff were pleasant and helpful.  Wireless internet was one of the fastest I have encountered in a hotel. Their parking garage is close by but finding our way to it took some research. Price was reasonable.  Overall a very good experience

reviews.title: Location location
reviews.text: We spent one night at this hotel.I always try to stay in a BW hotel when in the USA as they are always great quality This hotel was not disappointing either. Location is amazing, right on the strip.Parking is on site and is FREE, also there is no resort fee which was also great.Check in was quick and easy, the check in desk is in the casino part.Rooms are ok, comfortable bed, coffee and tea as usual.On of the few BW where breakfast is not included however plenty places to choose from around.Would definitely use again and recommend

reviews.title: January 2019 visit
reviews.text: This hotel is ideally situated on the South side of the Strip and very close to Caesar's Palace which was great for us as we had a show there to see. Everybody was friendly and the room was clean and quite big for the price we paid. Great value for money and we would certainly stay here again.

reviews.title: Could have been better!
reviews.text: Disappointed!  Used points for a night in Las Vegas while passing through.  I booked a room with 2 queens and expected the same room I always have gotten in previous stays at other Best Western s.  The beds were doubles and the room was SMALL!  We were on the ground floor next to the parking garage entrance and casino entrance.  It was a cool night outside but the room was 81 degrees and the air conditioning would not work.  When I called to ask for help they explained their air only works when it is hot outside and to open the windows.  Remember I said we were on ground level at the casino and parking lot entrances.  We listened to ubers, vehicles, and delivery trucks coming and going all night until around 8AM but at least the room cooled down.  BEWARE....look at the room before accepting.  Surely they aren’t all like this!

reviews.title: Unbeatable value for money right on the strip
reviews.text: Staying for one week at Casino Royale on my first trip to Las Vegas was an excellent experience.The hotel's location is central on the strip, right opposite the Mirage. It was perfect for the main casinos on my trip - barely a few minutes' walk from the Venetian, approximately 10 mins from Caesar's Palace and 15 mins from Aria.The quality of my king room was high. It was extremely spacious with pleasant and quality furnishings. Everything you expect from a 3-star hotel, and in fairness it felt at least that.This hotel was one of the cheapest available for my stay in January 2018 at roughly $90/night and the value for money was unbeatable.The excellent central location, no resort fees, quality room and more-than-competitive price put Casino Royale right up with the best hotels I have been to.

reviews.title: Just like coming home
reviews.text: This is our home away from home.  Everyone here cares about your stay and truly want you to be comfortable.  We were checked in by Alan. Reggie is always welcoming and we make a point to see him.  Assistant Manager Thomas makes us feel like family.  Tina is so friendly and helpful.  Ilsa, cocktail waitress, is someone we make sure to see.  The rooms are always clean and the housekeeping staff is efficient and friendly as well.  We will be back again this year on our anniversary!  As always no resort fee and parking is free!

reviews.title: Excellent Service
reviews.text: This hotel while older, is a great hidden gem on the strip.  Walking distance to all our favorite places.  The rooms were clean (nonsmoking), quiet and well kept.  We had some special requests during our stay and the staff was quick and efficient in meeting our requests.

reviews.title: Convenience is the key
reviews.text: This hotel is not the MGM or Bellagio, BUT, it works just fine for most normal travelers. The room was a bit small but clean and was fine for us.  The staff were all very nice, helpful and fun. There are enough restaurants very close by to keep most happy except for the expensive meals and you can walk to Harrah's or the Venetian in less time than it takes to get out of most of the big hotels.  We had a few loud neighbors at Midnight on Saturday, this is VEGAS, this is going to happen anywhere.  Biggest complaint was the toilet running which kept me up a little at night, very minor and can be fixed. Being able to leave your room and be on the strip or in the parking lot to get a cab in 1 to 2 minutes is AWESOME.  I get real tired or walking for 10 minutes just to get our of your hotel.  For me it is a great value if you don't mind staying in what would be a a normal hotel outside of Vegas.

reviews.title: Great hotel on the Vegas Strip
reviews.text: Very good hotel. Clean room, good internet connection, right on the middle of the action in Vegas. Walking distance to all major attractions.Felicia at front desk went above and beyond to make our stay very pleasant.That is my hotel in Vegas from now on.

reviews.title: Fantastic location in the centre of the strip.
reviews.text: You couldn't wish for a better location as the Casino Royale sits in the centre of the Strip. The staff were very helpful and friendly. Nothing was too much trouble. We left our bags in a luggage room on our departure day as our flight was in the evening, and there was no charge for this. We printed off our boarding passes at the hotel at no extra cost. The room décor is a little dated but it was very clean and you don't spend much time in your room in Las Vegas. There was a fridge, TV, hair drier, safe and coffee maker in the room.

reviews.title: Value for Money
reviews.text: I saw how they clean the rooms after check-out - they are so thorough! I would stay here again because it's along the strip, there is a Subway, Pizzahut, White Castle, Panda Express, Chipotle, Sephora and Sands is very nearby.

reviews.title: No resort fees - Great Location for New Years Eve
reviews.text: When you enter the hotel, one might get a bit wary as you have to walk through the busy and smokey casino to get to the hotel check in desk - we were wary until we checked in.The hotel side is completely quiet, you would not think that there is a casino just a few levels below.Check in was quick.The rooms are exactly what you see in the photos.The room was a good size for 2 people - neat and cleanWe had an issue with the shower head and it got sorted within 10 minutes of calling the reception desk.There is a keurig coffee machine in the room.Housekeeping did a great job everyday.Denny's is next door to the hotel and we got discount vouchers from the reception.This hotel was the perfect spot for NYE - just walk out the doors and we were in the middle of the festivities - there was a DJ playing outside The Mirage (directly opposite of Casino Royale) - fireworks went off at Treasure Island - it was Spectacular!!Elia checked us out - she was super friendly and gave us a pack of casino royale playing cards - good remembrance of our stay!

reviews.title: Great location mid-strip, excellent value for money!
reviews.text: This hotel is in a great location mid-strip. The rooms are a good size with large comfortable beds & TV.  Great to have a coffee machine and fridge in the room.  The rooms are as pictured and ours was spotlessly clean.  It was good to have Dennys next door and great that the hotel gave us 25% off vouchers.The staff are very friendly and helpful.  Elia on Reception was particularly helpful when we checked out and she re-arranged our pre-booked airport transfer as we hadn't realised there was a large convention which was likely to cause travel delays to and from the airport.  Thanks Elia, we made it in plenty of time!

reviews.title: Great choice with no resort fees
reviews.text: Stayed for 4 nights in November 2018.  Great location, nothing fancy but ideal for my needs.  I was mostly using Vegas as a base to visit national parks in the area so I didn't spend a lot of time at the hotel.  The staff were incredibly helpful.  A small problem with the TV was fixed immediately. Loved the Keurig in the room.  Hotel was in the back of the property so there were no issues with noise.  Would definitely stay again.

reviews.title: Last Vegas new years
reviews.text: Very happy with our stay here very central to the main strip and offered great value. No resort fees required like the bigger casinos . Would stay here again if we were to return to Vegas again. Staff very helpful and clean rooms.

reviews.title: Outstanding.
reviews.text: 'Outstanding' encapsulates Best Western Casino Royale!! Our family arrived quite late into the night due to traffic between LA and Las Vegas. Despite this we were greeted by two amazing night staff. Room suited our needs, and I loved that the window slid open as I much prefer to sleep with fresh air as opposed to aircon :) The hotel is in an ideal location. Within arms reach of eateries, shows, facilities etc. I loved

reviews.title: What a little gem in the middle of the strip
reviews.text: As seasoned visitors to Vegas, I’m actually annoyed I’ve walked past this place hundreds of times and never given it a second glance. It came up as an outstanding deal a few months so we have it a gamble and in true Vegas style the gamble paid off this place is exactly what you need in Vegas, clean, tidy, great staff and amazing location.
