From our arrival to check out the staff couldn’t do more for you, the rooms are big and comfortable.I would have no hesitation is recommending this Place to anyone who truly knows all you need in Vegas is a clean bed and hot shower, you’re too busy enjoying the life on the strip to worry about big fancy rooms like it’s neighbours for double the price 😉If in doubt, give it a true Vegas gamble you won’t be disappointed!

reviews.title: Great location
reviews.text: The hotel is in a great location, on the main strip. It's easy to find with a large car park behind. Customer service at check is very good. The casino has a good variety of machines and a few tables. Drinks at the bar are well priced but slow coming when playing. Several take away food options and a good steak house within the hotel/ casino. A good value hotel.

reviews.title: Great value
reviews.text: One bedroom apartment was great. Very clean and comfortable with a great bed. Fantastic location close to everything. The room was quiet except for the 5 minutes at night when the volcano across the road erupts. This hotel was really good value for money and we would stay there again.

reviews.title: Good hotel
reviews.text: Overall our stay was great however the check in was a pain in the back. I understand people can have a bad day but the guy who tried checked us in shouldn’t work front desk. It took us 20 minutes until it was finally our turn (with only two people in front of us) and then he wasn’t able to work out things and blamed me on stuff? No apology, no smile or anything. After nearly 10 minutes he handed us over to the supervisor who checked us in in 1 minute.The lady who did the check out was wonderful though! Asked about our stay, made sure all questions were answered, great customer service as you expect it from a hotel!

reviews.title: Clean and comfortable
reviews.text: I was not expecting a whole lot because it is an older property, not one of the big fancy hotels. It was clean, comfortable, not fancy and the price was reasonable. On the strip so it was fairly close to most places and they have parking which is good for Vegas.

reviews.title: It's worth the money for me
reviews.text: Love the place we stayed at the 4th floor and its so quite. They have a closet with mirror. The bed is big, me and my mum share 1 bed and my friend in the other bed.The thing that i just dont like is they dont have microwave. Staying here worth my money And this place is close to everything.  If you gonna staty in this place i recommend to use uber its more cheaper and all you have to do is walk to the Harrah's uber pick up zone and its just next door.

reviews.title: Best western
reviews.text: You can't go wrong with this hotel staff very very helpful price can't be beaten rooms very good it's not 5star but it's very clean and comfortable no negatives at all lots of dining options and no resort fees bonus

reviews.title: RETURN TO THE CASINO ROYALE
reviews.text: Stayed at the Best Western Plus Casino Royale August 22nd - September 1st 2018. This is my wife and I second 10 night stay at this hotel. What's not to love about it? Centre strip,free parking, no resort fees,rooms are quiet,well appointed,comfortable and secure. There are numerous eateries on site including an Outback Steakhouse. The bar prices are much less expensive than other casinos. We arrived at around 10am and we're given our room keycards immediately.We have booked again for 11 nights in July/August 2019. TOP NOKKA HOTEL!!

reviews.title: No resort fees or parking charges!
reviews.text: This is the only hotel in the middle of the strip that does not charge a resort fee! Most of the other resorts are charging $40+ per night. The location is excellent and its easy to park in the parking garage, They have a small heated pool but I did not use it. The rooms actually have refrigerators which you usually don't see on the strip. The hotel was quiet and clean. I stayed for 3 nights and only paid $240 through Travelocity.

reviews.title: Affordable and convenient
reviews.text: This hotel had nice rooms and they were very considerate and accommodating. I arrived into town very late so I noted that in my online check in and called several times. They were completely ready for my arrival around midnight and were helpful in directing me to my room which can be very daunting when the lobby is a casino. Reggie at the desk was extremely friendly and professional.

reviews.title: Location
reviews.text: Great place to stay right in the middle of strip.  Very helpful and friendly staff.  Casino was fun room was great. Pool area clean. Room had a mini fridge and comfy bed. Very clean.  Planning on returning in October.

reviews.title: Central Strip
reviews.text: The service in Casino Royale is outstanding. The complex is dated and  does need a little  tlc but the location and people make the difference.Reggie whom welcomed us and Tina who answered our questions. Location is excellent  with access to the duece stop and all the big casinos.The business centre was also great  for printing  boarding passes.

reviews.title: Stale, musty, and cold
reviews.text: The room and hall ways were stale.  Room temps could not be controlled.   Set by hotel maintenance.   Everyone doesn't want 67 degrees as their room temp. Hotel staff stated it was nothing they could do.  Would never stay here again.....even for free.

reviews.title: Fun gambling!
reviews.text: I spent several hours on numerous days here just for the slots.  It was a lot of fun and the pay outs were good.  The place does have a strange smell to it.  Drink service was very good.  I loved all the food options.  We ate at Subway, the foot long hotdog, White Castle and Denny's.  I would come here again for gambling and restaurants.

reviews.title: Use the Hotel's back entrance to access BW Casino Royale's garage
reviews.text: Stayed four nights, and our room was comfortable, healthy, and clean. The hotel has a business office, which consists of three computers with a single printer (color), which can be accessed with your room key. We had to used the computer twice, and had no difficulty in accessing the internet or using the email. The computer and printer worked perfectly for us.The hotel is compact, so everything is within easy reach. Both my wife and I are recovering from health problems, so the convenience of getting around was a major plus for us. There are two ways to get to the hotel’s free parking: the first way is to access the garage through the Las Vegas Blvd. entrance, and the second way is to access the garage through the city streets that are located in the back of the casino resorts.  I found accessing the garage through the Las Vegas Blvd. entrance stress filled as the people who walk up and down get very upset when you itch your car through the crowds. They have trouble enough walking with the changing walking crowd and, then, suddenly they are dealing with a car inching its way  through the  walking crowd. Some walkers get upset, and they let you know they are upset. I prefer using the city streets, or the second option, to access the BW garage: Listed below are the directions to the back entrance to the BW Plus Casino Royale parking garage;heading northbound on I15 I take the  spring mountain rd exitCross las Vegas Blvd; Spring Mountain turns into Sands AvenueTurn right on S Kovan LaneTurn right on Krueger Dr.; Krueger is going to split in two, left for Harrah's, right for Venetian, take the Harrah's side (left) then after a few yards there is a hard left turn for Harrah's where you will want to go straight.The Casino Royale parking garage will be on the right.After using both entrances I sure you will prefer using the back entrance to access the garage.

reviews.title: Meh
reviews.text: The WiFi here is crap, intermittently and unreliably works at times. Location is good, value is fair. Nothing about the hotel impresses, but it’s not trying or meant to.In the end, expectations were met for the price. I’d personally spend more for a better venue.I almost forgot— the tap water has a sulfur smell, the hot water runs out every morning, and the shower drain is mostly clogged.I tried uploading a single photo of the view of the dumpsters from the top floor, but the internet is so bad here, it wouldn’t complete.  It’s the first time I’ve witnessed a progress bar actually backpedal, hah.

reviews.title: Great Value on the Vegas Strip
reviews.text: While the casino itself was average, the rooms were fantastic. While many of the larger resorts require a lot of walking to get from your room to the Strip, Casino Royale's rooms are a quick step and key swipe away. Everything was very comfortable and clean, and the location can't be beat - especially since they don't charge a resort fee. A hidden treasure for staying on the Strip.

reviews.title: Casino Royale Best Western
reviews.text: The hotel itself is in a good location. It is near all the cool parts of the strip. The hotel is outdated and needs some renovations. The drinks were affordable and it was cheaper to gamble at this hotel. The value for what you receive did not match my expectations.

reviews.title: Great location on the Las Vegas strip
reviews.text: Very well priced hotel. Extremely friendly and helpful staff especially Thomas who made us feel very welcome. The walls are thin so there can be a little noise at times, but for the price and location it’s balanced out.

reviews.title: Good visit
reviews.text: Booked this place after reading reviewI would  say the hotel needs to be givenaa lick of paintAll members of  staff  were very pleasant and helpful.Rooms were kept spotless.Would definitely stay here againThanks

reviews.title: Good Place to Stay
reviews.text: It's hidden away on the strip ,but a greatly place to stay. Staff is extremely Helpful and friendly . Can't say enough good things about the staff and there assistance.When the print failed they were more than helpful,in correcting the problem. Room were up to date and comfortable. This is a nice place to stay on the strip and accessable to all the other casinos on the strip. Will definitely stay here again. Plus No resort fee or parking charge.

reviews.title: Excellent value for money hitel
reviews.text: Brilliant hotel in the middle of the strip and excellent value for money. We couldn’t have asked for anything better, especially as a low level hotel as required by my travelling companion.Would highly recommend

reviews.title: Excellent value; Great location; No resort fees
reviews.text: If you are looking for a no frills, inexpensive, centrally located hotel -- then this is it.  Our room was simple (everything worked) and clean.  It was about 45 seconds from our room to the sidewalk of the Strip.  Not having to walk through the entire Casino was great.  There was a coffee maker and a fridge in the room.  All in all a great place to stay.

reviews.title: EXCELLENT location, sleep cheap, but probably isn't the hotel experience you're looking for
reviews.text: The hotel is right in the middle of the strip, so it's easy to get everywhere you want to go by walking or riding the bus, and they don't charge resort fees like the other hotels. The casino itself is small, musty, and extremely outdated - I don't know how they can possibly compete and stay open. The hotel is serviceable for those of us who are always on the go and just need a clean bathroom and a decent bed. I would stay here again for the location and the price.

reviews.title: Best value on the Strip
reviews.text: Like is says when booking there is no resort fee , so no hidden extras to pay at check-out , it is right on the strip and easy walking distance to all the big hotels. It is the best value stay on the strip. The rooms may be a little dated but are clean and have everything you need to enjoy your stay.This is my 3rd time here and will stay any time i am in Vegas.

reviews.title: Love the lack of resort fees! and free parking
reviews.text: It's nice to be able to stay at an hotel on the strip that doesn't charge parking the min $35 resort fee.Everything else is allright. It's a no-frills hotel for the kinda guy that wants to see a concert and that's it.

reviews.title: Perfect for short stay
reviews.text: Great location,very good rooms.Check in is almost in the casino.It was very quick by Vegas standards. Room was what we needed,good shower,clean,ironing facilities,big screen TV.Room was quiet with the exception of some guests who liked to talk at above normal levels on the west to their rooms. No resort fees was a huge factor in our decision to stay.Will definitely stay here again.

reviews.title: My 50th
reviews.text: Great hotel very clean with free off street parking The room was large with a good size bed and tv they have a full size fridge you next to a super market so you can fill up with water you are bang in the middle of the strip would I go again or recommend it YES  100%

reviews.title: Me Rosemary Darcy
reviews.text: Highly recommend this property. Rooms are spotless, quiet, you have a fridge and coffee maker. Located in the middle of the strip and you don't have to walk miles through the casino to get to the strip. The management are fabulous going above and beyond for anything you require. No resort fees and fantastic customer service. Thank you Thomas Martinez. We will be back

reviews.title: BW Casino Royale
reviews.text: The hotel room was spacious and clean and offered a very comfortable bed and pillows.  Some minor issues with an outlet not working and only complaint is that the water temperature would fluctuate in the shower.

reviews.title: Birthday trip
reviews.text: Had a great trip and stay at the Casino Royale.  Hotel staff was very accommodating and our cocktail waitress was amazing.  She never left us wanting a drink anytime we were at the Casino.  Will definitely stay again. Great location on the strip also.

reviews.title: Hidden gem!
reviews.text: The Best Western Casino Royale is centrally located on the strip. Rooms clean and recently updated. WiFi is fast. Staff very accommodating and friendly. No resort fees. Very convenient and would stay again!

reviews.title: We had a great stay
reviews.text: Once you find the reception it was great. The staff are friendly and helpful. The room was Clean and just what we needed. Good TV. Nice fridge. Bathroom was also very good. We used the room for sleeping so was perfect for us. Didn't want to pay resort fees for stuff we had no interest in using. Would definitely stay here again. Oh and a great position on the strip

reviews.title: small hotel
reviews.text: The staff is kind. Typical for LV, without breakfast (bad), king beds (good). Good is that has only 4 floors (no need to wait for the  lift). I understand that they are adapting to competitors around, but for such a price you can find a lot of better hotels around the world. For Strip in Las vegas is good.

reviews.title: 5 night stay
reviews.text: Very disappointed, if you’re staying at the Casino Royale make sure your room is away from the housekeeping room and ice machine……….housekeeping are very loud in the early hours of the morning and the ice machine which is noisy is constantly in use.

reviews.title: Great location
reviews.text: We stayed here for 2 nights for the weekend. Price was very reasonable, and located in very central strip right across the Mirage. It's not like a very trendy hotel, but the room was clean and had everything we needed. It was great to stay!

reviews.title: Location great
reviews.text: Great stay friendly staff no resort fees the rooms were clean and comfortable I've stayed in a few big name  hotels in las Vegas and this one beats them all in particular the lady on reception was particularly warm and welcoming

reviews.title: Casino Royal in Vegas
reviews.text: Such a great location on the strip. I have stayed here twice now and both stays have been excellent. The staff were also brilliant and always willing to help.Will definitely revisit next time. Thanks again

reviews.title: Always consider this hotel when wanting to stay on the strip Vegas
reviews.text: Stopped here for seven nights. Definately hotel to consider. Not got the extravagance of other more famous hotels but does has brilliant location right on the Strip...literally leave your room three minutes on the Strip no endless corridors, down lifts from towers, through queues of people. There are only four floors and lift...brilliant. Took five mins to book in there was only one person ahead of us in the queue took five minutes to book out only two persons in queue. Friendly staff. Toilet blocked up fixed by man in five minutes no waiting hours for someone not to turn up. Very tidy rooms and great cleaners. Can't fault it...if you want extravagance of other hotels then walk out of this quality hotel and visit them. No rip off resort tax. Price very reasonable. I'm trying to think of negatives and can't find any

reviews.title: great place to stay on the strip
reviews.text: Great place to stay on the strip. Updated rooms, Great service. Location is close to everything you would want to do. The staff is always extremely helpful. Its is between Harah's and the Venitian.The casino is old style but they have been making upgrades.

reviews.title: Another great stay!
reviews.text: This is my second time in one year coming back to this hotel/ casino. Got here a little early and wanted to see if I could check in because normal check in time is 4:00pm. Rooms were ready and was able to get in early. Was checked in by Allen and made the process very easy because I had 3 rooms. He was able to get us all on the ground floor next to each other just as was requested. All 3 rooms were just great and so clean. From the front desk all the way to housekeeping, everyone was friendly. I have still one more night and wanted to write this review while I'm still here because that's how happy I am with this place. I was here for the Jimmy Buffet pool party, but this hotel keep the grounds clean and showed me that it doesn't matter how many people are in Vegas, they still make your stay perfect. Thanks again I will be back!!

reviews.title: Great Hotel
reviews.text: Brilliant hotel and location. Comfy beds and clean rooms. Staff very friendly and helpful. A few days in we had a bit of a problem with our room (which could have happened at any hotel), we were dealt with quickly and efficiently. Been to Vegas several times before and never really noticed this hotel, it's now my favourite.

reviews.title: Excellent location
reviews.text: This hotel is very well located, in the Las Vegas Boulevard, very close to Caesar’s and other casinos. The room is clean and the free internet is excellent. They have a free parking lot and few commodities to help you during your stay.

reviews.title: Began count down today
reviews.text: Just a month to go for our 52nd anniversary trip. Can't wait to see Thomas, Tina, Reggie, Sharon, Alan and the rest of the friendly staff. This is the only hotel we stay in. Rooms are clean and comfortable with free fridge and coffee maker. Casino is small by Vegas standards but fun with good games, friendly dealers and good cocktails. Big hello to Ilsa, Best cocktail lady on the strip. NO RESORT FEE AND FREE PARKING! What's not to like?

reviews.title: Value for money
reviews.text: Stayed here for 3 nights and have been very pleased with the hotel and the location even though it was quite pricey. We booked last minute so you probably get better deals in advance. The casino itself is excellent value for money and has a pleasant, easy going atmosphere. It’s a great place to learn if you’re not a gambler and we really enjoyed finding out about different  games that we would have steered clear of previously. Drinks are very reasonably priced and the staff are helpful and friendly. Make sure you sign up for a player card as soon as you arrive

reviews.title: little gem in las vegas
reviews.text: this hotel is in a fantastic location right on the strip yet when in your room you hear no noise. The staff are lovely and friendly and very helpful. The room is spotless and nicely decorated. bed is Super Comfy, and wifi is good.

reviews.title: Awesome Hotel Experience
reviews.text: I booked this hotel in the beginning of 2018, since we had a group of friends visiting Vegas at the same time. I had never stayed here before, although we have been to Vegas at least 100 times.  we have never stayed here.  The draw for me was that parking was free, and there is no resort fee.  It's a win-win situation in a place that has often rising charges for both of those.  The front desk employees provided exceptional service, as they detailed the easiest ways to get around the hotel, which ensured the care and concern the hotel has for the safety of its guests. The room was beautifully decorated, and was very clean.  I would definitely stay again.

reviews.title: In the middle of it all
reviews.text: If your looking for a Elaborate casino / resort style experience chose the Mirage across the street or the Wynn just to the north. IF you want a nice place right in the heart of it all without the extra non sense of the resort fee's and paying to park, this maybe your place. This is a best western hotel chain, Regardless of where your at in the world, its a solid hotel, not fancy or elegant.  I cant believe this place hasn't been purchased and bull dozed yet due to its awesome location as its surrounded by huge towers.   PLEASE READ...... ARRIVAL.  you can make a right off of Las Vegas BLVD headed northbound from the Flamingo rd exit of I15.  . There is a sign , a very small sign that says best western casino royale. Just past the most popular Walgreens in the world.  This will lead you to the parking garage. This could be dicey depending on the time of day of your arrivals.   OR is you get off the spring mountain rd (assuming your headed northbound on I15 from the airport)  take this exit to Las Vegas BLVD. once on  spring mountain cross Lv BLVD until you come up to a street called Koval RD.  Make a right down Koval. The first light you come to is a no named street, but it will show signs of leading to Harrahs. Follow the signs like your goings to Harrahs,  Don't go into Harrahs garage, keep going straight. It will appear like your lost, then all of a sudden on the right you will see the casino royal garage. The hotel check in is in  a odd spot, Follow the signs, you will find it. Don't bother dragging luggage with you until you get a room assignment. The hotel is small, so is the casino. Its very clean. Staff is friendly, the pool is small, the room was quiet. We stayed in the JR suite up on the 4th floor. Its quiet until the Mirage does the volcano eruption across the street, then the whole building shakes.The last show is at 10pm. Casino is a throwback to old Las Vegas, but the slot machines are all up to date and casino is clean. We played a few hands in Harrahs next door and that casino i felt was a dump.  The best part about this place is location, the cheap beer in the casino , the $20 gaming credit, and the amenities very near buy. In room amenities feature a Keurig, mini fridge (no microwave, but they do have a common one on the first floor), bed is comfy If you want to spend your entire time in LV in your room, again, stay elsewhere. IF you want a nice clean smaller quiet place to sleep at a good price, this may be your place.

reviews.title: Rough and ready
reviews.text: Check in was ok. first Room we got was terrible with poor views and slow air conditioning. Second not much better but ok. Usually wouldn't care but we were staying for a week. Rooms clean. Very noisy early in the morning with deliveries outside 4am onwards. Loud ai con too. Casino very dated. Carpet especially. some staff rude some lovely. I suppose you get what you pay for as it was very reasonable even though they got our bill wrong!!

reviews.title: Very Nice Stay.
reviews.text: We had a very nice stay here.  I have been there before and will go again.  Staff were very friendly and the room was quiet even though it was right on "The Strip".  The pool and patio are small but who goes to Vegas for the pools.

reviews.title: Perfect location and comfort
reviews.text: Check in was so good staff were very pleasant and helpfull the rooms are really nice and very comfortable and kept clean . We had the pleasure of staying 14 nights and the refrigerator and coffemaker ( free coffee too every day) as standard in the room was perfect unlike the other hotels we've stayed at. The casino might look old school but that only adds to the charm far too many of the original casinos have turned there backs on an authentic feel and tried to sterilize the experience.  We certainly will be back thanks

reviews.title: Great Location
reviews.text: Fantastic location right in the middle of the strip, but so quiet you would never believe it. Benefitted from free parking and no local taxes. Well recommended. Great sized rooms and comfy beds. It had a small outdoor "unheated" pool but it was never crowded. If there was one very small downfall, it was checking in, because, as we found out with all the hotels, the directions from the car park to the reception desk, took you all the way through the Casino. Once checked in, you could avoid it as there was a short sut to the car park.

reviews.title: Good hotel,  but (prepaid !) check-in took nearly half an hour
reviews.text: This time we chose this hotel instead of "New York New York" because of the price and the location. Check-in took nearly half an hour although our room was prepaid and the paperwork and my credit card were ok. At the 3 other Best Western hotels where we stayed during our roundtrip registration took about 5 minutes. The woman at the desk became less friendly by the minute. The hotel itself and the room were very clean and comfortable as is always the case with Best Western and the personnel were friendly and helpful.Unfortunately registration was a disappointment.

reviews.title: Great place to stay
reviews.text: Check in was a breeze - no waiting in long lines.  Room was very clean, quiet, remodeled, and all non-smoking. Beds were comfortable. Room had a fridge, kerig coffeemaker, and a safe.  A microwave is also available to use. Location is perfect in the middle of the strip. Outback steakhouse is just upstairs. Dennys, McDonalds, and many more affordable eating are close. NO RESORT FEES!! Will definitely stay here again.

reviews.title: Perfectly located but cleanliness needs to be improved
reviews.text: I picked the Best Western Plus Casino Royale due to the fact that it's perfectly located in the heart of the strip. This is the biggest and only major plus it has going for itself. The whole place smells like an old bunker and the bathtub in my room was dirty, filled with hair from previous users. Definitely not up to Best Western's usual standards.

reviews.title: Still cheap beer
reviews.text: Have been going to this bar inside the Casino Royale for the past 13 years and it is a great atmosphere inside. When we came last year it was $1 for a Michelob beer. Before we arrived this year we noticed that they had put the price up to $2 for a Michelob. Whilst we were here in September, they scrapped the Michelob deal and now it is $3 per beer which now includes Budweiser and Budweiser light. Even though the price has gone up significantly, you can still get a cheap foot long hot dog at the rear of the casino for $2.69. Great place for a booze and gamble

reviews.title: Convenient Location
reviews.text: We were in town for one night for a show, and this was conveniently located to the show. It's older and could use a face lift, but the rooms were clean and comfortable. They could change 2 things; add more handicapped parking and move the check-in nearer to the room area.....you have to walk through the casino to get to it.

reviews.title: Another Amazing Stay at Casino Royale!
reviews.text: We were second timers to Casino Royale. Sept 10-13 Room 423 The reasons we returned are as follows:-Comfy King  with fridge and plenty of room-No resort fee!!  ( reasons I left bigger properties)-Free parking is a MASSIVE Plus ( come in through back via Koval, take exit for Harrahs valet parking,keep going past the Harrah parking garage.. ( yes I know it looks kinda like a garbage lane) keep going.. Casino  royale garage entrance will be on right)-Mid strip-No needs to walk 50 miles to get out of your hotel-Fat Tuesdays!-Many restaurants, drug stores and attractions  nearby-friendly staffOne note on on the hair dryer.. It's in the closet on top of the safe.We will for sure be back as value is sometimes hard to find in Vegas and this property has it!Tips and tricks to travel with no regrets: If you have a car, a few minutes away on flamingo is a dollar store and target..the much less expensive option for water, snacks and sundry items

reviews.title: Short 3 day trip. Perfect location,
reviews.text: We chose this hotel for a couple of reasons. Location:- in the middle of the strip opposite The Mirage Hotel. Price:- Very Good price with NO resort fees which saves around $35 a day.The hotel is small but the rooms are just as good as some of the bigger hotels in Vegas. Very clean with good facilities, Coffee maker, iron,safe,TV. Ice machine in the hallway. Small reception area but staff were excellent. Especially Tom who went out of his way to help me with directions- Rooms were cleaned daily. Small casino but enough tables to play. Still free drinks when playing but only $2 for a beer anyway.I would recommend this to anyone who's on a budget or not.

reviews.title: Great Location - No resort fees
reviews.text: This was our third stay at Casino Royale, cant get away from the central location without paying resort fees and walking from room to strip within 2 minutes. Rooms are not the Vegas Glam but they would be classed as pretty good in any other city.

reviews.title: Good value and location
reviews.text: We stayed for 3 nights mid week and the room was good at a good price and no added resort fee which is a bonus. Being on the strip means that it easy to access the major casinos on the strip. Had some noise from other guests at night which was annoying with them talking loudly and banging their doors in the early morning. You have to walk through the slot machines to locate the reception area but we didnt have a problem finding it. We also used the pool one day and it was quite nice. As it was summer time we went in the late afternoon as it was too hot in the middle of the day to sit on the lounges.

reviews.title: Great Location with No Resort Fees
reviews.text: Located between Harrah's and the Venetian, and across the street from the Mirage and Caesar's Palace, this Best Western Plus is in a prime spot on The Strip.  The hotel is to the rear of the Casino Royale, which houses a full casino, an Outback Steakhouse, a 24/7 White Castle, a Walgreens, and several other fast-food spots.  On a hot day, I really appreciated that it was just a 30-second walk to Harrah's, and a one-minute walk to the Venetian.In the evening, you can walk outside to view the "Volcano Eruption" at the Mirage, directly across the street.  It is worth a view, starting at 8 pm, 9 pm, and 10 pm.I stayed at this hotel one year ago in September, and again this year in September.  I think I see a pattern evolving!  I chose this hotel for my premiere visit to Las Vegas for its location and its lack of resort fees.  With Best Western Plus, there are no surprises.  Instead, you can count on good decor, a mini-fridge, lots of TV channels (including several HBO choices), a good shower, and a comfortable bed.  They also offer free parking!I stayed on the lower floor during both stays, one room facing north (pool view), and one facing south (a view of a wall -- but with direct sunlight).  Both were fine with me.  I think most tourists who wander into the Casino Royale would be surprised to learn that there is a hotel on the premises.  Though the front desk is located within the casino, the hotel rooms are behind a non-descript sliding glass door that requires a card-swipe to open.  I liked that, and never felt unsafe during my stays.If a high-rise view along with high-cost resort amenities are not high priorities for you, this is the hotel for you.  I know that I'll be back!

reviews.title: Great Location
reviews.text: I recommend this hotel.  It is in the middle of the strip and easy walking to neighboring casinos if you chose to.  We liked the size, the cleanliness, easy acess to various food options, and friendly atmosphere.  The ventilation system kept the smoke mininal.  The security to our rooms was comforting.  The rooms were clean and quiet. Very comfy bed.  The best part was not having to wait forever for an elevator as happens in large hotels/casinos.  Definitely recommend and we plan stay again.

reviews.title: Good experience
reviews.text: The hotel itself is in a great location on the strip. Just know that the driveway to get in/out can be difficult due to the stream of people walking across the sidewalk. You just have to be bold and nose your way slowly. The parking garage is in the back, and is open to the public as well as hotel guests during the day-there is no valet, but no parking fee either. It's not the cleanest parking garage-there was junk on the stairwell, and there is an elevator. 3rd floor was the highest we had to park. The parking garage spaces are tight, but we always found a spot. Make sure you leave your parking pass on the dash every time. There is no security guard at the garage.  As others have mentioned, you do have to use the back entrance to get to the hotel lobby and you do have to walk through the casino with your luggage to get to the front desk. We found the people at the front desk to be very pleasant and helpful at check in/check out. Only guests with key cards can get in/out of the room portion of the hotel. They have a business office, but we did not see/use the pool so I can't speak on that. The rooms are small but very clean. Housekeeping is pleasant. If you decline housekeeping, they call you to see if you need anything. The hotel itself is surprisingly quiet. The casino is smoky, but the outside doors are open so that helps. Very convenient--Walgreen's, Denny's, McDonald's, Outback Steakhouse, event ticket booth, Fat Tuesdays are attached to it. It's across from the Mirage hotel, with Harrah's on the south side and the Venetian on the north side.

reviews.title: Very Good central Strip location
reviews.text: Not glitzy like its larger neighbours, but perfectly functional and adequate - a touch of normalcy on the Strip!Free on-site parking.Convenient location, small but clean room, swimming pool (did not use so cannot comment).No breakfast but so many other places nearby to get food.

reviews.title: Family Vacation
reviews.text: Great hotel without the hassle of large casino and long walk to elevators. Breakfast not included but easily accessible. Clean room with daily maid service. Free parking was a plus and close to hotel rooms.

reviews.title: Pay the extra $50, stay at a bigger hotel
reviews.text: Checking in was literally like going to the dmv. The front desk employee was so unforgivably slow. Like he had no cares in the world. Didn’t wear a name tag, and did not say hi or was pleasant in any way. No conversation whatsoever. Literally like the dmv. Best westerns are better than that. Way better. maybe corporate turns a blind eye to Vegas because it’s such a money maker. And not like u have to try for returning customers. There’s a million people here. The room was pretty good, except for the for housekeeping did not clean under there toilet seat... there was some fecal matter bout a half inch long and the width of a crayon just hanging out splattered beneath the seat. The right side of the hotel is literally next to a recycling plant so expect to hear more than just the usual Vegas noise. For about an hour last night there was the sound of glass bottles being processed. The sound of Breaking glass for an hour.... I do have to admit the morning crew was much better than the check in crew. Tina was super helpful in the morning even went with me to my room because me key wouldn’t work after 2 times. She figured it out and helped me back in my room. SHE is more of the BW type of employee we all expect. But I digress, I don’t think you save too much money going to a BW, I used my rewards points so I didn’t pay but if I had to come back without reward points I’m definitely staying elsewhere. Oh and as a rewards member to thank you for your loyalty they’ll put you in the farthest room possible. Because I wasn’t paying I got top floor all the way down the hall. Maybe coincidence but with how this trip went I’m not entirely sure....

reviews.title: Great location
reviews.text: This is a really nice hotel to stay at while in Vegas. It is in the center of the strip, right next to Harrahs. Prices are good, plus they don’t charge a resort fee or for parking. We stay here every time we come to Vegas.

reviews.title: Las Vegas here we come
reviews.text: We used this for the last four nights of our US tour and found it very convenient. I was taken in by the photo on the site I used showing its glitzy strip side frontage. Clean and spacious if a little tired in places it did however offer great value accommodation right in the thick of the action on Vegas Strip. I was a little unsure when we checked in as we aren't used to the smell of cigarettes in hotels and gaming halls anymore back home in England so it took me back a bit. Onsite free car parking was great and convenient for trips out in the car and if walking the strip was just outside the front door.

reviews.title: OK room in great location
reviews.text: The hotel feels a bit old, but it is moderately priced and the location is great - just in the middle of the Strip. Parking is free which is great, and reception staff was friendly. Would stay here again if in the area.

reviews.title: Ideal Location and Adequate
reviews.text: Most people would be a little surprised walking through a casino, with children while checking in but this is Vegas.....In case you are looking for an experience while in Vegas, this would not be your choice. However, if you are (like us) spending a night in Vegas after a hectic sight-seeing trip around the Canyon(s) before a flight the next day, this is absolutely fine. Rooms are on the small side and like I said, the entrance is unconventional, but it has adequate car parking (extremely useful) at the back and it is on the Strip and within walking distance of most important landmarks in Vegas.

reviews.title: Good price, great location
reviews.text: If you're looking for a clean, centrally located hotel at a reasonable price then this is the one for you. Located next to all the famous hotels, Casino Royal is perfect for exploring the highlights of the strip. The reception took a bit of finding, but the staff were friendly and effecitent. Rooms were ideal for us, good storage, clean, safety deposit box and comfy beds. The corridor could be noisy at times but as to be expected in Vagas. Would definitely recommend to others.

reviews.title: Nice Place to Stay
reviews.text: Nice, clean and friendly place to stay. No activities(stores, food court) except the casino but plenty places around to do fun stuff. Free parking and no activity fee. A Denny's and Micky D's next door for breakfast.

reviews.title: right on strip
reviews.text: spent our first 3 nights in Vegas here and was good clean comfortable good sized pool was quiet no noise from strip you did here people comeing back at night we had a ground floor room no view exept for a bench outside people sat and smoked there but you can't smell it check in was quick and easy although its in the middle of the casino strange its quite hard to find but if you are looking for good clean rooms at a good price on the strip and no resort fees look no futher

reviews.title: Great location, clean comfortable smoke-free rooms
reviews.text: This was our second stay at this hotel.  Love the location  and the smaller hotel versus the big resort. No wait time to check in or check out or ask a question. Staff are friendly and helpful.  The rooms are small but come with a coffee maker and a fridge. Beds are comfortable.  There is a Walgreens just down and to the right to purchase water, etc. Enjoyed being able to take the stairs from the room to be on the strip in less than a minute, compared to walking half a mile from the room to the exit in the larger resorts.  The casino is small and maybe a bit dumpy but has great drink service and maybe it was just our luck but it had better payout on slots than anywhere else we played.  Would love for Vegas to get with the rest of the world and ban smoking in all public areas.

reviews.title: Good location
reviews.text: The hotel is ideally located between different Theme Casinos on South Las Vegas Boulevard. Very Good if you warnt to explore the Strip by walking. Reception is a little bit hard to find going to the casino if you arrive by car.  No breakfast offered.

reviews.title: Fantastic location
reviews.text: We stayed here recently and I was very impressed with the hotel, fantastic value for money, particularly because of the location. When you came out of the front of the property you were right in the middle of the strip, opposite Caesars Palace, Treasure Island and a few minutes from The Venetian. Rooms were a good size, with a small fridge and coffee maker, clean and tidy. Staff were very helpful. What is really great here is the price of drinks at the bar and the fact there are no parking charges or resort fees. Bargain

reviews.title: Vegas baby
reviews.text: What a gem in the middle of the strip. Why struggle with big driveways, valet parking, long lines to check in and the walk for miles to find your room. This hotel is perfect. Easy self parking. Easy check in. Tour of the hotel. Only 3 stories and you walk straight into the strip. This hotel ticks all the boxes. Thoroughly recommend this wonderful and friendly hotel.

reviews.title: Location and Price. Can't beat that.
reviews.text: This BW is located right next to one of my favorite Casinos, The Venetian, but the rooms are nowhere near as pricey as there. This is wonderful because I got to be a quick little walk away from the places I wanted to see while saving enough to actually do said things. The casino portion is smaller but still nice and the food options near the rooms are not too shabby with a Subway, White Castle, Pizza Hut, CVS and even a Ben&Jerry's all less than 3 minutes a away from the rooms. The staff were friendly and helpful and I especially appreciated the front desk agent taking us through the casino to show us how to get to the rooms and where things were located instead of just handing us the key and letting us figure it out on our own. That was very much appreciated. No outside noise from the strip or casino which was great after a long 14 hour drive to get to Vegas. Parking very close to the rooms so it's easy to unload luggage, though I will saying driving in and out can be a pain with all the people walking along the strip. That's hardly the hotel's fault though. No big breath taking views from the room from what I can see but big deal, I'm there to be out on the strip, not stare at it through a window so I didnt mind. Overall I really enjoyed my stay and as did the rest of my party. Will definitely stay again and reccomend to others.

reviews.title: Honeymoon
reviews.text: This hotel was quiet for having a casino on the bottom floor. My husband and I felt safe here. There was only a few thing “wrong”. The bed was to hard for me and the pillows sucked. We only got to go swimming one time. The other 2 times we tried to swim the pool was closed for pictures, and then supposedly the pump went out. My husband and I were told we could use the  neighboring hotels pool but that was untrue. All in all the hotel was nice.

reviews.title: The little gem in Vegas
reviews.text: Great little place to stay right in the heart of Vegas. Smallish rooms but comfortable beds and pillows. Refridgerator and coffee machine, swimming pool, free undercover parking and No Resort Fees. For those on a budget this is the place to stay. Location is unbeatable.

reviews.title: Great location
reviews.text: Great location right in the center. Pool is small with only about 10 sun beds but wasn’t a problem as we virtually had it to ourselves. Checking was quick and easy. Coffee machine in room but no kettle if you like a cup of tea in the morning. Would recommend for a cheap stay on the strip.

reviews.title: 60th birthday holiday
reviews.text: This hotel is in a perfect location on the strip. Check in was quick and room had everything we needed for a budget hotel. The swimming pool was exclusive to us on a couple of days. You had mc Donald’s next door and a ticket booth for all the trips and shows right outside the door. The bus stop was close by too. There was never any noise heard from our room. If I ever went back to Las Vegas I would stay here again. And best of all there are no resort fees.

reviews.title: Good hotel on the middle of the strip
reviews.text: The hotel is located on the middle of the strip. Even though there is no dining rooms, next to the hotel there are some restaurant and fast food choices. The rooms were oke and there is even a possibility to use the pool(is a small pool). Behind the hotel in the parking garage you can park.

reviews.title: A/C not cold
reviews.text: The staff- front desk, housekeeping, maintenance and casino floor were all excellent.  The location is central and the machines were good to us.  The only thing that will keep us from returning, is the a/c never got cold.  Even after maintenance cleaned it out it did not get cold.  I had trouble sleeping because I was hot.

reviews.title: Outsanding little gem on Las Vegas Strip
reviews.text: My five nights here were very relaxing. I was greeted by Felicia on reception. She not only booked me in, but took the time to show me how to get to my room and a quicker route back to the car park. The rooms are clean and well equipped with a full size fridge and small box freezer. The bathroom was immaculate and the TV has a full range of TV channels.I drove out each day and always came back to plenty of space in the car park. It is also near all the free entertainment in Las Vegas including the Venetian street entertainers, The Mirage volcano, Caesar's Palace fall of Atlantis and Bellagio fountains.

reviews.title: Best Bang for the Buck on the Strip
reviews.text: My Bride and I searched for a hotel on or near The Strip for our 5th Wedding Anniversary at the beginning of July.  We settled on this hotel simply because we are BW Loyalty members AND because it appeared to be CLOSE to The Strip.  Admittedly, it was a little hard to find this little diamond amongst the behemoth casinos on The Strip:  One, because it is small in comparison to the others; Two, traffic was really bad (it's right by the corner of LV Blvd and Flamingo); Three, the hotel's signage blends in with the other signs on the adjacent buildings.Like I mentioned earlier, this hotel/casino is a diamond - and in my opinion, a Diamond in the very course rough.  The LV I remember is the LV in the early '90s.  What a change!!!!  There was so much going on!  Anyway, because of all the buzz around this casino, the hotel was VERY QUIET.Not only was it quiet, it was clean.  It had standard rooms with standard amenities including WIFI, safe, coffee maker, fridge and an iron and ironing board.  The bed was comfortable and it had great water pressure (to some people [myself included], that's important).  The customer service provided by the cleaners and ESPECIALLY by the Front Desk staff was wonderfully awesome. Special mention goes to Ms. Tina Curry, the Guest Service Supervisor.  She showed a bright, smiley, friendly and welcoming demeanor.  She made us feel right at home when we checked in.  (( I'll admit that I'm a little partial to her because she laughed at my jokes  ; )'  ))

reviews.title: No Resort fee
reviews.text: A basic hotel with no formal dining halls but it has seating for eating from the 24 hour Subway, Pizza, coffee shop etc.Rooms are clean and your right on the strip with private parking. Free internet in the room

reviews.title: Very Happy With Our Stay!! Updated!
reviews.text: Ok... Same review, but with 5 bubbles not 1! I don't remember the option to fill in the bubbles when I first left a review (I'm new to this). Since I didn't fill in the bubbles it automatically gave only 1! I definitely want to put 5! No resort fees! Clean and not smelly! Lots of food choices that are inexpensive! Smack dab in the middle of the strip! Very friendly staff! Loved the feel of the slightly smaller casino! Would definitely stay again!

reviews.title: great place
reviews.text: This is a great casino it is across the street fom the mirage and it has cheap drinks I thinj they were four dollars.  I really was shocked how nice it was I ll definettly go back.  They have a white castle burger there also

reviews.title: Great choice
reviews.text: It’s on a prime location, in front of Mirage. You get out of the hotel and you’re right on the strip.It’s not a modern hotel, but enough for Vegas, after all you spend most of the time walking and visiting.It’s my choice if I ever return to Vegas

reviews.title: Another fabulous staying in Vegas
reviews.text: Web spent wonderful time in Best Western Casino Royal in Las Vegas. Hotel is in the Strip, at great location. There are many restaurants nearby. Start is very kind and helpful. Hotel is old, but rooms are Ok, cleaned every day. In our rooms there was smell coming out from old beda in the Morning.

reviews.title: Great location, parking, gym and pool
reviews.text: We really enjoyed our 4 night stay here in a family room which had just enough space for us and two teenagers. The hotel is good value and the location is great for visiting both ends of the strip. The car park is handy for Uber pick-ups and our Papillon tour to the Grand Canyon departed from Harrah's bus stop which backs on to the Casino Royal's car park. And the air con works great too! Can recommend breakfast at Denny's and Walgreens is also next door. Would happily stay here again.

reviews.title: Hotel Las Vegas on the Strip
reviews.text: When you want to stay on the Strip and not want to pay a fortune,  this is a good hotel. Free parking, good service,  friendly staff and a pool. We had room 107, very quiet, a goods night rest in the city that never sleeps.

reviews.title: Hidden Gem on the Strip
reviews.text: A small hotel by Vegas standards but well appointed rooms, free parking and a small but perfectly adequate pool make this hotel perfect for a short trip to Las Vegas. Ideally situated for visiting the strip, there were several families staying at the same time as us so the pool was quite lively.Would definitely stay again.

reviews.title: Last Minute Getaway
reviews.text: Well worth the price right on the strip centrally located. The rooms were very nice not out dated the casino itself is pretty nice. Water pressure is really good, didn't have any problems with the internet. Parking is behind the hotel/casino with no direct access from parking lot to hotel but if you don't mind that not a problem.Rooms are well taken care of and the staff is very helpful and friendly.

reviews.title: Hidden gem!
reviews.text: We spent four nights at this hotel, having stayed there a few years ago. Cons: reception desk is a little inconvenient when checking in as you have to drag your luggage along through the casino. Pros: check in was quick and easy. There is NO resort fee. The hotel does have a small pool and a fitness room. Access to the rooms is just off the casino and you need a keycard to open the door.(Keeps non-guests our!) Our room was clean and everything worked fine. Be aware that even if you decline housekeeping, your room will be checked every 24 hours, which is hotel policy. It was pretty quiet - although you do get the people that think nothing of letting the door slam when entering or leaving their room, and some rather boisterous people in the hallway at times -but nothing you wouldn’t experience anywhere else! Location is the big thing: in the middle of the strip! The entrance is a little hard to spot if you have never been there before. There is (at present), a Lyft pickup spot behind the casino. Denny’s is a very short walk, as is McDonalds, and some other fast food places. There is an entrance off the casino to a Fat Tuesdays, as well as Pizza Hut, Subway and a hot dog place in the casino. Madam Tussaud’s is next door, with the Veneyian close by. Mirage across the street. Bellagio a couple of blocks away. Flamingo is close, as is Harrah’s, where you can get the monorail. It’s pretty easy to get around using monorail, or Uber and Lyft. If you do drive, the hotel does have an attended garage behind it. If you are looking for a basic, clean, moderately priced, well located hotel in Las Vegas, this is the place!

reviews.title: Best Western Casino Royale Las Vegas
reviews.text: This is a very nice property with a smaller casino on the Las Vegas strip that is refreshing when compared to the mega casinos on the strip.  Services is always good here and machines seem to pay more here than other casinos.

reviews.title: Great location on Las Vegas Strip
reviews.text: Everything wonderful except no breakfast. Very helpful and friendly staff. Large, comfortable rooms and great pool. Warm, clean water and not crowded. Great location next to Harrahs and Treasure Island.

reviews.title: Vacations
reviews.text: Hotel rooms are small but clean. You pay reasonble price for being on the Strip. Also swiming pool and parking is awailable. You reach everything in few minutes. Outback steakhouse is in the building as well

reviews.title: Great stay
reviews.text: Just got back from stay at Casino Royale loved it. Small hotel on strip, staff friendly and helpful rooms clean, free WiFi, fridge and coffee machine in rooms. Swimming pool clean and there are towels for you to use at poolThere are no resort fees here so extra spending money.Thanks casino Royale and staff had great time

reviews.title: Room deposit
reviews.text: Excellent location our room was on the first floor and you couldn’t hear any noise from either the strip or casino. Check in staff Walter was great, very speedy, they do ask for a credit card imprint for $100 which they agree to not charge providing there is no room damages etc.There are no frills but room very clean, great coffee, bedding immaculate. Pool is small but does the job. On main bus route too. However now we are back in the UK we discovered that the hotel does not give you the deposit back directly but uses the card presented as a deposit off your room bill. This has meant we have had to pay a credit card charge . We wouldn’t have used a credit card had the hotel been clear and truthful about already taking the money as a deposit It’s left a bad taste and put me off using the hotel again. I’m thinking that they probably always do this. They should keep to their written terms.We are off to Seattle this week and will be looking very carefully at check in to ensure The imprint is just that!

reviews.title: Great location
reviews.text: This hotel is in a great spot, service was very good and rooms were comfortable.  Our air conditioner seemed quite noisy compared to the one in my dads room, but they were not able to find anything wrong with it.  For a family I felt it was a great hotel.  It is small in comparision to other hotels in the area, so it didn't feel busy.  Often the kids had the pool to themselves and it was tucked in behind a casino so it was relativity quiet.  Hotel also has parking which is convenient.  Easy walk along the strip to check out all the attractions.

reviews.title: casino royale
reviews.text: this is a small but homely hotel ,a great location ,all that you want in your room fridge,good bed , good tv , cant fault it dead center on the strip ,next to dennys  a good place for breakfast the bus stop is close as well

reviews.title: BUDGET & LOCATION
reviews.text: I stayed with friends a the Best Western Casino Royal and it was better than i thought. We stayed there for 3 nights over a pretty busy weekend in Vegas (Billboard awards and a music festival were in town) and we chose the hotel mainly for its location and price. Theres no resort fee, thats good, but tecnically is not a RESORT. The room wasnt a big deal, but having a little kitchen space and fridge made a difference. the location is EVERYTHING!! right in the middle of the strip, theres a 24 hour white castle at the door right next to the casino, a subway and a pizza hut inside the casino to crave late night munchies and a 24 hours wallgreens on the corner. We had a really great time and not many things to complain, the water preasure was bad and it smelled like weed everywhere (i dont mind, i like weed, but some guest might hate it). although every hotel was booked in Vegas we had a good price, i would 100% recommend this hotel if you want to be in the strip and you dont want to spend a fortune.

reviews.title: Perfect hotel on the strip
reviews.text: Great location, friendly staff, and nice clean rooms...everything was good! :) most in vegas is a short walk away, like ceasars palace or ballagio. Great outback steakhouse inside the same building, and walgreens next door

reviews.title: Casino Royale
reviews.text: We visited the Casino Royale on our recent visit to Las Vegas. We discovered this place on our very first visit ten years ago and always enjoy it. This time it didn’t disappoint either, the bar tender Mike Jones really made our time here special. Mike was great taking time to chat to us and making us feel really welcome. He keeps a clean bar tooIf you’re visiting Las Vegas make sure you call in and say hello to Mike!! You won’t break the bank drinking in here either as beer is $3 a bottle

reviews.title: 4 nights for tech conference
reviews.text: No significant problems.  Room was in good condition and clean.  Individual cup coffee maker and mini fridge were appreciated.  View wasn't good, but NBD.  Great location with close proximity to the Venetian, etc.

reviews.title: Can't wait
reviews.text: Just made reservations with Thomas for our annual anniversary trip. (52 years)  . Casino Royale is our only choice of hotels. Tried six others over the years. Staff are so friendly and helpfull. Rooms always spotless and housekeeping always has a smile and so accommodating. Free fridge and coffee. Who else does that? Room key needed to access hotel. Casino is small by Vagas standards but fun and dealers are happy to help a new player. Chip is rthe best Box Man on the strip. Love that crap table. Can't wait to see Thomas, Tina, Reggie, Sharon, Allen and the rest of wonderful folks at Casino Royle. A soecial hello to Elisa. NO RESORT FEE AND FREE PARKING.

reviews.title: A smaller hotel in a great location
reviews.text: This hotel was great, small, not too noisy, you didn't need a packed lunch to get out, the reception were helpful (didn't look like a airport check in with so many people). It had a fridge that you could use (no mini bar with alarms when you move things). Nice pool. I would definatley stay here again.

reviews.title: Best Western plus Casino
reviews.text: This hotel is a bit older than others on the strip, however , having said that it has many good points to recommend it.  The location is perfect , right at the Centre of the strip. The rooms are clean and tidy with the usual amenities; tv, fridge, coffee machine, shower/bath with plenty hot water and the bed was large and comfortable. The casino has a couple of fast food outlets and a good steak house restaurant. The bar is very competitive price wise. Staff were friendly enough and helpful when required. There is a small pool which goes from 3ft to 8ft very steeply ( may not be ideal for children). Towels are also supplied to lie on. I would certainly stay here if I were to visit Vegas again.

reviews.title: It is what it is
reviews.text: This hotel is exactly as advertised, a budget hotel in a fantastic location.The room was clean and well maintained, although the staff were a little distant.  Small pool area that was quiet and relaxing.But this is Vegas and in hindsight I wish I had booked one of the “signature “ hotels.

reviews.title: 2018 CA National Parks
reviews.text: This was our last stop after visiting San Francisco, Yosemite, Death Valley and the Mojave Desert.  A well priced and placed hotel, comfortable and clean.  Comfy bed.  No free breakfast at this BW but Denny’s is close and easily accessed.

reviews.title: Great location, friendly service
reviews.text: We got very nice room but unfortunately facing next building wall. Super-nice front desk person (Reggie) took his time to show us easy way to our room and to the parking area. Hotel is very conveniently located right on a Strip next to Venice and has no resort fee.

reviews.title: Location, Location, Location
reviews.text: This hotel is located right in the middle of the Strip.  It’s easy to walk to all of the larger casino hotels from this location.  It offers free parking in a parking garage behind the hotel which we utilized because of having a rental car.  It’s a little tricky driving out of the property because a steady stream of pedestrians often blocks the exit.  You just have to be a little aggressive and inch your way out.  Our room on the top floor was clean and quiet.  It overlooked the pool from a distance.  Our bed and pillows were comfortable.  I loved the ease with which we got to our room whenever we returned to the hotel.  I felt like a rat in a lab maze when walking through the bigger hotels.  The hotel did not offer breakfast, but there was a McDonald’s right next door and a Denny’s within two blocks to the north.  The staff was friendly - the front desk clerk printed out a map for me to my next destination when I checked out.  We utilized the pool area a few times.  It was small but clean and comfortable without that awful chlorine smell.  I would definitely recommend this hotel if you prefer a smaller and quieter place to stay.

reviews.title: Nice hotel in middle of action
reviews.text: We enjoyed our affordable stay at BW Casino Royale. Clean, nice rooms. The casino was good but smoky. It is located across the street from Caesar’s Palace on the strip. Also, they don’t charge a resort fee like most of the other hotels in Vegas!! Great location!

reviews.title: Many Good Things
reviews.text: My brother and I stayed there last week and found the hotel to have a lot of positive characteristics.  The staff was very helpful and friendly, the room was clean, the pool is fine, and the gaming is less expensive than all other casinos in the area.The location is fantastic.My biggest complaint is that the room keys have trouble working.  If they get near a credit card, phone, or I suspect many other objects, they stop working.I had to have a key redone 3 times per day.

reviews.title: Well located
reviews.text: This hotel ticks all the boxes for location. Right on the strip and 2 min from room to front door unlike some of the gargantuan hotels in Vegas where it can be 30 min! Ideal for a budget stay and would certainly use this one again in the future.

reviews.title: Great Hotel & Location
reviews.text: Stayed here for 3 nights the location is amazing can't really get anymore central walking distance to nearly everything on the strip, only confusing thing was when we got dropped off it was around the back and there was no clearly marked reception signs so we had to carry luggage through busy casino on a Saturday night but thats my only downside.Staff are very friendly and helpful place was fairly priced plus for being in the middle of the strip  walk outside across the road you have mirage  to the right and left you Harrahs and venetian, and of course if you don't want to leave the building you are in Casino Royale i will review that separate.Rooms clean and no issues the pool was also nice we never used it but sat by it to eat a quick snack.I would definitely recommend this hotel and would stay here again.

reviews.title: A great choice in Las Vegas
reviews.text: The last of the small properties on the strip. The location couldn't be better; Casino Royale is set between the Venetian and Harrah's, across from the Mirage and Caesar's. The stoplight crosswalk is right out their south door, you don't even have to do the bridge. No resort fees, no parking fees. Rooms were renovated within the last two years and the beds are comfy. Parking is 200 ft from the hotel, not a long hike. Casino is small but lively and good play. Outback, Denny's and White Castle on site. And the best...Casino Royale is family owned and operated...and to a person, the staff is personable and professional. I mean every one of them, the desk clerks, the security, housekeeping, management, bar staff, etc., etc., etc.. Oh and should I tell you again...no resort fees, no parking fees in Las Vegas?

reviews.title: 1 Week Vacation Stay
reviews.text: I absolutely loved my stay at this property. I was pleasantly surprised by how nice the property was, and even more surprised at how nice my room was. I stayed in a King Suite, and it was everything I needed and more. I checked in Wednesday, after staying at a higher end property all week for a work conference, and realized I enjoyed my time at Best Western Plus Casino Royale much more than the other property, even though it was about 1/3 the cost. My girlfriend and I look forward to staying here again in the near future.

reviews.title: Right on the strip
reviews.text: This place is an inexpensive (compared to others) hotel slap bang in the middle of the strip in Las Vegas. Its casino is smaller than many others can give it a crowded feeling. That said it is easy to move around it if you are just passing through. The rooms are at the back of the casino and once in them the hustle and bustle of the strip disappears, no noise at all. There are four eating place within the casino itself fast food and sit down service. The rooms are clean , very comfortable and spacious with tea/coffee machine. Free wifi works well within the rooms and the swimming pool, although small, can be a welcome relief from the Nevada heat. The Best Western Plus Casino Royale has pleasant and helpful staff and is surprisingly affordable when you compare it with many of the nearby properties. Perfect for my pocket and we enjoyed our three nights here.

reviews.title: Hidden Gem right in the middle of the strip
reviews.text: I had 8 nights in Vegas and it was hard trying to decide where to stay. I could have blown all of my budget at the Bellagio, Treasure Island or the Mirage. Then I found this little treasure, tucked in behind the Casino Royale. It was a great find, very reasonable rates, comfortable quiet rooms.  The staff were very obliging and could arrange things for you within minutes. I have no complaints about this hotel, except that entry is through the casino. The location was right on the strip, opposite the Mirage and Treasure Island. Next door was Harrah’s. I would most definitely stay here again and recommend it to anyone that does not want to spend all their money on the large resorts.

reviews.title: Fun casino just like Mardi Gras
reviews.text: This is a fun casino to play at.  When the temperatures are nice they open the large garage type doors and leave them open  not only does this let some fresh air and light in but it helps to let some of the smoke out if you are not a smoker this is very nice.  The casino floor is not packed tight so you can move around easily if you are just wanting to walk around.  This is not one of the fanciest of hotels however it is a nice change and it is very clean.  The staff around the entire place is friendly and willing to help if you need it.

reviews.title: Low Budget on the Strip
reviews.text: My boyfriend stayed her earlier this year and wanted to take me back for a wander thru the casino. Much darker and crowded and certainly not impressive like its spectacular casino big name neighbors. He liked it as the price was right, rooms clean and in walking distance to his conference.

reviews.title: Affordable & great location
reviews.text: This isn't the Mirage or the  Belagio, but it is right on the strip and half the price.  Just simply cross the street and you can blow the money you saved over there. It's 4 floors, you can enter and exit the elevators with out wasted time. They have a pizza hut, subway,  outback, dennys and white castle connected to it.  As well as a Walgreens next door.

reviews.title: Great Spot
reviews.text: This place is centrally located, right on the strip near Harrahs, Treasure Island and the Mirage.It was great!  Quiet, inexpensive, covered parking and no resort fees.We will definitely stay here again.

reviews.title: Amazing stay with Casino Royale Las Vegas
reviews.text: My wife, kids and I booked two rooms from April 25th to May 4th. I use to stay at Harrah’s next door, but the resort and parking fee are atrocious. The Best Western Casino Royale doesn’t charge these fees. That’s what interested me about this hotel. They had received good reviews, so I proceeded with my booking. I couldn’t have been more pleased with the Casino Royale. I experienced the friendliest check in from any hotel I have ever stayed. Fast and efficient, I was in my room within minutes. The hotel is easy to navigate from the strip or parking lot. The hotel entrance might be 20 feet from the strip!!  The room are clean, all the staff we encountered were always smiling and friendly. This hotel is well managed and well kept. I will recommend the Casino Royale to anyone who asks!  Thank you so much for a great stay and being a part of a very memorable vacation:)

reviews.title: Great Location on the strip!
reviews.text: The location is so convenient to get from Las Vegas Blvd to your room.  You do not have to wind through casino lobbies to get to your room.  Very conveniently located in the middle of the strip.  The rooms were very quiet and comfortable. Excellent value for the room.   Definitely recommend.

reviews.title: Great location
reviews.text: I booked 4 nights stay at this property mainly for the fact there is no resort fee and its locationThe hotel reception is a little difficult to find as its in the middle of the casino, but just follow the signs or ask someone.  I checked in at 11 and was offered a ground floor room straight away or wait for an upper floor room.  I choose the ground floor and it was a nice room although the view was of the car park.  I had no problem with any noise and the bed was super comfy.  Everything in the room was fineThere is a 24hr subway and the bar has great beer prices...$2 MichelobThere is a small pool and vending machines for water and snacksI would say this is a great hotel if you just want somewhere to sleep and shower and explore Vegas.There is a $25 per night deposit payable but this was returned straight away when i departed ($100 at MGM)

reviews.title: No fuss hotel with Great Location
reviews.text: Only negative I have is the $25 per day incidental charge . Can’t see how you could spend $25 a day within the hotel itself .Informative and efficient check in tho and all these things are explained .Great location within walking distance of everything . Casino small and Smokey but enjoyable . Only appear to be a couple of waitresses at night so service is slow . Pool small but private and not overrun with people .Rooms clean and large enough for our 7 night visit Only 4 floors however and we were on the 2nd floor and could here the room above us when they were walking around sometimes . Would definitely stay again if looking for value for little money .

reviews.title: Very good, IF...
reviews.text: This is an average value property, but very good IF you use all the amenities that are actually included in the room rate (and of course there is NO resort fee).  What I mean by this is you can stay at one of the adjacent casino hotels, they are nicer, probably newer but they will nickel and dime you to death with resort fees, parking fees, etc.  That said, after all these extra charges are tallied, you may still pay less to stay elsewhere so really do the math.  However, if you drive here, there is free parking, if you want a pool and fitness center, that's included.  Internet is free and there is a fridge in the room, Keurig coffee maker as well.  Water bottles are even free at the fitness center.  Make use of these amenities and it is a very good value.  If you simply need a bed for a few nights then this place is not cheap.  Period.  That could be said of all the adjacent Strip properties, just don't kid yourself that because you are staying at a Best Western that you will get away paying half what the resorts are charging.  Also know there are some properties within a ten minute walk that actually are about half the price, but they are a block or so off the Strip.  These rooms here are dated but there is a LOT to be said for their Strip proximity; on this visit I counted the steps from my room to the Las Vegas Strip, it was only 44 steps!  That wouldn't even get you to the ice machine in most other hotels.I've stayed here for 10 nights over the past year and my only real complaint is the air-conditioning is not very good, regardless of how hot it is outside.  Between the constant on/off cycling, lack of a consistent room temperature, I don't know what's up with it.  I've tried every setting, cycle, it's just not happening for me so if you do stay here, maybe check that immediately upon entering your room.  In addition, be advised that this is one of the Vegas hotels to implement a policy whereby you can not leave the Do Not Disturb sign on your room for 24 hours or it starts to become a bit of a gong show.  They must check your room each and every day, regardless of if you require housekeeping or not.  It would be nice if they could come up with a simple policy where you could decline maid service while still not being disturbed, maybe have a set time where they could quickly check your room...Front desk staff are great, doesn't seem to matter who you interact with they are all friendly and helpful.  Check-in/out very fast.

reviews.title: Noise from recycling centre.
reviews.text: Very noisy at night due to waste recycling centre next door. Skips being exchanged, bottles being thrown into skips and general deliveries at all times day and night. Earplugs are required if you want any sleep at all.

reviews.title: Great location value for money hotel in Vegas
reviews.text: We stayed 4 nights at the Casino Royale and loved the central location. So many cheap eating places near and no resort fee to pay.Our room was clean and quiet. Bed was comfortable.We would not hesitate staying there again and recommend this hotel.

reviews.title: If only
reviews.text: great location, couldn,t be cleaner, good sized rooms, needs the noise problem sorting out, which wouldn,t take much, a breakfast choice would be nice. a ll the staff were very friendly and very helpful

reviews.title: In the middle of everything
reviews.text: My wife and I made our first trip to Vegas and stayed here. I was very pleased with this hotel. Easy walking distance to everything we were looking to do. The front desk (Allen) was very helpful giving me the run down of the town. The room was very nice, the maid service awesome and the staff very attentive. We liked the pool as it was very private. A couple things to know. There is no place for on site breakfast. We walked about 50 feet to a Denny’s so it wasn’t a huge issue. Uber picks you up behind the hotel. Which is weird but I get it cos the strip is so congested. There is a Outback Steakhouse right in the hotel.

reviews.title: Great location in the thick of it
reviews.text: Was a perfect location, across from Ceasars and Bellagio - and very close casinos and great bars nearby. Would definitely recommend. The rooms are clean - although the doors are not too soundproof, so could hear quite a bit of noise when guests came and went.

reviews.title: Great location and reasonable tariff
reviews.text: The location is a winner opposite the Mirage where we went to the fabulous Beatles Love show, an easy walk to the Bellagio fountains and next door to the Venetian with its gondolas. Unlike most Best Westerns no breakfast was included in the tariff. Room was good except for the delivery truck parked outside our window in the hotel car park at 5am with its engine running.

reviews.title: All the goodies needed for a comfortable and inexpensive hotel stay
reviews.text: A refrigerator in room, coffee machine (Keurig), wifi in room, hair dryer.  Business center with free computer access and high speed internet. Swimming Pool.  NO Resort fees.   It is the little things that make a big difference!   Right in the heart of The Strip.  Great bus (The Deuce) and Monorail service.  No need to rent a vehicle.

reviews.title: Great Hotel
reviews.text: Great location right at the heart of the strip, no resort fees a bonus, friendly staff, clean rooms. No restaurant but plenty within close proximity. If I visit Las Vegas again I would certainly consider staying here again.

reviews.title: First time in Las Vegas
reviews.text: We had never visited Las Vegas.  I called the hotel directly for information.  I was concerned about some of the other reviews about this location.  I spoke with Tina, and she was friendly, helpful, and kind.  She listened to all of my questions, and helped me with our needs.  She was very considerate, caring, and understanding.  Thank you - Tina!!!  When we arrived, Reggie was the front desk representative.  He was so welcoming, friendly, and patient with us.  With the time change, it was very late in the evening for us and we were disoriented.  Reggie was GREAT!!!  While he checked us into the hotel, he was so gracious, thoughtful, and caring.  He gave us some bottled water that we needed to take some medicine.  He was very kind and helpful!!!!  Thank you - Reggie!!!Our room was very clean, comfortable, and quiet!!!  My husband was very worried about the noise from the street, sidewalks, and casino.  Our room was QUIET!!!  (Again, thank you Tina!!!)  We had a mini refrigerator, safe, and coffee maker in the room which was terrific.  We were thrilled with our room.  The hotel did not have a complimentary breakfast which was fine.  We were right next to inexpensive restaurants, expensive restaurants, and there was a Cinnabon in the casino.  Another nice thing about this hotel, there is no resort fee and parking is free.  Would I go back to this hotel?  YES!!!

reviews.title: Great Find
reviews.text: We stayed here for a couple of nights.The location is top notch, right on the strip between the Venetian and Harrahs, right acorss from The Mirage. Many budget restaurants like KFC, Pizza place, Denny's on site. Rooms were cozy but comfortable. Beds were fine. Free parking. No resort Fees. Excellent for the budget conscious and for those not looking for that grand resort like feel..

reviews.title: Great stay
reviews.text: Fantastic hidden gem of a hotel. Great location in the middle of the strip. In room in 3 minutes from kirb to room.
