Has every thing you need no strip view but quiet small enough to be personal. All the amenities and more. Can’t fault it at all very clean rooms. Will definitely be back. Loved it xx

reviews.title: A hidden gem
reviews.text: Tucked inside the Casino Royale, this smaller hotel is right on the strip and convenient to walking to the Sands Convention Center and many of the Strip's attractions.  Clean, quiet and the friendly staff were great..

reviews.title: Outstanding customer service, central and on the strip
reviews.text: A very warm and welcome reception from the moment we walked into the hotel by the Thomas the general manager.  Went out of his way to accommodate our needs.  Set us up with courtyard view rooms that were completely silent to Las Vegas Blvd which was no more than 100' away from the room.  Even took the incentive to walk us to our rooms to ensure we didn't get lost in the casino.  No other hotel has ever done that for me!Very fresh new looking room with a flat panel tv and the usual Best Western amenities such as a coffee maker and fridge.  Hotel mentioned they had recently worked on the WiFi, which often is not a good sign... I had to get some work done and hopped online not expecting much but was amazed at the speeds.  At least 85Mbps up and down on the wireless, which is unheard of in most hotels.  Excellent job on the Internet upgrades, Casino Royale!Air conditioner worked well.  Water tasted good and the complimentary Green Mountain K-cup coffee tasted fresh.Definitely will be returning here the next time I'm in town for work or pleasure.

reviews.title: Casino Royale
reviews.text: Location was good but the property desperately needs an update the rooms old fashioned with shutters no drapes and the casino is dark and appears seedy not inviting.  It was value for money woth no resort fees and free parking.

reviews.title: Happy Again
reviews.text: Stayed here twice in the last 6 months and will stay again. Very happy with the accomodation, check in and out is a breeze. Location is the big factor here and if your just looking for somewhere to sleep and shower this is the place

reviews.title: Fun times , cheaper games than most
reviews.text: I know this place may not have the flare or the newest updates as others but the buy ins are a lot cheaper here compared to the competition which makes it nice . They also have a way when you sign up that after you lose your 20.00 they match you 20. It can sometimes be difficult to get down to depending on what you like to play but definitely a great time and good service as well, I will post pics

reviews.title: Best place to stay at this value on the Strip!
reviews.text: The hotel is right on the strip, has it's own free parking and no resort fee whatsoever. You pay what you see, no extra cost! The room is clean, bed comfy and internet good. Looking at the lobby and casino, it seems little old, but then the cost you pay more than justifies the amenities. There was no option for breakfast, it would have been great to have breakfast, even at extra cost.

reviews.title: Many small things that make your stay very enjoyable
reviews.text: Very friendly front-desk staff; modern-looking rooms; budget-friendly rate; plenty of parking in the garage. The beds are really comfortable and the room is quite spacious.We checked in prior to the arrival after receiving an email form the hotel - this has saved some time at the frontdesk.The location could not have been better - the hotel is in the middle of everything. It does not offer free breakfasts, but there is Denny's restaurant next door.

reviews.title: A little dated
reviews.text: Stayed at this hotel for 3 days after a 2 week road trip and was so looking forward to relaxing for part of the day beside the pool. Unfortunately the pool was closed for the week, we were very dissapointed. Thomas, who was on reception told us to go next door to Harrahs and if we were charged to use theirs he would give us our money back, a lovely gesture. We wasn’t charged. The Casino Royale is a small hotel, our room was quite large with lovely bed linen but the bathroom was small, good power shower. The carpets on the stairs could do with replacing and the stair bannisters painting. We didn’t really stay much in the hotel because it doesn’t seem to want to serve you drinks unless you are gambling, that’s how we felt. Friendly , helpful staff.

reviews.title: Small Hotel in Centre of the Strip
reviews.text: This was our 2nd stay at Casino Royale and if we were to go back to Las Vegas we would definitely stay there again.  It is a small hotel and there is nothing fancy about it, but it is a perfect base for a holiday in Las Vegas. A big bonus about staying here is there are NO Resort Fees! Your taxi will drop you at the back of the hotel and then you need to walk through the casino to get to reception.  Because it is a small hotel the check-in is almost immediate, which is great. (In large hotels on the strip we noticed there were huge check-in and check-out queues) Once you are through the security doors to the bedrooms area it is really quiet. No noise from the strip at all. The rooms are very clean and although not huge they have everything you need.  We found the bed very comfortable.This hotel is in a perfect location, opposite the Mirage and Caesars Palace and next door to Harrah's.  Lots of hotels nearby and those that are a bit further away can be easily reached by using the buses which stop very near Casino Royale.I you're looking for an inexpensive hotel in a great location, this is the one for you!

reviews.title: Nicely renovated
reviews.text: The entire hotel has been renovated and is very nice and clean. Very quiet hotel considering it is on the strip. Usually you could not sleep when at a strip hotel due to the party noise. Staff were all friendly and helpful.

reviews.title: GREAT VALUE!!!
reviews.text: This hotel may not be the fanciest on the strip but it's right in the middle of everything! You can walk anywhere you need to go, the deuce stops right next door and best of all, no resort fees! The rooms are quiet and comfortable. We were there for six nights and thoroughly enjoyed how central our hotel was.

reviews.title: Perfect Location, Clean Comfortable Rooms.
reviews.text: Stayed here for my daughter's wedding.  The hotel is not fancy like others in the area but the rooms area clean and the staff, from Front desk to housekeeping were very helpful and accommodating.  I'll definitely go back as soon as I can.

reviews.title: Good value
reviews.text: Good value for money, cheap drinks and great gambling. The atmosphere is fun and upbeat we had a really great time and met some lovely people. One of our fave places  on the strip we willDefinitely be back.

reviews.title: A done deal!
reviews.text: This place has everything for it's value.  You can't beat the location for the price. All the employees from Front Desk to Housekeeping are in good mood and very helpful.  For a hotel that is right at the Strip is very quiet all day long!

reviews.title: Gamblers heaven
reviews.text: This place is so much fun for low limit gambling the drinks are cheap the tables are low and the slots seem to hit all the time.. It is a low rollers dream .  It does get smoky and busy at times  It has a great players club so sign up and if you lose 20 dollars they will give you 20,, It has several fast food options if you want to grab something to eat also .

reviews.title: Ok
reviews.text: THIS BW is a little unusual as it has a casino connected.  Our room was OK clean and quiet but it was on the lower floor.  We have a dog who doesn't do elevators so we requested lower floor.  If their was a disappointment which we didn't expect...it was the absence of breakfast.  This adds to the cost and morning planning.  Plus side is the things to do outside of the hotel.

reviews.title: Vegas Getaway
reviews.text: Great location, short walking distance to Mirage, LINQ Promenade, Harrah's and Flamingo; lots of restaurants nearby. Downside - Finding the designated parking garage was a challenge (needs better signs) and beds were uncomfortable

reviews.title: Awesome
reviews.text: It was a very nice place to stay at , it was just on the strip , rooms were clean, no noise nice place to rest, the staff service where very gentile always willing to help , I will definitely recommend to stay there.

reviews.title: Great price and location
reviews.text: I stayed there for 2 nights and had a great time. The location, price and staff are great. There isn’t a resort fee and there is free parking.The room is clean and cozy, with bathtub, minibar, very hot shower for those cold days and a safe.The only thing I didn’t like about this one, is the reception, which is inside the nasty casino. The casino is really bad and it stinks. But I must say that almost everybody that works in the casino is friendly and helpful.

reviews.title: Excellent location and value for money
reviews.text: We booked here for four nights for the location and the fact it had no resort fees and we wasn’t disappointed. You step outside and you’re on the strip with Caesars palace right opposite! The room is a decent size and the bed large and comfortable. It’s very clean and the showers great, what more do you want from a room you’re only really in to sleep. We figured our awake time in the room for a four night stay was about five hours as we were out exploring the city. The staff were all friendly and helpful. We’d stay here again for sure.

reviews.title: A fabulous first stay in Vegas
reviews.text: My husband and i stayed at this hotel for a week celebrating his 40th Birthday. I did a lot of research about the resort fees as i wanted none of that! Right from check in, the staff were fantastic. Very helpful every time we had a question, and happy to point us in the right direction. The rooms were of a standard size (well, certainly for us from the UK), clean, comfortable and quiet. Yes, its not a 5* view, but we walked around all day looking at the view! The location was amazing. 2 minutes from the room straight on to the strip and right in to the excitement. What was amazing too, was because our room was so accessible, it meant we were able to pop in every time we were passing to drop off shopping, or get changed (very changeable weather for us).  The casino itself was wonderful. The small size meant the it was very friendly and we spent most nights at the roulette table chatting with the other hotels guests, and others who had come quite a distance down the strip to seek out this friendly little place.  All in all, a wonderful place. We will be recommending to anyone we know who wants to stay in Vegas!

reviews.title: Good price/quality
reviews.text: The hotel is very well located, very good price compared to similar ones in the same location. The only negative point is the carpet in the room, but other than that, all good. The staff is very friendly and helpful.

reviews.title: Excellent location + good cost-benefit relation
reviews.text: I stayed at the Casino Royale while attending a congress in Vegas. Chose the place because it was walking distance from the show. But the location showed itself convenient to tour in Vegas as well.The ground floor does not impress much: an old fashioned casino, not much free space, reception is somehow hidden.But the rooms are big enough, clean, a small fridge is a nice touch, and the morning paper is under your door every morning. I found it comfortable. Had a small problem with the safe, called the reception telling I was in a hurry, and less than 10 minutes later it was solved. So no complains.At checkout the attendant asked if I needed any help with my next move, and even offered to make a future reservation.Internet worked well (this is a must to have offer, on my opinion) and bathroom amenities were just right.There are no resort fees (which can add up to US$ 100 daily to your rate).Depending on your budget and your plans for Vegas, the Casino Royale will be a very good alternative.

reviews.title: Great
reviews.text: Disappointed when we first arrived after the taxi ride past the BIG hotels but I was so impressed with the Staff and cleanliness of the Hotel I'm glad we stayed there  Central to everything and great value for money.  It is not The Mirage but nor is it trying to be. Would definitely stay there again

reviews.title: Poor visit
reviews.text: The air conditioning in our room was out. We reported it and they said they would be right over. 2 hours later and another phone call later, they showed up. They told us they could not fix so moved us to another room. The air in that room wasn't working much better so they gave us a fan. It was 4 days of misery as it was so hot in the room.

reviews.title: Gem on the Strip
reviews.text: Stayed for a conference at the Sands Conference Center, which is just a 5 to 10-minute walk away. My room (205) was modern and quiet. Bed pillows and linens were nice, I got a great sleep every night. Plenty of hot water for a shower or bath. The in-room fridge and complimentary coffee enabled me to have a quick breakfast in my room before heading out for the day. Great location right on the Strip, and such a relief to be able to quickly get away from the exhausting crowds by simply stepping into the hotel. Friendly, helpful staff.

reviews.title: Great location
reviews.text: You can’t beat the location of this hotel, if your looking for views this hotel is not for you, but if you just want a nice clean quiet room then this is the one, no walking miles to get to your room either, no resort fees, and free parking, also includes a coffee machine and small fridge which is handy.

reviews.title: Not the nicest hotel but great location!
reviews.text: Spent 2 nights here and the room is clean and comfortable.  Nothing to shout about but the location is very good.  Having read many reviews in Tripadvisor that the complimentary breakfast offered in some of the hotels are not so fantastic I opted to stay very close to a McDonald's outlet and hence this hotel.  There is a 24-Hour McDonald's (Panda Express & Chipotle) right next door.  Also, The Mirage is across the street and the Harrah's next door.  Easy to get to the Forum Shops (Caesar's Palace) and Bellagio.  So, great location along The Strip.  Their service is good and efficient for check-in, check-out and for house-keeping. With my Do Not Disturb sign, they called and let me know that if I required anything, e.g. coffee or fresh towels, just let them know.  Overall, a good stay.TIP:  as you are driving along towards this hotel, you will see the hotel signage but you cannot drop off there.  Keep driving further up and you will see an opening for you to turn right and drive all the way to the back.  There is parking and a passenger drop off point.  The guest will then have to roll their bags through the casino back to the Front Desk.

reviews.title: Anniversary Trip
reviews.text: Our stay was wonderful. We had a “small” room but it worked for us. Very clean and quiet. I used the pool area and it was a  very comfortable and clean area. The hotel opens into a casino, go figure, which is fun. The location is perfect for walking the strip. The price was very reasonable. Thank you.

reviews.title: Clean and modern on-strip hotel without the resort and parking fee
reviews.text: This is a great hotel if want to be on the strip but not in those giant complexes where it takes forever to get from the parking/street to your room. Plus there's no resort or parking fees. Everything from White Castle to the Venetian shops to Mc Donald's and more are adjacent to the property. Although the casino is quite smokey, the hotel and its rooms don't have that smell. Pro tip: if you want to avoid the smokey smell of the casino when first arriving by car, enter the hotel from the strip-side entrance. The front desk is a lot closer there. For those sensitive to noise, get a room facing the inner courtyard which was very quiet. I could hear faint music from a neighbour but otherwise the rooms are well insulated. The gym is well equipped but it's not directly connected to the hotel. The entrance is off the pool area so this can be challenging during winter mornings. Parking is plentiful but be careful in the evening cause I saw a sketchy person lurking around. Although there are cameras, it would be nicer to see a security guard present. There is no microwave in the room which would be nice for longer stays. Overall, recommended and will return.

reviews.title: Location is key
reviews.text: Casino Royale is in a great location. Just step outside the door of the hotel and you are in the middle of the strip. There are numerous restaurants close by, both expensive and cheap  McD's, Dennys and White Castle. The rooms are definitely no frills. Fully stocked with 6 Keurig  coffees and teas. The bathrooms are small and cramped but that's ok with me. The only thing I had a problem with is the casino itself. It's sketchy. The carpets are d i r t y and smell like smoke and it grossed me out having to roll my suitcase all the way across the floor to check in and out. I cleaned my wheels very well after both trips. I wish they would make it a pathway using a solid floor so we could roll our suitcases to and from check in.

reviews.title: Decent hotel with some drawbacks
reviews.text: We selected this hotel based on it's location, smallish size (for Vegas anyway) lack of resort fee and reviews here on TA that indicated it was quiet.The hotel was as expected for the most part...but definitely NOT quiet.  We asked for a quiet room and were given #434 - which we soon discovered faced a loading dock, employee smoking area and a recycling center of some sort - every single one of our four nights we were awoken and kept awake by the sounds of large trucks backing up (beep, beep, beep) the crashing of cans and bottles and general loading dock chaos which went on well into the wee hours of the morning. Quiet and restful it was not.Otherwise, the hotel worked well for us, but it's unlikely we'd choose it next time based on the noise factor alone.Even Vegas needs sleep once in a while.

reviews.title: Great Location
reviews.text: If you want to stay in the heart of strip & be close to most of the action then this is the place.The Mirage hotel, Ceasar's palace , Venetian, Harrahs & treasure Island Are all within 3-5 mins of walk.The rooms are decent & clean with tea /coffee maker in the room.

reviews.title: Great location
reviews.text: Excellent location, middle of the strip. Front desk in middle of casino, and staff not the friendliest. Older hotel, with good size rooms and for the price, was very good value. Food court inside hotel, with shopping nearby. Pool area not great.

reviews.title: Ecellent Hotel/ great loaction
reviews.text: This hotel is located exactly were you want to be on the strip, hotel is not as big or loud as other hotels which i liked a lot. Rooms were big and extremely clean and comfortable.Staff was friendly and very helpful, i will defiantly be returning soon

reviews.title: Surprise
reviews.text: This little casino was quite a shock.  I didn't even know it was there.  Very warming.  It just felt right.  And actually won a few green backs while there.  The fishing game was pretty fun for entertainment.  I think it's a must stop.

reviews.title: Outstanding staff and service.
reviews.text: We stayed here for four nights in two rooms and have nothing but positive things to say about the hotel and staff. From the time we checked in until the time we checked out, everyone was extremely helpful, friendly and courteous.Our rooms were clean and comfortable. There was plenty of hot water, a Keurig coffee maker with coffee and tea, a mini-fridge, good Internet speed, a room safe; everything was great. Housekeeping did an excellent job every day. I liked the added security of needing to have a valid room key to access the corridor leading to the rooms. The front desk personnel were exceptionally helpful when I needed a mobility scooter due to a foot injury. They had one delivered within an hour and took care of getting it picked up at the end of the stay. The location in the center of the Strip is perfect. The pool is small, kind of what I might expect to see at a B&B in Key West. I'm not a pool person so that didn't factor into my decision to stay here. The price of the room was fair and a good value to me.I didn't drive so I can't comment on the parking or any costs that might be associated with it. It's not a high-end resort by any means, but it is a very nice, well run hotel. I would have no problem staying here again in the future.

reviews.title: Best Kept Secret in Vegas
reviews.text: What a find!  No it's not a big fancy hotel but the location is unbelievable.  Right next door to Harrah's, Ceasars is down the block and across the street.  Everything is within an easy walk.  Rooms definitely meet Best Western Plus standard.  Felicia was on the desk for check in and she was amazing.  Was able to answer all of our questions including providing suggestions for running routes.  In fact all the staff we had dealings with were excellent.  We weren't looking for fancy facilities.  We were out of our room by 8:30 and usually not back until bedtime except to change clothes.

reviews.title: Perfect home base! Just don't plan on a good rest!
reviews.text: Great location on the strip with close proximity to several casinos and restaraunts. Beds were horrible and could hear everything all night through the door. No sleep!! But its Vegas!! Some staff were friendly..others not so much. Definitely not family friendly.

reviews.title: Beatles LOVE
reviews.text: We stayed here when we came to LV to see Beatles LOVE. Great location and a White Castle in the lobby. Room was ok despite apiped in smell. Bed needed to be replaced The other bed was fine though.  All in all a good place to stay.

reviews.title: Great location! Great value!
reviews.text: Walgreens and Dennys right downstairs. Starbucks around corner. Coffee in room tho. Mini fridge too! Walk to Palazzo, Venetian and more.  Great value for being right on the strip!  Room was super comfy...

reviews.title: Great place to gamble!
reviews.text: Employees will approach you asking if you’d like to sign up for a player’s card. No hunting around for the player’s club desk. I thought this was a nice touch. Their current offer is play $20 and they’ll add an additional $20 for slot play. It’s a small casino but I always seem to walk away ahead.

reviews.title: Best Bartenders in Vegas
reviews.text: I’m a bartender myself, so I tend to be a pretty harsh critic.Those guys are fast, friendly and engaging. Just all around good. Their years of experience really show.Word of advice, get a least one lady behind that bar!

reviews.title: One and done
reviews.text: When we arrived, it was hard to find the registration desk, and walking through the casino with luggage was also a drag when you are unsure of where to go. We had to settle for opening windows during our entire stay in order to get air into the room, which left a lot of noise coming in from the strip. The beds at this hotel are extremely uncomfortable and hard. Some of the staff I encountered during my trip were pleasant and nice, others not so much. If you're looking to just have a cheap room on the strip, I would recommend this to you. If you are looking to enjoy your hotel experience while in Vegas, I would not recommend this hotel.

reviews.title: Worst Western
reviews.text: The room left a lot to be desired. The light fixture in the bathroom was broken and unsealed from outside, when other guests open and close doors the drop ceiling style fixture moves up and down 4”. The shower had a  broken shower head only allowing a low pressure trickle to come out. The hvac controls were locked out, leaving the window to be your only way of changing the temperature. List continues.

reviews.title: Small and Friendly
reviews.text: If you are looking for one of the Las Vegas Mega Casinos, move along this one isn't for you. However, if you are looking for an intimate setting where you can grab a Nathan's hot dog, chat with the dealer, and actually play at a 5 dollar table in the heart of the strip, Casino Royale is a must.They have 1 single deck Black Jack Table, 2 Black Jack Free (I Love the new game) and a couple of variation on Poker tables and a craps table along with a very large and accommodating Roulette wheel. The rest of the casino is made up of the usual electronic games. I stayed at the Black Jack Free tables (It was invented here at Casino Royale) for about 8 hours total over the course of three days. I visited and gambles at 4 other casinos while there and I can tell you my experience at CR was by far the best.CR won't provide a Wynn or Ceaser's experience.  However, if you are looking for friendly and convenient location, you have got to visit this spot in the heart of the strip.

reviews.title: Great price Vegas experience
reviews.text: My wife and I stayed at casino royale for our anniversary. The rooms were clean and affordable. The rooms were more like a standard hotel that you will find somewhere other than Vegas, but there is a connected casino and it has great placement on the strip. Would return.

reviews.title: Great Staff
reviews.text: We didn't stay at this hotel but we will on our next trip guaranteed. The floor staff was very helpful and friendly. It started with us playing the slots without a loyalty card. A floor worker named, Girard came right to our slot machine explained the program, sighed us up to the casino's loyalty card went and printed the cards and brought them to us. No lineup. He then gave us some interesting information on the background of the casino and answered any of our questions. We didn't get any of the other friendly bartenders names but were very impressed by the atmosphere of this hotel.

reviews.title: Our New Great Hotel
reviews.text: We spent 2 nights in this hotel. We had ALWAYS stayed at my favorite hotel the Riviera. It was tough to pick a hotel after the many years of our go to hotel. After doing some homework, we stayed here. We have always had a great stay at Best Western. We were not disappointed. The customer service was excellent. I love that its not a hotel with a thousand rooms and a mile walk to the street. Even though were were at the front of the hotel, the expected noise was not there. This will be our new go to hotel when we hit Vegas for the millionth time.

reviews.title: I love this location
reviews.text: This location is center of the strip, perfect for seeing the outdoor show at Mirage, surrounded by a ton of fast food option and still has a steak house, convenient for quick room access, perfect for my needs

reviews.title: Las Vegas
reviews.text: This hotel/ casino was interesting. Plenty to do during the entire stay. Las Vegas is a city that never sleeps. I had a hard time getting any sleep as well. There were doors slamming shut about every four minutes on the average all through the night for four nights in a row. This was a party environment for sure and a lot of commotion was going on throughout the hallways all night long. We had door bell knockers throughout the night. There were yellers, pounders, criers, and people sitting outside in the halls because they had been kicked out of their room by their room mates. There was no fridge, no micro wave. Very interesting stay won't be doing that one again soon.

reviews.title: EXCEPTIONAL HOUSEKEEPING STAFF
reviews.text: I was very impressed with the level of attention and care your housekeeping staff provided. I was greeted everyday by passing housekeepers. All Housekeepers  assisted me with a positive and friendly attitude regardless of how busy they were. I am truly grateful for for their hard work. I have never met such an outstanding housekeeping staff that provided such amazing service. Rooms were very clean and property was well maintained. Great job! I will be sure to brag about the wonderful service I have received from your housekeeping staff. You could truly tell they CARED!!!!

reviews.title: Gem of a hotel in a fantastic location!
reviews.text: My room looked onto the Venetian hotel next door. Outstanding location tucked between Harrah's and the Venetian. Half price ticket booth outside hotel and lots of eating options. Rooms a very good size, comfy bed and nice bathroom. No road noise in the rooms. Awesome deal for this popular area. Monorail was 5 mins walk away and bus stops for strip buses at the door. Can’t fault this place!

reviews.title: Best Weston Plus Casino Royale
reviews.text: Do yourself a favour and stay at this hotel. The rooms are big and clean. The hotel is central to everything eg transport outside the hotel to Northern Factory Outlets and Freemont St, Monorail acceee via the hotel next door, other major hotels across the road like Caesars Palace the Mirage and Treasure Island, next to Macdonals, Dannys', Outback Steakhouse within the hotel, two stands for discounted shows and activities right outside the door.

reviews.title: Freemont "charm" on The Strip
reviews.text: This hotel is a bit dated. I wouldn't pay the weekend price for this hotel, there are much better ones out there for the same price.  The Good:  The staff were excellent! Professional, friendly, funny, I had a great time getting to know them (leaving my key in my room and constantly needing a new one).  The bed was comfortable, I didn't wake up with a back ache, and was able to fall asleep pretty quick.  The room was clean and didn't smell weird.  The Casino Royale doesn't charge a resort fee!!  The Bad:  Two big issues here.  The air conditioning wouldn't turn on "because it was winter." I happen to know that other hotels on the strip let you cool your room down in the winter months. The room was VERY stuffy and warm, and leaving the window open all night long was noisy. I was very disappointed that the hotel did not at least offer a fan for those who are used to a colder climate (I checked, they didn't have any).  The shower head was busted in my room (it kinda sprayed and dribbled out at the same time, and it took me almost an hour to take a shower when I used it, and I'm a dude with short hair). I didn't notice the shower head issue until I was all moved in and ready to take a shower. Later on the maintenance guy said the only solution would be to change rooms, as they didn't have any shower-heads to replace mine with (when there are hardware stores all over the place in Vegas). Since I was staying with a group of people, I just used another room's shower. It was a bit inconvenient, but it didn't completely ruin my stay on the strip.  The room also seemed super dated, like it was a best western from the 90s that just somehow hasn't been able to keep up with the modern-ness of the strip. There's a flat screen TV and a new bed, but everything else just seemed "blah."  Bottom line: If there are bigger places available for the same (final) price, choose those instead.

reviews.title: Location location location
reviews.text: My wife and I are frequent visitors to Las Vegas. Every year during rodeo week we are in town.This year we decided to break away from the ridiculous resort fees and give  this hotel a try.I was okay with it, my wife, who’s more picky, was under impressed. For our work we stay in Best Western Plus hotels in smaller towns when the other big chains are not available.This hotel is a nice Best Western but no Plus!The hallways are cramped, the ceilings low, the bathrooms has a distinctive smell.The beds and pillows were okay, but not to the level we are accustomed to of a Plus.The staff is really helpful and accommodating. The food concessions handy for late night snacks with a MacD next door for breakfast.The room was quiet and we managed to get the temperature to an agreeable level.All in all the hotel is great for budget conscious travellers who rather spend their money on food and cheap shopping than crazy resort fees.The location is one of the best on the Strip with all the big places within walking distance.

reviews.title: Excellent, super clean hotel right on the strip!
reviews.text: The Best Western Casino Royale was amazing!  We came after a bad experience at another hotel and were so relieved by the high quality of service and perfectly clean room.  There was no long line for check in, like at other casino hotels, and it's right on the strip - no walking miles to get to the hotel rooms behind some big casino or resort. It's also very secure - the security guard even helped me find the check in desk.  We wish we could've stayed longer! Awesome hotel!  We won't stay anywhere else!

reviews.title: FIVE STARS!? For a BEST WESTERN!? You Better Believe It, Buddy...
reviews.text: Las Vegas was our final stop on an extended, whirlwind summertime vacation. While telling people about my plans prior to departure, they were always taken aback by our Vegas accommodations. "Why would you stay at all these other amazing hotels and then end up at the Best Western?" WELL, LET ME TELL YOU WHY...For one thing, Vegas has changed. A lot. Gone are the old days where you can get hotel rooms for next to nothing just about anywhere, especially on the weekends. So sure, the Best Western Plus Casino Royale is affordable BUT it's so much more than that. It's located quite literally in the heart of the strip. Next door to Harrah's, in front of the Venetian and across the street from the Mirage heart of the strip, so it's an easy walk to anywhere else on the strip. Oh, by the way, the room we had was QUIET, cool (as in temperature cool, it was like an underground bunker so it stayed dark, too. Perfect for sleeping in), comfortable and well-appointed. I would definitely recommend the Best Western Plus Casino Royale and will definitely stay here again.

reviews.title: Las Vegas Holiday
reviews.text: Perfect location. Clean and nice rooms. Good value for the money you pay. Free parking. Close to different breakfast options. Close to all the major hotels such as Mirage, Treasure Island and Paris. Easy check-in.

reviews.title: Great Location in the middle of the strip
reviews.text: We have visited Vegas many times and stayed at the bigger resort hotels. This time we decided location was more important to us than a fancy hotel you only sleep in. We decided on the Casino Royale and weren't disappointed. Yes the room was smaller than the neighbouring biggies and the rooms face i to a rear car park.But the pro's far outweighed this. There was no extortionate resort fees to pay on arrival for a start. You walk straight off the strip almost right into the accomodation area instead of a long walk through the length of the property like other hotels. The room also had a refrigerator and a coffee maker which were a welcome bonus.  The bus / tram stop was a short walk away. You are in the heart of Vegas strip here with a 24 hour McDonalds , White Castle and Dennys all adjoining the property. Yes the corridors are quite dull and the rooms quite small but it was spotless and location, price and the dollar beers at the sports bar sealed it for us. Casino Royale will definitely be our first choice from now on whenever we visit Vegas.

reviews.title: Really a hidden gem
reviews.text: Stayed at the Casino Royale for a conference in October and after having stayed at a range of the big hotels there, this was a really refreshing difference! The location is perfect to explore Las Vegas (right opposite the Mirage), the prices are much more reasonable than at the resort hotels (no resort fee!) and I even had an amazingly quiet room to the back of the hotel.I especially like the Keurig coffee maker in the room that helped me to get up and running in the morning.

reviews.title: Great Value on the Strip
reviews.text: If you are looking for a great value hotel on the strip then this is for you.  The rooms and casino are average, but you aren't paying overpriced mega casino rates with resort fees.   Located right on the strip within walking distance of many attractions.

reviews.title: Las Vegas Hidden Gem
reviews.text: I found this hidden gem on the strip and not only do I stay at this property but I also highly recommend it as a property with wonderful staff and location.  I have stayed at this property numerous times and have never been disappointed.

reviews.title: Awesome
reviews.text: Nice place to stay right on the strip.Easy quick checkin & friendly staff,rooms were nice & clean overlooking the pool plus you could open the windows.We have been to Vegas 4 times before & this place was the best,& no rip-off resort fees.Downstairs the beers were a $1,but i think they are $2 now,still pretty good value.On previous trips we always ended up here in the casino,great atmosphere,friendly bar staff.Whitecastles on-site & Dennys upstairs next door with a balcony overlooking The Mirage volcanoes,Would definitely stay here again,$25 taxi ride from the airport to the back entrance of the resort.

reviews.title: Excellent value for money
reviews.text: Fantastic came here as a family of five 2 rooms nice right in the action value for money bus 24 hours 8.00 Fremont street buffet cheap 15.99 Hotel needs a little maintenance only one lift working on holidays that was the only problem highly recommend

reviews.title: great location with old facilities.  good choice for budget travelers
reviews.text: great convenient location.  hotel itself and rooms are old.  elevator was not working but stair access is convenient.  Easy to get in and off the hotel room to the main street.  Parking is free and convenient.

reviews.title: Great value on the strip
reviews.text: I make an annual trip to Vegas to play poker.  I usually stay at Harrahs, Linq, Monte Carlo, etc.  I got tired of the resort fee games that these properties are playing, which now cost close to $40 a day.  In past trips, I would walk past Best Western/Casino Royale and wonder what it would be like to stay there.  This year we gave them a try.  We were pleasantly surprised. The rooms are very convenient to the strip, no walking all the way to the back of a casino to get to elevators.  Although it is in a busy chokepoint on the strip, the sound from outside is well insulated by a secured glass door.  We were in room 102 which means we were in the closest room to the casino and on the ground floor.  The room is a bit tight but we got used to it during our 11 day stay.   Beds were comfortable.  Location is great, across the street from the Mirage and between a Harrahs and Venetian.  Dining options are great for budget conscious travelers.  McDonalds, Chipotle, Panda Express, Denny’s, White Castle, and other Hot Dog and pizza stands were all close.  At check-in, i arrived on a very early flight.  The front desk was very friendly and told me they should have my room ready by 11:00, even though check-in time is 4:00 per my reservation.  They tried to get me in earlier but the length of my stay didn’t give them any options.  They held my baggage and had my room ready when I came back at 11:00.  They let me check in and didn’t ask for any early check in fee.  I have had to pay Harrahs $30 for early check-in in the past.  When I checked out this morning, the front desk was very friendly, asked me how I liked my stay, and advised me no charges were due.  This is how Vegas hotels need to treat their guests.  I will come back.

reviews.title: Will Stay Again
reviews.text: The best part of the hotel was the location and value for that location. It is usually so expensive to stay on the strip, and after a lot of work we found this to be the most affordable hotel within walking distance to everything we wanted on the strip. The room was clean and comfortable. Staff was friendly and approachable. Overall we were satisfied and would probably stay again.

reviews.title: Small hotel right at the strip!
reviews.text: This hotel is great! Rooms are clean and spacious. It is not as fancy as all the other huge hotels but the rooms are great! There is a small pool too. Great location right at the hart of the strip! Next to Denny's where we had breakfeast every single morning.

reviews.title: TOP NOKKA HOTEL
reviews.text: My wife and I stayed at the Casino Royale September 18th-28th 2017. Check in experience was first class. Our room on the 4th floor exceeded our expectations. Air conditioning worked well,was cleaned everyday, we had no problems.  The location is second to none,being centre strip,close to everything and only a minute walk to the bus stop. The casino bartenders are really friendly and the bar prices are very reasonable. There is a Mcdonalds next door which serves breakfast, also a Walgreens too. We have booked again for another 10 nights next year, we enjoyed ourselves so much. Thank you Casino Royale.

reviews.title: Quite Hotel on Strip
reviews.text: Was an inexpensive, quieter hotel on the strip. Was able to enter the room without going through the Casino every time. Close proximity to major events, adequate room for business. Good internet - very important. Elevator has needed to be fixed 3 years running. For the business traveller doing a convention - is a nice spot to retreat to, away from the hustle and bustle, but close enough if you want to get into the action.

reviews.title: Location....
reviews.text: We stayed here from 15th to 17 Dec. The room was a decent size, but the bathroom was way too small. The room was extremely hot - when we spoke to someone at reception, we were told that because it is winter, they only got the central heating going. It was too stuffy in the room and we were told that our only option was to leave the window open at night. We did that - only problem is that the window opened up to the Mcdonalds and some other restaurants and all we could hear till 3 and 4am, were people talking loudly, swearing, garbage trucks, bottles breaking etc. (room 400). We were only there for 3 nights, which was more than enough. The only plus point was the location of this place - right on the strip and close to a lot of restaurants. I just wish that after a whole day of being out and doing sightseeing, it would have been nice to come to a room, that was cool and relaxing, rather than spend sleepless nights due to the heat and outside noise.

reviews.title: Way Too Hot!
reviews.text: Arrived to find our room was 80 degrees.  Went to the thermostat and turned it down.  Hours later no change in the temperature.  Called the front desk and was told that the thermostat doesn't do anything as they only have central heating.  We were told to open the windows to cool the room off.  We did this and got to listen to the sounds of breaking bottles, trash trucks, delivery trucks and yelling the rest of our stay.  The main elevator was down the entire weekend so had to walk the entire length of the hotel every time we go on and off the elevator.  Water temp in the shower never got to hot or any real pressure.  WiFi was super slow.

reviews.title: Business and Pleasure
reviews.text: Hole in the wall BUT a good value $65 a night taxes and resort fees total.. Buy it right-Great value. Rooms are clean and fine enough . Not the high class resorts kinda room but clean.The parking lot is kinda cool too..tucked away safe looking.  Rooms are separate from cassino- I like that too.

reviews.title: Not a "plus" Best Western
reviews.text: Beds are hard as a rock. I called customer service and they said all beds are the same. Feels like plywood with sheets and a comforter.  All other plus hotels are like beauty rest hybrids or temperpedic.I am a diamond plus member and I only stay in the plus hotels which are normally 10x better than the old regular hotels. This one should NOT have the plus branded name.From the central hvac system where you walk in and you room might be 74° and you want A/C.. nope, whole building is on heat. Called desk, they said open window.. now room smelled like pot and diesel fumes.Taking a hot shower. Don't let anyone in the rooms next to you flush the toilet or you shower will go ice cold!!!You can hear everything through the paper thin doors too. Someone was having a conversation outside our door at 3am til I asked from my bed that they quiet down.No breakfast served. All plus hotels have a wonderful hot breakfast except this one. Please strip the plus logo off this old hotel.

reviews.title: Great value in the middle of the strip.
reviews.text: This might be a small hotel but as far as value goes it would be hard to beat.  In the middle of the strip and within walking distance of all the big hotels.  If all you want is a base to tour this town then this is hard to beat.  Would certainly stay here again if we returned to las vegas.

reviews.title: Ok, so not the Bellagio, but when we were looking just after a cheap room on the strip and this was fine perfect
reviews.text: Ok, so not the Bellagio, but when we were looking just after a cheap room on the strip and this was fine perfect

reviews.title: Great Hotel.
reviews.text: Tina at the front desk is awesome!!!  Rooms are very nice, hotel was clean and updated rooms were nice.  Hotel is perfect for the Vegas Strip.  Easy access to the strip. Hotel is central to shopping and other properties. For the price you cannot beat this hotel!!!!

reviews.title: Family holiday
reviews.text: This is a great hotel if you don't want to be in one of the huge hotels. It's quite cheaper, and only has a small casino and a few eateries, but for a family it's perfect. The room was very clean, updated, really nice. The staff were all nice and friendly.It's right on the strip, you step outside and you're in the middle of everything. Right next door is a Walgreens for buying food or any bits and pieces, there are restaurants everywhere. I would highly recommend this hotel.

reviews.title: Great location
reviews.text: Casino Royal is an older hotel on the strip but in a fantastic location directly across from the mirage. Rooms are clean and very comfortable. Staff very friendly and can’t do enough for you. Will definitely stay there again. Highly recommend it. For the price you just can’t beat it.

reviews.title: Customer service at tables needs improvement
reviews.text: Friendly service at the front counter to get your player cards. Played tables and slots at this casino. Can be a smokey casino at times. Was completely shocked at the roulette table that the lady with the long straight brown hair kept being excessively rude to all the couples there. She made it very obvious she didn't want some of them to play. The group there was sober, non-smoking, very polite and trying to ignore her rudeness. But after awhile you get tired of being treated that way when your spending good money there. The big shocker was she had no problem demanding each person who cashed out to give her a tip while she's holding your chips until you say ok.

reviews.title: Great location with free parking!
reviews.text: Booked for 2 nights during Thanksgiving weekend.  Glad to get a room on the strip.  The room was clean, comfortable and quiet!  And they have free parking!  Wish it offered breakfast, but otherwise, this is a great value of a place.

reviews.title: Treated awful by security when I sat down to play slots!!!
reviews.text: When I sat down to play slots at Casino Royal security immediately came up and asked for my ID. I am sixty years old so I new it was not because of my age but that he was profiling me. I asked if he was asking everyone for ID or was he just profiling. He said that I was asking people for money! I was playing a 25 cent slot machine and had over 200 hundred credits on it and a pocket full of 20 dollar bills. The he said he would throw me out if I did not shut up! Then when my wife spoke up he acted shocked that she was with me. My wife and I immediately cashed out and I told him he could tell his boss I will take my money to a different casino! Do not go to Casino Royal. Very disrespectful to customers!

reviews.title: Thank you for another great stay
reviews.text: We stayed here for 6 nights for our 51st anniversary.  We always enjoy our stay, coffee maker, great wifi, refrigerator, comfortable beds and the best staff in Las Vegas.  Check in was easy, our room wasn't quite ready so they held our bags while we went to lunch.  Elia (not sure of the spelling) was so nice and helpful.  She deserves a raise Thomas.  We had an issue with the safe locking but was reconciled in less than 10 minutes with a call to Elia at the front desk.  Reggie was awesome as usual.  We always have to find him for a quick catch up conversation.  He is the nicest man on earth and we love visiting with him.  A big thank you to Sharon at the front desk.  Didn't get to see Thomas this visit but will catch him next time.  We forgot some items in the bedside stand on checking out.  Realized at the airport, called the desk and they were so helpful.  Shipped the items back to us at no charge.  Thank you, you always go out of your way to make everyone's stay perfect.  Big hello to Ilsa, we so enjoy visiting with you and you keep the drinks coming.  Craps dealers are the  friendliest on the strip and always glad to help a novice player.  Box man, Chip, is probably the best on the strip.  He knows every bet, every roll on the table.  My wife loved the Roulette dealers but can't remember their names (sorry).  Win some, lose some but always have a good time.  Our room was comfortable and housekeeping always does a great job.  Looking forward to next year.

reviews.title: Best value on the strip!
reviews.text: We stayed here for five nights and it was great! They are very accommodating! Anything we asked for they provided. One of the best things about the Casino Royale is that there is resort fee of any kind. It was clean and conveniently close to everything! Sure you can get fancier and much more expensive, but who stays in their room? You basically need it to sleep shower and dress. We didn’t even use the tv. The casino down stair is really nice. They gave you 20.00 when you lost you first 20. Which I did, but was able to play for long time because I was up 40 at one time. My wife was able to quit while she was ahead, she did very well on wheel of fortune! Restaurants were very close and you had a wide variety to chose from. Very close to the linq and the high roller. Overall this was a great place to stay, we loved it.

reviews.title: great base for exploring Vegas
reviews.text: The room was nice for the price, but the location was the real bonus.  There is a Denny's in the building, a McDonald's nearby and next to the Venetian which had lots of dining options (including Grand Lux Cafe which was more reasonably priced than most).  Easy walk to the Bellagio and around the strip to see the sights.  My son took the monorail to the stratosphere tower.  Free parking and good internet.

reviews.title: Best Western Casino Royale
reviews.text: We stayed here for one night and it was a great place to stay. It is convenient since it is at the strip. Just the perfect spot for us in the strip. The rooms are clean when we got in. Bed were good, we hadn't had a chance to really notice how comfortable the bed was since we were there for just a night and just slept for just a few hours. Hotel staff were accommodating and polite, they helped us alot and made sure our stay is comfortable. What I also like is that they can hold our luggage's after our check out while we stroll the strip one last time. Overall it was an enjoyable and comfortable stay for us.

reviews.title: Great value for money hotel
reviews.text: This hotel is in a great location, with the added bonus of free on site parking. The rooms were spotlessly clean and had a good sized fridge and coffee tea making facilities. Overall a good value for the money hotel

reviews.title: Great position but that's about it...
reviews.text: With the casino below the rooms, noise and smoke were a constant.***My wife and I have traveled extensively and have never before been told that our room had to be viewed every 24 hours!  Twice we were called from front desk stating that our "Do not disturb" sign had been respected although we have to view the room every 24 hours.UNBELIEVABLE!!!  We are a private couple, this was an invasion of privacy. The front desk said that something had happened recently, so this new policy was in place. Nowhere in and notation was this clause noted. It wasn't worth arguing, I wont be returning.

reviews.title: Relaxing get away
reviews.text: Great place to be at when you do not want the crowds and hustle of Las Vegas yet be in Las Vegas. Not a big casino so the crowds are down but if you like the large casinos they are across the street. Food is at the casino not a buffet but five restaurants, I have desided that the buffets in Las Vegas are over priced.

reviews.title: Convenient Lication
reviews.text: Loved the location ion the Las Vegas strip.  Small and cozy motel and casino.  Friendly people.  A few problems were no luggage racks (an inconvenience), ran out of hot water when second person was showering, And the room and hallway were quite cool.  When we checked with the front desk, they said the heating system had not yet kicked in for the winter months.

reviews.title: Old hotel, but perfect location
reviews.text: It was an old hotel, the carpet was dated and grimy.  The receptionist is hidden among the machines, just follow the signs to the reception.  Room was old.  Carpet was dirty and old.  We actually left a note for housekeeping to vacuum the carpet.  She took the tip but didn’t vacuum the floor.  :(Bathtub felt grimy.  Water pressure was ok though.  Aircon/heater was not working.  We were freezing in the room but couldn’t get the heater to work.  There was no kettle but Keurig coffee maker was provided with 4 capsules.  There were 4 of us, we asked for two double beds.  Room was a little tight for 4 of us and we had to push the beds to one side.  Otherwise there is no space for the luggage.  The three things that are good about the hotel are that there is no resort fees imposed, the parking is near and the location is perfect.  Just right smack in the middle of the Strip.

reviews.title: Fun
reviews.text: Telly enjoyed this budget hotel on he strip. WasPleasantly surprised by this smaller discrete hotel right on the strip. The rooms where quiet and secure  I thought it had more character than it’s rather grand neighbours. And free parking. Very nice stay.

reviews.title: Great Location
reviews.text: It's one the best options on the strip, price is reasonable and the quality is standard. This hotel doesn't have a brand new look, but compare w the amount paid i feel is a good option if you are going to stay for a couple of nights for business.

reviews.title: Outstanding Service and Amenities
reviews.text: My wife and I stayed at this hotel because of it's location and customer service. We highly recommend the hotel.  Although the price is higher than many other larger scale hotels, the service and location are perfect for us. We find the service, amenities, cleanliness, location key reasons to why we stay at the Casino Royale.

reviews.title: Nice
reviews.text: My friend and I were very pleased with the Best Western Casino Royal and will return, another time.  Nice HOtel and everything conviently located.  Everything in walking distance in Vegas on the Strip. .No ,need to stay anywhere else.

reviews.title: Great Service, Great Location
reviews.text: This is a Fantastic Location, Close to everything. A Modest Room with a cozy bed. and top notch service. the no resort fees or parking fees is what drew us in and we will defiantly return to this location.

reviews.title: Pleasantly surprised
reviews.text: The room was clean and tidy. Check in was easy, but I did have to walk through the casino to find the front desk. Parking was easy and free!! The only problem was the shower drain was clogged. Ended up standing a pool of water at the end of my shower. We were on the bottom floor and there was a bit of banging doors and stomping noise, but nothing that prevented us from sleeping well. I was pleasantly surprised to get a value hotel right on the strip.

reviews.title: Absolutely Perfect 40th
reviews.text: Stayed at the Hotel to celebrate my 40th Birthday and couldn't have asked for more. The hotel is ideally located right in the middle of the strip near the Venetian, Mirage and Harrah's. Accessing the strip was real easy, Tip use the Deuce bus a real inexpensive way to travel up and down the strip with regular stops at most hotels.We stayed in a suite and the room was huge and modernly decorated, with a kitchenette, separate lounge with big screen TV, big sofa's, Bedroom with king size bed and separate bathroom which was huge, with a Jacuzzi bath.Whilst we stayed we went to watch Celine Dion at Caesars and was absolutely great and celebrated my birthday at the Bottom of the Grand Canyon having taken a helicopter trip with Pavilion . The views were amazing.We couldn't fault the hotel or the service, reception team were more than helpful and whiling to help with any questions or queries we had. Would certainly return if staying in Vegas again.

reviews.title: Great location and more!
reviews.text: Great stay in a prime spot on the strip..quiet, clean rooms...friendly, accommodating staff..great price with no resort fees..absolutely only drawback was the smoke smell in the casino, but that is everywhere...absolutely no smell or noise in the guest rooms...

reviews.title: Good for the price
reviews.text: Good room for the price. Nice location. Helpful staff. Check in was easy. Rooms have a modern updated look. Cleanliness of the room was acceptable. WiFi on the lower level rooms was almost nonexistent.

reviews.title: Cher concert
reviews.text: In Las Vegas for Cher Concert. Hotel is affordable and in a great location. Reception staff friendly and helpful. Non smoking hotel. Rooms were nicely decorated and clean WiFi service good. Parking is free. Lots of reasonable restaurants nearby. Gambling at Casino Royal is reasonable and has friendly staff. We had a rental car but you don’t need one. You can walk everywhere.

reviews.title: Best cost effectiveness of hostelling service I ever experienced.
reviews.text: Comparing to my colleagues staying at other hotels of higher grade in the same days, the quality and cost effectiveness of this hotel obviously bit them all. Particularly, the provision of coffee maker and the supply of ice definitely other hotels didn't have. Great for businesses stays of single.

reviews.title: Casino Royale LV
reviews.text: This hotel is outdated and the staff were not very helpful. The furnishings were very outdated and the bed was lumpy. I had difficulty sleeping every night. The location wasn't bad. Very noisy corner, but I could not hear any noise in our room or hallway.The rate was affordable, but not worth it. I will not return.

reviews.title: Value cannot be beat
reviews.text: Clean room, very quiet considering this is right on the strip.  I stayed here during a conference at the Sands Expo center.  Short walk away and saved probably $200/night rather than staying at the Palazzo or Venetian.

reviews.title: affordable
reviews.text: This hotel is worth staying at if you want to stay on the strip.It is situated perfectly and near the monorail if you want to get anywhere on the strip to save walking time.Very quiet inside the hotel even though its attached to casino royale you cannot hear a thing.Clean rooms with good water pressure for showers.Do not waste your money on fancy hotels that charge resort fees. This hotel does not charge fees.you can visit all the hotels you want and spend time in them touring and using their casinos anyway.Would stay again!!!

reviews.title: Close to everything
reviews.text: This is my 2nd stay here - I love how you don’t have to walk through miles of gaming areas and huge lobby’s to get to your room - no resort fees - helpful staff - the hallways are showing their age but the room and amenities are fine

reviews.title: Alright
reviews.text: We were received with a not so happy face and my husband even tried to joke around with the lady at front desk.  Although that changed after a while.  But overall, the room was clean, and price was reasonable

reviews.title: Perfect location
reviews.text: The rooms were spacious and clean. The beds are firm and comfortable and the shower was good and powerful. The location is perfect for the strip with the Venetian next door and caesars palace over the road. The bus goes from outside the Venetian to the old strip.

reviews.title: Great place to stay
reviews.text: Excellent service and nice, clean room. Perfect Las Vegas strip location.  Very friendly, helpful staff.  Convenient restaurant. Dollar bottles of beer at the casino and Fat Tuesday is just only a few steps away.

reviews.title: Great Location
reviews.text: Friendly staff with good in room wifi just steps off the strip. Nice in room amenities i.e. refrigerator, coffee maker and no resort fee!  Room appeared recently updated along with bathroom and fresh paint. Location can’t be beat.

reviews.title: Cheap and nasty all over
reviews.text: Toilet did not flush.  Maintenance called at 11pm and decided he did not know how to fix the toilet and laughed about the situation.  We where then called to move rooms at 1.30am to another floor away from the group we were travelling with.Our new room smelt terribly - couldn't bare to use the bathroom wash basin due to a potent smell coming from the drain pipe.  Shower was over bath - bath waste outlet had a build up of hair that was molded to the plug stopped and waste which could not be detached.  Not pleasant and made me want to vomit anytime I had to use either.Hotel was cheap and nasty in every way.  Would definitely pay more to stay at another hotel on the next visit.

reviews.title: Central, clean , friendly and flexible
reviews.text: close to monorail - very clean, with nice bathroom, clean comfortable beds, with walmart, dennys, White Castle and other eating facilities nearby. Very obliging cheerful staff who were happy to assist with directions and information. Getting a cab was a breeze with them. Being able to park our car on the premises was a bonus.

reviews.title: Pretty Ok
reviews.text: Let me start by saying the location in the middle of the strip is excellent!  It also housed my favorite casino that we visited in Vegas.  The entrance to the hotel portion of the building was a little creepy, dated and odd, and it's such a long walk to your room when your room is at the very end of the hallway and there's only one way into the area.  (On the bright side, being so far from the street and having a view of the parking lot meant it was quiet!)  We also had a bit of trouble finding the entrance to the pool.  The room itself was a little small, and the bathroom was very small and very dated (and it smelled awful anytime we flushed the toilet) but overall the stay was fine.  The air conditioning in the entire hotel apparently stopped working on our last night there, (in the mid-August heat!)  When I called to report it the front desk didn't apologize, but did make up for it in the morning when we checked out, so that was nice.  (Though I did have to sit in the lobby for several minutes until the front desk person came back from a break.  Obviously everybody should get breaks, but in this case there was no backup other than a security guard to tell me I had to wait)I would consider staying here again, but I would definitely price shop a bit before booking.

reviews.title: A real bargain.
reviews.text: First, and foremost, it is right in the center of the Las Vegas Strip.  Just about everything is either next door or within walking distance. It is clean, quiet, and inexpensive. Maybe not as fancy as some, but very comfortable. Since I found this place, I don't stay anywhere else.

reviews.title: On the Center of the Strip
reviews.text: The Hotel is located at the central portion on the strip and hence very convenient. The rooms are nice and well maintained. Though not comparable to the various luxurious staying options on the strip but given the price we pay at this Hotel it was the best value for money.

reviews.title: Terrible hotel
reviews.text: The cleanliness in the room was terrible! Because of the amount of dust in the room, it was very hard for me to breathe. For a whole week we did not change sheets even though they were dirty and never cleaned the room once they just rearranged the bed cover and that was it. The sealing in the room was bad every time they opened the door in a room next to us or in the room opposite, we thought we were being opened and heard everything from the room next to Ef'alu when they entered the bathroom. I will not go back to the hotel and I think the hotel is doing a bad job for a great company

reviews.title: Centre of theStrip
reviews.text: Great hotel at the centre of all the action of the strip without all the hassle and long line ups of the big strip hotels. Especially appreciate that there is no BS "Resort Fee" added to the cost of a nights stay. This hotel is a little gem in the heart of sin city!

reviews.title: Cheap table games on the Las Vegas strip - located by some of the big name resorts.
reviews.text: Located in between the Venetian and Harrahs on the strip is a small casino with cheap tables. Don’t expect frills, but if you are down to your last stash of cash to game with-you mght want to try this out.

reviews.title: Great location
reviews.text: Great location on the strip. Attended a conference at the Venetian, and it was a five minute walk.  Table games were very fun and interactive.  Bed was a little hard for my taste; however the room was great.

reviews.title: Great Location
reviews.text: Great Location in Las Vegas. Tram is close so I can get to the convention center and the Lounge prices are great. They always take great care of me when I come to the City of Lights. I love the smaller venue also.

reviews.title: Hotel ruined my precious holiday
reviews.text: I don't want to think about this terrible experience related with Best western hotel in Las vegas.  I cannot sleep at all night at this hotel and really uncomfortable whenever meet officer in Front.  Still now, I cannot belive all employees in this hotel treat me unfriendly.  With big and consecutive noise and broken refrigerator, I can get the best terrible experience in Las veags.

reviews.title: Conference Stay
reviews.text: My recent stay was met initially with bad news, that my room was not reserved (due to compromised credit card and inability to bill it). The staff though took this in stride, was very helpful and took good care of me, made sure my room (and colleagues) was taken care of, same rates I booked at and all was done with a can do attitude. Room and everything else was also great. If only all staff and management could be so helpful, travel would be less stressful.    Of course location and price were also great. Only problem you might have is - if uber pickup etc. might want to walk next door - or just have the staff get you a cab (they offer!) as folks seem to have a hard time finding it (entrance for cars is hard to see)

reviews.title: Family Celebration
reviews.text: Perfect Location for everything! Comfortable bed, clean room, great free wifi. The ground floor is the casino which we enjoyed before retiring to bed, and the reasonably priced drinks. The room is also really quiet and no noise from the strip or the casino downstairs was ever heard.The Reception staff are mostly friendly and helpful. The amount of time spent in your hotel room when visiting Vegas is so minimal you can't go wrong staying here! I will definitely be back. We as a family (age 16yr old the youngest) loved every minute of our 5 day Visit Celebrating our sons 21st & making memories!

reviews.title: Disappointing Anniversary
reviews.text: I was very disappointed with everything with this hotel.  I stayed in Sedona for three days just before I got the Vegas and I had my expectations of the Vegas hotel very high because the Sedona experience was awesome the Vegas Rotello was just the opposite everything from the beginning to the end was terrible we made the best of it my wife is never gonna let me down I should’ve stayed somewhere else .

reviews.title: Great location
reviews.text: Good hotel with perfect location. Main attractions are a few steps away - the Bellagio Fountains, Ceasarw Palace etc. Wallgreens is just next to the main entrance so it is easy to grab some snack. Rooms are spacious and nicely furnished. Good one if you are about spending money on the games rather then on the słabiej rooms.

reviews.title: It was ok
reviews.text: Room was clean but the air conditioner was very loud and did not regulate the temperature well and it was a small room. Really no cost savings. Could have stayed at the Venetian for about the same, even with the resort fees!

reviews.title: Great location
reviews.text: Location is the best..Centrally located, right next to the Venetian, across from Cesar's palace and the Mirage.  Within walking distance to the Linq. Great restaurants nearby. For quick bites there is McDonalds and Dennys on the premises.

reviews.title: Horrible
reviews.text: This casino is a crap hole. It is dirty and there is a white castle in it. The smoke is unreal because of poor ventilation. The entrance by the souvenir stand smelled like pee, and I'm not exaggerating at all.

reviews.title: Nice location
reviews.text: Right smack in the middle of The Strip. Lots of shopping and eatery nearby, McDonald is just next door. In-house casino, reception in the middle of the casino. Rooms are clean and tidy. They even deliver newspaper to the rooms.

reviews.title: Weekend in Vegas
reviews.text: In Vegas for a wedding. Staff, location, was excellent. Got a deal on the rooms. Parking good. No complaints except problems with the coffee machines in both rooms. Easy to get good coffee at McDonald's next door. Overall happy with the experience and of course it's a Las Vegas Classic!

reviews.title: my stay at casino royal
reviews.text: very nice clean rooms  and very accommodating staff  nice location right in the center of the strip. Very easy check in and out  Clerks were very helpful with baggage   until,check in  and taking to room . a lot of nice eating places very close  would stay again.

reviews.title: A Nice Surprise
reviews.text: After the Uber driver found the hotel and I found the check-in desk (some better signage would help), I was surprised by the quality of the service and how much I liked the room. It was clean, everything worked, and my entire stay was peaceful.

reviews.title: Good Value, Grouchy Staff
reviews.text: Pros: less expensive, no resort fee, can be out of the room and mid-strip in moments, very convenient location.Cons: tired hotel, almost looks like a motel, and the staff do not seem like they enjoy working there one bit - super unfriendly and unnecessarily grumpy. That’s probably poor management, not their fault..

reviews.title: A smell reserved for Only the Seediest Hotel
reviews.text: The lighting in the hallways was like that of a Seedy hotel on the south side of town - and the smell was stale and dank completing the experience. i paid less at the Mirage hotel where I thought was a higher priced hotel.

reviews.title: In the centre!
reviews.text: This hotel/casino is right in the middle of the strip opposite the Mirage. Although not super fancy the rooms are well appointed and cleaned daily. The bed was super comfy and fresh towels. The casino itself is fun. I paid $4 a Corona. Walked next door to Harrah’s and paid $8.50! I was told this was because most are corporate hotels and set prices accordingly. Back to Casino Royale for me! I would stay again. 🍺

reviews.title: Always a great stay
reviews.text: Great hotel every time I stay. I only stay here when I want to be on the strip. It is close to everything I want to do. The back way in is a little tricky until you do it a couple of time, but it the way to go. I like just self parking it is really easy if you want to use a car.

reviews.title: Well located
reviews.text: Our family (myself, wife and two children 14 and 11) stayed for 2 nights. The room we had (which had a partial view of the strip) was quite nice and clean compared to other Las Vegas hotels I've stayed in previously. My initial impression on arrival at the hotel wasn't favourable however as we had to walk our kids through a smokey casino to find the reception desk. Not nice. The desk staff were OK, but not overly friendly. What made up for it was the price, location and quality of the room. The place was quiet (at least where we were staying) and there is free parking in a multi story garage behind the hotel, where we left our car for the duration of our stay. There are lots of restaurants steps away from the front door of the hotel. Entry to the hotel area is via a security card so safety is not an issue for families. There is a discount tickets outlet right outside the entrance, which we found useful to purchase tickets for some local shows at a discount. This is a good budget option in a central strip location. OK for families as long as you don't mind the long walk through the casino to get to reception.

reviews.title: Still up to scratch.
reviews.text: This hotel remains the bargain hotel on the Strip. Just about the best location for exploring the Strip (next to the Venetian and close to the Monorail). Rooms are quiet, quite spacious, clean and well provisioned. Service is very good. Substantial buffet is offered next door at Harrahs, although it has deteriorated compared with the competition at Wynns.

reviews.title: Vegas
reviews.text: The Best Western Plus Casino Royal was a very nice lower budget accommodation right in the heart of Vegas near a supermarket and right on the main strip across from The Mirage. I would stay there again.

reviews.title: 4th stay and not disappointed
reviews.text: This is my 4th stay at this hotel, clean well maintained rooms and property. In room coffeee maker and refridgerator and no resort fees make this property stand out above the competition. We will stay again on our next visit to Las Vegas.

reviews.title: Fantastic!
reviews.text: Stayed here for 5 nights and enjoyed every moment! Perfect location at a fantastic price! Quiet and clean with lovely staff. Small compared to other hotels but we loved that! Lots of eating places right on doorstep. A great find!

reviews.title: Absolutely excellent!
reviews.text: We were truly impressed with the facilities and Service rec'd at Casino Royale. Greeted warmly at check in, set up for players club, and shown the shortcut to guestrooms. Room was spotlessly clean, lots of counter space in bathroom and a good sized fridge. Pillows and bed were very comfy. Lamps had outlets in base to charge phones which I always appreciate.  What was surprising was windows that Open...loved that.!!! The 4th floor was incredibly quiet! Had great slleps!This was our 4 th trip to Vegas and the reason we came to Casino Royale was no resort fee and free parking...the value in this is beyond measure( Also on checkout day you are able to continue to park for later flights.) Note on parking..the far easier way to reach the parade is off Koval Take the Harrah exit and stay in the lane marked valet parking checkin...keep going ( Even though it looks like a garbage lane.)..you will pass Harrah garage on the left ..keep going...the Casino Royale parade will be on the right.Walgreens, Dennys , and tix4tonite are next door..White Castle , Subway, Cinnabon and Nathan's are in the Casino. And  my fav ..Fat Tuesdays is also along strip side..You don't have to stray far to get whatever you might needThe best compliment I can give -We are already planning a return with Casino Royale..Thanks to all who made out stay fabulous!Tips and tricks to travel with no regrets: there is a dollar store and target nearby off flamingo...I purchased extra hangers for the closet..water and pop for the fridge...

reviews.title: Great value for money with excellent location
reviews.text: Perfect for family travellers on a budget. A great hotel in the strip with clean comfortable facilities. No views from the room but not needed if youre just looking for a place to sleep. Staff are friendly and theres a free parking on site

reviews.title: Stopped in for a bite to eat
reviews.text: I stopped in Casino Royale for their White Castle restaurant. Really the only reason I am giving it two stars instead of one is because it has a White Castle. Anyways, got my food and decided a gamble a few dollars. I had $6 in ones and decided to go to the gage to get the ones changed to a $5. This is where it went south. One of my dollars was half way ripped from the bottom. The guy at the cage, Gary refused to take it. Made me feel bad about it. Made me feel worthless. The way he gave all the money back after declining to take the ripped $1 bill. I never write reviews but the whole thing made me feel so bad, I decided to write this. The casino is okay. It has a William Hill sports book and dollar beer. It’s very small. Tonight it seemed busy. But that one employee made me feel so low the way he looked at me and talked to me. When I asked his name, he said, with his head held high, my name is Gary. Like he knew I was going to report our interaction and he didn’t feel like he did anything wrong. But he did, he made me feel very bad.

reviews.title: Great location and value--Best upgrade ever!
reviews.text: Stayed here twice in October, before and after touring the canyons.  The first two nights were fine and we had a comfortable king bed and nice room overlooking the pool.  When we arrived for our second stay a week later, check-in was a problem, as our assigned room had been given to someone else and the desk clerk had to reassign us....to a room overlooking the trash compactor area for Harrah's next door. When I (politely) asked for a better room, I was initially told that the hotel was fully booked, but then the desk clerk upgraded us--to the best suite in the hotel ($875/night)--for two nights.  Absolutely the best service we have ever had!! Best Western really can be the best...if you get the right desk clerk and get a room overlooking the pool.

reviews.title: Great Location, No resort fee!
reviews.text: Our stay was very pleasant... There were ample supply of toilitries...bathroom is clean.. large king room ...including a small kitchenette with coffee maker and fridge... as well as a safe , iron and ironing board...Parking is free with your stay. There are many restaurants and bars surrounding hotel and within the hotel itself..may offerig discounts with coupon booklets provided. Staff were friendly and the room and hotel were clean. Would recommend staying as there is no resort fee. A +++

reviews.title: Freezing rooms
reviews.text: Freezing rooms!!!! No use of turning the air-conditioning off and leaving a note to the cleaning services as they will turn it back on... The rest of amenities is quite ok, beer in the casino bar 1$:)

reviews.title: excellant as always
reviews.text: check in and out no long queues, central hotel, small personal with everything you need, room was spotless,  a coffee machine in the room even the big hotels don't do that, I would have no problems in recommending or booking myself here again

reviews.title: Good for the Price and Location
