reviews.text: If you want to be in the middle of everything in Las Vegas, this is a good place to stay.  The price of the rooms is quite good for the location.  The A/C did not work as we has expected as it shut on and off all night which was very distracting.  The refrigerator was turned up all the way and was barely cool.  The mattresses are quite hard but that may just be my opinion as I don't like a hard mattress for my back.  It's located right in a casino so if you like to gamble, you're in luck.  The staff were very helpful and friendly and check-in and out were very easy to do.

reviews.title: Great room and price on the strip
reviews.text: Nothing fancy but very clean and comfortable.  I was pleasantly surprised at the size of the room.  Located on the strip beside Harrah's and across from Caesar's Palace.  In walking distance of various shops and restaurants.  Very nice and would stay again.

reviews.title: Fell short of my expectations.
reviews.text: This staff upon checkin was not very friendly, it was strictly business. Later in the night we went to the desk again with a question and Reggie was very helpful and kind. He should be the checkin person. The room was a little smaller than expected. There were urine droplets on the toilet and the TV didn't work even by pushing the power button on the back. We didn't call for someone to come fix/clean because we were in a rush to get to a concert. The beds were comfortable though with good pillows. I had higher expectations for the hotel because I was an employee at another property. Unfortunately, those expectations were not a reality.

reviews.title: NO Resort Fee :)
reviews.text: I don't understand why a hotel can't just charge what they are going to charge and leave it at that.  Most Vegas hotels charge an extra $30+ per night as a resort fee.  That drives me crazy since I go to Vegas for work and never use any of the "resort" amenities.  The service is great at this hotel and it could not be more of a convenient location for about anything in Vegas.

reviews.title: Quaint, central and under-rated
reviews.text: Crikey!  Where should I start?  Well let's get the good things out in the open with price.  This hotel is good value for money, it is not luxurious but there is no "resort fee" to pay. The rooms are comfy and the beds, by European standard are huge.  Next great thin is that this is not a typical "resort" hotel.  There is no shopping mall for instance, there are no gimmicks such as dancing fountains or son et lumiere displays and as the rooms are at the back of the hotel, you are likely to get a good nights sleep.Next great point is that this is probably at the best position on the Strip - yep, right in the middle, nestled between Harrah and The Venetian, within a few steps of the "deuce" and opposite The Mirage.  There is a small pool and a token gym, but I guess that you don't really come to Las Vegas for exercise!Sure, there is a casino, slot machines and every opportunity to transfer your cash to the Hotelier seamlessly if that is your pleasure, but it was not my reason to visit Las Vegas.On the minus side..... well for me it is smoking that is permitted in the public areas - oh, and the room cleaning is fairly shambolic (but that might have been because we had a lot of kit with us strewn around the room) with refills missed and half drunk mugs of coffee that were not cleared away.Would I stay there again?  Most certainly.What star rating would I give it?  Actually I would give it a two and a half?  For the simple reason that there is no restaurant so not quite up to a 3.  Certainly not the luxury of a 4, but brilliant value for money.  Let's face it, once asleep, does it matter what floor you are on, how large the bed is or what colour wallpaper?

reviews.title: Great Location
reviews.text: Would not hesitate to recommend this place. Right in the middle of the strip but far enough back not to hear anything. Room was very comfortable for 2 adults and 2 kids, smoking area on all floors and great little pool. Easy to catch the Deuce up and down the strip, will stay here again next year, have stayed at Linq, Excalibur and Palazzo before and this little hotel although not as luxurious as the Palazzo was just as great, after all when in Vegas you do just need somewhere to shower and sleep

reviews.title: Perfect location no resort fees
reviews.text: our second time at this Hotel and again it was superb, close to centre strip and walking distance to all the major casinos, had a good business center with 3 computers, no resort fees made it an easy choice  cost wise, rooms were big and tidy.bar was cheap and plenty of food options available, would stay here again.

reviews.title: Vegas Birthday stay!
reviews.text: Very clean room, accent painted walls, Staff was kind and helpful. Great location on the strip, loved that no "Resort fees" are charged so price was unbeatable by large named Casinos. My personal preference is a softer mattress but I will definitely stay here again when I visit "Sin City."

reviews.title: Perfectly located
reviews.text: We spent 2 nights in the motel. It is perfectly located to discover Las Vegas! Nearly every highlight can be reached without using your car. The room was clean and the size was ok. Although Las Vegas never sleeps it was quiet the night there. The Casino is as well nice and all employees were friendly and helpful. In case we should visit Las Vegas again we would choose it again.

reviews.title: A/C went down - twice...
reviews.text: My wife and I stayed early in August for 6 nights.  First, some of the positives:  Fantastic middle Strip location with an abundance of retail and restaurants right next door; very quick to the Strip from the room, literally a two minute walk max regardless of where you are in the hotel; quick casino access; pool not crowded; free water bottles at the fitness center; friendly staff, quick check-in/out; free parking...You will want to enter the casino parking garage by NOT turning into the lot off the Strip (pedestrians never stop to let you by).  Access the parking off Koval behind the property, then follow through under the Harrah's parking sign, you'll see the Best Western parking past this on the right. Upon arrival in our room we realized that the a/c was not going to bring the room temperature below the mid-70s regardless of the setting.  Also, the fridge didn't work and the tub wouldn't drain.  The next day a very friendly and efficient engineer came and took care of all those problems, even replaced the fridge.  So, very good service and we couldn't complain.  The room itself, a little dated but you can see from the reviews which amenities there are and also no complaints in this department.  It was the last night when the air-conditioning went out for the entire hotel, it had been around 100 during the day so the room was stifling and the system was down pretty much all night.  When we went to check out the following morning front desk said that people who booked directly with the hotel would receive a refund for the night.  Since we had booked through a 3rd party, I suggested that she simply credit our Best Western account with enough points to equal a free night, it would be simple and we'd stay at another BW in the future so really this was fine, much easier than having them contact the other provider.  She seemed happy to oblige, credited our account and we left.  The following day I checked my BW points balance and realized that the points given amounted to less than $5, really an insult.  I eventually contacted the manager, was assured that they would contact the 3rd party and give us a refund for the night.  As we're talking around $150 (a weekend night), I thought it was worth pursuing, and as a Canadian this was closer to $200 for us.So this is why the review is 6 weeks in the making, to date I have had nothing credited to my account, no 3rd party refund.  If possible, simply adding the sufficient number of BW points to equal another stay would be fine but I'm not holding my breath.To sum up, the ease of access, free parking (if required) and no resort fee make this a nice choice, overall it isn't priced any cheaper than the adjacent lower-end casinos (even after the resort fee), so price-wise there isn't a savings here, it is more the convenience.  Would I stay here again?  It would of course depend on the rate, whether I needed a Strip hotel at all since downtown properties are less than half the price...

reviews.title: Location is all
reviews.text: Opposite Cesar's Palace and next door to Venetian, this was a well situated and not too expensive one night stop. Went to simple Mexican chain around corner from hotel for quick supper, and parked hire car in hotel's car park.

reviews.title: Best Western Casino Royale
reviews.text: Best Western Casino Royale is a hidden treasure. Its location is excellent, the staff was super attentive and helpful, and my  overall experience was  outstanding. I will definitely stay at this Best Western property for my next trip to Las Vegas!

reviews.title: Girls trip
reviews.text: Was located in the perfect place , had dennys and McDonald right by it , was quite at night , was small hotel but very personable staff . Close to bus stop , so you could get any were . Casino was great , didn't get lost in it . Next to the Harrahs and in walking distance to several other hotels and casinos

reviews.title: The worst Best Western we have every stayed in
reviews.text: There was a smell of sewerage in the room coming through the air con on a frequent basis.The first night barman was rude when we didn't tip. We are not from here, not used to the culture and usually wouldn't be expected to tip for every drink purchased - especially when its a bottle! (e.g. just takes the cap off)Racist comments from black jack dealer (we are Irish & Australian citizens but living in Canada, which the dealer took issue with)Check in took 45 minutes and the clerk was clearly stoned. The Casino downstairs was seedy and low rent.Awkward entrance to the hotel and having to drag our cases through the casino to get to the rooms.Room was a bit cramped.View of bins from our hotel window.Price of hotel was too much for what we got.Having stayed at a number of Best Westerns worldwide, this one does NOT love up to our previous experiencesLocation was great though.

reviews.title: Fantastic
reviews.text: Located in the middle of the strip next to the Venetian and Harrah's.  Staff were brilliant both hotel and casino.  The room was comfortable an clean and quiet.  Unfortunately it was the last night when we found out that if you were playing the slot machines you got free drinks but never mind we had the last night although can see why you can get a gambling addiction even for someone who doesn't know how to use the machines.

reviews.title: Good hotel 3*
reviews.text: Very clean room, big comfortable bed. Small pool too deep for children starts at 5ft - 8ft over a short span, not very big at all with only a few loungers. Great location close to the places you want to be. Getting an uber from here is difficult. One of the worst casinos on the strip, very old fashioned.

reviews.title: Perfect Location !
reviews.text: Perfect location on the Las Vegas strip.  Cleanliness of room was great, excellent selection of restaurants close by with CVS and Walgreens within walking distance.  I would not hesitate to book this hotel again.   No issues at all :)

reviews.title: aniversary trip
reviews.text: Great hotel, very busy place in Vegas but they all are.  Overall, nice stay. Any kind of breakfast, other than high calorie stuff, would be great. Coffee service in one place only, besides the room k cups with powered creamer. For those that do not gamble 24-7, its a little tough. Location is ideal though. The pool was wonderful!!

reviews.title: Great customer Service
reviews.text: I have never been at a hotel with such a long tenure of hard working employees. All the employees work together to provide a great customer experience! The rooms are very clean from the floor to the ceiling.

reviews.title: Best Western Plus Casino Royale, Las Vegas
reviews.text: A perfect hotel in a perfect location.  Everything about our stay was perfect.  The location couldn't have been better.  The room was clean, quiet and comfortable.  The price was very reasonable for the location, right in the centre strip.  The reception staff were helpful and cheerful.  Check in and check out was very organised.  A gem of a hotel.

reviews.title: The best location
reviews.text: Have stayed here many time and like it a lot.  The rooms are top class with everything you need, the view is over an alleyway but who cares. Location is right on the strip, it's only a small hotel so no huge queues at check in and you don't have to hike miles to your room, parking is right out the back so again no long walks to get to the car.Reception staff as usual were happy and smiling

reviews.title: Sept. 8th
reviews.text: Front desk staff not very nice, very difficult to find your way to the rooms. Air conditioning was not working in the whole hotel the last night we stayed, once again the front desk staff were not nice. Save yourself the aggravation, spend a little more and stay at the Mirage or Venetian.

reviews.title: Best Western Plus Casino Royale, Las Vegas,
reviews.text: Great location and good car park at the rear, we used Denny's next door for breakfast and Outback for tea...easy as...nice smallish hotel, try and get an upper floor room at the rear its quieter, preferably not near the lift or ice machine....they rattle all night...but overall good no problems, clean and comfortable

reviews.title: Outstanding!!
reviews.text: We came to Las Vegas for our daughters birthday, the experience couldn't of been any better. The staff was great from the time we checked in and the time we left. The rooms were very clean and the beds sooo comfortable. The only thing I can suggest is maybe a microwave? But other than that we have a great time.

reviews.title: GOOD STAY AT BEST WESTERN PLUS CASINO ROYALE
reviews.text: This was a good trip for my friend and I.The hotel was in the middle of everything, close to Denny's, next door to other casinos, next to Ben and Jerry's ice cream, they had good sales on shirts and other items, close to a drug store, very close to the tram. This was in an area easy to get across the street and move around. Like I said in the middle of everything.

reviews.title: Las Vegas Adventure
reviews.text: If you're looking for the typical noise and flashing lights, this is the place for you.  I don't know if the value is good compared to the other hotels in the area.  it was $200.00 per night.  I assume it's a little less during the week. It's very close to some of the other big casinos, so you can find really good restaraunts nearby.  The beds were pretty terrible, but other than that it was fine. No view at all and the toilets were subpar.

reviews.title: Great Service Recovery
reviews.text: Best Western truly known how to ratify issues and I thank them for that. If i were to come back to Las Vegas, I would love to stay at the Best Western Plus Casino Royale again. I would also recommend them to my friends and family as well.

reviews.title: Better Late then Never
reviews.text: I know this might be pretty late, but I was a guest at this hotel back in June for EDC. The trip was amazing but there were some hiccups in the beginning of the trip. My friend and I were going to be arriving a couple days early for EDC so we can enjoy the strip and see some of the shows. Well we book our room at another hotel for the first night since it was kind of last minute. As we were heading to the airport, my friend had a few to many drinks and was escorted off the plane. Being that I am the nice friend, i went with her so she wasn't left at the airport alone till the next morning. Which that wasn't quite the way I wanted to spend my trip but life happens. Since we were booted off the plane the next flight out to Las Vegas wasn't till 5 a.m. the next morning, so we had to spend the night at the airport. The longest 12 hours of my life. It was cold and uncomfortable to sleep. Finally we got out to Las Vegas, I called the Casino Royale to see if maybe our room was available. Like I always say at my hotel, never hurts to call and ask. They said our room wasn't, so we still went to the hotel. Just to drop off our stuff to walk around, when we really just wanted to shower and relax a little bit. When we got to the hotel, the next gentlemen at the front desk. I think he was the Manager, he was amazing. We told him what had happen at the airport and how exhausted we were. Not even pushing for a room, he let us check in early. So accommodating for sure. I definitely recommend this place. If you don't plan on staying in your room and just roaming the strip, this is the place to be. It's right smack in all of the action of Las Vegas and the staff was just the sweetest!

reviews.title: Fun
reviews.text: Visited this casino and pretty much did most of my gambling here.  Bar was good and the Tables and Slots were fun to play.  Did a lot of winning here. Was a very fun atmosphere and I would say if you are a first time gambler this is the place to come.

reviews.title: Never again
reviews.text: If you would like a travelodge (British style) with wall to wall one armed bandits then this is the place.  The staff were totally unfriendly, the rooms were not cleaned until really late in the afternoon, which is a real pain when you want to get ready for the evening!!

reviews.title: Pleasant Surprise Mid-Strip
reviews.text: Nestled mid-strip inside/behind the Casino Royale, and next door to Harrah's, this Best Western is quiet and clean. While our room didn't have a "view" (it  looked out onto the parking lot), you could not hear the constant music and noise of the Strip. Be advised, unlike other Best Westerns, this one does not have a guest breakfast.

reviews.title: Great location
reviews.text: This hotel is right in the center of the strip.  Cessation Palace, Mirage, and Treasure Island is across the street, and Harrahs is right next door.  The room was nice, and the bed was very comfortable.

reviews.title: Meets expectations
reviews.text: Large, clean room, tastefully decorated.  Bathroom clean, in good repair, a little small.  Large people may have difficulties.  Public areas clean and in good repair.  Wi-fi works well.  Reception friendly and knowledgeable.  Direct on the strip, room was quiet but without a nice view.  It does everything one would expect from the location, price class, and best western.

reviews.title: First Timer
reviews.text: Honestly,the next time i go to Vegas i will stay in one of the classier hotels for sure.The prices are not much more,for what you get.The nicer hotels have a lot more to see for sure.The location was great,as the Strip is the place to be for sure.So much to see and do on the strip.If you want a more casual place to stay without all the bling,then id recommend Casino Royal.Outbacks Restaurant upstairs was Fantastic,as well as we enjoyed the little burger sliders at White Castle's in Casino Royale.It felt fairly safe at this smaller Hotel.The $1.00 beers were  good also.It is a much quieter place if that's what your looking for.As well as it is very casual.

reviews.title: Great location, great price
reviews.text: A great location and price. You won't be disappointed with the facilities and cleanliness of the hotel. Provides a little kitchenette, bed, tv, internet and modern bathroom. Well worth the money and the great convenience of being right in the heart of the Las Vegas Strip.

reviews.title: Great rate great stay
reviews.text: Real nice rooms all redone check in a little slow but not bad  great center strip location best of all price in room coffee free wi and best no resort fee the staff here is very nice lots of food places in building Walgreen right next door what more could you want

reviews.title: Great Room, Location and Staff
reviews.text: Situated about half-way down the Strip (across from the Mirage, and between Harrahs and the Venetian) the BW Casino Royale is within walking distance of so much.  And if you are tired walking, the facility offers so much without ever having to step out onto the busy sidewalk:  a long casino and bar, an Outback restaurant (upstairs), Ben and Jerry's, Fat Tuesdays, White Castle, Denny's (upstairs) and Walgreens.Sharon, at the front desk, is truly friendly and professional.  She answered all of my questions before I had a chance to ask them!  I appreciated how she walked me through the casino to the locked entrance to the guest rooms, showed me how to use the electronic card, and pointed me in the right direction.My ground floor room was spotless.  On a 98 degree day, the air conditioning kept my room cool without any effort.  The large LG TV had a perfect picture, and the number (and quality) of channels far exceeded most hotels.  The armchair and ottoman were comfy.  Though the bed was firmer than I prefer, I slept soundly.  The shower head, water pressure, and temperature were fine.  I didn't need to use the elevators (there is one just inside the entrance to the guest quarters, and another half-way down the long hall).  Unfortunately the latter (as well as the locked door to the pool) are located on the other side of the wall next to my room -- both were annoying.  Those sounds tapered off in the night.  Honestly, this being my first trip to Vegas, I was expecting a lot more noise...so all in all, I was pleasantly surprised.Thank you, BW Casino Royale!

reviews.title: Great location
reviews.text: This was our second visit to this hotel and the hotel is exactly the same this trip as the last visit. Very friendly efficient checkin. The Only difference was that we were on the 4th floor and unfortunately placed right outside the cleaners storage cupboard so noise levels were higher than we would have liked. Otherwise the room was clean and air conditioning worked well. Coffee and free paper and right on the strip without long walk from the hotel to the strip as with every other strip hotel we have stayed at. Pool area isn't that nice and if your looking to spend a lot of time at a pool then I wouldn't recommend staying here. There are no resort fees and parking/internet/pool is included in the room rate.

reviews.title: Good size room
reviews.text: I can't compare this hotel to others on the Las Vegas strip because we only stayed at this strip hotel. Check in was quick and friendly although as we understand is typical with most Las Vegas strip hotels, one has to battle through the gambling area to find the reception. At least this hotel is relatively small so the "battle" is easy. Staff welcomed us and pointed out the way to the residential area of the hotel which is accessed through a secure door. Our room was on the third floor and was a good size. The room was clean and well appointed although our view was of the wall of the building across a small laneway. This didn't worry us we were only staying one night. The room was insulated from noise from the casino, although there was some noise from fellow guests arriving back from late night revelry. The rooms are all non smoking which is a big plus for us. The hotel is close to many of the larger casinos which host Las Vegas shows, so it was an easy walk to get to the show we had booked, Cirque du Soliel, All You Need is Love. The hotel suited us for our limited stay.

reviews.title: Great location, no hidden fees
reviews.text: Thoroughly enjoyed our stay. The location is across the road from The Mirage & Caesars Palace (almost middle of the strip) so you can walk everywhere or catch the bus if needed. Some of the power points in our room didn't work so unfortunately we couldn't use our mini fridge which was disappointing however we utilised the ice machine instead. Room was serviced everyday and staff were very helpful.

reviews.title: A little hidden gem
reviews.text: We booked this hotel after our last visit as we found it had everything we needed close by. Check in was fast and very efficient. We were given a room on the 4th floor of the hotel witch is the top floor. As Las Vegas was in the middle of a heat wave we did find the a/c in the room did struggle at times to cool the room down but the unit was very quiet and it did keep the room bearable. Found the room to be clean and very well presented with everything we needed. The bathroom was bright and clean with plenty of clean towels supplied in the room. There was a bit of noise from the corridor but we assume the hotel was full as it was labour day weekend. Will we stay here again yes without a doubt. The parking was free and the hotel accommodation felt secure as only guests could access the rooms.

reviews.title: Perfect Location
reviews.text: Centrally located on the Strip you are right in the action.  The casino itself is small-- but there is something for everyone.  And you are right next to large (and more expensive) Casino's if that's your thing.  The rooms are updated, CLEAN and comfortable.  The cleaning service is amazing.  The front desk is very helpful and informative. There are food options all around this hotel (and inside)  We will stay here every time we come to Vegas going forward -- so glad we found it

reviews.title: convenience
reviews.text: Hotel is smaller than most which was fine with us, very convenient to everything.  Has a few fast food restaurants right inside including Outback.  Smaller casino than those big boys on the strip which we did not lose our shirts, went home with money in our pockets

reviews.title: Great Hotel to stay in Vegas
reviews.text: We loved this hotel for our Vegas nights.  It's right across the street from the Mirage, convenient to everything on the strip and very nice rooms and wonderful staff.  Our room was very reasonable, the casino is small but good, and there is a McDonald's right next store for breakfast if you are not a big eater. The parking is free, they have a pool, and no resort fees, so if we go out again, this will be our place to stay!

reviews.title: good value
reviews.text: great price and location.  Bus stops right there.  And plenty of food and shopping right in the area.  Cheap beer at happy hour and the bartender always remembers your drink.  Rooms were cleaned everyday and restocked with toiletries.

reviews.title: Great value. Excellent staff.
reviews.text: Great location. Loved the pool. The staff were brilliant. Will recommend this Hotel to friends. Nice room very clean. Right on the strip opposite the Mirrage Complexes. Upstairs Restaurant great food with sports.

reviews.title: Vegas delights
reviews.text: Value for money clean rooms with all the amenities we required.  Free parking on site.  Would recommend to others. Not flashy like the other big hotels on the strip but was a nice clean comfortable place to come back to every night and get a good nights sleep.

reviews.title: GREAT LAS VEGAS STRIP LOCATION
reviews.text: Great Las Vegas Strip location with no Resort Fee's  Room was clean, quiet & comfortable. Staff was friendly. professional and helpful. Lots of food and eating choices either in or adjoining the Hotel.

reviews.title: Nice rooms should add a microwave
reviews.text: We stayed here for 8 nights for my birthday weekend.  The room was clean. Housekeeping did a great job and everyone is super friendly and helpful. I only had 2 issues. 1. My car almost got towed because the person who checked me  in didn't bother to give me a parking pass. 2. For 8 nights, I could've really used a microwave. But on the bright side, they have a great casino in the lobby. Also in the lobby, basically, there is White Castle, Fat Tuesday, McDonald, Walgreens, Denny, Outback, Nathan's Hotdog, Subway etc. You literally don't need to rent a car but we did because it was 106 degrees outside. Lovely Hotel, will definitely recommend.

reviews.title: It's ok
reviews.text: Located on the strip but has no views from the rooms (at least the room I was given). No microwave in room which is rough if you're staying for more than a day or two. The Casino isn't huge but is an adequate size. Getting in and out of the parking lot area can be quite tricky depending on the time of day.  If you're a Best Western Rewards member your free room upgrade feature won't work here so don't even bother asking or expecting. The rooms are clean, the water pressure was not that great but it's suffice. Very convenient food and drinks attach to the hotel including Outback, White Castle, Fat Tuesday, Walgreens, Dennys, Subway, Cinnabon's and Nathan's Hot Dogs.  I enjoyed my stay because it's Vegas but I don't think this location was worth the  room price.

reviews.title: Great stay on the strip
reviews.text: Nice cosy hotel on the strip. Walgreens supermarket next door. White castle opened 24hours for easy food. Cinnabon and other food places on site. Ticket stores outside.. easy to book shows. Convenient to all attractions.

reviews.title: Gavin
reviews.text: You get what you pay for - it's "average" at best, not even the small pool was open - however the room  was clean and everything worked - I suggest you stay at one of the more fashionable hotels on the strip.... Your stay in Las Vegas will be better for it.......

reviews.title: Great location and enjoyable stay
reviews.text: We stayed 4 nights here in Las Vegas. Location 5/5 - The hotel is located quite central of the main strip. There is public transport and many restaurants nearby. Room 4/5 - The room was clean and spacious and had all the basics required for our stay. The bed was comfortable but the room/bathroom is a bit outdated. Probably needs renovations sometime soon. Amenities - The hotel has a gym, pool, in-house ice cream store. Pretty much what you need after a long hot day exploring Las Vegas. Price - For what it is, I thought it was good value for money.Service 5/5 - The staff were great upon check-in. We had no issues during our stay here.I would recommend this place to budget travellers. Definitely not the most luxurious place to stay but it has everything you need in Vegas...

reviews.title: What a pleasure
reviews.text: We stayed August 19-26 2017. We did the express check in the day before arrival.We arrived by taxi and walked to the counter with no wait...check in took maybe 3 minutes and we were off to our room. I had made a special request on my room and it was met. I found a cool inviting room with a fridge that was nice and cold. The room was very clean. As I was unpacking the front desk called to see how I was doing and if everything was satisfactory and if I needed anything...how nice was that. Through out our stay our room was cleaned daily and I do tip everyday. All our requests from housekeeping were met ie extra coffee etc.We found the casino fun, plenty of security, loose slots, great beer choices, we do not drink the dollar beer. We drink Sculpin beer and I guarantee that it is the lowest price you will find on the strip., $4.oo, if you walk next door to Harrah's you will pay $8.00.The staff at both the hotel and casino are very friendly. Subway was one of the cleanest and freshest we have been to. We enjoyed White Castle too.It is so close to everything. Also important you may not know that there is a tram in Bellagio that will take you to New York New York casino that is free. It was a great for us and we wanted to explore and it was very hot outside.We have been to Las Vegas maybe 30 times and I have to say all in all this is our favorite place to stay.  NO need to worry about getting a cab to the airport for departure they are reliable and quick.Thank you...Best Western and Casino Royale....great time

reviews.title: really bad experience
reviews.text: unfriendly staff disease once needed a taxi, waited long, never arrived rec eption difficult to be found because inside casino room perfect and other services ok no possibility of breakfast good position to visit las vegas

reviews.title: A nice little hotel among the giants on the strip.
reviews.text: Perfect location, clean rooms and a small but nice pool. In short everything you need.No breakfast but quality fast food around the corner. Stayed there with our family and was impressed by price and location. No stupid extra charge in form of a resort fee pp.

reviews.title: One night stop-over
reviews.text: We needed a place to stay for one night with an early morning flight. There was a casino located on the bottom floor and it was conveniently located close to several large hotels and attractions on the strip.  Easily accessed by ride sharing and taxis with drop off and pickup in the back.  Rooms were clean and had everything we needed. A good value in an expensive town.

reviews.title: Good price performance
reviews.text: Spent there one night showing children Las Vegas. Room was clean, good service and for one night in Las Vegas it was just good enough hotel. It has good position on Strip next to Venetian hotel. There is nothing to love about this hotel but also nothing what would make you angry

reviews.title: good location, comfortable and well-priced
reviews.text: 3 night holiday stay as a couple. No resort fees. Great location on the Strip near the Venetian and Bellagio (saw a show there). Despite being part of a Casino the room was very quiet. Included wifi, comfortable and clean.  Staff were friendly and helpful. Able to check into room early. Express check out was effective. Front desk helpful - rang us a taxi very early morning of departure. Hotel is looking tired and weary - needs an update. On arrival taxi dropped off at car park (no where to stop on Strip) so had to drag bags through Casino. Front desk was hard to find. Used ride share for a pickup and Uber wanted us to walk to Venetian parking garage.  Suggest messaging driver to pickup in rear carpark of Best Western.

reviews.title: Las Vegas Birthday party and vacation
reviews.text: The motel was in a very good location about mid way along the strip. The room was clean and most of the staff were very nice and went out of their way to make our stay a nice experience.  Would definitely stay with them again and recommend them.

reviews.title: Location is excellent
reviews.text: If you are looking for accommodation amidst the action on the Stripe and don't want to pay a fortune, look no further.  Clean, comfortable accommodation and surprising quite (no noise from the strip or attached casino).  Plenty of restaurants and fast food options close by too.

reviews.title: value for money
reviews.text: Very well located on the strip. Prices shown on the web include resort fees and free parking. No hidden extras. Wish they had better breakfast options on premise - like other Best Westerns elsewhere. Checkin/out was smooth. In-room Internet was great. Allowed multiple devices to use internet.

reviews.title: Great location and great value
reviews.text: Great location for a great value! The Casino was fantastic and had cheaper tables to play on with great service throughout. We spent a good amount of time playing there and came out on top. The waitresses were responsive and consistently walking around- didn't have to wait long nor search for them. Can't beat this value for a place to stay in Vegas right on the strip.

reviews.title: Great location for a bargain price
reviews.text: This hotel was located right on the strip in Vegas and was only a fraction of the price of the larger casino hotels. We were close to great restaurants, shopping and shows. Ben & Jerry's right in the lobby was a plus!!

reviews.title: Nice hotel - very loud thought
reviews.text: Nice hotel People returning off the strip kept me awake for hours Staff offered to move me to a new room but I could not be bothered Security visited them twice to keep the noise down Restless sleep and I had an international flight the next day

reviews.title: Value for money on the 'Strip'.
reviews.text: Comfortable  clean room. Everything worked. Key card entry was tricky:  had to withdraw the card very quickly.  Best value we could find and right on 'The Strip'.  Was mid summer and extremely  hot, but once inside The Forum shops across the street it was easy to remain in air con comfort and progress thru many hotels

reviews.title: Small room but location is great
reviews.text: Budget hotel. Rooms are very small for Vegas strip hotel. Location is great. Right out front where you can catch the Duece bus to anywhere. Bed very comfortable. Smoky smell to room and the air conditioner broke during our stay making it uncomfortably hot. Mold in bathroom and the tub was so slow to drain that by the time you finished a shower the tub was 1/2 full.Found the price high for what you get very high. Found nights at Mirage and Ballys for cheaper (even with resort fees) and much nicer.

reviews.title: Great Value
reviews.text: I have stayed here at the Casino Royal several times. The location is great, the rooms are clean, the staff is friendly and helpful. love the White Castle in the food court and lobby bar is underrated.

reviews.title: A terrific value in a town not known for terrific values . . .
reviews.text: I was in Las Vegas for a single night recently to attend an event at one of the larger hotels on the Strip and I chose the Best Western Plus Casino Royale for three primary reasons: location, White Castle, price.  To be fair, any hotel with a White Castle attached has a distinct advantage in my book.The location is tough to beat, almost dead center on the Strip, across from the Mirage, three minutes from Caesar's and mid-way between Wynn and Bellagio.The price was extraordinary, though I must admit to doing a little extra research that yielded significant savings.White Castle?  If you know it and love it, no explanation is needed.  If you know it and don't love it, no explanation is possible.The hotel itself was actually a big surprise.  You navigate from the main entrance (in the rear of the building) through a sea of slot machines to the small office which is neat and tidy; the office staff were most pleasant and helpful.There is one key-access door to the hotel rooms, across the casino floor from Ben & Jerry's.  My room was one floor up, either by a flight of stairs or the elevator.The room was a real surprise.  It was modern, clean and in perfect condition.  It featured a desk & chair, mini fridge, a coffee maker, toiletries in the bathroom, a nice wide screen TV and a thermostat set to "meat locker".  When you've been traveling all day, getting a room that cold is invigorating and most welcome.Best of all, there was no noise from outside or from the casino downstairs, so getting some decent rest was no problem.There is one thing to note: even though there are many national chain restaurants represented at the Casino Royale, and along the rest of the Strip, don't expect to pay your home town prices in Las Vegas.  The town runs on money and even familiar names are not exempt from taking advantage.If you do your homework shopping for rates, and you're looking for value, convenience, cleanliness and quiet, you'd be hard pressed to find a better buy than the Best Western Plus Casino Royale.

reviews.title: Final stop on tour
reviews.text: It's a very basic Hotel, the casino area could do with a good clean carpet sticky in places. The check in area is small but staff are very friendly. Too many people were sleeping on the benches in the food area,

reviews.title: A very good hotel at the heart of the Vegas Strip
reviews.text: If you want to spend a fabulous holiday on the Vegas Strip, the  best place to stay is at the Best Western Casino Royale.  Situated at the heart of the Strip, the hotel has moderate furnishings, but very clean, has a gym and a small private swimming pool.  Rooms are large, complete with a coffee machine and a refrigerator.  Excellent internet service.  Hotel lobby might give you the impression that it is a shabby motel.  But you change your mind as soon as you start reaping the other benefits.

reviews.title: Rote 66 trip
reviews.text: No refrigerator or microwave in the room disappointed us during the stay here, We were lucky we got a room here as no one else seemed to have a vacancy. For the price we paid we expected a microwave and refrigerator in our room. No such luck.

reviews.title: excellent location, great value
reviews.text: Prime location on the strip, near bus stops & next to Venetian, opposite to Mirage.Small hotel with good size room, adequate facilities such as fridge, safe, coffee maker etc...rooms could do with modernising but good enough as they are.No fees for wifi, parking or resort fees which obviously makes this a great bargain at the price.Staff friendly, rooms kept to high standard of cleanliness.Excellent value for money compared to other hotels on the strip.Only criticism is we requested extra pillows but the hotel does not stock extras!!!Highly recommended

reviews.title: Same as other Best Westerns, decent, clean
reviews.text: I was looking for a cheaper hotel as all the main Strip hotels were sold out.. came to this one, its just the same in the hotel part as any other BW.. clean rooms, good size, mini kitchen.. its also located in the heart of the strip, so very convenient..

reviews.title: Good place to stay
reviews.text: I have been to this hotel twice. The first time was on my vacation and my family and I really enjoy it. The hotel is on the strip and was close to everything. We did a lot of walking and did not have to drive around. I only reason I could not give this hotel an excellent is that most best western offer free breakfast and this hotel does not.

reviews.title: Las Vegas trip
reviews.text: Easy to find from airport using gps, car park entrance tucked away slightly (next right after harrahs car park, go past McDonald's sign then on right. People don't want to stop walking to let you in!) tip, go to reception first without luggage, or you'll take it all through casino. Theres an entrance on left opposite casino entrance to take luggage and lift. Not up there in newness with other hotels but smack bang in middle of everything. Rooms clean and good size, comfortable beds good tv, coffee maker and fridge. Next door is Walgreens for water and such. Only used casino once and won a fair bit, also inside are food outlets at back. Would definitely stay here again.

reviews.title: a great find :)
reviews.text: Stayed here 2 nights over july 4 weekend. Room very comfortable for 3 and bath clean with good towels. Staff were very nice and offered bottled water (scorching hot temps). There's a coffee machine in the room and a great pool that my girls used after a long day. This place is no frills but very comfortable - has no resort fees which is why we chose it, yet it's very central and convinient.  Can't talk about the casino because they are not of age ! But to get to reception you have to go through it - very crowded.

reviews.title: What's not to like?
reviews.text: We stayed at this hotel for 3 nights as part of a road trip around SW USA and our only regret is that we didn't stay here for a another couple of nights.The location of this hotel could not be better, it is situated slap bang in the centre of the strip. Given this location I was surprised that we heard no noises or disturbances at all during our stay.The parking is plentiful with easy access and egress and is completely free for guests. Check in was easy and the staff were very friendly. This hotel and casino is relatively small and therefore there was no 10-15 min walk through the labyrinth of a major hotel to get to your room. The rooms are modern, clean and comfortable and compare very similarly to higher priced hotels such as Ballys etc.The casino is small, but friendly and we enjoyed an evening on the tables there.This hotel has also bucked the current Las Vegas hotel trend of charging extra resort fees and therefore provides excellent value.Great location, easy access to the strip, great parking, comfortable rooms, decent casino, friendly staff, fantastic value - what's not to like?

reviews.title: Great Value
reviews.text: Loved the cleanliness and safety of this hotel. Room had fridge, dryer, ironing board and coffee machine. Great value on the strip, quiet at night, hotel staff really helpful.  Close to everything on the strip

reviews.title: Good Location
reviews.text: It's a walking distance to major hotels and casinos. Temperature is terible in July be it morning or night. No breakfast provided at this location. The reception inside the casino so direction is not really that obvious.

reviews.title: Staff was nice
reviews.text: Staff the day of my check out was great. Can not say the same about the person who checked it in. I do not appreciate being woken up at 8 am in the morning after I already called to have things noted on my reservation to avoid any issues.

reviews.title: Good price in the middle of the strip
reviews.text: This hotel was just what I expected it to be for the price.  People were kind and room was clean and comfortable.  Location was great in the heart of everything.  We were there with family so we had to get 2 rooms which was the only downside since they couldn't accommodate 5 people in a single room.  Parking was convenient and free.  Would have been nice to have a breakfast like most other Best Westerns but this is a casino not a typical hotel.

reviews.title: a suitable hotel
reviews.text: -good central location- money valuable- one dollar beer at the casino- bus station in front- kiosk beside enterence for reservation of shows and resturants tickets- calm and clean outdoor pool- u can find every thing within steps

reviews.title: Disappointed!
reviews.text: Sadly, the hotel is very dated.  There is no view.  The carpet needs to be replaced or cleaned.  If you are a Diamond member, they sure do not recognize your allegiance with any special welcome or room upgrade.  For the price, you would be better off at another hotel on the strip.

reviews.title: Visit
reviews.text: Vacation was only for one day. Value for location is good however casino looked and smelled a little lower quality than others. Smell just before entering parking garage was hideous. Small changes can go a long way.

reviews.title: great location on a budget
reviews.text: this hotel offers eveyrthing you need if you are looking for a good hotel good location and budget price tag. I cannot fault it the room was clean and had everything we needed I would not hesitate to book this hotel again if I was to return to Las Vegas.

reviews.title: It is what it is
reviews.text: Very good location just opposite Caesers Formum shopping centre.  Relatively handy for Caesers, Bellagio and 'Paris'.  Walking the streets to get anywhere is pretty horrific.  Casino downstairs in hotel is pretty dire and dingy but the room was OK for a couple of nights before we flew home.  I couldn't recommend Las Vegas to anyone - it's the pits and we were only ending our holiday road trip from there.  Two nights was way too long for us

reviews.title: Great location
reviews.text: The rooms were a decent size for 4 people. A very small hotel all together, the pool was great!! We had alot of time in there, pool was big and we had it to our self a couple of times. Great location on the strip!

reviews.title: GREAT LOCATION and price for STRIP!
reviews.text: Not a fancy place but we had 3 rooms for a family trip to Vegas here.   Location can bit be beat! Price reasonable for Vegas.   ROom was nice and comfortable.   Could walk to anywhere.   Parking behind building and easy for an Uber.

reviews.title: Great Position on the Strip
reviews.text: clean and modern rooms with a perfect position on the Strip and at really reasonable pricing very close to all the big casinos on the strip also the Best Westin has a great little casino with friendly staff

reviews.title: Awesome hotel
reviews.text: Was not expecting this hotel to be as awesome as it was!!! I will definitely will be returning to this hotel! The room it self was very nice the bed was vet very comfortable and the staff was really amazing!

reviews.title: Great place to stay!!
reviews.text: Wonderful location to stay with your family. There is so much to do within walking distance of the hotel. Will we definitely have to go and stay here again. The staff were nice and helpful. The food in the area is amazing. It is worth the trip and stay here.

reviews.title: Excelent localization.
reviews.text: Nice hotel. The reception is inside a casino. Friendly recepcionist. Internet very fast. Perfect localization, in the middle of Strip Las Vegas. There is a balcon of Tix 4 Tonight next door. Bedrooms noiseless. Perfect accoustic isolation.

reviews.title: Great location at a great price
reviews.text: The most comfortable beds with an excellent location at a great price. Would highly recommend this location to anyone staying on the strip. The check in was flawless and its located right in the middle of the strip 👍

reviews.title: Birthday trip
reviews.text: Local was amazing but the beds was horrible and it made my back hurt and my friends felt the same way. I like that they had a CVS, Denny's and also a White Castle, even subway that was great to have close by.

reviews.title: Great hotel
reviews.text: The Location was perfect, located right across from the mirage. Staff were friendly, especially Tina. There's aLift to pick up  at the hotel  and Uber nearby. Plenty of restaurants and the bus stop is just a few feet away. This would be a good hotel for family or single. It was very quiet so sleep was good.

reviews.title: Good but bad smell in the parking and swimming pool
reviews.text: Good hotel and room, but with low ceiling, and no large open windows. So be careful if you are claustrophobic. And unfortunately, smell of trash in the parking and the swimming pool. Smell of sewer in the corridor. Good casino, with a lot of slot machines

reviews.title: Dumpy casino floor, nice but depressing room
reviews.text: Should have stayed in the Orleans instead, this hotel was very dingy. Rooms were modern and super-clean, but the hotel was missing a lot, TBH. Wanted to stay on the strip to see what it was like but regretted it. Should have stayed downtown or at the Orleans where there is more to do. You live, you learn, I guess.

reviews.title: Not Up to Best Western Plus Standards.
reviews.text: In a Best Western Plus I expect a better quality mattress. The mattress was a standard motel mattress not the better pillow tops I expect at Best Western Plus. No breakfast with this Best Western. The staff was very good no problems there at all. There was an Outback steakhouse  a Denny's and food court located in the Casino for dinning. The wife and I ate at the Harrah's casino buffet next door, big mistake as was pricey and not up to Golden Corral buffet.

reviews.title: Sooo hot
reviews.text: Right on the strip in the middle of everything, CVS Pharmacy next door for all your needs, Checkin staff were great and housekeeping were very friendly. Rooms are great , very typical for Best Western, don't expect a view other than the parking lot, great pool but no umbrellas 42degrees celciuis, pool was useless in the blistering sun

reviews.title: Clean and quality for the price
reviews.text: Very nice and quiet rooms even on the ground floor and located  on the strip.  Great parking, nice location.  Took awhile to get checked in but everything else was good.  Lots of food and coffee choices in Hotel.  Small pool but nice.  Very nice rooms.  Comfortable and clean. Staff very nice.

reviews.title: The Best Area If Your Walk Around The Strip
reviews.text: I hope the internet hotel is more faster and the best place to stay in if you are or your family wants to walk around the strip ...BTW this is our 2nd visit here in BW Casino Royale Cleanliness and I hope give us more trash bags and reg sugar for coffee.

reviews.title: a nice European type hotel
reviews.text: This is a great place to stay if you. Are looking for a clean hotel with few amenities. Coffee, a mini fridge, Internet & tv are all included for the room rate. Can't beat that that w/a strip location.

reviews.title: Great location
reviews.text: Great place to stay. Very central in the heart of the action. Easy access to the monorail. Lots of places to eat, glitzy and glamorous. So many sights. High roller. Surrounded by casinos. Buffet at Ceasars palace.

reviews.title: Deceiving
reviews.text: Because this was a family trip we booked this hotel because it said the casino was in a separate building.Well it is in a separate building but you have to go through the casino to check in. And it's not a nice casino it's very dark, smelled bad and creepy so check in had to be all the way in the back!The only reason I'm giving a 3 is because the room was nice but with the strange way you had to go to enter the hotel made us feel unsafe!

reviews.title: Fantastic
reviews.text: Easy to find.  Car park to the rear of the hotel with plenty of spaces.  Left cases in car and went into casino to check in.  Hotel front desk well signposted when you get in.  Friendly and efficient staff on check in desk who showed us the way to our room through the casino rather than going out to car park to get there.  They also gave us a permit to put in the car for free car parking during our stay.  Room a good size with coffee maker and fridge.  Decent bathroom.  Free wifi in room and no resort fee.  Positioned in the middle of the strip so easy to walk everywhere we wanted to go.  Would highly recommend.

reviews.title: Great value for Las Vegas
reviews.text: We stayed for Memorial Day weekend when all prices in Las Vegas are high.  This was great value in comparison to the other prices I was quoted and is very well located near the centre of the Strip, onsite parking is available and there is a small pool.  Of course, it's not in the class of the Venetian or the Belagio but, as one other reviewer commented, you don't spend much time in your room anyway.  Only thing missing is the great breakfasts that you get at most Best Westerns.

reviews.title: Okay
reviews.text: Its basic and affordable, and if you're doing Las Vegas right, you wont spend too much time in the rooms anyway! The rooms have very fast internet, good air conditioning and you can make it nice and dark during the day for those vegas hang overs.

reviews.title: Great Value!
reviews.text: This is probably the best value for a hotel on the Strip that anyone could ask for. There are no resort fees (so good!!) and the proximity to the Venetian and LINQ promenade really can't be beat. Our room was nice and clean, and we really appreciated the good-size fridge, because we quickly realized we needed a TON of water to be able to survive in LV heat in June. Which brings me to my next point: there is a Walgreens adjacent to the hotel, AND a Ben & Jerry's counter is literally five steps from the entrance to the hotel rooms. Perfect!! The only problem we ever had was a slow-draining tub, which was quickly amended once we left to explore the next morning. No, there isn't free breakfast here, nor a lush pool (though the pool they have is nice and clean), but when you're on a budget and are eager to explore Vegas---you can't stay anywhere but Casino Royale!

reviews.title: Holiday travel in the states
reviews.text: Easy to find great location great service.,love the lights of Vegas at night and been able to visit Hoover dam nearby,good parking facilities,great transport system and easy to use good highway system and easy to drive around

reviews.title: LA
reviews.text: Good location, good hospitality, clean room, BW is a place I will recommend for other people when asked about a place to stay in LA. Subway was always open but I would still include a minimum breakfast in the offer.

reviews.title: BAEGAS 2k17
reviews.text: My friends and I stayed here for our first 21+ trip to Vegas. All of us we're on a budget so this place really helped us out (only pay for the first night's stay upon reservation and free cancellation up to 3 days prior to check in). For what we paid to stay here, the rooms were great- amenities, comfy bed, very clean, etc. we were really close to fast food and Fat Tuesdays so that extremely convenient as well. Overall, I was pleased with my stay and would recommend others stay here too.

reviews.title: Good location but old room!
reviews.text: The location of hotel is good close to everthing.  And good point for this hotel is no resort fee and free parking. But hotel and room is quite old. And smell not so good inand outside area. Even hotel not provide breakfast for guest. There are many restaurant near by

reviews.title: Great Location/ Wonderful Staff
reviews.text: Excellent service, clean comfortable rooms, quiet well maintained pool area. Lounge decor a bit dated and smoking indoors threw me off. However, overall great experience, excellent location on Las Vegas Strip!

reviews.title: Location location location
reviews.text: Great location if you are on a budget in Las Vegas, the rooms are basic but working fine, there is a little pool at the back side of the hotel, and the hotel is having very good parking facilities.It's for sure not a five star fancy hotel, but good value for money and very well placed at the Strip.

reviews.title: Tranquility and just a few feet from the Strip
reviews.text: So the check in desk is in the middle of the "Casino Royale" !!  but when you are shown the residents access through a sliding door, on the other side all is peace and tranquillity.  The rooms have the usual pleasing Best Western standard.  we really enjoyed our stay everything on the strip in walking distance and when our shuttle did not arrive the reception staff rang them for us...so full marks all roundOh and a Dennys next door and if its full another 15 minutes walk away and the "Deuce" strip bus stop is just outside as well

reviews.title: Location Location and no resort fees
reviews.text: Love the location of this hotel close to everything, lots of places cheap to eat. Great beer $1 at bar. Staff were friendly, rooms were great with coffee machine and fridge included in price, best of all no resort fees

reviews.title: Almost perfect
reviews.text: Super location and clean rooms.Super comfy beds with good amenities such as fridge,safe,iron board,good size tv and internet connection.       Problems encountered were having to walk through the casino itself to get to and find reception...the lifts were on the blink most of the time which were never actually repaired while we were there..Apart from these small issues the over all stay was a great experience..     We would recommend this hotel for the location and room for what it cost..cheers.

Great hotel on a top location in the middle of the Strip. Nice and quiet rooms, friendly staff. Would certainly go again. No big massive hotel. Locations for dinner around. Recommend Outback Steakhouse.

reviews.title: Great location for a great price!
reviews.text: The hotel is in a great Strip location, next to Harrah's and across the street from The Mirage and Caesars Palace. The rooms are comfortable, with mine having a small fridge for water. There is a Walgreens, large Denny's and McDonald's all next door. I would stay here again, when I want to save money and be in a great central location on The Strip.

reviews.title: Outstanding Staff
reviews.text: We had an outstanding staff by Katrina, Walter, and Sharon when we checked into the place.  We had many, many Best Western Gift Cards which took time to input, but they were so nice and helpful and patient with us.  That made us feel important to them.

reviews.title: At the very center of the strip!
reviews.text: We liked the location of the hotel. If you are travelling without a car, BW Casino Royale is a good option. It has not have a  outstanding concept as other hotels have. However, it is great that they do not charge a city tax for your accomadation

reviews.title: Best Western? Best secret!
reviews.text: Stayed here with family for 2 nights . Right in the centre of strip , only 200 yds from Colloseum  ( there to see Ms Dion ) . Our first time in Vegas . Hotel staff so , so helpful , rooms well furnished and quiet.  Restaurants and Walgreens under same roof . Brilliant value . Don't tell the hotel but would be a bargain at double the price!

reviews.title: Great Vegas Stay
reviews.text: The location was excellent, and the service & cleanliness were top notch. I was completely surprised with this hotel relative to the price I paid. It was very well maintained, and up to date. My next Vegas trip I will certainly stay there again.

reviews.title: Great location hard to find the entrance
reviews.text: Hotel is in the middle of the strip and surrounded by everything, close to food,and shopping and all of the casinos.  Room was great, not easy to get to the room from the lobby of the hotel.  Room was clean and crisp and inviting.

reviews.title: Good location and value for money
reviews.text: Good location on the Strip close to Bellagio and Ceasars Palace and a short walk from all the other hotels and restaurants. The room was quite big and very nice with two double beds. Good in-room WiFi and close to Walgreens where you can buy water, sweets, medicine or anything else you might need.

reviews.title: Centrally located.
reviews.text: Good quality hotel, right on the strip. Opposite the Mirage hotel and next to the Venetian. Good helpful staff with clean rooms. Because the hotel is behind the actual casino it's very quiet and you wouldn't know you were on the strip.

reviews.title: Vegas Experience
reviews.text: Vegas, great stay, and won money at the casino! Clean room and nice to have reasonably priced restaurants in the hotel. Parking covered and free. All personnel great.  Manager very accomodating, and the bellboy, Oviro, was terrific both times. Thank you for a fun time.

reviews.title: Vacation
reviews.text: The room was clean and comfortable. The staff was helpful and friendly. Only problem was the safe in the closet made it hard to hang clothes. When you open the closet the safe is right in front of you. It would have been better if it were placed on the other side of the closet.

reviews.title: casino only did not stop at hotel
reviews.text: I did not stop at the hotel but wanted to let people know i Went to the casino there and they had a bar where you could get a bottle of good beer for a dollar and 2 dollars for a bud light instead of paying 8 dollars in every other bar so we spent many nights i there they showed the football and the cheapest cash machine to draw out just 3 dollars where my hotel charged 8 dollars. Its more down to earth prices and friendly staff

reviews.title: Great value, low ceilings
reviews.text: Not a big, fancy hotel however the value was great.  Taxi service was slow to arrive behind hotel, the pool was a little small but well kept.  The staff were super helpful and we were in the middle of the Vegas action.  2 am White Castle burgers - check, soft pretzel - check, drug store near by- check, check!  Would recommend staying here if value is your goal.

reviews.title: Great hotel stay
reviews.text: Hotel was great...didn't offer my type of drinking at the bar...slots were fun...room was clean and comfortable. Will definitely come back...a little inconvenient because of construction and entrance closed.

reviews.title: Just Ok. Decent location. Not a resort.
reviews.text: Rooms are fairly basic but comfortable. Don't come here expecting resort facilities. It's just a hotel above a fairly down at heel, but pleasant enough casino. The location between the Venetian and Harrahs is good however so plenty of places to eat nearby. If you want to avoid 'resort fees' this is a consideration. However we would probably stay elsewhere next time. I think for the rate we paid the value was only average. At the time of writing the Casino has a $20 slot promo which was fairly good fun.

reviews.title: You can,t get closer to the avtion
reviews.text: The location of this hotel is perfect.Check in was a breeze.The room is clean roomy well decorated quiet and smells clean.Why pay sky high prices at the resorts when the Casino Royale is outside Ceasers Palace,Mirage,Treasure Island.The staff are pleasant and nothing is to much trouble they all greet you with a smile.The beer is $1 a bottle in the bar.There is a subway and hot dog stall for quick snacks.Denny's & Walgreens is next door.Walk out the front door right onto the strip.The pool is fine and gets good Sun.Could not fault this hotel.

reviews.title: My new hot spot !
reviews.text: We only spent 1 night here, a stop on our way back home from California but wish we stayed another night or 2.  We had such a good time !  We were able to walk the strip and not have to worry about getting into a car to go back to a hotel off the strip like we have always done because the prices of the hotels on the strip are usually outrageous.  This hotel was reasonably priced and the hotel was nice.  The rooms were very clean and the beds were nice and comfy as well.  PLUS, the have a Fat Tuesday's IN the casino !  We will definitely stay at this hotel again...

reviews.title: Great Room for the cost and location
reviews.text: My husband and I stayed at the Best Western Casino Royale the first full week of June as we were attending a conference in LV and it was the first time we stayed at this hotel. In the past we've stayed at the Golden Nugget, Main Street Station, Luxor, and the Venetian. We booked Casino Royale based on reviews and the price. You couldn't ask for a better location on the Strip, no resort fee, free covered parking and close to everything. Our room wasn't huge but it was clean, comfortable and cool. We enjoyed the added bonus of having a small refrigerator and Keurig coffee machine in the room so we were able to have coffee before venturing out. There's a Walgreen's on the property so we were able to buy bottled water and snacks to keep in the fridge. The hotel is between Harrah's and the Venetian with Caesar's and the Mirage directly across the street. The High Roller was a short stroll away as were many other restaurants and bars. For those visiting Vegas on a budget this is a great place to stay.  Although we flew to LV we did notice their was covered parking for hotel guests. We didn't use the pool so I can't comment on that. I would stay here again.

reviews.title: Beyond our expectations!!!
reviews.text: Mr Allen provided us with 5 star customer service..Hotel allowed us to check in earlier than usual..Staffs looks happy to work der..Rooms r fabulous beds r very comfortable..My son satisfied with der fitness center with free bottled water. The Hotel is in the center of all actions

reviews.title: VEGAS or BUST!
reviews.text: This trip was a lifelong bucket list dream for me.  I recently retired from 41 years of teaching.  Being a Vegas fanatic I researched the pros and cons of staying at some of the strip hotels and decided to pass on the fees and over the top lobbies and stayed at this jewel of hotel.  It is centrally located with a family feel.  It's has everything you need to see Vegas first hand.  The connected restaurants, gift shops are all very affordable. We parked our car for free and bought bus passes and tickets adjacent to the hotel.  Will ALWAYS stay here for future trips.  It is truly a wonderful place and I am a Diva when it comes to hotels.  Great price...great location....great "White Castle Dennys and even a Walgreens

reviews.title: Suprising
reviews.text: This was a really suprising room given the price difference and its location to other 'big' chains. It was extremely clean, had all the amenities in the room and had optional daily house keeping. We opted out of this as we were too in and out of our room. It was great that there was a casino right outside our door so we didn't have to fight the huge crowds outside just to walk to one. The staff were super friendly and helped us out when our door cards stopped working (don't put them near your mobile or credit cards as they demagnetise) even though there was a lot of renovating going on it wasn't loud at stupid times and the staff did offer a refund up front if we were not aware of it happening. I would 100% stay here again, it was the comfiest place we stayed in the US!

reviews.title: Early Summer Vacation
reviews.text: Hotel room was clean, bed very comfortable, all amenities in room were very nice.  Bonus that room had wet bar, refrigerator and Keurig Coffee maker and safe.  The parking is a covered structure and their is no additional charge.  this hotel also does not have a resort fee that most others charge.  The location is directly across from Mirage, easy waking distance to everything in town.  The Bar was by far the most inexpensive to drink at if you were not gaming,  $10 for a beer and mixed drink.  All staff encountered were friendly, courteous and attentive.  Only grip was bathroom was a bit cramped, but overall value was fantastic.

reviews.title: Good Location
reviews.text: Good Location. Disappointing entrance reception. Rooms clean. Aircon works perfectly albeit noisy. Beds a little hard, pillows too soft.  Being as you only really sleep in the rooms, its ok for short/mid term break. Not luxurious, but that's probably reflected in the price, although you are paying for the prime location as I wouldn't call it cheap!!

reviews.title: Our Vacation
reviews.text: My husband and I stayed here for four nights. The hotel was right on the strip and quite because they were in the back. Small but very clean and had refrigerator and were near the casino. We will like to stay here again when we came to Vegas. It had Restaurants in It. OutBack Steakhouse,  Denny's and White Castle in the hotel. We really enjoyed every minute there and

reviews.title: THE place to say on The Las Vegas Strip..
reviews.text: Decided to stay here again due to location and due to the lack of ripoff resort fees.  Cab leaves you out in the back of the complex but it is just a short walk to the side door entrance.  Our request for a room next to our friends was honored, checkin took about 10 minutes.  Room was of good size and had a fridge, iron and board, good closet space and good wi-fi and TV.  Service was polite and pleasant.  Everything was great save for the sleaze outside the hotel on Las Vegas Blvd., worse than ever!  This of course NOT the hotels fault.  A good affordable breakfast next door at MacDonalds.

reviews.title: perfect location great price ideal for vegas
reviews.text: Basic hotel for great price no frills but exactly what we wanted.no resort fees which was good.easy check in and out.very helpful staff.rooms cleaned daily.position was great  with bus stop not far from hotel.book this hotel if you dont want frills but clean easy  position hotel. Have fun

reviews.title: Great value
reviews.text: Really convenient location. Close to all the hotel pick up and drop offs for tours. Really close to everything you would want to do and see. My room was quiet no outside noise at all. Well stocked and clean every day. No resort fees was a huge savings.

reviews.title: As noted by many, excellent location and great value.
reviews.text: Stayed two nights, asked for room on first floor away from ice machine with a king bed--and they gave it to me, no problem.  Checkin was easy, although front desk is buried in the casino, and one gal had a hard time understanding that I wanted to check in (but the other desk person was bright and cheery).  As noted by others, no resort fee and free parking!  Good rates with Best Western card, one dollar Michelobs in the casino!  Standard room size, had a refrigerator and Keurig coffee machine, safe, and hair dryer; quite clean.  Pool was small, simple, and quiet, which my wife loved.  Adults can feel comfortable here.  Next door at Harrahs the pool was noisy and so crowded you could have walked across it on people and never touched water.  Our friends stayed at Harrahs, and wished they had stayed here. This small hotel and casino is a gem, and we will definitely visit again.
